a very beautiful and peaceful place managed by a friendly and attentive team. the attention to detail was impressive, all our needs were satisfied. the tourguide max was able to show us most of the big five, furthermore he largely improved our knowledge of the wild animals of botswana. the rooms in the camp are comfortable, you have the option to have the bed moved to the balcony so you can sleep outside and there is a bathtub on there, too. also there is a small but refreshing pool with a bar and an astonishing view. overall it was an unforgettable experience. we will happily return if we have the chance to.
a very beautiful beach that can be reached from "downtown" by hiking from beach to beach.

a very beautiful beach with sharks sometimes, if you're visiting one beach on the island, i would go to this one. the trail requires you to go down two stairs but it isn't that difficult. sometimes there is a bit of a queue.

a very beautiful complex. lots of buildings of different sizes, beautifully decorated, artesian fountains, lots of statues including one of the buddha, huge (the reclining buddha). a must-see in bangkok. you need at least an hour to visit it.
a very beautiful garden. peaceful and calm. good place to relax and take a break. great for a quiet walk and you also get a beautiful view of the city!

a very beautiful lake with a lot of beautiful scenery year around and this picture is the proof. not very known as other larger lakes in northern italy due to its remoteness but still worth a visit if you are in the area. it is shadowed by many other attractions in the area

a very beautiful parc with old trees, perfect for a stroll. unfortunately it is very frustrating that they apply nonsensical rules to the visitors like : foldable furniture to sit down in the grass areas comfortably is not allowed. meaning that older people who cannot sit on the ground are segregated. 🤔

a very beautiful park just a few minutes by train from sapporo station. there is a special train called " lily train " that goes round and round the park. the flowers are so pretty this time of year in early september. no crowds of noisy tourists and a perfect place to unwind.

a very beautiful park which i have visited several times and brought my overseas friends there. on weekends, you can expect many visitors and will have to take turns for a birds eye view at the top at the viewing point. i would recommend visiting there either on the morning or evening on a weekday. you will get to enjoy the serenity and beauty of the nature. it will take about an hour to finish walking the park. highly recommended.

a very beautiful park with both chinese and japanese gardens, and more. you can take a walk, cycle, or run while enjoying the scenic views, or simply relax and have a picnic. there are plenty of rest areas, restrooms, and restaurants available. unfortunately, the lake water was dirty when i visited, but the overall atmosphere is still peaceful and enjoyable.

a very beautiful park with easy trails (there might be a lot of stairs when to walk down & up the pool). highly recommended, family oriented and it’s free as well. just need to pay for parking. could spend a good 2-3 hours there, or 4 hrs in you jump in the pool. beautiful water falls at the suspension bridge as well. it’s closed at 9pm.

a very beautiful park with easy trails (there might be a lot of stairs when to walk down & up the pool). highly recommended, family oriented and it’s free as well. just need to pay for parking. could spend a good 2-3 hours there, or 4 hrs in you jump in the pool. beautiful water falls at the suspension bridge as well. it’s closed at 9pm.

a very beautiful park, both adults and kids can enjoy. there is an amusement park once you walk down. there are plenty of greenery and lovely views. there is a restaurant and small stalls. there are toilets. there are plenty of flies and mosquitos, though, so be prepared.
a very beautiful park-garden next to the koutoubia mosque. beautiful fountains, many palm trees, lime trees, flowers. this place is the calling card of marrakech.

a very beautiful park. incredibly cozy when the cherry blossom season is almost over and there are not many tourists. peace and quiet in every corner. unusually many people jogging in the morning. one of the places that you simply must visit in tokyo for relaxation. a practical recommendation - avoid the close presence of chinese tourist groups. in my case, i had to move to a quieter place in the garden to enjoy the peace and harmony.
a very beautiful place for sitting and resting

a very beautiful place. great people and a fantastic environment. the view is magnificent. however, it's not for the unathletic. we climbed stairs for about 60 minutes, but the view is the most beautiful i've ever seen.
a very beautiful stream with a good walking area and a good rest area for visitors
a very beautiful temple, don't be lazy to go up and inside. an unusually beautiful temple, no tourists, lots of colorful details.

a very beautiful temple. if you’re with a guide, everything will be explained to you. the entrance fee includes a sarong, which is wrapped around you upon entry and returned when leaving the temple. it wasn’t crowded. some areas are only accessible for prayer.
a very beautiful view, highly recommended if we go up by motorcycle. it's not easy, but not impossible. you can do it in less than an hour.

a very beautiful, large temple with a huge number of interesting, unique figures and buildings - mongkol vararam. this is one of the most beautiful and picturesque temples on the island. it is immediately noticeable that it is very well looked after and ennobled - the work of a landscape designer is visible here. in addition to the usual, buddhist temple buildings, this one is distinguished by the fact that on its territory there is a small, organic park with a fountain, which is under the care of a large number of buddha statues, shimmering in the sun with gold. it is definitely worth visiting while on the island! the time for visiting it is from 1 to 2 unforgettable hours: a great mood and good photos. a pleasant, peaceful atmosphere, charged with positive energy, reigns in this place. there are few tourists here and it is very pleasant and comfortable to be in this place! full information with video and easy navigation - in the app 👉 phuketon
a very busy harbour with tourist boats doing tours of local islands, many residents have their own boats. plenty of local restaurants, shops and bars nearby.

a very central small but cute park where you sit and watch people from every type passing by. has a nice garden! a great tip: you can take a shuttle bus to the airport from there every one hour fir 5$ only.

a very clean, neat and well-maintained park full of greenery. leads to koutoubia, surrounded by some very fine variety of fauna and flora. there is even a play area for children and a very good space dedicated to cacti plants.
a very colourful place. the city it self has personality to it, and just walking around felt like i was in a different world! i definitely recommend visiting!

a very comfy small camp in the serengeti. great lodge with a nice view, excellent food and lovely staff. good safari shop to visit as well. our 2 guides (rabin and gwandu) were top! we did 10 stars breakfast in the bush and a cocktail in the wild. unforgettable and a must do. we also saw a lot of beautiful birds!
a very complete and interesting (and cheap) museum about the history of whaling in azores. the entire process of hunting and processing sperm whales is very well detailed on this former factory.

a very cool museum, you could spend an entire day there. unfortunately, they closed at 7pm and we came in late so it was hard for us to see everything. we paid 20€ for two because of reparations at one of the floors/gallery. great value.

a very cozy lodge with very nice sunset view. the owner of the lodge is very friendly and attentive to his guests. he showed us around the property and the roof top sitting area. location is very convenient which is only 5 mins drive from petra visitor center. there are good restaurants nearby. the room and bathroom is very clean. there is a common room where we can play board games and coffee together. i highly recommend this place!

a very cute little park with ups and downs that lacks benches but is beautiful and pleasant to visit when you're in the old city anyway. contains the wishing bridge and some portal like sculpture. gets better if you take a cold valilla drink with you.

a very dangerous experience. do not follow or listen to anyone you do not know. entering the market is very difficult and you will face mazes upon entering. there are some, not all, who do not fear god and will try to lure you and lead you into mazes that have no beginning or end. in the end, you will face criminals. be very careful. if you do not know well who you are referring to or if you have a trusted person with you, do not go alone.

a very dynamic club of driven people! we stayed with 6 people in a beautiful spacious log cabin in pyha. the fact that we flew from 3 countries and therefore also 3 airports to lapland was a challenge for the organization. and with success all transfers were perfectly arranged. during our stay the entire team was always friendly and helpful to us. all activities were well organized. in short, a very nice club to have a relaxing holiday.

a very emotional and powerful museum. it must be said that it’s very well done. (you can only bring your own water inside, no colored drinks.) the only thing that bothered me is that they charge money for this “attraction,” even though we can consider this a cemetery/pilgrimage site…

a very fascinating and unique experience. we were on time for the guided tours.. the guided tours are of limited time only, so if you want the guided tours make sure you get on time.the guide we had was pretty experienced and gave a lot of details about the site. the site was surprisingly huge. it is filled with hot geysers, mud pools, and a lot of other interesting sights. the smell of sulfur fills the air which might not be suitable for all types of audiences. we also got a lot of time to take pictures. the experience also included a maori hand carving session which we really enjoyed . it was a perfect touch of culture to the whole experience. overall the experience was other worldly and very unique.

a very friendly welcome and experience with our hosts. having meals in their kitchen, feeding the animals and helping with ploughing their field to prepare for the planting of potatoes when the rainy season starts was an unusual experience! loved the sail on the lake. beautiful sunset from the small church at the summit of the mountain behind the village.

a very fun activity to do whilst in dubrovnik, staff were very helpful sorting transport to and from your accommodation. would definitely recommend! the hour was definitely worth it, half an hour isn’t enough.
a very fun and friendly place ... i know the owners personally and year after year the atmosphere improves ... i love this place!

a very fun experience up to the pedestal. not too many stairs (190+). the museum inside was very intriguing. we went on a super hot day, and there is absolutely no shade waiting for the ferry back to manhattan in a extremely long line all the way past the flag. and we waited a long time.... but other than that, it was a great day!

a very fun hiking experience! a little scary at night though if you haven't done night hiking in the dark here. there is a fast hiking couple ahead of us that went and rescued a couple of chinese tourists that got lost, and later on we rescued that fast hiking couple since they got lost too.

a very fun local night market with a lively atmosphere. you can enjoy a variety of local food stalls—some accept credit cards, though most do not. people are eating, dancing, and singing, making this small night market vibrant and full of energy. i really enjoyed the experience.

a very good collection. just one detail: the woman who accompanied us was always very vigilant, which made the experience a little uncomfortable. in other museums, these women were very insistent on accompanying us during the visit, turning the lights on and off in the rooms, and they eventually asked us for tips. here, we paid an entrance fee, so we decided to split up and walk in opposite directions to avoid the woman following us and asking for money. at the end, we left very quickly; it was a good method.

a very good experience, all the excursions were fantastic, very good service, the guides were very friendly and professional, the food was excellent, in short, a different and wonderful experience, i recommend it 100%.

a very good moment with mai and his family, he guided us through his garden to show us the vegetables, spices and herbs they are using in traditional cambodian cuisine. the meal itself was exquisite and more than full filling (salad, 2 dishes, dessert). the price is very interesting compared to restaurants in the center, and you can have a way more intimate lesson so the transportation time is definitely worth it !
a very good nature walk, there were very few people and we really enjoyed it. but if you are expecting for an amazing view at the end of this trail then you will be disappointed.
a very good opportunity to care for and contribute to the care of our natural reserves.

a very good place from different sides: this is a beautiful historical area, and numerous restaurants and eateries, and numerous shops and souvenir shops. there is also a kind of flea market here too. a walk along the port itself is especially pleasant and authentic.

a very good place from different sides: this is a beautiful historical area, and numerous restaurants and eateries, and numerous shops and souvenir shops. there is also a kind of flea market here too. a walk along the port itself is especially pleasant and authentic. you can come here many times and still it will be interesting to walk along the streets, stairs, sit in a local restaurant or go to the local flea market.

a very good place to view arenal volcano! entrance is $15 and you have access to the volcanic side and lake side of the park. we got to see a sloth, armadillo ( in the parking lot) , snake. you’ll get a good view on a sunny day. for the lake side of the park, once you exit the volcanic side , take a left turn. after a few meters , you’ll find a dirt road that would continue for 1.7 kms. lake was peaceful.

a very good place to visit when you are in norways. aside from its picturisque sceneries, they have also museum, aquarium and water activities aside from hiking ofcourse. you will never regrets visiting this place. just watch for the weather ofcourse.
a very good place to visit with the kids, many different water slides (good for toddlers and teens) a few different pools, the water temperature is 35° to 42° (not too hot).
a very good swimming pool for swimming. 50m for intermediate and 25m beginners. we paid 700¥ for the entrance, a bath is also included, if you want even a gym.

a very good travel experience. we got to know the faroe islands thoroughly in 7 days with our guide joaquín, who knows the islands and their inhabitants perfectly (we were struck by the fact that in every town we visited, he knew at least one or two people). the trip and the daily excursions were tailored to the group's time and needs. we also highlight his expertise and knowledge of all the food and accommodation options, allowing him to recommend and ensure a perfect trip. amazing!

a very iconic spot of vsj. it was not too crowded on a weekday afternoon, and the lighting was amazing. there are many photogenic spots in old san juan, but i would strongly recommend this one. no bars or restaurants within 100 feet or so, and you’ll be able to take bunch of pictures without too much hassle.

a very important place to learn about and understand the extent of what happened here in the 90s. the building itself, riddled with signs of shell and bullet impacts, stands as a monument to the courage and tenacity of its defenders. and interesting how something built by napoleonic troops wouldn't face its true battle until the 1990s.

a very impressive temple and palace. they have some exhibitions and the entrance to the main hall and the side hall are free. as in all temples respect to the others and taking out your shoes is a must. it is very nice to visit if and close to the main station and kyoto tower.

a very informative and interesting museum. the exhibitions cover history, geology, flora, and fauna – all very well presented. interactive elements make the experience even more enjoyable. definitely worth a visit while in tórshavn.

a very interesting & entertaining walking tour led by lana. she is an amazing tour guide and we thoroughly enjoyed the experience. this old town & jewish quarter tour is along a flat path and has no inclines, just a few steps. we stopped halfway through for a comfort break which was well received. would thoroughly recommend. thanks lana 👏🏼👌🏼

a very interesting intersection that separates the medina from the main mosque of marrakech. here you can safely wait for the light to turn green and go in the direction you want. the cannon that is placed adds more color to the island itself.

a very interesting look inside the history of the netherlands. i visited the colonial/slavery part of the museum which had some pretty interesting information about this past. many things were well kept and there was even a little game to be played about which spices or materials came from which part of the world. in the beginning there was also a brief part about the history of the museum itself which was very helpful in understanding the context.

a very interesting museum for those visiting these places on holiday to understand the local culture and its origins through a journey that blends the ancient and the modern. a thorough visit, including viewing videos, takes about two hours. the admission price is modest (7 euros for adults), and admission is free with a val di fassa guest card. i personally visited on a rainy afternoon, but for anyone spending their holidays in these parts, i wouldn't miss it.

a very interesting museum with permanent exhibitions that discuss multiple topics related to the dutch colonial past. most, if not all panels are writing in dutch, english, and include a qr code for sign language translations as well. there are also several and quite interesting videos, which contribute to accessibility and interaction, but can also make the museum feel a bit noisy.

a very interesting place to visit with a good and fascinating history. the tourist information centre is very good location nearby to get info about the history. the open souvenir market from the main gate to the shrine was also interesting, but a bit too commercialized, and it gets very crowded. so, go there earlier in the day to avoid the crowd.

a very large market, where you can find pretty much everything you can imagine, including snakes, frogs, insects and worms. a spectacle for a european tourist, although the hygiene rules we are used to are not really respected.

a very significant historical structure, whispering of a bygone roman dominance over egypt. the fortress was built in 300 ad by emperor diocletian in order to protect the entrance to an ancient canal, previously rebuilt by trajan, that linked the nile with the red sea. it was at the boundary between lower and middle egypt, where the river craft paid tolls when ascending or descending the nile. according to the 7th-century writer john of nikiu, the name "babylon" was given by nebuchadnezzar ii, who conquered or campaigned in the area in 568 bc. he named it after his own home city. john also reported that the fortress was first founded by nebuchadnezzar. during the arab conquest of egypt the byzantine fortress held out for about seven months before finally falling in december 640 to the arab general 'amr ibn al-'as.

a visit to dubrovnik’s old town is an unforgettable experience. surrounded by impressive, massive stone walls that have been wonderfully preserved, the city captivates with its historical charm and unique atmosphere. a walk along the walls offers breathtaking views of red terracotta roofs, narrow, winding alleys, and of course, the mesmerizing turquoise-blue adriatic sea. the main street, stradun (plaka), is bustling and always full of tourists and locals alike. along it are souvenir shops, restaurants, and cafes, and it leads to key sites such as the impressive onofrio’s fountain and the magnificent rector’s palace. every corner of the city tells a story, from ancient churches to peaceful monasteries. although the old town is packed with tourists, especially in high season, you can still find quiet and charming corners in the side alleys. the mediterranean atmosphere, along with the rich history and impressive architecture, make dubrovnik a must-see destination for anyone looking for a combination of culture, scenery, and beauty.

a visit to les jardins majorelle is a must when in marrakech. it’s one of the city’s most famous and popular attractions — and for good reason. the gardens are absolutely stunning, filled with towering cacti, vibrant flowers, lush greenery, and those iconic pops of deep majorelle blue and bright yellow that make the entire place feel like a living work of art. important tip: you’ll need to book your tickets online well in advance. even with online tickets, you still have to queue to enter, but having them secures your access. we arrived in marrakech on a sunday and could only book tickets for the end of the week, so ideally, buy your tickets three to four days ahead of your visit — or even before you travel. once inside, everything is impeccably maintained. the paths are clearly marked, staff members are stationed throughout and ready to assist, and the whole garden feels serene despite the number of visitors. there’s a charming café on site where you can relax with a drink or a light bite, and i was impressed by how clean and accessible the restrooms were — a small but very appreciated detail, especially since the garden itself isn’t enormous. from the exotic plants to the calming fountains and colorful architecture, everything looks like it’s been freshly taken care of. it’s a peaceful, visually captivating space that’s a pleasure to explore. in short: if you’re visiting marrakech, don’t miss jardin majorelle. it’s as beautiful in person as it looks in the photos — maybe even better.

a visit to yasaka shrine in the early morning set a peaceful tone before the gion matsuri began. the shrine, a key part of the festival’s spiritual roots, offered a serene atmosphere with its bright vermilion gates and lanterns, providing a glimpse into the rich traditions behind the event. by 9 am, the streets near shijo-dori and karasuma-dori filled with the lively energy of the gion matsuri. the yamaboko floats, towering and intricately designed, began their procession through the city. each float, a work of art, reflected the craftsmanship and history of the local communities. food stalls offering festival favorites, along with locals in yukata, added to the authentic festival experience. the festival’s spirit was felt throughout the day, and the yoiyama evenings leading up to the main parade were equally enchanting with illuminated floats and traditional music. with its perfect blend of history, culture, and celebration, gion matsuri is definitely one of the must-do events in kyoto, offering an unforgettable experience for anyone visiting the city in july.

a worthy side-trip along the way with a moment of solitude is the ancient lion triclinium. diverting 10 minutes off the beaten track through a challenging hike in a canyon brings you to this sandstone chamber, which once held amazingly intricate sculpture, but many of the details have been lost to the ages. gaze out the doorway at the desert. listen to the wind whistling through the canyon. the triclinium is an ideal perch for quiet and peaceful contemplation away from selfie sticks before continuing the ascent to the monastery. this evocative eddy tames the tourist tide for memorable isolation.

aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhh! thats all 😭 absolutely terrifying but absolutely brilliant and sooo freaking pumped after i did the k bridge bungee yesterday with my friend who i couldn’t have done it without. the people on the bridge and in the shop really helped calm my nerves especially walking up on the bridge taking my weight i was sooooo nervous. then the lovely dear lady who’s name escapes me who i gave a hug after, told me what i will feel, how i will fall, and the rush of excitement and joy i’d feel after, then she said to get behind the rail and take a seat. another commitment, was visibly shaking when i sat down to get my ankle straps and the guides helped so much letting me know how to make myself do it etc, they calmed me down, hooked me up, got me to the edge and said don’t look down just keep your eyes up or else it will look twice as high, he kept me on the edge, said take deep breaths, you’re scared now but you have to just tell yourself you’re gonna do it on 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, and you’re gonna go on one. i let go of the bridge, looked at both cameras, kept my arms out breathed deep, closed my eyes, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. i went….. and my god that drop wasn’t what i expected at all. something that can’t be explained. it’s not like a rollercoaster at all i promise you you will not feel a horrible in your stomach butterfly feeling. you feel nothing then after 4 seconds you feel the pull of the bungee and i opened my eyes then to a whoosh of verbal tyrants of positivity and self love and pride. i tell you right now it’s one of the coolest feelings to know you’re done something so scary.. will know what to feel next time and it will be just as terrifying. thank you so much to everyone involved who helped my experience and calmed me down and made me jump. ps the guide counted me down on the drop of the beat. no wonder i jumped.

aapravasi ghat is seriously something else. it is like stepping back in time to this place where so many people, about half a million, first arrived as indentured laborers. it is fascinating to think that this one spot in mauritius was the first for the british, and that it totally changed the country. even though you only see parts of the old buildings, you can just feel the history there. if you are in mauritius, you absolutely have to go there.

absolutely amazing and something i’ve never seen before! the pictures don’t do it justice. round trip took us 2.5 hours, but we stopped a lot to take pictures along the way. there are plenty of pictures and signs to guide you along the way, so you won’t get lost, and the trail is very obvious. the hike to the upper falls was definitely moderate with lots of ups and downs, stairs, and flat stretches of walkways. we had snow boots on, and still slipped a couple times. so take your time on the steep parts, avoid the slippery black rocks, and stick to where the snow is thicker. snow cleats aren’t necessary, but are nice to have if you can. if you’re scared of heights, this is not the trail for you.

absolutely amazing day at waterbom bali! we spent an unforgettable day at waterbom bali with our family and close friends, and it was beyond expectations! even though i’ve been coming to bali for over 20 years, it was my very first time visiting this legendary water park — and what a surprise! the occasion was the birthday of our lovely friend jazzy jasmine, and it turned out to be the perfect excuse to finally explore the park. from the very beginning, we were blown away by the warm, welcoming staff — always smiling, always helpful. every time we came down a slide, there was someone at the bottom ready to greet us with a big smile. the water slides are fantastic — both fun and thrilling. the park is incredibly clean and well-maintained, with zones for smokers, non-smokers, kids, and even chill areas for those who just want to relax. the kids’ zone is amazing — our child didn’t want to leave the pool all day. we had a delicious lunch — the food was surprisingly good for a theme park. lockers were clean and secure, restrooms and showers spotless. the staff went above and beyond to help and guide us. as a cherry on top, our day package included a foot massage — and it was heavenly. we nearly fell asleep from the relaxation! this place is a must-visit if you’re in bali, especially if you have kids. waterbom bali is truly one of those places that makes your trip special. highly recommended!

absolutely amazing experience from start to finish! they picked us up right from the airport, and everything felt super safe and organized. the atv ride through the jungle was thrilling, the zip-lining was a blast, and the cenote swim was beyond beautiful. the guides were so friendly and made sure we were comfortable the whole time. one of the best adventures we’ve had in tulum - highly recommend! sabino is the best tour guide and he made sure we got all our photos and videos during the tour!

absolutely amazing experience from the beginning to the end. i enjoyed every part of the trip. our guides were incredibly knowledgeable and taught us so much about the canyon and history of exploration of the canyon. they cooked amazing food and it was nutritious and filling. we felt safe the entire time. our guides took us on some great adventures and hikes to see waterfalls and fossils and other fun landmarks. i highly recommend hatch expeditions.

absolutely amazing experience with islakite surfing! i had the most incredible time doing kite surfing with islakite in boracay! the instructors were professional, patient, and extremely knowledgeable. they tailored the lessons to my skill level and made sure i felt confident and safe on the water. the equipment was top-notch, and the location was perfect – the beautiful turquoise waters of boracay made the experience even more magical. whether you're a beginner or an experienced kiter, this is the place to go! kudos to the team’s passion for the sport and their friendly approach made it such a memorable adventure. i can't recommend islakite surfing enough – it’s a must-try if you're visiting boracay. thank you for an unforgettable experience!
absolutely amazing experience with paula. very thorough and super relaxing. one of the best thai massages i’ve had. beautiful fresh ginger tea to finish. can’t recommend highly enough. thank you!

absolutely amazing experience! the highlight was definitely the awesome guide—a punjabi guy with a great sense of humor who made the entire session super engaging. he cracked jokes, but more importantly, delivered a solid crash course on elephant biology—explaining the difference between african vs asian elephants, males vs females, and so on. somehow, he made a biology lesson fun, and it really elevated the whole experience of feeding, touching, and interacting with the elephants. we got unlimited feed to give to the elephants, and everything was well-organized and respectful to the animals. the english-speaking female guide was also wonderful—she answered all our questions patiently, especially about the grandma elephant and how the sanctuary operates. at the end, they even showed us how they make paper from elephant dung—surprisingly fascinating! highly recommended if you’re looking for an ethical and memorable elephant experience in phuket.

absolutely amazing experience! the lapland husky safari is a must-do adventure. the dogs are full of energy and clearly love what they do, and the ride through the snowy wilderness is breathtaking. the guides are friendly, knowledgeable, and make sure everyone feels safe and comfortable. the huskies are well cared for, and you can see the bond between them and their handlers. this was the highlight of my trip—100% recommend it to anyone looking for an unforgettable arctic adventure!

absolutely amazing experience! this was the best thing we did in alaska. we really enjoyed it. we mushed the dogs on a wheeled "sled" through an off-road trail. we learned a lot about the sport of dog sledding. most importantly, my kids loved playing with the puppies. every single staff member we met was amazing, knowledgeable, and loved what they do.

absolutely amazing experience! we flew over and into the canyon at sunset, it was beautiful. our pilot, mitch, had only started working at this company at the beginning of the year but he did a great job! very knowledgeable of the area and made sure everyone was comfortable throughout the entire experience. thank you to mitch and the rest of the crew at papillon helicopters! 🚁 ☺️

absolutely amazing experience! we went to vienna for our honeymoon and this was one of the top highlights! natasha our guide was simply excellent. she was so enthusiastic about what she was showing us! she was honestly the best we can't say enough good things!

absolutely amazing experience! 🌊🐬🐢 we had such an unforgettable time on the iruka dolphin and snorkel tour. from start to finish, everything went so smoothly, and the entire experience was filled with fun, excitement, and stunning marine life. a huge shoutout to the incredible crew: gaylin, drew, ella, and kiya. you all were absolutely amazing. so friendly, welcoming, and fun to chat with. your energy made the tour even more enjoyable, and you could really tell you love what you do. we were lucky enough to see dolphins up close, snorkel alongside sea turtles, and enjoy the slide off the boat, which was a blast. it was such a well-organized, memorable adventure and we’d recommend it to anyone looking to experience the beauty of hawaii from the water. thank you, iruka team, for an incredible day. we’ll definitely be back!

absolutely amazing experience!! we loved every minute of this winter tour and teresa was a truly energetic, experienced, skilled and professional guide. she briefed us first with all the techniques and safety measures needed for enjoying this tour. so glad we stayed an extra day just for this tour and it was damn worth it!! the fjord itself was breathtakingly beautiful with mountains all around full of snow. i highly recommend this tour to everyone!

absolutely amazing experience!!! great, professional, safety oriented staff with detailed dive brief, inwater supervision and in boat assistance. good equipment, vessel and interval stop. saw whales, dolphins and dugong to and from dive site. saw sharks, turtles and an amazing variety of exceptionally large fish, nudibanch, octopus etc. highly recommend odyssea!!! thank you for an incredible dive day!!!

absolutely amazing experience!!! my skin feels divine now lol. off the beaten path but beautiful and the ladies are great at what they do. and so sweet! 15/10

absolutely amazing experience, would go back in a heart beat. the whole park experience is seamless, very safe and all staff is super friendly and helpful at all times. food and drinks are also incredible and worth the upgrade. if you can do the dolphin experience i highly recommend it is a once in a lifetime thing.

absolutely amazing experience. my family of two parents and two teenage daughters had a blast. our guide jordan was especially great and the rest of the team worked together seamlessly. from getting you into your wetsuit, on the raft, down the river and back ashore everything was top notch. highly recommend this if you are looking for something a little more adventurous on your trip but not too over the top. as an added bonus they took some pretty great photos for us during the trip that you could purchase at the end of the trip.

absolutely amazing guys that can't do enough for you. i have gone on many trips with them over the years and they have always delivered 5* service even in the worst of weather's. if you ask for something they will always try and accommodate. make sure to give a tip in the jar as they really do deserve it.

absolutely amazing historical landmark. definetly a must visit place in rome. the castle is unique, firstly built as emperor's mausoleum, later became a military fortress, was used as a prison by the papal state, and now is a museum that holds a great art collection, many paths to explore, and a cafe were you can have a drink. at the top of the castle it is the best view of the rome city.

absolutely amazing park. parking was easy to pay via your phone. seemed to be plenty of parking. the boys loved bouldering around the shore. can’t get super close to the lighthouse unless you ignore the sign like my young kids did. we didn’t get in trouble (seemed to be no one around), but just a warning for the parents out there the fence doesn’t continue on the east side of the lighthouse so it allows you to climb right onto the restricted area. anyway, don’t think my boys are wanted in canada and it is a wonderful park with great views.

absolutely amazing safari tour! sadan was incredible! so friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. unlike other tours we saw that felt impersonal, this experience made us feel like we were the only ones on the desert safari. could not recommend it enough make sure to ask for sadan!
absolutely amazing show! they were brilliant on the first day, can't believe how well they made it work following all regulations and still making it feel immersive. great job guys, don't give up!
absolutely amazing store!! the lady was very welcoming and she had a super great collection, 10/10 would recommend checking this place out if you are in vintage/thrifting 👕

absolutely amazing time!! spent the day here, tons of great activities. really enjoyed the zip lines, horseback riding, and buggies. swim in the cave was a huge highlight. shout out to our guides cappuccino and sexy pineapple, you both made the day wonderful and entertaining. gracias

absolutely amazing tour experience. from somehow avoiding the mass tour boats at all the spots to the best meal we’ve had in el nido, these guys are the real deal, they may even serenade you with some tunes while you cruise from island to island, could not recommend more!!

absolutely amazing way to see the salt flats. bikes are very suitable for the terrain and well maintained/safe. robin is a passionate and knowledgeable guide. i also did a second day tour to the mountains with a visit to hot springs with lunch which was also incredible. should you have a problem with your own bike he is a good mechanic with a well set up workshop.
absolutely amazing! highly recommend! multiple different temperatures in all the pools!

absolutely amazing! i was in a lot of pain my shoulders and back riddled with tension and huge knots. a big huge relief made from the thai massage i received. the room was warm and smelt divine. owner was patient and very caring and knew the assignment. i received more than what i paid for and walked out of the parlour feeling extremely great with less tension in my body. can’t wait to holiday in rotorua in the future. i will definitely book in again.

absolutely amazing! the dinner cruise in the historic nile river was the best. the food was delicious and they have big servings. the staff were very friendly and accommodating. the live band was wonderful and made the whole trip enjoyable. i am glad i booked this as part of my cairo trip. thank you!

absolutely amazing! the lion king was a breathtaking performance from start to finish. stunning costumes, powerful singing, and incredible staging brought the story to life in the most magical way. the atmosphere in the lyceum theatre made it even more special. a must-see for all ages!

absolutely amazing! the story was wonderful and the performances were fantastic. all of my kids ages 12, 7 and 3 were completely engrossed. i’ve never seen anything keep the attention of all 3 of them without a single lapse before. i was also very entertained. wished we lived closer than 6 hours away so we could visit more often. totally worth the little splurge. the food and drinks were also very good.
absolutely amazing!! so much fun and some spectacular views. jacob and jordy were very lovely and made it a great experience. will definitely be recommending it to friends and family!!
absolutely amazing!!!! not only will you learn more about the natchez steamboat but the amazing history of how nola came to be!!! i would definitely recommend this tour with the lunch included!

absolutely amazing, david our diving instructor was understanding and made us feel safe the entire trip! the employees were so kind and funny, im so glad we went with these guys!! the original trip (dif company) 2 days prior had boat troubles, and had turn around, we didnt even make it to the reef :(. luckily we were able to rebook with reef experience and im so glad ❤️❤️ had an unforgettable trip.

absolutely amazing, i stayed the whole afternoon in there :d i’m a museum person, so i would say that i have seen my share of them but this one was really nice and sticked out to me because of its cool fake interiors (60er café, old school, chappell, bunker, etc.) and bunch of interactive things (sit on a wooden horse, put an armour on, making flour, etc. ). information wise there was a lot, i think i left the museum smarter 😂 the ticket man was also very kind, same as the rest of the staff and it was completely for free for me as a student !

absolutely amazing, kevin anna spoke perfect english and understood about food allergies as there was also a cooking class were we made pad thai. elephants were the star of the show camp was clean and well organised we fed them fruit and rice balls which were a combo of veg and beans then off to have a mud bath with them and then a shower off spent half day which was just right, definitely worth every penny and we left a tip too how could you not given the fabulous experience we had.

absolutely amazing, my son and i had so much fun and the restaurant was great, even though i didn't realise from web research that it was a buffet! the buffet was top notch, restaurant quality food. we bought extra luge tickets we enjoyed it so much, and they allowed us to come back to complete our adventure pass activities after the weather stopped us doing the skyswing and skyline, but we had great fun luge-ing all day in the rain! luge'd again when it was dry and it was still fun but we were used to drifting around the corners in the rain and going faster, so don't let bad weather put you off! we're returning again in 3 weeks! absolutely an amazing trip that was well organized and had fantastic guides. so glad we took the 14 day trip and that they had a paddle raft plus a dory to try. both the paddle raft and the dory were fun especially in the rapids! food was phenomenal, all sleeping and dry gear was included which made packing simple. our guides had a morning talk/ check in and after dinner check to see what we liked. there are so many side trips and camps to see they tailored the trip to our group, adjusting based on our feedback. will definitely go again and even take a longer trip!

absolutely awesome experience! we did the river surfing trip - exceptionally guided, really well organised, and some excellent boarding. appreciated the time to practice skills in the water before heading down stream. the rapid sections were exhilarating and the flat river sections wonderfully peaceful. big thanks to sam, harrison, colewin, ruth and the team for a great day out!

absolutely awesome. great for the whole family. we could have spent all day here. so much to see from the different levels of the aquarium to the planetarium to the dinosaurs. such a cool place and we can't wait to go back. highly recommended

absolutely awful from start to finish. came here on holiday and honestly wish i hadn’t bothered. the place was filthy and completely unhygienic — it felt more like a rundown back room than a spa. the massage was hands down the worst i’ve ever had, completely pointless and left me feeling worse than when i walked in. the woman on reception was incredibly rude and patronising, zero customer service skills whatsoever. to make things worse, the air conditioning didn’t even work. instead, there was a cheap old fan just blowing hot air around the room, making the whole experience unbearable. when the fan inevitably started making a rattling noise, the same rude woman barged in and actually accused me of breaking it — absolutely laughable. this was the final straw. i wouldn’t go back here if you paid me. total waste of time and money. avoid this place at all costs.

absolutely beautiful beach. the sand is super fine and soft. the water is translucent, refreshing. and beautiful to look at. if you can get there early before the crowds and boats show up you'll enjoy some very serene moments and have the water and beach all to yourself. once the crowds roll in you'll still have a great time, but it's not quite the same when it's just you and the ocean. we've visited dozens of beaches in south america and playa norte is among the best and most beautiful in our opinion. make time to stop by and spend at teast part of your day here.
absolutely beautiful country and people. heartwarming hospitality. special mention to sagua for being a most wonderful guide/companion throughout the trip.
absolutely beautiful garden during spring and summer!
absolutely beautiful going on a game drive as well as driving in the park in your vehicle. we got to see the big 5 on the same day. follow the map and you won't go wrong.

absolutely beautiful hike, not too challenging in terms of elevation. we hiked it from machico to porta da cruz and was about 12.5km one way. we got the bus back from porta da cruz bus stop to machico which was only 2 euro and the bus ride itself was very scenic. the hike has an array of scenery, a levada walk on the machico side passing beside quaint house and farms, then turning into forest before reaching the glorious cliffs themselves and then the scenic descent into porta da cruz. it also was one of the quietest hikes we did on the island (didn’t run into that many people) truly underrated, it stands out as one of our favourites!
absolutely beautiful lagood to kayak through and take in the incredble landscape and geology. snorkelling / swimming not reccomended due to jellyfish.
absolutely beautiful one of a kind place on earth! sunset or sunrise...gorgeous.

absolutely beautiful park around the esplanade area downtown. close to the st. lawrence market, right beside the flat iron building. there are lots of great restaurants and bars to explore all around it. tables and chairs provided underneath a canopy of beautiful trees. also, other areas of seating provided as well. the water fountain is stunning! it's definitely a park worth checking out day or night to sit back and relax with family and / or friends. it's a real gem in the heart of wonderful toronto.

absolutely beautiful park to go to especially between march and april. only costs ¥500 for adult tickets and one can easily spend 2-4 hours going through all the areas. food options are a bit sparse and pricey, but you can bring in items and have a picnic like many others do. sometimes you will see cosplay events and other special occasions people bring. would highly recommend to come early to beat the crowd as it will get very busy.

absolutely beautiful performance. it was breathtaking, and so cool to see such old instruments in use. yes, the pew backs are uncomfortable, but there is a seat cushion, and you don’t even notice the seat once the music starts. we arrived 35 mins early and sat in the front row, the church wasn’t crowded at all. absolutely beautiful rooftop spa! it was a hidden gem, and love the idea that you can buy multiple passes to reduce the cost and visit more often! we went on señorita tuesday, loved the vibes and the music and that it was 5$ off!

absolutely beautiful spot to take a walk with your pet, spend some time just reading or enjoying the beauty of all the flowers and little birdhouses. i love taking my dog axel, we always make new friends with others. wonderful place to take photographs or just to relax. absolutely beautiful little park in the middle of midtown.

absolutely beautiful spot ❤️. do take your time and take in the breath taking freshness and nature. there's some wandering wild life that will come up to you, if you let them. when you reach the falls, sit back and relax. the surroundings are absolutely beautiful. two thumbs up 👍👍 absolutely take your time 😉 there's no rush.

absolutely beautiful temple! make sure to have a local guide or someone who understands the religion so they can explain what everything means. absolutely stunning temple. make sure to have a seat in the temple to take a moment to admire the surroundings, and the sounds. most of the stones are renovated, but there are original stones from when the temple was built (according to our guide, this temple was built around 1,000 years ago).

absolutely beautiful trip with a great crew, amazing views, and fantastic food. everything is well coordinated and tailored to the individual guest. the views and water are some of the best we’ve ever witnessed.

absolutely beautiful venue! set inside a converted church, the atmosphere is truly unique. it does get very crowded, though, and finding a seat can be a challenge—especially during peak hours. i love coming here in the winter since it’s warm inside, though the basement is noticeably colder (but much quieter). they also have a rooftop area with limited seating, which is a nice bonus. food prices are on the higher side, but the drinks are delicious and worth a try.

absolutely beautiful! nature is gorgeous in this easy hiking path. the easiest way to get here is to drive to the parking lot near the old cathedral at the lake called capela de nossa senhora das vitórias. entry costs 4 euro per person (cash only). the gate closes at 16:30 and you have to be out at 18:00. back and forth took us about one hour including a short break at the waterfall to take pictures.

absolutely beautiful! our tour guides taught us about many of the trees, plants, animals, and history of the rainforest. we did not take the waterfall hike, but rather, an easy walk which led us to a pool of water. very refreshing to dip our feet in, swimming allowed.

absolutely beautiful, peaceful and serene. long trails, lots of options and detours to explore. there are some small waterfalls and streams along the way. you can take your dogs, there aware public toilets and there is parking at the base.
absolutely beautiful. plus, the vortex is quite strong here. considering you basically have to scale the rocks to reach some of the paths, be sure to bring comfortable hiking shoes.

absolutely beautiful. so many places to park for the various portions of the park. i went on a sunday afternoon and it wasn't too crowded. there are gorgeous running/bike/hike paths with amazing overlooks of the bridge, water and the city. so pretty

absolutely beautiful. stunning. would do it all over again. i booked the tour with the bus on the website of the vatikan museums (im not sure you can walk there because i didn’t see any people there). would do it all over again.
absolutely beautiful. the historical significance and the stunning architecture make it a must-see. it’s a peaceful spot to reflect on the past and admire the surroundings. truly a remarkable place!

absolutely beautiful. we visited in -8° and there was snow on the ground. care must be taken on the rocky paths as some parts slippy and can imagine it being quite slippery when wet also. steep drop from view point but it is breath taking! we also couldn't resist going for a quick swim even with the low temperature. i can't wait to return in the summer months for a proper swim. small car park but it wasn't too busy at the time of our visit.

absolutely best place for everything. want luxury; got you. want electronics; got you. want clothing shoes outdoor stuff everything is either in this giant set of buildings or right around it. oh and amazing food!

absolutely best place to start a sup or kayak adventure. ideally located in a part of the inlet that is full of marine life it’s also protected so that only a strong wind would prevent getting out. took the whole family - they have sups and rec kayaks for younger/newer people and awesome fibreglass kayaks for adventures further afield. can’t be beat - good prices and excellent and knowledgeable staff.

absolutely breath taking views. we didn’t pay to walk the trail..didn’t seem worth it to me because the main statue i wanted to see are outside the park and there were gorgeous views outside the park as well! where you can over look the edge. the only reason i didn’t give the park 5 stars is you have to pay to use the restroom which was only 10 pesos (which is nothing) but i thought that was very ignorant to charge people to use the restroom. but i get it if you don’t pay to walk the park you will pay to use the restroom.
absolutely breath taking, you have to visit if possible, stunning views, may have to take a metro card for the tramway, but if your driving, just keep in mind there isn't a lot of parking spots.

absolutely breathtaking! a must-see spring experience visiting high park during cherry blossom season was nothing short of magical! the sea of delicate pink and white blooms creates a dreamy, almost surreal atmosphere. whether you're strolling beneath the sakura trees, having a picnic, or capturing photos, every moment feels special. the park does an excellent job managing crowds while keeping the experience enjoyable. early mornings or weekdays are ideal for a quieter visit, but even with people around, the beauty of the blossoms shines through. pro tip: check peak bloom updates online to time your visit perfectly. don’t forget to explore the rest of high park too—the trails, ponds, and wildlife make it a perfect day out. (only visit during weekdays or early mornings otherwise you’ll find more people than the blossoms!!) a true toronto gem that brings joy every spring! 🌸 highly recommend!

absolutely breathtaking! if you visit paris and don't experience the eiffel tower from the palais de chaillot, your trip is simply incomplete. this isn't just a viewpoint; it's the heart of the parisian experience itself. the ambience is pure magic – the gentle hum of the city, the enchanting lights, the perfect platform for soaking it all in. it's more than a view; it's the main event, a symphony for your senses that you'll cherish forever.

absolutely breathtaking! the quad tour in marrakech was an adventure like no other. the stunning landscapes, vibrant colors, and warm hospitality made it an unforgettable experience. highly recommended for anyone seeking an adrenaline-filled journey through morocco's beauty!

absolutely breathtaking! the skypark observation deck offers one of the most spectacular panoramic views in all of singapore. from the top, you get an unbeatable look at the city skyline, gardens by the bay, and the sparkling marina bay — it truly feels like you’re floating above the city. as a guest at the marina bay sands hotel, i was able to enjoy this incredible experience without having to pay for admission, which made it even better! it’s definitely a perk worth taking advantage of if you're staying at the hotel. whether you're visiting during the day or catching the sunset over the skyline, it’s an unforgettable sight. highly recommend making time for it — camera essential!

absolutely breathtaking! visiting angkor wat was an unforgettable experience. the architecture, history, and atmosphere are simply awe-inspiring. every corner of the temple complex tells a story, and walking through it felt like stepping into another world. i’m truly grateful i had the chance to explore this incredible place. highly recommended to anyone who loves culture, history, and stunning views!

absolutely breathtaking! walking the ancient walls of dubrovnik is the highlight of any visit to the city and a true must-do. the views from above are simply spectacular—you can see the brilliant red rooftops of the old town, the shimmering adriatic sea, and lush hills in every direction. the walls are steeped in history, and as you stroll along their two-kilometer length, you feel the centuries come alive around you. the experience is organised, with spots to pause for drinks and plenty of photo opportunities. yes, the ticket price is high, but the memories and perspectives you gain are genuinely priceless. after all the money goes towards restoration works to the town. go early in the morning or later in the evening for a quieter, cooler walk. worth it and —unmissable!

absolutely breathtaking! 🌊 the cape of good hope is a must-visit — stunning ocean views, dramatic cliffs, and the fresh sea breeze make it unforgettable. the scenery feels like something out of a postcard, even on a cloudy day. highly recommend bringing a camera and just soaking in the natural beauty!

absolutely breathtaking. full stop. the old town square is the heart of prague — surrounded by stunning gothic, baroque, and renaissance architecture that makes your jaw drop every time you look up. between the astronomical clock, týn church, and those pastel-perfect buildings, it’s like walking into a renaissance painting. now let me be clear: it’s busy. i’m not exaggerating when i say thousands of people pack into that square during peak hours. tour groups, buskers, horse carriages, influencers filming tiktoks while nearly getting trampled — it’s organised chaos in the prettiest setting imaginable. despite the crowds? still a solid 5/5. it’s magical. day or night. and somehow, even while shoulder-to-shoulder with half the population of europe, it still feels worth it.

absolutely breathtaking. kruger is nature at its most raw and beautiful. we saw elephants crossing the road, lions walking on the road, and even a leopard in the distance all in one day. the park is massive, so plan ahead. the rest camps were clean, staff helpful, and the roads well-maintained (even the gravel ones). a must-visit for anyone who loves wildlife.

absolutely breathtaking. this place was massive, the gardens and flowers were very well-kept, so so beautiful!! the restrooms were clean, parking was cheap, and don’t forget to bring a camera! one thing i will mention though is the amount of birthday and weddings photos people were taking there. we couldn’t enjoy the camellia house because it was unfortunately rented out for a birthday photo shoot, which by all means please take great bday pictures but it was just a tad bit disappointing.

absolutely breathtaking. when i think gobi desert, i've always thought of the vast sand dunes. now that i've visited khongor, i'm in awe. i didn't visit the extremely tall dunes because it was late in the day. so we went to something of "middle" height. it was still a good height and somewhat of a strenuous hike. we experienced a slight rain, then heavy winds at the top of the dunes followed by a dramatic sunset. be prepared for heavy winds and blinding sand blasting. if you wear contacts. be careful.

absolutely brilliant day out! best snorkelling experience ever. gorgeous fish, coral & the most majestic sea turtle up close & personal. look for the pro photographer under the water - we purchased some of the amazing pics she took of us. glass bottom boat was amazing, kids loved the waterside. buffet lunch was excellent. cant fault anything, a real highlight of our trip to cairns. thank you so much.

absolutely brilliant experience and fantastic guide in sameer who was warm, welcoming and entertaining. he was with us the whole day, and gave us a fantastic jeep thrill ride on the sand dunes, and looked after us when we booked an extra quad bike experience and through our day to make sure we weren’t overcharged. the open quad bike ride was really good fun and safely helmets are provided. the meal and entertainment at the bedouin camp whilst not authentic was good value for money with plenty of tasty dishes served buffet style. don’t pay extra for the non self service area as the food is the same. entertainment was good. only criticism is the poor choice of soft drinks and attitude of some of the staff, very abrupt. definitely recommend this tour and thank you sameer. your company and expert driving made the day a really memorable experience 😊

absolutely brilliant. the cast is fantastic. really have time for you and make it feel like you are the only one in the room. definitely a must see and experience. i cannot praise it enough. made the children feel welcome 🤗 thank you for a lovely evening.
absolutely brilliant. well thought out exhibits. reasonable prices. the interactive stuff is great for kids. the room that holds the stanley cup is beautiful. every hockey fans dream.
absolutely clean and contact-friendly and cuddly horses!

absolutely delighted with our stay at this luxury lodge in kenya! the amazing staff went above and beyond to accommodate us, even with our unusual schedule, always ensuring we were well taken care of. the food was a highlight; the beef tartare was surprisingly fresh and delicious, and the breakfast spread offered an impressive variety of options to start the day right. our room was exceptionally comfortable and spacious, providing a perfect retreat after our adventures. a special thanks to manager moray, whose exceptional hospitality made our stay truly memorable. we will definitely be returning!
absolutely enjoyable. the artist dung in the studio. he had a great collection of lacquer artwork. so inspiring. the incense village is suitable for making pictures

absolutely enjoyed being at la finesse spa in fes! just moved here from the states and was trying to find a local spa to go to whenever and for whatever. this spa did not disappoint! everyone was so welcoming and sweet. the place was clean and organized. no issues at all! thank you la finesse!! i cannot wait to come back again and try out your other services :)

absolutely epic day on the great barrier reef aboard ocean spirit!! beautiful boat, very spacious and stunning reef. loved being able to go onto the cay and check out all the birds too. matt, nico and scotty put in the extra and made our day on the way home ;)

absolutely exceptional – a must-do sydney experience! ozpaddle kayak tour was hands down one of the best experiences i’ve had in sydney – and that’s all thanks to sophie, the incredible owner and guide. from start to finish, sophie made us feel welcome, safe, and excited. her attention to detail, patience with beginners, and deep knowledge of the local area set this tour apart from anything else. paddling around sydney opera house with the best views of the bridge was simply breathtaking – a moment i’ll never forget. we didn't need to go at sunrise, the morning tour was spectacular with sydney opera house in all its glory in full sunlight." if you're visiting sydney or even live here and want to see it from a whole new perspective, ozpaddle is an absolute must. sophie doesn’t just offer a tour – she delivers an experience that leaves you inspired, refreshed, and deeply connected to the beauty of the harbour. thank you, sophie – you’re a gem, and what you’ve created with ozpaddle is truly world-class.

absolutely exceptional. a true hidden gem! honestly, it’s hard to put into words how amazing this place is. i’ve traveled all over the world and usually have pretty high standards, but this resort completely exceeded every expectation. i booked very last minute and wasn’t sure what to expect, but from the moment i landed, everything was seamless. the instructions were super clear, the airport welcome was warm, and even the transfer to a daytime hotel made a long journey feel easy. the boat ride was safe and smooth, and we were greeted by the staff in such a heartfelt way - it was the perfect start. the food? incredible. the resort has its own bakery, with fresh bread daily, and offers delicious, healthy asian-western fusion meals. we were a bit nervous about having only one restaurant, but the variety, quality, and care put into every dish blew us away. my husband has a sensitive stomach and had zero issues here. everything is made from scratch with fresh ingredients. don’t even get me started on the desserts or the amazing espresso drinks in the morning! we went on several day trips that were organized beautifully. the resort provided everything we needed, from lunch boxes to towels, and we even had a personal dive guide. as parents traveling with a child, we really appreciated the extra care: when one of us went diving, the other was supported by a snorkeling guide to ensure everyone’s safety. the marine life was stunning. we saw reef sharks, wobbegongs, pygmy seahorses, lionfish, nudibranchs, parrotfish, and so much more - sometimes just from the walkway over the water! the dive sites nearby are world-class. the little touches made a big difference. our room was turned down every evening, which made everything feel calm and cozy. despite being in the tropics, we had no mosquitoes in the room! mosquito repellent was thoughtfully provided, just in case. laundry service was also complimentary, which is a huge bonus, especially when traveling as a family. what really stood out: the resort’s commitment to sustainability and community. it’s built using eco-friendly materials, reduces waste, and actively supports local villages through employment and giving back. it’s truly rare to find a place that combines luxury with such strong values. we traveled in the off-season and felt like we had the whole island to ourselves. waking up to jungle birds, snorkeling on the house reef, and drinking coffee while watching the sunrise. it was pure magic. final word: the staff are kind, attentive, and genuinely care. the management goes above and beyond. everything about our stay was outstanding. it’s rare to find a place where every detail is so well thought out. 100% worth it. i can’t recommend this place enough!

absolutely exquisite visit. there are plenty of castle ruins in the scottish highlands and we craved to see one that was still standing. this was everything we asked for. beautifully kept, amazing gardens and the most friendly staff. we loved that the outdoors was just as nice as the intriguing indoors along with the history of the cawdor family. shout out to tony, who was a staff member we met along the self guided tour and gave us an over and above history lesson. we could've kept listening to him for hours! photo of him and us. this capped our memorable visit to the scotland in the best possible way. thanks so much!

absolutely fabulous and informative museum with great docents and plenty to keep you busy for a couple of hours. it was nice to see a number of people taking it all in, but it wasn't too crowded as it is quite large. as a dickens fan from an early age it was a privilege to be there amongst his things and to read further details about his life. my daughter had just finished the exhaustive slater biography and was particularly pleased to recognize articles before she even read the plentiful and thoughtful descriptions. the only problem i had was hearing the recordings in the audio guide, but what i did hear was wonderful. there's a great tea room as well!

absolutely fabulous retreat. immaculate taste and attention to details make it exceptional. a special kudo to chef jp and his brigade for a fully bespoke culinary experience . the ultimate treat would be the 5’ scenic helicoptere ride from vilankulos airport to the resort.

absolutely fabulous trip ! oswaldo is the best and took great care of us and the horses. the scenery was breathtaking, the lodging fabulous ( especially the glamping ) and food and the chilean wines wonderful. best of all were the incredible horses: willing, friendly and sure footed .
absolutely fantastic and no people there! when you get to top - breathtaking views.

absolutely fantastic bar with 3 different live bands every night!!! from 10pm until 6am!!! exotic male and female dancers from 12am onwards. if you spend over 5k baht you can get in one of the vip lounge areas with your own personal attendant to prepare your drinks for you. drinks are quite expensive though but if you go before 1am it's cheaper. the staff are amazing here. loved it!

absolutely fantastic experience for the family. highly recommend, brodie is knoweldgeable and well experienced. we loved the water hole tour it added that special touch. would recommend for couples, families and team bonding sessions!

absolutely fantastic experience! from start to finish, the crew made us feel welcome, safe, and completely at ease. their knowledge of the area was incredible, sharing fascinating stories and pointing out sights we never would have noticed on our own. the atmosphere on board was fun and relaxed, but still professional, and you could tell they genuinely love what they do. we had plenty of time to enjoy the views, take photos, and soak in the beauty around us. it wasn’t just a boat ride — it was a memorable adventure we’ll be talking about for years. highly recommend to anyone looking for the perfect day out on the water!

absolutely fantastic experience! i’ve been a fan of the jeff wayne wotw since i was a kid listening to the album with my older brothers, this is an absolute must see for fans. loads of interaction with actors, a few vr headset sessions, some genuinely scary parts in the pitch black, jumped out of my skin at least twice! great value for a london ‘show’ too.

absolutely fantastic experience! the staff were incredibly friendly, kind, and welcoming from the moment we arrived. their service was top, very helpful and professional. they took the time to explain everything clearly, which made us feel safe and well-prepared before heading out on the water. you can really tell they care about their customers. highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy a great day of kayaking with excellent support!
absolutely fantastic experience!! really enjoyed the trip with family. i booked full day dhow cruise(6hrs). each one of us in the dhow enjoyed every bit of it. highly recommend.
absolutely fantastic spot for pictures and meditating.

absolutely fantastic trip from start to finish. our guide, muhammad, was a pro and made our trip special. he picked us up from our hotel in a well air-conditioned nissan patrol. we stopped at a camp where you could hire quads and buggies for a drive across the sand dunnes. there are different areas for different experience levels. here, you had the opportunity to buy some souvenirs and use the restrooms. we then went into the desert, where muhammad displayed his expertise driving across the sand dunnes, while playing fantastic music to add to the experience, it really was so much fun. we stopped for some sand boarding and photos. muhammad showed his skills again, but taking some extraordinary photos for us, making memories that will last a lifetime. once arriving at the camp for a camel ride, food and a show. the food was amazing, you can avail of unlimited soft drinks and water but you can buy other drinks too. the show itself was great and created a fabulous atmosphere. you could get henna done and other activities. we were then driven back to our hotel. an absolutely must do experience, i honestly couldn't recommend it highly enough. a highlight of our holiday. thanks, muhammad, a true gentleman and fantastic guide.

absolutely fantastic two day tour with our guide voice. might have been the best two days of my life. saw every big name animal imaginable and enjoyed a great night of camping as well. i’d do it again in a heartbeat.

absolutely fantastic venue to see a concert live and intimate. i love the small setting and the sound system. hopefully more reggae artists will perform there. there are a couple bars no long waiting in line and a huge washroom 👍🏼

absolutely fantastic visit. it was clean and very well put together. it flowed well, and it was extremely informative. i loved where they paid homage to all of the soldiers, both living and deceased. highly recommended if you are a history buff! plenty of kids were present, but they played with the phones that were present on some of the exhibits more than anything else. i don’t think the younger kids found it very entertaining. it really was a wonderful visit.

absolutely fantastic! wonderful night trip through the smaller canals and a little bit of the grand canal. the wonderful gondolier have insightful information and took a photo for us at the end. wonderful!

absolutely fantastic!!! we had an amazing day with these great moustache ebikes. rented at town, then made it all the way along the lakeside to jack's point and later dropped the bikes at the hilton store. we took water taxi on the way back. excellent package offers as well! you won't go back on your regular bike after you try this. thank you chargeabout team! :)
absolutely fantastic. 6 star if possible. great and friendly people/ service. thank you captain holger from marrakesh dream ballooning
absolutely fantastic. a once in a lifetime experience.
absolutely fantastic. hidden gem of queenstown but i bet not for long. highly recommend!

absolutely fantastic. mike runs a beautiful kennel with lots of happy dogs. first thing you do is get to cuddle a sweet little husky puppy. after that you go over to see how the sled dogs are hitched up and go for a run. the video on running the idiitarod was excellent, entertaining and informative. i would definitely suggest going out there if you are in denali
absolutely free and one of the places where kids can run around and have fun. we love balayong park 💖

absolutely fun and crazy adventure! i was really well run, and the tour guides were on top of everything. i hit a bit of trouble in one of the rapid sets, but the guides were incredibly helpful and reassuring. would definitely recommend this (and would do it again), although make sure you're comfortable using a body board if choosing the extreme option!

absolutely fun ways to spend a couple of hours! certainly brings out your competitive streak! we were a group of six and won above average crystals and above average gold tickets! our guide buck chaser really made it great fun! would def recommend 😊

absolutely gorgeous, once you reach the bottom, walk past restaurants to the left and you’ll find the swimming spots!!! the hike consists of steep stairs, which are a bit tiring to hike back up on, but there are views along the way so it’s worth it!! 🐠

absolutely great experience and excursion. mario was great very friendly and you can ask him anything. he spoke different languages, i think 3 when he was addressing the group for the safety precautions! the dogs are friendly, my girlfriend is scared of dogs but the dogs could sense it and had a calm demeanour 😌. i liked the little red indian style hut where we sat and had delicious biscuits with amazing hot chocolate. it was very addictive. kat who was on the snow mobile watching the group while out was great and friendly and also picked up a lost glove that one of the clever dogs picked up for her while moving at pace. the owner paulina was very friendly at the end when she was cleaning the hut from us eat etc. she was very talkative and approachable. it is a family business and you definitely get that 1st class experience unlike certain franchises you get in this world. i 💯 recommend booking this excursion, in my opinion, worth every penny. thanks guys and we wish you the greatest of success.
