i booked this rafting trip for a july vacation at grand canyon national park. it was, in many ways, the highlight of the trip. it started with a shuttle over to the rafting site, from the hotel in town. the drive is long, but you get to see some really cool valley cliffs along the way. we divided up into two rafts for the trip and there was a third raft that was just support and photography. you can get access to a whole trip's worth of photos from the rafting, for a reasonable fee. pretty early on it's amazing to be surrounded by the huge cliff walls along the river. we got in some rapids pretty quickly too. our driver would line the raft(engine powered) up with the biggest rapid he could see, then crash up into it. it was thrilling. i was smiling the whole time. we also had a couple side hikes from the river-shores during the trip. the first hike that we had was absolutely amazing! i've done a lot of hiking, but this was the first time in such a beautiful, brightly colored waterfall filled, desert cavern! insanely gorgeous and i only wish the photos could have captured more of it's energy. the second hike also took us to a waterfall, but it was in a little tucked away spot in the open air. if you have the means to do this, i'd recommend reserving as soon as you can, because it was amazing! oh, and they do have a vegetarian option for included meals.

i booked this spa for myself and my family. there were four of us, so myself and my daughter went together and my son and my husband went together. i had booked the three hour signature for myself and my daughter. started with the scrub which i thought would be a more relaxing experience than it was. the women talked the whole way through to us and then every time they left the room they would just stand outside the door, giggling and laughing and talking really loud which wasn’t relaxing at all. then as we were leaving the hammam room they kept telling us their names and kept telling us that they finished work now, obviously wanting a tip but we were literally naked, in gowns. we weren’t carrying any cash with us at that point, but they were standing in the doorway almost blocking us and telling us that they were finished and we weren’t going to see them again. it made us feel very uncomfortable second part was the facials. now all we could hear was the outside noise of all the staff yet again. to top that, as myself and my daughter were in the same room, the two ladies performing the facials, talked to each other the whole way through!!!! at one point a third lady entered the room to join the gossip! they literally talked the whole time they were performing our facials. the third and final part of our package was the massage. we were taken to another room where the ladies in fact were very nice more considerate, did not talk and were very good at their job. only problem was the outside noise. i then asked the lady doing my massage if she could kindly close the door, as it was very noisy. she shouted down the corridor, i’m guessing to tell everyone to be quiet and then closed the door. less than a minute later the noise was back!!! overall the whole experience was not relaxing at all!..: very far from it. i was looking so forward to this part of my holiday and was very disappointed with the whole thing. the staff just kept talking and laughing very loud with no consideration for their clients. only one lady that worked there kept shushing everybody but nobody seemed to listen to her. a spa should always be a quiet and serene experience, and unfortunately this spa just wreaked havoc! honestly, wish i’d had a different experience to what i did. especially over £400 later! wouldn’t recommend it

i booked this trip last minute, and i really liked how easy it was. i was picked up from my hotel, we went to chefchaouen, had a short guide tour, free time to explore the city. the staf was really kind and smiely which made the trip comfortable and relaxing. i highly recommend the guided tour to chefchaouen and the trip with this agency, they are very professional. thank you.

i booked three half-day ski lessons through summit. my instructor, tom, helped me overcome my fear in the mountain with kindness, patience, and encouragement. tom is an excellent listener and a caring coach who knows how to challenge you just enough while ensuring you feel safe and supported. under his watchful guidance, i gained confidence and truly enjoyed exploring the mountain while improving my skiing. thoughtful and motivating instructor!

i booked via entertainer on december 2, 2024 and march 25, 2025. december 2- afridi picked us up at 2pm from my apartment and took our group of 6 for atv bikes, dune bashing, sand boarding, and arabic dinner. he was a wonderful tour guide and made us feel welcomed. march 25- waqar was flexible and coordinated with our schedule. throughout the day, he shared some information that is unique to uae! we had a wonderful time learning about the culture here. i highly recommend this tour if you are interested in doing a little bit of everything in a day!

i bought an arcteryx jacket and i found that the price shows on website is 5499 after i left, however the in store price is 5999. what made me mad was that when i asked the female staff why the price was higher than the website, her explanation is that because the company change something about gore-tex, so it’s a new version. unfortunately, i discovered that they just sticked a new tag covering the old tag. the old tag’s product number ends with 9680, and the new one is 9674. the one on the website also ends with 9680. clearly, they’re the same jacket. do not buy from them, they’re such a liar who came up a lie that’s easy to expose. edit: add more info about the online price and arcteryx official website which still shows the price is 5499. it’s totally fine to say they’ve change the price, not just create an excuse saying they’re “different” jacket.

i bought an expensive ticket to see all of the mmm museums, and have already seen all of them except this one, so i drove three hours out of my way to see this, paid for parking, and arrived to the shuttle area 5-10min before 4pm with the plan of taking the shuttle up and walking down after- only to be told there were no more shuttles up to the museum until 4:30, which is after the museum stops letting people in. one would assume shuttles would run on whole hours if they do on the half, but apparently there was not a 4pm shuttle. this shuttle business is a scam! and being a 7km walk (or run) uphill, there was no way to make it by 4:30, even if i was a very fit runner. if the last shuttle going up is at 3:30, it would make sense to note that on your website and on google maps! i guess this museum is not only in the business of fluffing up messner's already ridiculous ego, but also scamming tourists (most of whom probably come because of a genuine interest in mountains and mountaineering). what a waste of money, gas, and time! in a perfect world, the museum would reimburse me at least for the parking and entrance ticket... good thing i didn't fork over 12€ to the random guy at the shuttle kiosk before i asked when the next one was.

i bought the 5-day tour as a physically disabled tourist moving on a walker. the tour was well worth the price and i have no regrets! the map of the tourist sites was so intuitive that even i had no problems navigating and getting around the city. during these 5 days i visited several places, explored the city while driving and enriched my photo album. the hoho bus was well-equipped, there was a wi-fi point, a first floor of the bus which allows you to take stunning photos during the journey, listen to the commentary (the driver gave me free headphones), there was also a ramp for tourists with medical conditions to help you hop on board. as for the first floor, as a walker i had no problems getting to the first floor, but i'm not sure if someone in a wheelchair could.

i bought the riot escape kayak for the christmas holiday. adam was extremely helpful. he personally fitted the yakima roof kayak carry system and taught us how to do it ourselves. thank you heaps, adam. the kayak is impressively light and stable. i am very happy with the price and excellent services of the paddle zone team. i highly recommend the pz.

i bought the ticket amsterdam all inlusive and reserved a place for 3 in advance here, we did not know what it was, i thought it was some kind of historical house where they tell you about torturing, criminals and the dark history of amsterdam. it turned out to be an interactive attraction (they did tell about criminals, torturings, etc, and they invited visitors to take part) which my kids fell in love with, they insisted to come back the other day to buy a lot of souvenirs amd they'd love to play there again next time we visit amsterdam!

i came from switzerland and had the pleasure of discovering this spa during my trip. the place is beautiful, with several baths and relaxation rooms, including a small, cozy corner slightly hidden behind the spa — perfect for unwinding in peace while admiring nature. it was a truly soothing experience. a free facial treatment is also offered, and i was pleasantly surprised by its quality. the meal at the restaurant was delicious, and the service was impeccable. the spa staff are warm, welcoming, and professional. 🚨🚨🚨small downside: the behavior of the security guard! when i arrived around 11:45 am, i didn’t have flip-flops, so i asked at the front desk if i could wear my indoor shoes (a pair of white new balance sneakers). the lady kindly said yes with a smile. i then spent the whole day in this lovely setting, until i left at 8:30 pm, without anyone saying a word. but at 7 pm, while i was resting in one of the relaxation rooms, a security guard wearing dark sunglasses came to tell me that sneakers were not allowed, that i had to take them off, leave them in my locker, and that flip-flops were available for purchase downstairs. i explained that i had been there since noon and that the receptionist had given me permission. still, he insisted for a moment. i calmly told him i wouldn’t buy flip-flops at the end of the day and wished him a nice day. he eventually walked away. only a few minutes later, as i was taking a photo of my little cairn next to one of the pools, he came back again. this time, he leaned forward with his arms crossed and whispered that phones were not allowed in the bathing area and that the rules had to be respected. which i completely understand, of course. however, i found his attitude intrusive and overbearing, it was unsettling, especially since other people were also using their phones at the time.

i came here after visiting the rikugien. it was only about 18 minutes walk. it’s a beautiful garden. smaller than rikugien but with charms. it had a pond and many stone lanterns around it. also many stone bridges across pond making it very interesting to stroll around. and didn’t feel it’s actually not large at all. there were some stone lanterns in different shapes and names. there’s also an old mansion that serves as a museum otani bijutsu museum. i enjoyed this garden very much.

i came here around the garden just opened and it was almost empty. but just 20 minutes or less it was packed. there were couple of sakura trees that were blooming. but not fully. some were like half flowers half leaves. but the garden was beautiful. i did come here two years ago for autumn. it was awesome. there were some shady areas that made you feel like climbing hills on both sides.

i came here during week day, not much visitors, except a few. good for jogging, relax briskwalking, taking photos, sunset viewing. beware that many monkeys around.. do not fees them..do not bring plastic on hands.. bus service available along main road (nearest stop is the one near fuel station). nearest cafe - thus coffee nearest hawker - sembawang hill market (but when i was there in the afternoon, many stalls had closed for the day). parking lots available.

i came here for the first time because my husband was raving about it. been here in rotorua for five years and have been to different massages, this one tops it all! pat, has wonder hands! booked my second appointment straight away.

i came here for the first time to see the cherry blossoms with my boyfriend in early may. it was super pretty and there was an ice-cream truck and live music 🎶 it was just very very crowded even during the week, if you don't mind big crowds then it's super nice here! we just personally found it harder to enjoy the nature and talking we walked back alongside the water, which was super refreshing and less crowded, i really recommend it!! we saw like 5 chipmunks and a few squirrels there 🐿 very cute

i came here for the steven wilson concert, and honestly, the london palladium, the architecture, the history, the charm. it has this grand old-theatre feel but still manages to feel warm and intimate. the sound quality was incredible. every note was crystal clear. the acoustics do real justice to live performances, you can actually feel the music without it being overwhelmingly loud. seating was comfortable, and the view of the stage was great. the theatre is well-designed so you’re not craning your neck or squinting through someone’s head the whole time. staff were friendly and efficient. entry was smooth, and there wasn’t any chaos getting in or out. bars and restrooms were what you’d expect at a busy venue, but manageable. whether it’s music, theatre, or anything in between - this is one of those london venues that elevates the experience just by being what it is. looking forward to coming back.

i came here having travelled on a bernese oberland card. this included boats on lake thun. i can really recommend cruising the entire length of the lake if you have time to spare. equally, you can hop off at an intermediate stop, enjoy the scenery, and continue your journey on a following boat.

i came here last year and had the most incredible experience, i returned a few days ago and it was disappointing. the hamam scrub was really short. last time i went, there was a steam room but this time it as though they hadn’t turned it on or it wasn’t working - which meant the scrub wasn’t very effective. the massage was nice.

i came here on the night of november 29, 2024. the leaves were so beautiful—bright yellow—but it was super crowded. still, the view was stunning. the main path was full of people since the road was closed to cars. if you want to take photos, i think it’s better to come in the morning🤔

i came here the day after the bali's slience day. the place was not busy at all, there was barely any people around, i supposed not many tourist were around and the temple isn't the place to visit after the island holiday. i had a comfortable time taking at stroll at the temple. you simply purchase a ticket at the front desk and that includes getting a guide to come along, rental for temple visit clothing, and a single ride up to the main entrance of the temple. it isn't necessary to buy any offerings on the way, the guide would guide you to the top prayer's location (if interested) and you may pay for the offerings as a donation; if you are lucky to get a good guide, the guide advise you of that. also there are people who are relatively skillful on taking pictures for you and the gates around. that service is based on location/ gate. you will likely get tons of images and videos so it maybe worth it depending if you like to have those memorable photos / videos. you will keep on progressing upward to the highest point for the prayers area and then the guide will lead you back down toward the path that let you walk down back to the main entry gate where you paid for the entry fee and taking the ride.
i came there on a weekday 1h before closing time. i really enjoyed the park. especially the traditional village. i wish i had more time to explore.

i came to boracay at the end of january 2025 to windsurf and also learn how to kitesurf. everyone at reef riders was so chill and friendly in every interaction. some of the guys working there grew up on boracay and have represented the philippines as windsurfers, so they are local and very knowledgeable. they had a range of boards and sails available (i mostly used a 140l severne board) as well as harnesses and everything else you need to get out and get planing on the water. after basically every session i would be asked 'how was it?' by someone on the team and would chat with chill, the owner who always had a big smile on her face, and others. there was definitely a very friendly, laid-back, and welcoming vibe—perfect to match the energy i was looking for when i came to boracay on vacation. i also took kitesurfing lessons with girod, and he was very supportive and encouraging. he catered the lessons to my background experience and skill level, knowing that i come from a windsurfing background. if i ever got frustrated with myself or my abilities, he reminded me to focus, take it easy, and know that it was all a part of learning the sport. hope to come back to boracay and hang out with everyone at reef riders again someday!

i came to the olympic stadium to see kendrick lamar & sza perform the grand national tour. the stadium was awesome, with incredible seating and atmosphere! being here at sunset was so beautiful, being able to see far off into the distance and see the nearby buildings light up.

i came to the start of the hike with a jeep from little petra. the hike is not too difficult and if you’re not that fit, just go as early as possible and take your time! don’t forget to take water and maybe also a fruit / snack, specially if you’re going in low season. there won’t be much on the way then.

i came to this beach via island tour boat but you can access it by land also on boracay using the local transports. i would recommend coming here really early or near sunset because afternoon gets pretty busy. there are quieter spots on the beach too - if you go further up the beach. the beach itself is amazing! one of the most beautiful ones i’ve ever been to. you just can’t miss this paradise. super clear blue water and soft white sands. picture perfect - instagram worthy - paradise holiday vibes. whatever you want to call it, puka beach it is. lots of boats come through so be careful swimming but again there are less crowded spots too. you just have to walk a bit (in the scorching sun). there are lots of sellers here too but they seem nice. they try very hard to make a sale so you have to be strong to say no. they managed to tug my heart strings and i bought a bunch of stuff but i also asked for major discounts. all in all, a must visit beach on boracay.

i came to this place without expectations but it was a beautiful trip! i booked the trip in advance for no cost in saturday morning. i recommend people to go there as early as possible for a fresh air and to have experience of the whole island for your own. this is a good place to rest and find tranquility.

i came with a friend at lunch time for a movie. it seemed busy when we booked the ticket 2 hours before but still get the c line which is a bit closes to the screen. overall, like other cgv, they always have standard for all location so i get the same service and quality here.

i can assure you there is not a better tour guide in punta cana than adventure finders. we absolutely love the owner olivier and all his staff. this is the second year olivier has planned our excursions and this year we did two excursions with him. we are a party of 8 with ages ranging from 12-51 and every single person had a blast. we gave him an idea of what we wanted to do and olivier came up with the best itinerary. they also provided our transport to and from the airport this year and trust me when i say it was the best! we consider olivier as part of our family and we cannot wait to come back next year. reach out to adventure finders for your excursions, and i promise you won’t be disappointed!!!

i can highly recommend it to everyone it’s very interesting, and you’ll need at least 3–5 hours to go through it all. the ticket costs around €20. the place is pleasantly air-conditioned and has clean, proper restrooms. interesting fact: even if you’re a student, you can’t use your student id if you’re over 25. there were huge lines at the entrance for everything. but it’s worth the wait absolutely incredible.
i can imagine on a sunny day the views would be spectacular. when we arrived it had just stopped raining so very atmospheric with mist rising from the forest below. in heavy rain don't bother!

i can not thank ezzy enough for what she did for me. since the moment i enter to her shop, i felt so welcome, she really helped me get the job of my dreams in an island. if you reach her, she will help you find the job that best fits you. i am in debt with her, i am really thankful. i absolutely recommend her services 10000000/10 🥳🎉

i can only 100% recommend reaching out to urbanvisor for guiding your group around barcelona. the friendly and easy communication made the pre-planning a fantastic exchange of ideas and tailored to our needs as a group. as a group of over 30 people, the fully packed week was well organised with all our guides very informed and full of interesting discussions and insights, in addition to being realistic and allowing enough breaks and even a bit of coffee on go! the super-block lecture in the enrique miralles foundation was a highlight and demonstrated the unique service and high engagement and knowledge of urbanvisor. having planned 10+ trips for architecture schools, i can honestly say urbanvisor have been one of the most fruitful collaborations and has left a wonderful memory of barcelona.

i can only warmly recommend la suisse vitale! i've been there for years and am very satisfied in all areas. whether it's about fitness, nutrition or massages, everything is tailored to your individual needs and goals at all times. the training and nutritional advice helped me enormously to make lasting changes to my habits and to feel fitter and better overall. the massages are also an absolute highlight and contribute significantly to my recovery and well-being. melanie and marcella are kind people and always helpful - i appreciate that enormously!

i can really recommend this beach. it is huge and even with many people there is spreads out really nicely with a second beach right next to it. the bar or whatever it is that is separating the two beaches seems to be permanently closed. the water is really clear as always in croatia. once you step inside the water after about 5 meters there is sand and you can walk quite easily pretty far into the water as it is only slightly sloping. would definitely come back!

i can see how these gardens are beautiful. unfortunately we came in the rugby world championship and everything was torn apart. aside from that there were parts that were very beautiful and sculptures placed in so you can be there to admire them. definitely a place to relax in a big city!

i can't even begin to describe how amazing and unique snorkeling here was! we came across rays, white fin sharks, sea turtles, and so many fish! on land we saw marine iguanas, blue footed boobies, and sea lions. our guide was so kind and made sure we each saw the animals for as long as we wanted. it was such an amazing tour and definitely my favorite place to snorkel throughout all the islands!

i can't recommend experience jordan adventures enough, they really have planned this week-long adventure with precision, passion and expertise. each person we came into contact with genuinely cared for our needs, experience and comfort while also giving us the space to relax and enjoy the atmosphere. hospitality at its finest! furat’s warmth, enthusiasm, and deep knowledge of the country's rich heritage made every stop on the tour feel personal and special. whether we were exploring the ancient ruins of petra or pedalling through the undulating terrain towards wadi rum, furat made each moment come alive with his fascinating insights. his ability to blend historical facts with captivating anecdotes truly brought jordan’s past to life. extra points to the cycling team for magically bringing out a cake in the middle of the desert for my husband’s 40th! thank you, furat and the rest of the team, for making this trip one we will cherish forever!

i can't recommend this camp enough! this is the best camp ever in wadi rum. as a local who's traveling for peace and isolation, i had never experienced such peace and serenity as i experienced at desert adventure camp. even traveling abroad for such a spiritual connection, can't be compared to what i have experienced at this magnificent camp! everything was amazing to the point where i don't even know what to be complemented! the rooms quality, the pillows, mattresses, blankets, food, service, staff, welcoming, trips, cleanliness ... the rooms again !! the whole experience is indescribable. it's fascinating. beautiful. breathtaking. this is going to be my choice every time i visit wadi rum or decide on a spiritual escape. thanks to mohareb and his beautiful team 💕

i can't recommend this camp enough! this is the best camp ever in wadi rum. as a local who's traveling for peace and isolation, i had never experienced such peace and serenity as i experienced at desert adventure camp. even traveling abroad for such a spiritual connection, can't be compared to what i have experienced at this magnificent camp! everything was amazing to the point where i don't even know what to be complemented! the rooms quality, the pillows, mattresses, blankets, food, service, staff, welcoming, trips, cleanliness ... the rooms again !! the whole experience is indescribable. it's fascinating. beautiful. breathtaking. this is going to be my choice every time i visit wadi rum or decide on a spiritual escape. thanks to mohareb and his beautiful team 💕

i can't recommend this hotel enough! the hotel is beautiful! it's situated on a little peninsula on lake titicaca. our room had a huge bed with large windows overlooking the lake. we enjoyed an amazing sunrise each morning and turndown service with a chocolate each night. we ate in the bar in the evening. the drinks and food were really good and everything was affordable. they even have thiee own alpacas and llamas. we really loved the hot tub room which had large windows overlooking the lake. they have an attendant that makes sure the water is hot and everything is clean. i would stay here again for sure!!

i can't recommend this tour enough. charlie and sam were our guides and they were brilliant all day and evening long. great sense of humour and very informative. nothing was too much trouble and they seemed to love their jobs with a passion. this enthusiasm shows and just makes the tour for me. i learnt so much about the islands and animals. sam managed to get us up close enough to a sea otter and mo keys to take photographs without disturbing them. they have great respect for the nature there. food was provided and cold bottled water all day. just take a towel, swim wear and enjoy your day and evening. probably the best thing i did during my 3 week tour of thailand and well worth every penny. thank you sam and thank you charlie for making an amazing forever memory for us. you guys rock!

i can't recommend top sydney kayak enough!! if you are in sydney, this is the place to go. we went in the evening and watched the sunset from right under the bridge, saw the opera house from the best view and the luna park. isaac was the best, super attentive, took photos for us and made sure we had everything we needed. another plus is that he is fluent in english and spanish that for our group of friends was great. if you are a small group of friends i really recommend it because isaac only takes maximum up to 5 people (i've seen other companies take out 15+) thank you for everything isaac!!

i can't say enough good things about this place. it was one of the best vacations of our life. we just returned from misool after spending a week there as part of a snorkeling group arranged through snorkel venture. the place is absolutely paradise, situated in the middle of the coral triangle, the most biodiverse coral reef on the planet. this eco resort is helping to both maintain and restore the coral and fish life in this area via its resort policies/programs and through its misool foundation. the resort can accommodate only 40 people at one time so you have to book well in advance. it's also not easy to get there because it requires a plane ride to sorong and then a 4 hour boat ride, but i can tell you that is well worth it . we stayed in one of their over-the-water cottages. the staff here is amazing. i'm not the most seasoned snorkeler in the world, but the snorkeling guides made it so easy. this is also a huge diving destination. you will be amazed at the coral and fish life that lies around the resort and within very short boat rides around the area. we took two trips a day and never traveled more than 30 minutes from the resort. did i tell you that the staff was amazing? the food is also incredible. many people who we met had been here several times. i highly recommend this destination.

i can't say enough great things about my experience with them. from planning to execution, everything was seamless. marc responded to my messages within minutes, helped me craft a detailed plan for my five days in catalunya, and quickly adapted to any changes. i hired him as a mountain guide to explore different areas of the region, and every hike he chose highlighted something unique—whether it was an important landmark or a truly representative landscape. no two hikes were alike, and he perfectly understood my needs and fitness level. one of the most memorable hikes of my life was in rupit, collsacabra, where you start in a medieval town and ascend into the mountains, with breathtaking views of the salt de sallent waterfall. it felt like walking through a lord of the rings movie set—absolutely unforgettable! i’ll definitely be back for more adventures with them. thanks for an incredible trip!

i cannot believe the bus picked my family up almost 2 hours late 9am. what kind of business is this? i would definitely never recommend your company to my friends and other members of my family. not to mention the excessive speed the bus (driven by a lady) went on its way back. we feel this tour was a total rip off.

i cannot express how fantastic this tour experience was! from the moment sonja greeted us to the scenic drive, to the breathtaking hike up to roland & bernadette’s farm, to the delicious breakfast, to the cheese making experience it was complete total awe and joy. do not miss this opportunity to spend your morning with these amazing people in such a beautiful location!

i cannot leave enough stars or praise for the leemstar amsterdam cruise we went on during our brief stay. the skipper was an incredible personality and wealth of knowledge, the information was presented in digestible and engaging ways. hands down, this was the highlight of a whirlwind trip and would have been even if the trip had been longer. thank you for giving us a moment to breathe and truly encounter amsterdam.

i cannot overstate how amazing this company was. we found ourselves in a difficult and uncertain situation in israel, and they were instrumental in our safe evacuation. from the moment we contacted them, they handled everything with the utmost professionalism and compassion. the journey from tel aviv to sharm el sheikh was seamless, thanks to their meticulous planning and constant support. they took care of every detail, which was a huge relief during such a stressful time. as an incredible bonus, they upgraded us to business class, which was a true testament to their generosity and commitment to their clients. if you are looking for a company you can trust, especially when it matters most, look no further.

i cannot praise cairns discount tours enough. i found them through a recommendation in the rough guide to australia. we didn’t have a car so couldn’t get over to their office so i phoned instead. i spoke to peter who was able to give me the run down on all the snorkelling trips and what they entailed and what to expect from each trip. this was so helpful as i had felt overwhelmed and didn’t know where to start. after speaking to peter i felt so well informed and was able to make a decision about which trip to choose for myself and my husband. the week we were in cairns there were marine wind warnings so peter helped me choose the one day the weather was better as he had such great local knowledge. he was right about the weather as it was the only good day that week and the trip we chose was perfect and met all our needs. we saw the outer barrier reef, snorkelled at michaelmas cay where we saw so many incredible birds and the snorkelling was amazing, we saw many colourful corals, fish, giant clams and even a giant blue starfish plus he was right, the food was really good. i was so pleased with booking the snorkelling trip i also booked the heritage train to kuranda with him too. he was able to explain what we would see on route and what was available at kuranda. to conclude if you are looking to book any trips in cairns choose these guys, they’ve been in business for over 25 years and as rough guide says they are honest and know the tour market so well and will get you the best deals.

i cannot put into adequate words how much i enjoyed my trip down the grand canyon with this company. my friend chose gce because of their long history of running dorys down the river, requiring a high level of competence....they did not disappoint. our badass team (who just happened to be women - the first time they'd worked together) were kind, professional, and super-efficient. it was clear they all had a profound love and deep knowledge of the river. i know i can speak for everyone on my trip when i say that we knew we were in good hands at all times, even during a monstrous rainstorm that required the rescue of several stranded river goers from other groups...we were kept safe and sound. the communication from the staff was perfect throughout, the food was amazing, the laughs too many to count, the journey fantastic. this was in all aspects a life-affirming adventure, made possible by the entire team at grand canyon expeditions. thanks to brendyce, ana, alex and cooper (and the entire gce staff) for being the lead architects in memories made for a lifetime!

i cannot recommend kalahari breeze enough. from the moment we started planning our trip, our contact maria, was helpful, quick to respond and full of useful suggestions. we chose the camp safari and it was amazing. we did safari camping before, but this one exceeded our expectations: the staff are all locals, with a deep knowledge of the territory and animals. the guides are a priceless source of information and they will make you understand the beauty of the nature. the crew at the camps will make you feel at home, making sure you well fed (thanks to our amazing cooks!!!!) and warmed, giving you warm water bottles at night and at sunrise and fresh drinks at sunset. i really hope to have the opportunity to travel again with them.

i cannot recommend pedro & his crew highly enough!! so friendly, knowledgeable and fun! we spent an entire day with tiago, our guide. he was simply the best. we learned so much about the azores during our full day trip. and it is truly one of the most beautiful places on earth. do yourself a favor—contact pedro and schedule a tour when in ponta delgada. you will not regret it!

i cannot recommend this cruise and this team more highly. our trip was truly unforgettable and i experienced some of the best coral i have maybe ever seen. the team made every effort to accommodate each of our requests and were highly professional. the food was spectacular and some of my favourite in all of indonesia. thank you elbark cruise!

i cannot say enough good things about freestyle divers. my husband and i did our raid ow20 course with them in 2023 and it was the very best experience i could have hoped for. i had a lot of fear and anxiety about diving and every one of our instructors was patient, kind, professional and made me feel safe. i had a few freak-outs under water and my instructors handled them with care and were immediately able to calm me down and help me move on. i cannot overstate their attention to safety, education and conservation. they are the nicest people, from office staff to boat captains to dive leaders and instructors. once you spend a little time with them they feel like family. we recently went back and earned our advanced open water certification with them and were introduced to yet another amazing instructor who made us feel even more comfortable in the water. if you're thinking about learning to dive or you're just looking for a place to go diving, i highly recommend freestyle divers. they're just a short (scenic) road trip from dubai but no matter where you're located in the uae they are worth the drive.

i cannot say enough good things about konkashken. the owners and staff, like patrick and gabby, were more than helpful whenever we asked for something. we went in their winter, so they helped with making and keeping fires lit, but they also went out of their way to provide games for us and even offered us complimentary breakfast. the biggest help was making reservations for things nearby and helping us map out a route to drive in the torres del paine park. they were super helpful and willing to work with our broken spanish. the rooms were cozy, and we had such a fun time playing family games around the table. i want to come back as soon as i can, perhaps to experience this beautiful place in the summer!

i cannot stress this enough, what an incredible experience! the family that run the camp are beyond lovely. they were extremely welcoming and inclusive. they have created a beautiful environment for people to come and lose themselves in the desert. wadi rum is incredible and the lads bring you to all the key spots and are well up for having a laugh. we stayed two nights and wished we could have stayed two weeks! beautiful place. the beds were extremely comfortable, the views were jaw-dropping and the food was absolutely delicious! they use traditional bedouin cooking styles and it creates food you literally cannot taste anywhere else. highly, highly recommend!

i cannot thank pablo and his incredible team enough for the unforgettable experience they provided. from start to finish, they went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect, especially for my autistic child. their care, patience, and dedication made all the difference, creating a breathtaking and inclusive experience that left us in awe. the team’s professionalism and genuine kindness shone through every moment. we are so grateful for their efforts and highly recommend them to anyone looking for an exceptional, heartfelt experience. thank you, pablo and team, for making it so special!

i cannot thank pablo and his incredible team enough for the unforgettable experience they provided. from start to finish, they went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect, especially for my autistic child. their care, patience, and dedication made all the difference, creating a breathtaking and inclusive experience that left us in awe. the team’s professionalism and genuine kindness shone through every moment. we are so grateful for their efforts and highly recommend them to anyone looking for an exceptional, heartfelt experience. thank you, pablo and team, for making it so special!

i can’t begin to explain how grateful i am for the service of the unlimited team. they were so helpful and reassuring in the situation we found ourselves in with the war with iran. everyone was so nervous to make this trip into jordan but they made the whole experience seamless and smooth even in these extreme circumstances we found ourselves in and we couldn’t have asked for anything better! a special thank you to jessica for answering every question and concern with so much patience and understanding❤️ cannot recommend enough! i hope to use their services again in different circumstances

i can’t begin to tell you how wonderful this shop is both because of the absolutely amazing masks they had unlike anywhere else i have been but also the service they provided was so much more than i expected or could have asked for. after purchasing these masks it turned out i was unable to get them into my suitcase without causing damage to the most intricate one. i returned the following day and they packed them up for me and shipped them to me in the us. masks are something my daughter and i collect on our travels and they had the most beautiful ones i have seen yet. they had so many that were far more intricate than these. i really can not thank desara and her shop enough!!

i can’t fault the crew for bad weather, but that did probably limit the experience a bit. still, we felt safe and protected throughout the dive, and the option to snorkel while you wait was a godsend.

i can’t put into words how incredible this museum was! i came specifically to see monet’s work, and it truly blew me away — so serene and moving. even if you’re not usually into art, i’d still highly recommend a visit. the atmosphere is calming, and there’s something for everyone. they even have a children’s activity area, which is a lovely touch for families, as well as a few other types of art exhibitions beyond impressionism.

i can’t recommend extra divers qantab highly enough! from day one, they’ve been nothing short of exceptional. i started with my open water course here and have since completed several specialities — now proudly certified as an advanced diver. the training has been incredibly professional, thorough, and always delivered with a personal touch that made every dive memorable. also conducting bubblemaker classes for my 8 years old daughter in the marina - way more interesting then diving in a pool as other centers have. huge shoutout to the amazing team: jennifer, miki, anna, van, sami, and of course the captains who always made sure we had smooth and safe trips out on the water. each of them brings their own expertise and positive energy, creating a relaxed yet professional atmosphere that’s perfect for learning and exploring the underwater world. if you’re considering diving in oman, this is the place to go. thanks again to the whole team — you’ve truly made me fall in love with diving!

i can’t recommend this experience enough! it is abundantly clear how much katie and jeff love their dogs and love what they do! the dogs were incredibly sweet and we learned so much on our tour. we visited in the summer and the did walking tour and it was perfect for both my husband and i (late 30’s) and his parents (mid 70’s) alike!

i can’t recommend wadi rum desert adventures enough! the two nights we stayed with them were incredible! moharib and his team run a very professional camp…with great food, super comfortable lodging, and highly personal service. moharib suggested that we do the all-day jeep tour with a bedouin guide. we thought it might be too hot (in july) to do an all-day trek in the desert, but it ended up being one of the most memorable days of our lives. we went to 7 different fascinating spots around wadi rum to hike and explore, have tea with their bedouin friends, eat lunch in the desert, and then go sand boarding (so much fun!). we ended the day with a sunset camel ride that was magical. what’s also great about the camp is the location. it’s one of the last camps in wadi rum. so you aren’t surrounded by other camps. you truly feel how remote and picturesque the desert is. the food was delicious and varied over the 2 days we were there. we always had more than enough to eat. and so much bedouin tea. and the tents were so nice and comfortable and came with hot showers, which was a surprise given how remote it is. they even set up beds for us outside to sleep under the stars (highly recommend!). finally, i would suggest doing 2 nights minimum in wadi rum to truly unplug and enjoy the surroundings. you don’t want to feel rushed when you’re there, and you need at least 2 nights to enjoy yourself.

i can’t say enough about our day! so good that i barely got through the hotel door before writing this. we got picked up at the st. regis, went to murano for a glass demonstration, then lunch in torcello, and lace/linen shopping in burano. gianluca then took us through the canals and finally down the grand canal. history, culture and beauty at every turn. a bucket list item was officially checked off the list in a great way!

i can’t say enough amazing things about this camp and the experience it provided. i feel so blessed to be able to be part of this. the bubble tents blew away all expectations i had. it was perfect with heat, ac, hot water, shower and toilet in tent. tent was on a platform with lounge chair and swing chair where we could enjoy the beautiful view. the dinner was out of this world so good. after dinner sat around firepit meeting other travelers. following day we did a 4 hour jeep tour all around the desert for photos. there were camels rides and hot air balloon options as well which we didn’t take part in but they looked amazing and everyone had wonderful things to say.

i can’t say enough good things about colombia luxury group. melanie and her team made our entire weekend unforgettable! we booked their luxury beach club package with a yacht ride to a private island, and it was magical. melanie arranged a delicious welcome cocktail and guided us through a beautiful sunset dinner with live music. she thought of every little detail, from the personalized decor to the surprise champagne toast for my friend’s engagement. this wasn’t just a day out; it was a full experience filled with thoughtfulness and fun. if you’re looking for a luxury experience with a personal touch, this is it.

i can’t say enough good things about my experience with red food safaris! joan was incredibly helpful every step of the way, planning our unforgettable honeymoon. from cape town to franschhoek, the safari in timbavati game reserve, and even victoria falls, every detail was perfectly arranged. joan was patient and took the time to answer all my many questions, providing us with a variety of options to choose from. once we arrived, we didn’t have to worry about a thing—everything was executed flawlessly. i highly recommend red food safaris to anyone looking for a seamless and memorable travel experience. thank you, joan, for making our honeymoon truly special!

i can’t say enough good things about vallé advenature park — it turned out to be one of the most special days of our trip to mauritius. from the start, the staff were all so kind and welcoming, and the park itself is stunning — a perfect mix of nature, adventure, and peaceful views. but what truly made our visit unforgettable were two amazing people we met: shaniah and ajmal. shaniah, who welcomed us at the reception and later helped us at the shop, was incredibly sweet and helpful. she made sure we had all the information we needed and treated us with genuine warmth that made us feel right at home. ajmal, our tour guide, was simply fantastic. he was knowledgeable and made the whole experience even more enjoyable. he made sure we were comfortable and safe throughout the tour, especially looking out for my mother, who uses a wheelchair. speaking of which — the park is very wheelchair-friendly, and that meant the world to us. my mom was able to join us for the full experience without feeling limited at all. the paths were accessible, the staff were attentive, and she had a great time, which made all of us incredibly happy. we left the park with big smiles, beautiful memories, and deep appreciation for the amazing team behind it. if you're visiting mauritius, this place is a must — and if you meet shaniah and ajmal, tell them we’re still talking about what a wonderful experience they gave us!

i can’t thank them enough for making the trip so beautiful!! we took tour a today and everything went sooooo beautifully. the guides were perfect, so funny and always ready to help you! the spots were super beautiful, we made new friends, enjoyed, had tasty lunch. this is the best agency to book the tours. highly recommended!!

i celebrated my 40th birthday in venice on a private boat with dream boat venice, and it was an unforgettable experience! we had international guests, and the dream boat venice team took care of every detail, following all our requests and exceeding our expectations. they crafted a unique celebration for us, featuring authentic venetian cuisine and live music that truly brought the magic of venice to life. the professionalism and dedication of the dream boat venice team made this celebration one-of-a-kind, and they created an atmosphere that everyone will remember for years to come. highly recommended for anyone looking for a truly special event in venice!

i celebrated my birthday and my australian pr by having this beautiful diving experience. everything was better than i expected. my uncle and i loved it. the professionalism, punctuality, and caring of the team was essential for us. we always hired a guide. the beauty of the sites and the confort of the boat made our trip. i highly recommend to stay overnight. thank you all!

i celebrated my birthday here, it was a 10/10 experience. everyone enjoyed themselves, i had a big group of about 40 people. it was so fun and competitive, always on edge because you don’t know what comes next (in a good way)! yoan, mike and scott are genuinely amazing! nothing but praise for all of them from everyone that came for my group! i will definitely be returning

i chanced upon this travel tours on facebook group. the tour owner post more often which adds credibility. i book 1d1n balabac tour with them. all the transaction are done online (bank transfer and voucher and itinerary). by far, it was the biggest online transaction i had for a tour but never i had single thoughts or worry even the trip got more closer. they keep me updated time to time. trip: i had short brief about my balabac itinerary and got pick by van a bit late but acceptable since he pickup other guests too. i reached buliluyan port earlier than expected, there where i met tour personal guide jed. she is a local and had live in balabac and knows in and out of the island. she speaks well in english, filipino and cebuano. she made our balabac day trip seamless, enjoyable and memorable. patawan island and onuk island are the only two islands we choose and glad we did. they are best islands of all balabac and spend more time of these two paradise. accommodation- i had less expectation of where we stay in balabac since the island is still developing but the guesthouse we stayed is actually ok. somehow, exceeds my low expectation. it has ac, warm water, comfortable bed. food- we had seafood lunch in patawan island, prepare by the resort chef. nice dinner in balabac island, serve with class a grilled fish, can't complain our stomach is happy. transportation- boat from inter islands are small but do its purpose. highspeed boat from balabac island back to the main island port is fast and saves a lot of time. van transfer from city from/to port both are excellent drivers. overall, very happy with the service rendered my this tour company and staffs ms vanessa and ms jed. highly recommend them.

i climbed both mount kilimanjaro and meru with miles to smile and had an incredible experience on both trips! my guide, magnus, was very experienced and professional but also full of energy and extremely supportive when i was struggling during summit. i climbed kilimanjaro alone and had a blast with the whole team. i felt safe and never alone with such kind and fun people. the food was also delicious! while in a tent on the mountain, our chef prepared a range of impressive and diverse warm meals. on the logistical side i felt very well taken care of, and every part of the trip went smoothly. the miles to smile team gave me clear lists of what i needed and was able to lend me anything i did not have (including tent, sleeping bag and summit coat and pants). their equipment was of very high quality. i 100% recommend both kilimanjaro and meru with miles to smile, and i already look forward to going with them again!

i climbed this hill to watch the sunset over angkor wat. the trail starts just outside the south gate, and it takes about 20 minutes to reach the top. at the summit stands the pyramid-shaped temple of phnom bakheng, and from the upper level you can see the horizon. although sunset was around 6 p.m., many tourists began reserving good spots after 5 p.m., so it’s necessary to go up early to secure the best view. unfortunately, i wasn’t able to see the sunset, but the panoramic view from the top was spectacular and i was very satisfied.

i come to this market just to have some dinner. whoa, there are a lot of stalls in here. this is my first time having dinner in the market. there are crowded in here as well. i am walking around a little while just to find a suitable stall for it. there are many options xd. i came across a stall that has a show on netflix. which sounds so cool. i am going to several stalls for having a meal. the foods are definitely delicious. i am buying some sushi and chips for my snacks after the dinner. i have a wonderful time in here. i guarantee i will come again if i have a chance once again visiting korea because i want to try other foods as well. i love this market.

i completed my open water diver course with aquaventures and passed with great success thanks to alex and the entire team. unfortunately, i didn’t have much time, but the course was adjusted so i could finish in just two days. everything was very well organized and professional. alex is a cool and friendly guy, very knowledgeable and brings a lot of calmness to the dive sessions. excellent dive spots were chosen for my training. on the first day, countless sea lions swam around us, and on the second day, we dived with sharks, rays and turtles. on the third day, as a certified diver, i joined a dive at kicker rock and saw countless hammerhead sharks, galapagos sharks, turtles, sea lions, mantas and massive schools of fish. i would book with aquaventures again anytime! i contacted several dive centers and their offer was the best. thank you for the unforgettable experience!

i contacted andean ways in puno with super short notice (less than 12 hours, on a saturday) to ask for a transfer from puno to la paz. they have managed to organize this very well, both drivers on the peruvian and bolivian side were great and we could pay with card online. thanks for the help!

i contacted hassan nearly 1 month ago and he organized everything perfectly. starting from the airport transfer, to a wonderful day tour with an amazing lunch. he also helped us with anything we needed and he was always there in time! he and his team are very reliable and recommendable. if you want to have a relaxed holidays contact hassan and he will make your vacation in zanzibar perfect!

i contacted wet n wild explorations for a multi adventure 10 day trip in ladakh (early june 2025) with water rafting, kayaking, camping and treking; apart from local sightseeing. my husband and i requested tsering chotak to plan the entire itenary as an adventure trip. the rafting on the shoyk river and kayaking on the zanskar river were organised with all safety gear and precautions ensuring at the same time that we thoroughly enjoy the experience. each trip had a picnic lunch outside in the open with the tents pitched by the team. chotak convinced us to attempt a downhill bicycle ride - a distance of 35 km from warila to agyam. his team provided the gear and cycles meeting all safety requirements. this included a picnic lunch in the snow! so cool! a 5hr trek to hunder dok gave us the chance to see a beautiful gorge with the river flowing below... an exhilarating experience! camping in the open was very well organised with hot food, warm tents and sleeping gear following an environment friendly protocol and a crackling bonfire. the suv vehicle provided for our 10 day trip was most comfortable and was equipped with drinking water and oxygen cylinders. the entire wet n wild team were most helpful, knowledgeable, friendly and fun to be with. the hotels booked by the team very top class and luxurious. we even visited a ladakhi village and stayed at a homestay to experience village life! thank you chotak, rishav, mannu and your team of professional kayakers anton, daria and the support team rinzin, ramesh and norbu for a very exciting adventure trip that exceeded our expectations! will love to come again... good luck to u guys for your fantastic efforts... shilpa

i could have spend all day there. it’s a great spot for bores on all things army. the map room on the top floor is unique. dating back to louis xiv these maps are topographical (3d). they were used to plan defensive measure. the army from louis 14 to the collapse at sedan against germany occupies a floor. lots of good animations and exhibits. the basement was a history of charles de gaul.

i could hike this trail every day. what an incredible coastal trail with fantastic views and diverse terrain. we hiked it late in the day, and we saw maybe three people along the entire route. it's an absolutely idyllic part of the island. the feeling of walking here on an island in the middle of the ocean, where all you can hear is your own breathing and the sound of the waves, is incredible. here's to more places like this in the future!

i could not have asked for a better introduction to yellowstone national park than through yellowstone wild tours. emil and kyle both have such a passion for the land and the animals. they are both incredibly knowledgeable and very respectful of the animals space and our groups safety. every day was magical and full of animal sightings! we watched a bison give birth and we saw obsidian a momma grizzly, and her three cubs walk onto the same ridge where beryl, another momma grizzly, and her two cubs were eating. talk about an adrenaline rush!! it was an intense moment but both moms kept their cool and avoided conflict, keeping their babies safe. we also saw black bears, coyotes, a wolf, a bald eagle, marmot, dusty grouse, bison galore, a fox, a muskrat and a tiny peek at a pika. yellowstone is such a special place and i highly recommend yellowstone wild tours to show you it's beauty!

i could write a lot about this unique archipelago. that would be both to state the obvious, and repeat what already has been said, a million times over. lofoten should be experienced. at least once in a lifetime. be prepared for all kinds of weather. but it's beauty is not diminished by any weather. except perhaps if violently brutal to the point you have to stay indoors. during winter, even if that too will present another aspect of this fantastic gift to mankind. my little story in images begins with the ferry from bodø to moskenes, close to å and where the road ends. then a few pics along the road. plus a few non-road side. when i write this a few years have passed. in an increasingly more turbulent world, and increasingly more polarized political climate, lofoten may become my escape this year. but i'll let you who see these pictures, judge for yourself. want to get away from all sorts of noise? find some tranquillity? breathe fresh air? maybe do a little more than leg stretching? try lofoten. go there and be mesmerized. nice people, great seafood and vistas wherever you turn your head. pictures are taken in the following order: - while on the ferry - parts of lofoten from the sea - å, or close to å - sørvågen - reine - kabelvåg

i decided to book a sunset catamaran cruise with my kids while i was in waikiki. i heard about pink sails from a youtube video of all things. someone i follow went on a whale watching tour and it sounded great, however, because it’s august, it’s not whale season so i chose the sunset cruise instead. the weather was wonderful today with a few clouds and some wind. the crew members were friendly and fun and hard working to make sure everyone had a good time. the price of the cruise was extremely affordable. they played what i would call “all inclusive party music” while we sailed, which was fine by me but my daughter called it old music. we did some sailing out to a nice spot in open water where we went for a nice swim in the water for half an hour before carrying on towards diamond head until the sun almost reached the horizon and then we returned back to dock which was so enjoyable as i sat in the netting at the front of the boat watching the sunset. i would highly recommend doing this cruise. the only feedback for improvement would be that they need some signage or sandwich boards to let people know where to line up or check in as everyone was on shore wondering where to go and what to do before the cruise. other than that, the experience was well worth the cost and the crew are deserving of big tips.

i decided to read a little bit and ended up camped on a bench in front of castle geyser. there is a nice walking path in front of the geyser leading into the upper geyser basin. be sure to check when this geyser will erupt because it only goes off twice everyday. worth seeing if you can, especially to see the water cascading down the sides of the rocks

i did a tour with ahmed and zain tours in december 2024 and absolutely loved it! in short: i highly recommend ahmed and zain tours to anyone who does not just want to have a stereotypical tourist experience but also wants to have a more personal experience of the desert. especially the night under the stars is an awesome experience. ahmed is a great guide, who speaks excellent english, shares many intricate and intimate details about life in the desert, drives well, and also cooks tasty food. the tour itself allows you to see most of the best sights in the desert without feeling like you are just tourists being ferried to as many places as possible. it was not my first time in wadi rum, so i thought i knew what to expect, but ahmed absolutely exceeded my expectations. the communication before the trip was already great and once we arrived, we found ahmed to be a warm, talkative (speaks excellent english), very funny and knowledgeable guide. our first day consisted of a jeep tour through the desert where we saw some of the most important "must-see" sights. however, the schedule was not completely fixed - we could choose if we wanted to see certain things or not, so we elected to skip the parts that have to do with lawrence of arabia, as both my friend and i had already seen these. at each stop, ahmed was very easy-going with the time we had there. i never felt rushed, whenever we were ready to drive to the next stop, we would join ahmed back at the car or at the local bedouin tent for a tea. in the evening, after watching a great sunset, we slept under the stars in the desert, an experience i can absolutely recommend. despite the cold weather, ahmed brought enough blankets and mattresses and kept the fire going, so that we felt comfortably warm. it was also then when ahmed told us more about the desert and the bedouin way of life, which was a very special experience. the next day, we continued driving through the desert, going to some rather remote places to engage in some hiking. again, ahmed allowed us quite some say in what we wanted to do. i really recommend zain tours if you want to really experience the desert and its many facets, and if you want a guide that is more than just the driver, but who properly engages with you and answers all your questions!

i did my day skipper practical course in september with barcelona watersports, and the week i had when i arrived was incredible, thanks to our amazing instructor jude. jude's extensive nautical knowledge, passion for teaching, and encouragement genuinely inspired and motivated the entire crew daily. beyond the week, it left us feeling confident to go forward and pursue even more yachting qualifications. he had the answer to everything, and delivered the course in a way that the whole group could understand and felt comfortable with. he is a total asset to the organisation - and if you get the chance to be taught by him, you're lucky! the downside of booking with this company was that communication via email / telephone with the rest of the organisation prior to the trip was non existent and needs to be addressed, until jude thankfully took over upon arrival in bcn!

i did my first ski lesson here. the resort is location outskirts of saariselkä. you can reach there by ski bus. it opened on christmas day too. that's great. all staffs are welcoming and understanding. i reached to ski resort late on the lesson day as ski bus was not running with full schedule because of christmas. they understood and allowed me to take my ski lesson. the weather was bad on the day but worth it. the instructor is very friendly and helpful. if any one wants to do ski, go for it.

i did my research in advance and found jesse months before my trip to galapagos, and decided to do two days of scuba diving & 3 days of free diving (padi advanced course) with him. the whole experience was very amazing - during free diving, jesse really help pushed my limit and trained my btv, with all the practices with exhale dives, on the third day i was able to reach 37 meters through free immersion. during the open water free diving trips, i saw sharks and rays around, feels very different from scuba, 100% recommend! during scuba diving, i saw groups and groups of hammerhead sharks during the dives (which is why i go visit galapagos), thanks to jonathan, and tons of white tip sharks, groups of rays, huge turtles, etc. the dive shop provides great breakfast, amazing snacks between two dives, and lunch boxes after all the dives of the day. everybody is extremely friendly and easy to talk to. if you are not doing liveaboard in galapagos for scuba diving, i highly recommend this shop!

i did not expect to come into this bar and have this much fun. from the bartender to the music it was a vibe. it is english friendly so don’t be worried, come in and get a drink. enjoy the vibes and have fun… get on the pole.
i did not know what to expect when i decided to buy my ticket. the staff were friendly. i purchased cute cards to take home as gifts. the tower is nicely maintained. the view was beautiful.

i did not stay at the hotel, only visited the burj for a day trip. this was a very nice experience. views were phenomenal. we did the sky lounge ticket (skipped the 1.5hr line). the cost was worth it! we also had complimentary cookies, tea, and coffee on the 148th floor. it was neat to eat that i've visited the currently, tallest building in the world!

i did not stay at the resort, so this review concerns only the dive center. the dive masters were really nice and helpful, i had marsel and mogi (hope i spelled them correctly🤞🏼). they helped me burn my mask as it was getting foggy, they were showing lots of marine life underwater and they were overall attentive. saras were also nice on the boat and replying to my questions and helping out! one less positive aspect was the boat itself, it needs some maintenance and better time organization. the boat was late one morning because of technical issues, and another day there were delays because of the little space available for docking the boats in the harbor. regardless of the delays and wait time, we enjoyed amazing dives in cool dive sites! the design of their tshirts is very nice, i bought one! the dive equipment is in a good state and the dive masters are setting up everything on the boat for you, you only need to buddy check. they provide sunscreen on the boat, which is cool. but the best thing was the local tiger balm geliga which works wonders for opening up the ears and making equalizing easier! thank you for this life hack!! other points justifying the 4 star review: •wetsuits with some holes (but i guess its common in dive centers) •having to pay in full in order to book the dive online (usually you can pay a % in order to book your spot and the rest when you check-in) •creating groups of a mix between advanced and open water (luckily the best diving in the area is shallow, so we were not missing out on anything in the deep) - fast air consumption of someone in my group, but luckily my dive master assigned me to another group underwater so i could continue my dive while they ended their dive earlier (thank you sara for letting me tag along!)

i did not visit the hotel, i visited the hot springs so i won’t rate the rooms. the pricing is way too high in my opinion for what you get. don’t get me wrong the garden area and hot springs a re very pretty but small. there are three hot springs, on big one and two small ones. then there is a garden / jungle all around. i expected more hot springs for 17 euros per person and i honestly expected a little bit more of an authentic feel to it. the hot springs felt just like pools in the jungle not like actual natural hot springs. i absolutely disliked the fact that children are allowed to enter as it is supposed to be a relaxing experience and that is not possible with children under 16ish around. the locker system is extremely frustrating, i honestly recommend leaving your valuables at home. it is a beautiful place and a unique experience so please experience it for yourself but maybe regulate the standards.

i did some dives with tarzan in early march and had a great time! everyone was very friendly, equipment was well maintained and most importantly, there were lovely happy dogs! the trip to pianemo was amazing as well. i will come back for sure!

i did the 2 hour trail ride and it was fantastic. the ranch is beautiful. the staff was great. the ride takes you through beautiful scenery. it makes you feel like your group is the only one out there in the mountains.
i did the 5km circuit and it’s so beautiful and peaceful. easy walk. but very hot. have your hat, sunscreen and water. for the price you might want to do the longer hikes but they are more difficult
