my daughter and i had a thoroughly enjoyable and entertaining evening laon the ‘murder express’. from booking (and the needing to change the date) until last orders at the bar, we were given fantastic customer service. i have a hearing implant and was given a table in the centre so that i would be able see the actors clearly and also use my basic lip-reading skills. the meal was perfect and served by friendly, polite waiting staff. our cocktails were beautifully presented and of good quality. the whole atmosphere was fun (with a little bit of menace !). the actors interacted with the audience so everyone felt like part of the production. most people had dressed smartly or in 1920 costumes which all added to the theme of the show. i would definitely recommend this experience to friends and family. if you consider the price of a theatre ticket and meal, this experience was definitely value for money in my opinion.

my daughter and i had a wonderful 6 hour safari with steve. his expertise increased our chances of seeing some wonderful animals and birds including osprey, goldeneye, red grouse, deer, and red squirrel. he is friendly without being overbearing and shares his knowledge freely. recommended without reservations.

my daughter and i had the most amazing experience during the women’s retreat at spirit quest over the weekend! this is my 2nd time here and i can’t say enough wonderful things about it! the staff and programming always delivers beyond expectations, i highly recommend them and will definitely be coming back!

my daughter and i had the pleasure of taking our first surfing lesson with nick as our instructor, and i must say it was an incredible experience! nick took the time to carefully explain the basics of surfing, from the proper technique for paddling and standing up on the board to how to read the waves and catch the perfect one. he was patient, encouraging, and always willing to answer any questions we had. thanks to nick's expert guidance and encouragement, both my daughter and i were able to catch our first waves in no time! it was an incredible feeling, and i couldn't have asked for a better first surfing experience. i highly recommend nick as a surfing instructor to anyone looking to try their hand at this amazing sport. he has a true passion for surfing, and his positivity and expertise make him the perfect teacher for beginners like me. i can't wait to hit the waves again and continue learning from nick!

my daughter and i stayed for the weekend and the room was spacious and nicely decorated. the beds were comfortable. there was a nice patio outside our screen door with beautiful views. the entire home was clean. we arrived late friday night and we followed the instructions that i received by text. the key was in our door so that we could get in. we were not greeted the next day by anyone, as a matter of fact we didn't see anyone the entire time we were there. only texts were made for communication. after reading the reviews i expected to meet someone named megan or someone to at least greet us. it was very hot in our room, the furnace was on high all night long( felt like it was set to 80*) and it was very difficult to sleep. i could not close the vents as they were on the ceiling. also, i expected a tv and microwave in our room as it stated in the ad and there wasn't. as a matter of fact most of the things that were on the list in the ad were not in our room. if i had been there for one of their retreats, i would have been okay with that as there would have been other people to socialize with. it was very isolated and i only saw one person, a guest, walking out the back door, while i was there. one thing that really bothered me in the room was the bathroom sink faucet. the nuts that hold it in place were extremely loose and the faucet moved around when you turned it on. it only took me a minute to reach underneath the cabinet and tighten them. small details like that make a difference. it makes a place look shabby. overall it was an okay stay for the price.

my family and i had a great time with marin outdoor adventures. we had a private surf lesson with sandy and loved it so much we booked another lesson with her for the next day. sandy gave the three of us (all beginners) personalized instruction and made us feel so comfortable on our boards. she was great!

my family and i had a wonderful afternoon sailing on this ship. we experienced all kinds of weather and waves and the incredible landscapes and friendly crew made sure we enjoyed every bit of it. if you are ever in tórshavn, i highly recommend this tour!

my family and i had a wonderful experience with reef encounter! the hospitality from the crew members was outstanding — everyone was helpful, friendly, and genuinely amazing. one of us got certified by diving instructor david, who was extremely professional and provided excellent mentorship throughout the course. a special thanks to giordano, our snorkeling and diving guide — such a fantastic person who made every moment in the water feel safe and exciting. a big shout-out to chelsea, the talented and professional oceanic photographer, for capturing all the breathtaking moments with her stunning photos. and also to maria, who did an amazing job with housekeeping and made us feel welcome and comfortable throughout our stay. overall, the experience far exceeded our expectations — it was truly unforgettable. even a 5-star rating doesn’t seem enough to reflect how incredible it was. we highly recommend reef encounter to anyone looking for a once-in-a-lifetime adventure!

my family and i had an awesome time here ! staff were all extremely friendly and courteous. it was pretty cool chilling on the boat and enjoying the scenery before getting up on the jet skis. definitely recommend

my family and i had our eyes on this boat on our first trip to punta cana. this year we made it happen and weren’t this least bit disappointed. we did the private charter for 11 of us and we had a blast. the crew were top notch. assisting this bunch of “golden girls” everywhere we needed them. you don’t have to think twice about booking this excursion. and javiel took some awesome photos..!!

my family and i had the great pleasure of being guided by tomosa on his classic venetian styled boat. honestly, it wasn’t the boat, the possible sunset, or anything else that made the trip it was tomosa. hands down an exceptionally smart, humorous, and well spoken skipper. my husband and i enjoyed his stories and wit so much that we almost had to be reminded to take pictures. he was organized by explaining to us what we were doing, where we were going and when we would do certain things. i found him to be considerate of our elderly group member to ensure she made it into the boat safely. we just had such a great time with him and learning some of venice’s history. my husband and i love naval history and seeing venice from this perspective was so much fun. we drank prosecco, the whole bottle. i would highly recommend take a cruise with him, sunset, no sunset… it’s still an absolute blast to talk to him and hear all the wonderful historical stories.

my family and i planned to move to israel with our four children. it was very important to us to have a comfortable beautiful home when we arrived. we bought and planned a house renovation while living abroad. efrat was instrumental in planning, coordinating and executing the project. she is a wizard with space and used every corner efficiently to accommodate a family of 6. i could trust her to design something beautiful and functional according to my taste and style. we arrived to a perfect house with towels in the bathroom and sheets on the bed. it felt as if we had a family member looking out for us. once we arrived she was also there to help us with any questions with the house. i highly recommend efrat and her team and would and will continue to use her!

my family and i recently stayed at the arenal manoa hot springs resort as part of my 50th birthday celebration. the staff’s service was on par with a four seasons, and in some respects better. the level of detail they went out to make my family and me feel special was simply amazing! the hotel itself was beautiful with amazing views of the volcano. we appreciated very clean rooms and turn down service. i can’t express enough how much i enjoyed the stay at this hotel!

my family and i spent 5 days at patagonia camp and it was an amazing experience that we will remember forever! the staff were extremely friendly and welcoming, the food was delicious, the excursions were phenomenal, and the yurts were so comfortable with an amazing view. i hope to go back someday and highly recommend going!

my family and i stayed here for 3 nights. whilst the location was great, whether heading to la fortuna town for an evening or to the surrounding sites. the resort itself is quite large and has a busy feel. the staff were all friendly. the rooms itself were quite dated and we found the plant in the bathroom slightly strange. the breakfast buffet was disappointing. the fresh fruit was the best part of it and the rest was not incredible. there are plenty of awesome coffee shops up and down the main road that we would recommend instead.

my family and i stayed on the andamari boat and had a truly unforgettable experience. from the incredible food to the trekking and snorkeling excursions, everything was fantastic. the staff were caring, fun, and genuinely kind. thank you for making our trip so special!

my family and i stopped into this store a couple of weeks ago to grab a few drinks. yes, they had a good selection of items, but the staff is absolutely atrocious. it was a little cramped where the line was forming and i was trying to be polite and move out of the way. a young woman employee came through and rudely waved her hands to move us all out of the way without saying a word. then as the line moved up, the male employee behind the counter rudely announced that we had to be on the white circle. i never saw the white circle on the floor, but if i had i wouldn't have even known what it was for. maybe put up better signage if you're so strict about how or where the line forms! if it hadn't been for us being so parched from the heat, those drinks would have gone right back on their shelves. we go on many cruises and will be back in san juan, but i will refuse to go back here so employees can speak to my family so rudely and condescendingly.

my family and i took a walking tour through 3 villages with lydia and it was absolutely amazing! the views were incredible and we were away from the crowds. lydia really made the experience - she was so personable & such a joy to be around. she taught us so much about the history and culture and it felt like we were friends at the end! truly was one of the highlights of the trip!! these arizonans can’t rave about it enough!! can’t wait to go back :)

my family and i traveled to squid acres on the denali highway and it was an absolute highlight of our time in alaska. the dogs were incredible, and the hospitality and information cody and paige shared about their experiences competing in races and raising and racing dogs was amazing. we also loved the private atv tour/hike with paige and retired dog nova in the afternoon. for the time spent and the insights gained from the owners, it was a bargain and i'd recommend it to anyone who is in the denali area.

my family and i truly enjoyed this park. we purchased a self guided tour and we managed to complete our hike in about 2 hours. sadly, we didn't encounter any animals on our hike but we all truly enjoyed this nature trail. the trails were easy to access and well marked. it felt safe and secure. the pathway was paved and with a safety railing on the edge. there are a total of 6 hanging bridges and you have the option at several markers to loop back to end your hike. there's a public restroom at the entrance and a gift shop which were very convenient. i highly recommend it when in la fortuna area!

my family and i wanted a boat day where we could adventure out and see the islands surrounding croatia and near where we were staying and this did not disappoint. we stayed at sun gardens and asked if pick up could be at the dock there to make it easy for us and they responded quickly saying it wouldn’t be a problem. orset (not positive of the spelling) was wonderful. as we got onto the boat he was super friendly and instantly made us feel comfortable letting us know he had refreshments and could turn on our music if we’d like. he then gave us a rough layout of what we wanted to do and what he suggested. we visited 2 islands and ate dinner at one and it was a wonderful experience. our kids got to play at the beaches and we had delicious gelato. he never made us feel rushed and tried to cater to us best he could. traveling with 3 kids is a lot but the boat was one of the best experiences we’ve had on any of our trips. i would highly recommend without a doubt!

my family and i went for the friday night fireworks. crazy crowded! still we had a good time. we walked along the beach and dipped our toes in the water once before a high tide alert sent us scurrying.

my family and i went on a discover banff tour the other day and we were very happy with the outcome of the tour. we got to see many amazing sights during the day. our tour guide, ray was super knowledgeable about the area and all of the stops we went to. (bonus he was also very funny). i would highly recommend this company to anyone looking to explore banff or any surrounding areas.

my family and i who are tourists visited the vantage point from where we could see this crater "in all its glory." and as bonus, the said vantage point is also where you can have a magnificent view of lake toya and the resort town of toyako onsen. by the way, my family and i made our way to the vantage point by 4x4.

my family did a total of six certified dives and also surfing lessons with clear waters and we all agree the organization was tops: very professional service, always available online, excellent english-speaking guides, good quality equipment. absolutely would use again!

my family had a blast with go hawaii, they were so professional and made the day amazing. we did the parasailing and the snorkeling. it was an incredible experience and i would do it all again. the parasailing was my first time and my daughters (9 and 12) absolutely loved it. the snorkeling, while we didn’t see any turtles or fish, it was just an amazing party on boat. we loved swimming in the middle of the ocean and the crew made us feel comfortable and had plenty of refreshments for everyone! book this company, they were amazing!

my family had the very best day of our vacation with moses. we were picked up at our condo at 630am. we traveled to yellowstone and along the way we had many conversations about how this part of the country was formed. moses was the best guide and taught us so much about wyoming. we were able to see bears, elk, bison and even a grizzle with 2 cubs. he knew all the best places to go and see the wonders. we stopped at a wonderful park, by the river, and had a delicious lunch that he provided. the park was private and on a beautiful river. i cannot say enough about our experience. it was marvelous and well worth every dime. we will return

my family just did a quick stay at dunia camp and it could not have been more perfect. every detail was well thought out and the staff couldn’t have been more hospitable. i can’t imagine a single detail that would have made this trip better. a huge shout out to our driver, irene, who took great care of us on the drives. i can’t recommend dunia camp enough.
my family just start to live in ak since oct 2018 , this is the first trip for denali , we would like to see this place in winter and summer, so it is time to stat, we really love this place

my family of 11 had a great time at tulum tower. the staff was amazing and our hostess in the sky, candy, kept the party going. it was such a great time and the views were amazing. most definitely worth the money!

my family of 4 had a blast at twist! my kids had a lot of fun with the exhibits and my husband and i enjoyed learning about the science of the illusions. i highly recommend this activity that allowed us to escape the heat and chaos of london for a little more than an hour. we booked our visit the morning of, so we didn't have to wait once we arrived....and the staff were friendly. the place was clean and not crowded, so we really enjoyed our visit.

my family of 4 had a blast at twist! my kids had a lot of fun with the exhibits and my husband and i enjoyed learning about the science of the illusions. i highly recommend this activity that allowed us to escape the heat and chaos of london for a little more than an hour. we booked our visit the morning of, so we didn't have to wait once we arrived....and the staff were friendly. the place was clean and not crowded, so we really enjoyed our visit.

my family of 5 adults and 2 teenagers had an amazing time at denali raft adventures. we are a pretty strong group of paddlers (minus my mom who was pretty much just asked to hold on) so dylan was the rock star who took us straight for the rapids! he really knows the sport and the river. highly recommend! take the canyon run and choose paddling! don't be an oar-rider! we happened to be there on an unusually warm day so we had no issues with being cold. there were a few suits and booties with some leaking but we stayed mostly dry on the inside. just layer up if it is cold and go for it! my sister-in-law thought i was crazy for booking but absolutely loved it. total highlight for the 15yr old nephew. and my mom (77) loved dylan!

my family of 5 visited this neat little museum in puno and spent about an hour there. there are 3 floors, and photos are not allowed on the first 2 floors, which is where all the information is about coca. too bad - there are some pretty neat displays and excellent historical and contemporary information alongside some photogenic artifacts. on the first floor you can sit in a small theatre and watch a 10 minute movie which basically summarizes the museum’s info, and is quite interesting. the top floor has a wonderful collection of extremely colourful costumes worn in the annual february parade for candelaria. you can try them on and take photos. fun! if the door to the museum is locked, the employee may be explaining items to tourists on the upper floors. i think there’s a bell to ring. we enjoyed our visit and learned a lot. recommended!

my family of 5 went barron river rafting and it was great! this river was an exhilarating experience perfect for a family or group of friends. the rapids were the perfect balance of fun and safe. our tour guides, harry and marco were extremely friendly and made sure we felt safe! thumb up to the photographer as well. she took amazing photos. i cannot recommend this more!

my family recently visited the ella swing where you can get a spectacular view of the ella rock. the visit itself was spectacular and will be a memorable family moment for years to come. here are some travel tips that may help you: (1) the view of the ella rock is best seeing from the spot where the ella swing & little adams peak are located. this is all in the same location at the top of the same steep hill. autos are able to take you to the top where you can explore all three attractions. the walk to the top is not a short one and quite steep. there are little stalls/shops selling water and snacks along this hill. the drive is bumpy but it's a lovely view of the ella rock and the high elevation/and green landscape. * both my children went on the ella swing and it was fabulous experience for them (and for us watching ). we did not rent the dresses as my daughter took her own. this is a must do if you enjoy heights and want to get some memorable photos of the incredible view of the ella rock. other tips for your stay in ella: * booking a hotel in ella town makes it very convenient to travel to the ella rock, and other attractions and restaurants. * the commute from our hotel in ella town to the ella rock (which is viewable from the ravana pool club / ella swing) was about 10-15 mins (or less from our hotel). * while there are no 'mosquitoes or bugs flying around visibly', the area is rich in biodiversity, dense with numerous varieties of flora and fauna - which could cause bug bites (especially if you are new to the country/and travelling with children). make sure to take some after bite cream and to dress comfortably. any other question - don’t hesitate to reach out and enjoy your trip :)
my family stayed with paramount tent house for 2 days. it was very comfortable and unique stay for us. host was ver good and respectful. we liked the food. they cooked food for my small kids too.

my family took the 10:00 champagne boat tour to view the bastille day (fete nationale) fireworks. we couldn't have chosen a more perfect way to celebrate the holiday! the service from start to finish was well organized and professional. our viewing spot to see the drone and fireworks show over the eiffel tower was fabulous! we had fun meeting new people and enjoying the show. we returned to the dock a little after midnight. this trip was well worth the cost and not having to deal with crowds of people near the tower.

my family was pleasantly surprised with our visit here. while it is a little awkward to get to on foot, the site itself is wonderful to walk around in. the best way to see it however is to join a free tour. the tour in informative and explains a lot of the different buildings and rooms you are visiting. it was great to learn more about the war of 1812. even though it wasn't great weather, we all enjoyed our little tour there. the fact that it is free of charge is excellent, i think more museums and historical sites should be this way, so that made me like it even more. i highly suggest adding it to your list of places to visit while in toronto.

my family went on a full day fishing trip and it was one of the highlights of our trips to the faroe islands! i can really recommend going fishing with blástein. we caught a lot of fish, and had a really great time the whole day. and the views from the boat are amazing! it is possible to keep all the fish you catch, so you can eat it for dinner or take it home to your own country! 10/10 for us!

my family went on a horse ride at the tail end of autumn and this place is the only one open in the area during the season. adan was very accommodating even though we were running a bit behind due to the roads being slick and icy. he loaned us snow pants that i’m glad we used because it was cold at the top of the hill. amazing views at the top!

my family went on a sunset sailing cruise and had the best time. they are very organized, pick you up and drop you back to your hotel. it was very easy to communicate with them & they were very responsive. they took us to the most beautiful spots, the food was delicious & the staff were phenomenal. super nice people. very reasonably priced too. this was definitely a highlight on our trip.

my father and i decided on an adventure in tanzania. my father is 79 years old and this was a big dream of his. our goal was to climb with a local tour company (as a lot of tours are owned outside of tanzania). this particular tour company was recommended and we decided to book our trip. our goal was to climb kilimanjaro in 8 days on the lomosho trail and then after the climb do a safari. upon landing in kilimanjaro, the internet at the airport crashed and we couldn’t get our visas for over three hours, our plane was already late an hour upon arrival. edwin and frank were patiently waiting for us outside the airport and greeted us with huge smiles and immediately we felt like we were in good company and would be well taken care of during our trip. edwin set us up with our climbing team, with lead guide chuwa, and assistant guide stephen. they took us up the mountain with our 6 porters and cook joseph. the food was awesome, home cooked and always wholesome ingredients, with many tastes of african home cooking. we had snacks and popcorn on the mountains for breaks. we were never hungry or thirsty the whole time. the service exceeded our expectations. chuwa was a master leader on the mountain and he and his team got myself and my father to the summit. coming down the mountain was a challenge for my father, and chuwa’s team was amazing at helping him, beyond words and gratitude. my father had some medical complications after the climb and edwin and frank were there to help with grace and expertise in moshi and arusha. we managed a safari for one day and our guide was hafidh was a professional at his task and answered all of our questions about africa, the culture, the people, the animals, the trees and flowers, we tried to stump him, but couldn’t. i can’t recommend edwin and his taste of kilimanjaro tour company enough or even thank them enough to get us through our trip safely with grace and kindness. if you’re thinking about this tour company you won’t be disappointed, they handled everything, the good and the bad. this will always be a lifetime achievement for myself and my 79 year old father. thank you again, edwin, frank, chuwa and hafidh!

my favorite activity i did on my trip to dubai, the staff was so friendly and helpful!!! the views are breathtaking and the water was so clean!! i absolutely would do this again, if your looking to have a great time and learn more about oman you’ll love this!!! the captain was so knowledgeable and helpful when it came to getting in the water!!! you feel very safe and comfortable in the water!!! definitely coming back because i left my heart in oman!!!

my favorite area to spend a day, or two or three! historical, beautiful, lively and with great restaurants straddling both arabic and jewish life. the flea market was awesome but the views from the top were stunning too. every bit of it is wonderful!

my favorite beach in jeju! could not believe what i saw! (such milky sea water) my, what a sight! you are beautiful. and it was during the storm mitak so can’t really imagine what it’s like on a summer’s day

my favorite beach on the island, very wild and beautiful. gorgeous blue waters with amazing reef area, tons of large fish and even saw a sting ray. highly recommend snorkeling here. definitely need a car to get here. take care of the beach and don’t liter!

my favorite dive center in the uae. excellent guides and instructors, and the only dive center i trust for completing dive certifications/ licensing. the whole dive team at freestyle divers is amazing. neil, jess, misha, jackson and all other staff members are the best! the flexibility and willingness to put effort to provide the clients with their desired dive trip is outstanding. the high levels of attentiveness to marine life as well as their great concern for diver’s safety allows me to comfortably recommend them to my family and friends. keep on being the best at what you do 💙
my favorite flea market in berlin. i bought small jewelry for 2 euros 😁😁

my favorite hike. we always see animals when we hike this trail. antelope, bison, bears... this is my go-to hike when i visit yellowstone every summer. there is a bathroom at the trail head. i recommend hiking early morning for most animal activity and cooler weather in the summer.

my favorite national park in usa came visit 5 times already. always beautiful all seasons. this month is april still cold snow vibes and stay at curry village 2 nights. so much fun hiking camping in curry tent. highly recommended.

my favorite part was the mirror maze and then downstairs! wonderful adventure, definitely worth seeing if you’re in the mood for some indoor fun.
my favorite place in quebec city: heritage building, beautiful stores and restaurants. you can feel european vibe there.
my favorite place in the world...

my favorite place in zanzibar to get away from the crowds and the noisy traffic. the area is very quiet, peaceful and gets very few visitors. it's a guided tour around a part of the forest. you'll learn about the history of the area, the plants that grow there and about the wildlife that live here. do bring something to keep you hydrated.
my favorite place to hunt tomica,shirt,bag,also other toys,must go early,they open at 9am,also have a lot of food truck,so easy to find drink and food

my favorite place to walk in the world. it is never ever the same scenery as the ships are always moving and the seasons make the ambiance different all the time. it is a perfect 5km from park royal to a bit past dundarave so 10km is an easy park, run and back. i have walked here early at 5am and as late as 1230am and it is super safe and well lit. i have been going here for over 25 years and it only keeps getting better.

my favorite spot in quebec city! great place to go for a run or picnic. a vast area consisting of parks, museums, easy trails, viewpoints, etc. that was once a battlefield. not a lot of opportunities to read up on the history of the city, but for a fee, visitors get a tour of the citadel, which is otherwise restricted to public.

my favorite tea house on this trek so far!! the owners are so lovely and hospitable. beds were comfortable and they provided extra blankets for us in the winter 🥹 love the attached bathroom, shower, and wifi! thanks so much for a great stay 💛

my favorite “park”. a great getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city. a huge plus is that there are no macaques here. good diversity of migratory birds and other wildlife. try to go during low tide to spot the crocodiles. hard to get public transport/taxi/grab, will need to drive in

my favourite attraction in gardens by the bay! only $12 entrance fee and beautiful walk near at tree canopy level overlooking the flyover, marina sands bay and the park! great place to take pictures and enjoy the view! the walk itself is not long, but you'll be outside, so it's probably good otherwise would be risking a heat stroke! highly recommended to visit especially as a tourist!

my favourite beach. i have been coming here almost every day for my whole life, and it has so much to offer: swimming, bunnies, forest walks, fish and chips, kayaking, paddle boarding, the folk festival, and so much more! be respectful of the wildlife in this park and don't feed the animals or walk where you're not supposed to 🐇 *i would like if the city was more open about what they were doing with the bunny population, because they have removed all of the plants that provided them shelter (it looks like chernobyl) and now the bunnies are spread out all over the park.
my favourite park in paris. it’s got different areas with beautiful foliage and buildings, and peacocks just walking around. don’t miss the mini waterfall to the west side of the park!
my favourite pub crawl. the host gives a comedic tour of parts of the city, and we get free booze along the way! i loved his story about the statues on the rudolfinum.

my favourite shop for clothes in venice. exceptionally well-informed, talented and helpful staff. different price ranges and overall very inspiring. i highly recommend a visit to sangue blue in venice.

my favourite smaller park in cdmx. highly recommend the fresh juices sold near the baltimore exit. the park is best for walking doggos. having lived nearby for a year i am happy to report that not much has changed in the last 8 years. 🌳🐩

my fiancé and i had a great time visiting the jeju world natural heritage centre and walking the trails. you first must book a reservation before going (you won’t receive a confirmation email, just a confirmation on the webpage). once you arrive there is a check in space where you pay and get your ticket. you then go to sign up for the tour, i assume, we weren’t fully sure since none of the staff spoke english. our time slot was at 9 am. inside the natural heritage centre you can see exhibits, use the washroom and access wifi. we did this while we waited for the rest of the group. there were about 30 people on this tour, maybe more, people of all ages but everyone spoke korean so we were a little left out. the tour guide was amazing, she kept a great walking/hiking pace and seemed to have a lot of knowledge (i wouldn’t know as it was entirely in korean). my only complaint is that you must stay with the group, we thought we could maybe hike the course on our own, but it’s a large group and you can get caught behind some slow walkers. also there is a decent amount of talking, so the 2 hour section we did about half hour of it i’d say was explanations and stopping to talk. the trail itself is beautifully laid out, lots of steps/stairs and then carpeted trail and lovely look out points!

my fiancé and i have been avid members of creekside kayaks for three fantastic seasons now, and it's been an absolute blast! first and foremost, the staff is simply outstanding. they're not only friendly and welcoming but also incredibly smart and efficient. they take care of us from the moment we arrive, making sure we have everything we need for a safe and enjoyable kayaking experience. the kayaks are well-maintained and a breeze to use, and the life jackets they provide are super easy to wear. one of the things we love most about kayaking at false creek is the chill atmosphere that allows us to reconnect with ourselves and the water. the location is a piece of paradise within the city. and speaking of which, it's super easy to get to, making our kayaking adventures even more convenient. the scenery is just amazing! we get to see all sorts of wildlife, like cormorants, sea gulls, and if we're lucky, even some sea lions. while there are various water activities around, including water ferries and yachts, the water is remarkably calm, making it a breeze to navigate through. the two-hour rental per session is perfect. it gives us plenty of time to soak in the beautiful surroundings and make the most of our day on the water. and what's even better is that after just five sessions, the pass practically pays for itself – can't beat that! all in all, kayaking at creekside kayaks has become an annual tradition we eagerly look forward to each season. it's an excellent way to spend the summer in the city. if you're looking for a remarkable kayaking experience with friendly staff, top-notch equipment, and a serene spot right in the heart of the city, creekside kayaks is the place to be. you won't be disappointed!

my fiancé and i took a 2-week birding tour with sustain safaris from cape town to bloemfontein through west coast national park, tankwa karoo, cape point, betty's bay, agulhas, de hoop, wilderness, and karoo national park. we saw 303 species of birds and saw all but one of our target endemic species (only missed it because of the weather), which is an incredible feat! michael knew exactly where to find each species. we also saw many mammals and a few reptiles, which were nice bonuses. we stayed in nice, but not luxurious places (at our request to keep the tour price lower) and michael was keen to eat wherever we wanted to (even trying vegan restaurants with us)! the way that he tailored the tour to our requests and budget was incredible! it's also great that the company is owned and operated by a south african instead of a major international birding tour company. michael is also a keen conservationist and puts part of the money from each tour into conservation, ensuring that there will always be nature in south africa and beyond. overall, i'd highly recommend anyone to book a tour through sustain safaris! michael is a wildlife expert, very personable, flexible, and dedicated wildlife tour provider.

my fiancée and i visited siberia station spa for a couples massage and to enjoy the facilities, and it's a really beautiful spot tucked away in the wilderness. getting an uber from quebec city was super convenient, only about a 20-minute ride, which made it an easy escape. the natural setting by the river is definitely a highlight and perfect for a relaxing spa day. upon arrival, everything looked great, and the initial impression is impressive. the massage itself was pretty good, and the staff we interacted with were kind and attentive. we'd certainly recommend considering a treatment here. the spa facilities, like the various hot tubs and saunas, are spread out nicely in the forest, and it wasn't overly crowded during our visit. we often found ourselves with a hot tub or sauna to ourselves, or with just a couple of other people, which was a big plus. however, there are a couple of key things future visitors should be aware of. firstly, when i booked our couples massage, i was under the impression from their website that access to the spa facilities was included. their site mentions your spot is "guaranteed" with a massage booking, which to me implied it was part of the package. unfortunately, that's not the case. access to the thermal experience is an additional charge – it was about $180 extra for the two of us on top of the already fairly expensive massage. this wasn't clear upfront, and honestly, felt a bit shady. for a high-end experience, transparency on this significant extra cost should be much better. secondly, they require you to wear footwear around the facility for hygiene, which is understandable. however, they don't provide complimentary slides. you either have to bring your own or purchase theirs for $15 a pair. given the spa's wilderness location and the desire to maintain hygiene, it feels like they could include basic, recyclable slides in the entry or treatment price, rather than upselling something most people will likely discard. the facilities themselves are generally very nice and set in that beautiful location. while they are mostly well-kept, a little deep cleaning here and there and some minor maintenance would really elevate the experience, though i get that maintaining everything perfectly in a wilderness setting presents challenges. overall, we had a nice and relaxing experience at siberia station spa, and i would recommend it to others looking for a nature spa escape near quebec city. the massages are good, the staff are pleasant, and the setting is serene. just be prepared for the extra cost for facility access if you're booking a treatment, and bring your own sandals! with clearer communication on costs and perhaps a couple of minor tweaks, this place could easily be one of the top spa destinations in the quebec area.

my first safari experience in africa was back in july 2018 and it was a 2-week safari trip to tanzania with my son, who was 20 years old then. i knew i would be back to this amazing continent in consideration of the fabulous experience we both had. as a globetrotter for almost 3 decades and from my previous travel to tanzania, i have no doubt that in order to fully enjoy the safari experience, i must look for the most reliable service provider and a very good private ranger/guide for my second safari visit, but this time in south africa and i was going as a couple with my hubby. after extensive research, i concluded with safari.com as i was intrigued by one of their packages in their website i.e. a 7-day safari experience which included a 3-night stay at kruger shalati (within the kruger national park, south africa) and another 3-night stay at the wallow lodge (within the victoria falls national park, zimbabwe). the package also included a 1-day trip to botswana (chobe national park & river safari in chobe river). i was extremely fortunate to have found kim abrahams from safari.com to be my liaison/coordinator for the planning and administration of this trip (31 dec 2024 to 6 jan 2025). kim was courteous, accommodative and followed up thoroughly on all aspects of this trip including diligently assisting us with the 3 flights which we had to take during this trip. this was despite she was on vacation! thank you, kim! the experience at kruger shalati and the wallow lodge was excellent as they provided top-notch service and both resorts were relatively new (less than 5 years). the safari guides/rangers for both the facilities were amazing & despite that dec/jan being a "low season" for animal sightings, we managed to see all big 5 within our second game drive. both facilities even had dedicated servers throughout our stays with them and they were all very lovely. should there be one thing which needed improvement, it would be for the wallow lodge to accept private game drive/outing (especially when i was more than willing to pay the extra for going on private basis.) kim had tried to make it happen prior to my confirmation with safari.com. kruger shalati agreed, and without hesitation, i topped up the difference. unfortunately, the wallow lodge informed kim that they did not offer this option anymore (even with the topping-up of the rate). but i was thankful that i was able to discuss with the manager of the wallow lodge after my first game drive and she managed to arrange a private ranger/guide for the rest of my stay in zimbabwe. unfortunately, this was not possible for the 1-day trip to botswana and that did not turn out too pleasantly. i could not believe that there were two american ladies in our group of 10 people who were actually smoking within the national park during our game drive stopover (for some drinks) and the ranger/guide did not stop them from doing so. it would be disastrous for both the park and animals should their actions actually started a fire! with the exclusion of the botswana group game drive, i would say everything else was perfect for me and my hubby. hence, thank you, kim and safari.com for making it a memorable experience for us. should anyone who is reading this article is considering a safari experience, look no further. you will never regret going with safari.com and consider yourself very fortunate if you have kim abrahams to be your coordinator.

my friend recommended this hike during our visit. i had wanted to do a hike while we were there and she thought this would be a great one for the views and the difficulty. we made a reservation to go early, which was the best decision because i cannot imagine climbing this in the heat. it was very easy to check in and the staff was very friendly. we did not have any issues finding parking, but the lot was pretty full. if it is the summer, i definitely recommend wearing something breathable, especially if you choose to wear long sleeves to protect your skin. it was uv 11 basically the whole time we were there so it was pretty hot going up. i also highly recommend good shoes and clothing you would wear to work out or do more intense activity. i am used to hikes, so we had sneakers and light clothes. we saw many people in sandals, crocs, sweatpants, sweatshirts, and so on. i noticed a lot of people struggling to climb up, as the path is not paved once you get on the actual crater, it is natural rock and you make your own path in a way. i thought it was a truly amazing hike with absolutely beautiful views. i would say it would be difficult to do with younger kids or older adults who are not very mobile or agile. there’s a section with very steep stairs that would be hard for them to get up, but i believe they also have a ramp. there is also a tunnel with about a 6 foot clearance, which is not a problem for most people. my boyfriend is 6’5”, so he did have to bend down some, but he was able to get through everything. overall i would recommend hiking it if you are able, but i would definitely say it’s a more moderate to hard hike than easy, especially in the heat.

my group and i had the best 8 days exploring the grand canyon thanks to the knowledge, care, and leadership of our crew. den, orion, jacque, and parker provided amazing meals, fun hikes, immaculate attention to detail, and great stories along the way! i will never forget my time down there thanks to everyone at gce.

my group had an awesome time on the pink cat party boat. the drinks and food were fantastic and they even let us play our own music. the highlight of the excursion was the floating bar in the water. thank you to javier and the crew for making sure we had a great experience!

my group rented a private catamaran for 14 to isla mujeres. the team on the tour made this successful. they kept the music pumping, the drinks flowing, and were constantly checking in with us. these guides really made each of us feel special and seen! i give them the highest ratings on professionalism. if you have the chance, go with this company.

my heart is exploding with happiness!!!!!!!!!!!!!! our tour guide ann was amazing!!! there are no actual words to explain what an incredible experience our jeep tour was!!!! this was definitely the highlight of our trip! this is a must do in my opinion. if you visit sedona i highly highly highly highly highly recommend you do a jeep tour! it's a completely different experience to not have to drive yourself around and go site seeing or hike! we were able to give our attention to our kids 100 percent of the time all while exploring the vortex's and outdoors. we can't wait to go back!

my highlight of wadi rum; a narrow fissure with many ancient inscriptions and rock art. it’s one of the most popular desert tourist destinations, so you need to be one step ahead of coaches as the tricky high path is only just wide enough for two people to pass. i would definitely recommend sturdy footwear as the rocky path is uneven, sloping and dusty!

my hike in copacabana, bolivia was totally epic! the views were mind-blowing, with stunning mountains and lake titicaca in sight. the trail was challenging but totally worth it. it felt like a real adventure exploring ancient ruins and soaking in the rich history. the only downside was the altitude, which made it tough to catch my breath at times. i had to make like 5 stops and it was crazy hot. but all in all, super amazing!

my husband and a friend and i did this wine tour together in the fall in sedona, and it was absolutely perfect! jim was an excellent tour guide, and curated a special day for us! first, we stopped to get some special chocolates to eat with our wine tastings. then we started at a beautiful local winery named alcantara, which was just a lovely place to sit and enjoy the fall - but also had delicious wines! next we went to have dinner and wine at the merkin vineyard on the hill in cottonwood - such a special place to visit! last we checked out redwall distillery in sedona, which was a lovely way to end the day! the choices of places to visit were very eclectic, and suited every palate. jim was an excellent host/tour guide, and made sure all of our needs were met. he also took many pictures for us, so that we didn’t need to take pictures ourselves, and therefore could be more present in the experience. we had the best day! i highly recommend wine tours of sedona!

my husband and i absolutely loved this hike. it is technically easy and mostly flat the whole way. you are in the sun for the entire 6 miles so bring a hat, sunscreen and plenty of water. the breezes coming off the water kept it from being too hot which was nice. the views are stunning the whole way but the point is exquisite. make sure you walk through the gate to go all the way to the point. the mountains are stunning against the crashing waves. breathtaking! we saw tons of albatross! totally worth the trek. highly recommend.

my husband and i and a friend did both the city bus tour and the swamp tour. both were excellent. brian did a great job giving us history of new orleans. the swamp tour is about an hour bus ride to where you take the actual swamp tour. captain tony was our swamp guide. he was awesome. we got to see lots of alligators including elvis and bubbles. we saw wild boar and raccoons. it was a great experience!! definitely recommend cajun encounters.

my husband and i are both serious photographers. this exhibit was exceptional in both the photographer’s skill with a camera and teaching us today through the visual images, the history of the country in the last half century. absolutely magnificent. thank you for providing the public and us travelers into the icelandic world.

my husband and i booked a beginners guided tour with them and had an amazing experience we'll never forget. it was our first time ever trying kayaking and neither of us can swim that well. we had been thinking of taking it up for the longest of time but had been too afraid. through their training and guidance, they made it feel so easy and so enjoyable that we have now become confident enough to go kayaking by ourselves. thank you so much for helping us get over our fears and to actually enjoy the experience. amazing team, amazing place, and everything was just perfect ❤️ ps: besides a kind and friendly guide we also got a personal photographer. thanks marnie for the tour and the beautiful photographs of us trying kayaking for the first time.

my husband and i booked a couples massage while in town on holiday. booking was simple and straightforward. the space is clean and nicely decorated, and very easy to find. yim and priya did a fantastic job of our massages, leaving us both in a dreamlike state. the price was very reasonable for what we got, and we are considering booking additional services before we leave. would fully recommend!

my husband and i booked a private excursion with seapro. luis picked us up at the beach and it was a smooth ride to our boat with pepe and carlos. richard who was from infinity photos was our photographer who took beautiful photos of our family everyone was so kind and fun! it was our first time as a family who did snorkelling and we saw amazing sea creatures. my kids loved the dolphins in the sea lions, especially the sea turtles. carlos and pepe were great host made us feel safe and comfortable and it was just a great experience i definitely recommend this to anybody who goes to punta cana dominican republic.

my husband and i booked a private tour from fes to chefchaouen with fes city travel. our driver/guide, badr, organized the trip. from start to finish we had such an amazing experience and i can't imagine having gone on this trip without using this company. i would absolutely recommend them. badr, our driver, was super polite and professional. he made himself available whenever we needed a ride. he really went above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience. thank you very much

my husband and i booked the 1 day trip to the salt flats, and had such a wonderful time. we booked onto the english speaking tour, and our guide josé was amazing- friendly, informative and a good laugh! he answered any questions we had with ease and i really appreciated that he gave us some context to all the sites we visited throughout the day. the lunch provided was delicious (and generous!), and watching the sun set with a glass of wine in hand was truly magical. we loved our tour and would 100% recommend booking this if you're heading over to uyuni.

my husband and i booked the package for 2. our first time at a hammam. we do a lit if spas and retreats in the uk and cannot recommend highly enough. the hammam was great fun and a brilliant experience and the massage is the best i’ve had. topped off with a gorgeous facial. we both loved it, was a really special visit for us. thank you.

my husband and i booked the wine and food experience and absolutely loved it!! if you are a white wine fan stopping here is an absolute must. the woman who led the experience was very friendly and knowledgable. learning about the different grapes, history, and processes on how the wine is made in santorini was fascinating. not to mention every single wine and food pairing we ate we enjoyed. sooo delicious. thank you again!!

my husband and i celebrated our newly engaged friends here and this place was perfect! we sat outside and had yummy eats and champagne. the server was also very nice. this was a perfect late night eating vibe. we’d definitely return.

my husband and i did 3 straight days of kite surfing lessons with daniel and 2 days of surfing lessons. we absolutely loved it! we've always dabbled with kiting and surfing but never really "got going" properly. with daniel we were quickly up and riding, his style is very casual and friendly which means you feel happy, confident and most importantly, safe. we also caught the best wave we've ever managed to ride and now feel confident to go out and kite or surf knowing at least we know what we're supposed to do! we would absolutely recommend pryde and daniel in particular if you're looking for fun instruction that actually sees you improve in a short period of time. thanks so much daniel, we cannot wait to come back :) hannah

my husband and i did the day spa pass, and it was an amazing experience. our spa day began with a refreshing cold tea, we then changed into robes in their locker rooms. we had a body scrub followed by a one hour long massage. it was so relaxing! our scrub left our skin so smooth! we then got to enjoy the pool and spa which were absolutely beautiful! the staff helped us get lounge chairs under the shade. the drinks and food at the pool bar were great and the attention they provide to clients is superb. thank you to everyone for an amazing experience!

my husband and i did the east coast catamaran trip last week and had a really enjoyable day. there were only 8 people on board, and there was plenty of space to get comfortable. the crew really looked after us and we were never without a drink in our hand. the bbq was fantastic and catered for all dietary needs. we were able to see monkeys on the river, swim and snorkel at the coral reef and visit île aux cerfs for a couple of hours. would really recommend booking, it was one of our favourite days of our holiday.

my husband and i did the full day private tour with jeff as our guide, we did the ice walk to pleckaitis canyon, we were so lucky with the wildlife findings throughout the day, we saw mooses so close by, mountain sheeps and elks. our guide jeff was super friendly and helpful, we loved learning everything he shared with us about the history of the place and also about the rock formation of the land. everything was nice and easily arranged through email. we were glad to see jasper recovering from a really hard time after the wildfires, i truly recommend their services.

my husband and i did the oak alley plantation and swamp boat tour and had a great time! clark and dominique were fantastic—clark was especially informative and engaging with the history. the swamp boat part was a lot of fun. the only thing i’d change is the length of the plantation tour—3 hours felt a bit long for that part. otherwise, it was a great experience overall!

my husband and i experienced our first scuba diving adventure, which was both thrilling and a bit nerve-wracking. dominique and lin were incredibly supportive throughout. dominique provided thorough training the day before, and the guides accompanying us were extremely patient, ensuring our safety and comfort. their hospitality was remarkable. if you're planning to dive in zanzibar, this is definitely the spot to visit!

my husband and i found this great place on some windy days, and it was a total win! we rented a full kite setup, and the gear was top-quality—kites for every condition and even a smaller 136 board (which was hard to find anywhere else). the crew was super friendly, always ready to help and hook you up for a good session, plus they had great tips on spot and conditions. prices were very good too, the vibes were awesome, and the whole setup just made for a great experience. so if you’re in boracay to kite and need solid gear and good energy and support this is definitely the place to be :)

my husband and i had a blast learning to efoil. i am not going to lie - i was very nervous and scared of getting hurt. mike was an excellent instructor and made us feel super safe before even entering the water. once we got started we were standing and speeding up in no time! every step got easier and easier and it was one of the funnest things we've done in a while. we are definitely taking advantage of seakindlys monthly membership and going to go as much as we can! this is such a great activity to try if in pr or join if you live here. it was much easier than i expected and was such a fun and relaxing way to enjoy the water.

my husband and i had a great experience with the team for our first two days kitesurfing last week. great communication, friendly and helpful guides, and gave us extra time to keep practicing with our instructor. definitely recommend!

my husband and i had a great time on our trip to isla victoria. our tour guide, melina, spoke wonderful english, answered all our questions, walked thru the island with us explaining all the history and then recommended restaurants for our next stop on our trip, puerto varas. thank you for a memorable day!

my husband and i had about 45 minutes for a quick stop at this museum and goodness was it fun. the display room is not large but the mardi gras costumes are fabulous and very cool to view upclose with a flashlight. since we were the only two in the building, we were enthusiastically welcomed into their costume collection and the gentleman working even picked out a dress for me to try on, which i had to finish the look with a headdress. we had fun trying on a few other costume accessories, taking photos, and hearing stories about the traditions in nola. loved it all!

my husband and i had an amazing time to wadi bani khalid and wahiba sand desert. jihad was kind and knowledgeable. he went above and beyond our expectation. the highlight of our trip was the stunning sunset and dinner at the camo. thanka jihad, highly recommend him.

my husband and i had our very first kayak experience this morning to celebrate my birthday. adrian was our instructor (nice selfie adrian, i just saw this!) and he did an amazing job. he was professional, patient, and super passionate about his job. he ensured everyone felt safe and relaxed. we will definitely come back and hopefully we can work with adrian again. all the staff here were super friendly. highly recommended!

my husband and i had such a wonderful expereince. we opted in for the paddle boarding and snorkering tour of the cenote and had a wonderful time. our guides spoke great english and were able to teach us a lot about the surrounding eco system and history. the tour lasted about 3 hours from pick up to drop off and the cenote wasn't too far from the town of tulum. we will definitely use extreme control for our next adventure in tulum!

my husband and i had such an amazing time in torres del paine! we loved staying at the lodge. patrick and his staff are so welcoming, helpful and caring. we do not have enough nice things to say about our visit. we had dinner at the lodge one night- delicious. breakfast was great also! they offer take away lunches also if you want to spend the day hiking. the lodge was quiet, comfortable and so cozy with the stove that heats your cabin.

my husband and i had the absolute pleasure of visiting bavaro adventure park in punta cana, and it was one of the highlights of our trip to the dominican republic. we booked the polaris adventure and horseback riding combo, and the experience exceeded all of our expectations! from the moment we were picked up from our resort (right on time!) to the time we left, the entire day was seamless, exciting, and incredibly well organized. the check-in process at the park was smooth, and we were immediately struck by how friendly, welcoming, and professional every single staff member was. everyone spoke great english, greeted us warmly, and made us feel like vip guests — they looked you in the eye, asked your name, and made genuine connections. such a rare and wonderful touch! highlights of the experience: • polaris off-road sxs ride: driving through muddy jungle terrain was so much fun! it was adventurous but never felt out of control. • blue cenote swim: absolutely stunning and refreshing. a serene break during the adrenaline-packed day. • cultural gift shop stop: a great little presentation on how dominican coffee, hot chocolate, and mamajuana are made — with tastings included! we happily purchased a few items to bring home. • delicious dominican lunch: flavorful and authentic, it was a perfect break in the day. • zip lining: this was my first time zip lining, and i was honestly nervous — but the staff made me feel completely safe and supported. they were serious about safety protocols, which i truly appreciated. the multiple zips, including a canopy bridge and a final splash into water, were thrilling! • lazy river tubing & waterfall pool: such a relaxing way to wind down the day. beautiful surroundings and just a lot of fun. although we opted out of the horseback riding portion simply due to personal preference, it was nice to have the flexibility in the schedule. photography & memories: phones weren't allowed during the adventure for safety reasons (a decision i totally respect), but they had multiple professional photographers capturing moments throughout the day. we ended up purchasing the digital photo package with 59 amazing shots — totally worth it to relive the memories! final thoughts: i can't recommend bavaro adventure park enough. it offers a full day of adventure, culture, nature, and relaxation — all wrapped up in world-class service and hospitality. whether you’re an adrenaline junkie or just looking to explore the beauty of the dominican republic in a safe and fun environment, this park has something for everyone. 10/10 — would absolutely do it again!

my husband and i just returned home after spending 5 unforgettable nights at club med kiroro grand. we decided to try jpow skiing in hokkaido, and we’re so glad we chose kiroro grand as our ski resort. from the moment we arrived until the very end, we experienced nothing short of excellence. the hospitality was exceptional, and the personalised service truly lived up to club med's reputation. a special shoutout to merlin and her incredible team! everyone worked tirelessly round the clock to ensure the guests' safety, health and comfort plus keeping us entertained and engaged at all times (we didn't know where they get the energy from : ) ) we would like to thank our go, tong, for taking care of us throughout the entire stay. also, a big thank you to nino, the ski director, for taking such great care of cary, and to gos dylan, man, adit, and everyone else for their hard work and dedication. gm merlin is our superwoman —she was always there to greet us at every mealtimes, at nights performing on stage, and bidding us farewell with hugs when we were leaving. this is the "home" feeling club med strives to create: giving the utmost care to guests, putting us first, and ensuring all our needs were met. we will see you again soon! best, cary and jayne

my husband and i just visited today and they wouldn't let us buy a fish! so, why the 5-star review? because we clearly didn't know what we were doing, we needed education, and this lovely couple took their time explaining ph, ammonia levels, and water/tank care. before shopping for fish, we had made the mistake of buying a small, 2.5 gallon tank, which we learned is harder to care for than a large one. the couple at ocean aquarium asked us to consider a larger tank, but this small one is all that we can fit in our apartment. so, they patiently explained everything we'd need to do to maximize our chances for success. they set us up with the supplies we need to condition the water over the next month to prepare for fish and plants. they told us to bring them a water sample in a month and, if it passes their test, they'll sell us fish and plants. we loved how passionate they are about their craft and their fish. while we were disappointed that we couldn't get our fish today, we really appreciate the time they spent with us to ensure we didn't take something home today just to accidentally kill it. besides, we now have a little knowledge and we can enjoy the next month learning more and preparing our aquarium. edit: after a little over a month of conditioning our tank, we just went back, passed the water test, and got our fish and plants! so far, they're thriving. we really appreciate the knowledge that the couple at ocean aquarium spent time giving us.

my husband and i love deserts so much. it has always been a dream of mine to go to wadi rum after seeing so many movies filmed in this vast and beautiful place on the edge of the world. i found wadi rim stillness through their instagram. they had excellent reviews so we booked with them, and it was such a good decision. we opted for the “become a bedouin” experience and loved it. we met with habis at his home in the village to start the tour. we drank some tea and then met our guide hagis for the first day. it felt exhilarating to have the sun in our faces and the wind in our hair as we zipped across the desert seeing khazali canyon and scenes from the set of “lawrence of arabia” and hearing about the history of the area and the rich culture of the bedouins. the camp was rustic but very clean and comfortable. i loved the tents. they were very sturdy and wind proof. the beds were super comfortable. not what i expected in a “camp.” it was more “glamp” than what i expected. the food was amazing. it is made fresh every day. oh, and by the way, your guides will also cook you a very good lunch every day in the back of the truck. there is apparently nothing that bedouins can’t do! the stars at night were unbelievable and so close. you can see the milky way. also, there are no other camps nearby so you have the whole area to yourself. the second day we had nave for our guide. he was also very knowledgeable and had good english skills was very personable. we had some great conversations with him. the white desert is where you want to go. the stillness there is profound and beautiful. you really feel that you have left the world you know behind and have landed on a beautiful planet of rock and sand. we had another beautiful night in the camp and then rounded out our trip with a camel ride back into town where we were delivered back to the modern world and our car safe and sound at habis’ house.

my husband and i originally came to crystal divers for some fun dives, but ended up spontaneously signing up for our advanced open water course — and we’re so glad we did! chris was our instructor, and we couldn’t have asked for a better one. he’s not only a fantastic teacher but also an all-around great person who made every dive an unforgettable experience. the rest of the crew was just as amazing, creating a super fun and welcoming atmosphere from the start. throughout the course, we explored several incredible dive sites and completed certifications in nitrox, navigation, wreck diving, deep diving, digital underwater photography, and fish id. every dive was packed with excitement, learning, and lots of laughs. the dive briefings were thorough and professional, and safety was clearly a top priority at all times. special shoutout to pascal — his boat rides and great music set the perfect tone for each day. we can’t recommend crystal divers and their entire team highly enough. it was an experience we’ll never forget!

my husband and i really enjoyed the 2 hour tour. we got a fantastic insight into tea production. we had the most brilliant tour guide nethmi, her english was perfect, she was knowledgeable and enthusiastic. we spent time going through each stage of the tea process to make our own green tea (which you get to drink at the end). the staff are all very kind and i will forever drink my tea now knowing how much hard work is put in to it. 100% recommend if you are in ella or close by, easy to get to by tuktuk.

my husband and i stayed in this hotel for one day in february 2024. this is a very unique hostel. all the houses are built on floating islands made of reeds. the floating islands are about 30 meters long and 30 meters wide, surrounded by lake water. sitting in the room, you can see the beautiful lake. we rowed a boat around the floating island to play in the water. the host ivan and his wife are very kind and friendly. they try their best to provide the best service for guests, making our stay here an unforgettable experience.

my husband and i stayed on reef encounter for 2 nights/3 days with the top deck club and also got open water certified. to say it was the experience of a lifetime is an understatement. our instructor ellis was excellent in all areas. i was quite nervous to try scuba in the ocean for the first time, and ellis was exceptionally patient, encouraging, and helped me feel more comfortable and confident under water. the reefs and sea creatures were breathtaking, and we even got to do a night dive once we were certified. it was clear that the entire crew was so happy to be there, highly organized, worked well together, and ensured we were comfortable throughout our stay. the service and food was also wonderful. we highly recommend choosing reef encounter no matter your experience level with scuba!! we will never forget this incredible experience!

my husband and i took a 3 night cruise from aswan to luxor on safiya 2 and we cannot recommend it highly enough! the boat and accommodation was beautiful with every detail considered. the food was excellent throughout the trip with all soft drinks included. the staff on board were friendly and professional at all times and really made our experience extra special. we enjoyed a wide range of activities during the cruise - the perfect balance between fascinating history and cultural experiences: fishing with a local community, baking bread and eating breakfast in a family's home, who chatted to us about their lives. we visited a camel market and enjoyed a cookery class on board the dahabiya. the family atmosphere on the boat was so special - we didn't want to leave! if you are visiting egypt, make this your priority!

my husband and i took a summer tundra walk with courtney and five of the beautiful sled dogs, and it was an unforgettable experience. the dogs were incredibly friendly, playful, and sweet, each with their own unique personality. they were also very well trained, which made interacting with them even more enjoyable. courtney was a fantastic guide--she shared not only interesting facts about the dogs but also offered great insights into the alaskan environment and culture. this was truly one of the highlights of our trip to denali!

my husband and i took kiteboarding lessons with sian kite during our honeymoon, and it was an incredible experience! sian and sonja are not only amazing instructors but also genuinely kind and welcoming. they assessed our skills and tailored the lessons to suit both of us perfectly. we had researched kite schools in the area, and after speaking with sian, we knew he was the right choice. his passion for teaching and focus on making the experience fun and safe were exactly what we were looking for. if you’re in tulum and want a personalized, unforgettable kiteboarding experience, we can’t recommend sian kite enough!

my husband and i took my three adult daughters and their spouses to paris last week for a much anticipated family vacation. our cocktail cruise down the seine river on the luxurious dolce vita was one of the highlights of our trip. anna, our organizer and host, was so easy to work with and extremely friendly. you can't go wrong booking the dolce vita; just ask our kids! m&z: as a first time paris visitor, our scenic river cruise was an unforgettable experience. gliding along the seine, the dolce vita puts the city’s most iconic landmarks on display. whether enjoying a glass of wine at the back of the boat or lounging on the front deck, the panoramic views offer a unique perspective of the city of light. it’s a perfect blend of relaxation and sightseeing, ideal for first-time visitors or anyone wanting to experience paris in a dreamy, cinematic way. l&j: hands down, one of the most memorable experiences i had in paris. the yacht was pristine, the views were postcard-perfect, and anna made us feel completely at home. their passion for hospitality truly shines—gracious, engaging, and professional in every way. whether it’s your first time in paris or your fiftieth, this tour is something special. a&m: our river cruise experience was nothing short of amazing. the staff were friendly and accommodating. the boat was beautiful and well maintained. the route was intentional, passing both the eiffel tower and notre dame. one of our favorite paris experiences!

my husband and i took the discover banff wildlife tour on our first day in banff with brianna as our guide. she was very knowledgeable and shared lots of interesting stories with us about the local area and her experiences in banff. i would recommend this tour for your first day as the stops really help you get your bearings. we really enjoyed learning about the geology and hoodoos.

my husband and i went here on a saturday morning and we had no wait time. the walk up the stairs is a lot and once we thought we were almost at the top, it just going. it’s free to walk up the stairs and there are some amazing viewpoints from there. to then enter the building and see the exhibitions it was 17 euros for each of us. the exhibition was interesting and we really enjoyed it.

my husband and i went on a tour with spencer scouting for animals. we were very impressed with spencer’s level of preparedness. to help us understand the animals that we might see, he had photos, different types of binoculars, samples of horns and antlers (so we could feel the weight) and an example of the collars that are used for bear tracking. but the most impressive thing about spencer was his passion for the wildlife. passion, however is not enough without the knowledge, and he had plenty of knowledge too! his knowledge covered the history of the park, its problems in the past and in the future, and of course knowledge of all the animals. despite a slow start to animal spotting it truly ended on a high as we had to stop the car as 3 elk cows crossed the road in front of us. as we were admiring them we suddenly noticed a big elk stag had appeared a mere few metres from the car. it was a little intense for a while, until he decided to join his herd. it was a truly memorable experience!
my husband and i went snorkeling with fahim and all the team at dive point. im very anxious in the water but fahim was very reassuring. he was a great guide and teacher we really enjoyed it!

my husband and i went to banff with our toddler 9/18-25/24. it was chilly, and in the mornings, it sometimes got to below freezing. i wore leggings, a t-shirt, and a heavy fleece jacket with a beanie and it was enough to keep me warm! wear layers so you can peel off as you hike. we wore trail runners and those were adequate for hiking. we stayed in canmore and drove into banff, which really wasn’t too far. *note: get a bus pass to moraine lake and lake louise. we weren’t able to get the parks canada shuttle, so we went with a private company, fairview limousine shuttle. it was ca$25 for lake louise and ca$35 for moraine lake per person, but if you wanted to do sunrise, it was like 3x the price. we did the shuttle to moraine lake at 7:15 am, so we got there just after sunrise, at 7:45. it was so cloudy that day that being there for sunrise wouldn’t have been worth it anyway. thursday, 9/19 - peyto lake (.8 miles total) - got there at 1:30 pm, there were enough parking spots. took less than 30 minutes total, including stopping for pics. stay on the trail! the trees are incredible and smell amazing!! absolutely stunning views. they have toilets with no running water in the parking lot. - bow lake - walked around a bit, didn’t really hike. we heard there’s a nice hike, which we would’ve done if we hadn’t started so late in the day! - mistaya canyon (.7 miles total) - took 20 minutes, pretty!! friday, 9/20 - johnston canyon to upper falls (3.4 miles total) - got there at 8 am on a rainy and cold day, so there was plenty of parking. by the time we got down at 10:40, parking lot was full. bathrooms with running water at the start. because it was rainy and cold, the trail was almost empty. very pretty! took us a little over 2 hours, including stopping for lunch. we would’ve loved to do ink pots, but the toddler was cranky. - emerald lake in yoho national park - got there at noon and it was packed, had to park far away. stroller-friendly boardwalk. amazing views. little cafe and bathrooms without running water. we were there for about 30 minutes, but there are plenty of trails if you choose to hike! - natural bridge - got there at 1 pm, found a parking spot. bathrooms without running water. quick stop, very cool. saturday, 9/21 - tunnel mountain summit from upper parking lot (2.6 miles total) - at 8:45 am, plenty of parking. very cold—below freezing. took us 50 minutes to get up with stops and pictures, spent 30 minutes at the top but it was just so cold. took us less than 30 min to get down. the elevation gain was challenging. - two jack lake - very pretty viewpoint! go down the gravel path and look on either side for lovely views. - lake minnewanka - eh, skip it. - johnson lake - plenty of parking at 12:45 pm. easy hike around the lake. not worth it. sunday, 9/22 - took fairview limousine shuttle to moraine lake. - moraine lake: rockpile trail (.8 km loop): got to the lake at 7:45 and the shuttle left at 9 which was more than enough time. quick walk up to take pics, hung out up there to pass the time until the bus came back. - lake louise: lake agnes tea house trail (3.4 km one way): lake louise was stunning. completely uphill hike to tea house with stairs at the end. we stopped a lot of times and drank a lot of water. took 1:15 on the way up. lake agnes was fine, but nothing compared to lake louise. spent about an hour at the tea house, the wait really wasn’t that long. got tea, vegetable soup, biscuits, a cookie bar. took an hour to get down. much easier going down, but hard on the knees. monday, 9/23 - hoodoos - fine, pretty short. we followed the sign someone had written on and didn’t go past where the trail ended because there were. no views past it. if you don’t have time, this is fine to skip. - bow river - we stopped at the bow falls viewpoint for a picnic lunch. it was so peaceful. we didn’t do the trails, but i’m sure it would’ve been lovely. even just stopping there for lunch was so nice. highly recommend! banff was incredible. don’t pass it up!
