my husband and i were lucky enough to visit oeno p a few weeks ago. the wine and setting were absolutely amazing, but what absolutely made it even more special was meeting maria who gave us so much information on not only the wine but also the best places to visit on santorini. we went back when my entire family of 16 arrived, and everyone loved it so much. the wine, the setting and maria made our visit unforgettable. we are already planning our return. maria, thank you again for making our holiday so, so special!

my husband and i were unsure if we should go without our kids, and im glad we still went. we had an absolutely amazing time. we arrived around 130pm, and the car drive through the safari took us about 1.5 hours while listening to the audio guide and stopping while seeing animals. we then went into the park (bring your bathing suits). enjoy the day. everything is included except the additional feeding of animals, but you can still get close and encounter them all. we grabbed a dole whip to cool off. by 4pm, we were done with the park, but if we had the kids with us, we could spend all day at the water slide and water park. we decided to drive through the safari one more time as it was getting dark as it was about to storm. i'm so glad we did. the animals were way more active and out walking around compared to mid day when they were hiding in the shade. lions were active, and the workers were actually putting them away, and they were up roaming around. it was faster, only took us 30 minutes as we passed by other cars that were still enjoying the animals.

my husband and i, alongside my sister and brother and law stayed at moremi crossing last month. this was the highlight of our trip and exceeded every expectation i had of a safari. jonas and godfrey were our guides and they were exceptional. the staff, lounge, food, and all activities were all incredible. it felt surreal to look out from our tent and see elephants so close by. jonas and godfrey made every game drive special and catered them to the animals we had not seen and having us experience every aspect of the beautiful okavango delta. i would highly recommend this to anyone coming to botswana. truly a once in a lifetime experience

my partner and i did the afternoon snorkelling trip. the entire trip was so special from start to finish! we stopped at the first snorkelling spot and saw soooo many turtles on the reef, it was amazing! the most i’ve ever seen and we’ve snorkelled all over the world! a yummy traditional lunch was provided before heading to the second snorkelling spot with a white sandy beach! we enjoyed the sunset with music as we headed back to the harbour, a truly magical end to the day! thank you so much to bakang, ahmed and twahir for hosting us and making our day amazing!

my partner and i had an incredible 5 day dahabiya trip from luxor to aswan on the safiya 2. by far the most incredible experience we had in egypt! the boat is stunning, with spacious bright rooms and beautifully designed common spaces (and a mini pool!). the itinerary is a great mix of ancient temple sites along the nile and contemporary cultural experiences, with enough time to relax on board too. this company goes to spots others don’t, including a final night right near aswan in the most beautiful mooring near the aga khan mausoleum. our guide mahmoud hassan was fantastic - a real highlight of the trip, so knowledgeable, patient and friendly. he was so passionate about the layers of egypt, ancient and modern, and we came away feeling so enriched. i would recommend asking for him if you are booking a trip! all of the crew were brilliant, but particular shout out to sammy, his excellent dance moves and friendly smile. there were good vegan options at all meals - i had noted this when booking but needed to remind the crew when i came on board. i would recommend being extra clear with all staff about dietary needs, particularly if you have allergies or intolerances. it would be great to have a turkish coffee option but there is instant and filter available so you will still be caffeinated. i personally wouldn’t take the horse and carriage again to edfu temple (which was standard) as the horses were not in great shape, but our guide was considerate and asked about people’s comfort levels with this form of transport beforehand - we just didn’t know to say no at that point, but you might want to! overall, we absolutely loved our trip with dahabiya nile sailing. would definitely recommend to others if they want a stunning, relaxed and beautiful trip on the nile free of the large scale cruise ship chaos and fumes.

my partner and i just wrapped up an incredible trip with teman liveaboard in raja ampat— and we had the best time! i love snorkeling, and he’s into diving, so this cruise was the perfect match for both of us. this was actually our second time cruising with teman. the first was in komodo, and now we’re back for more in raja ampat! the reefs were vibrant and full of life, and while i stuck to snorkeling, he said the diving spots were absolutely amazing. the crew made sure we both had a great time, whether we were in the water or out exploring. one of the highlights was the early morning trek to see the birds of paradise—and yes, we actually saw them! such a magical moment! this trip was full of unforgettable encounters: we swam with so many sharks, i was so exciting and happy, don’t worry they are cute! and we were lucky enough to spot a pod of dolphins right near our dinghy in the sunset. we also snorkeled in the jellyfish lake, surrounded by thousands of jellyfish.. it was surreal! and as the cherry on top, we saw mantas and even spotted a rare albino oceanic manta! i was screaming and had tears of happiness… it was definitely an unbelievable and unforgettable moment. i personally loved and truly enjoyed every part of the itinerary. each stop was well thought out and beautifully paced, it gave us the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation.. we made sure to bring our own gear, like our camera, drone, etc., to capture all the special moments. we came home with so many beautiful photos as great memories, that we’ll definitely look back on for years. both komodo and raja ampat are unbelievably beautiful. we really enjoyed the hikes, with panoramic views that took our breath away. the crew was warm, welcoming, and made us feel right at home from day one. then, let’s talk about the food—every meal was a delight, something we genuinely looked forward to every day. they prepared so many homemade indonesian food, classics and revisited teman recipes. western food was also on the menu to change flavors, but they really focused on quality asian food! one of our favorite memories was the karaoke and beach dance night. we all gathered under the stars, singing, dancing barefoot in the sand—it felt so relaxed, fun, and full of good vibes. that night truly made us feel like part of one big, happy family. definitely a core memory. if you’re looking for a trip filled with epic snorkeling, one of the best diving places in the world, stunning nature, and warm, friendly people, then, teman liveaboard is the way to go.

my sister and i took a private tour of mykines with oda of go local in july to see puffins but it was so much more than that. oda is so lovely and personable and just a fascinating, super cool person with a joie de vivre and an inspiring amount of energy . we loved getting to know her and hearing about the island, the faroe islands, puffins, her life, and the wonderful sustainability efforts she is making for the island. she told us about responsible tourism that isn't only sustainable but also gives back to the community and the land and how important it is to her and to the wonderful faroe islands. she spoke so lovingly about the puffins and educated us on all the different birds on the island which was very educational and entertaining. i have added some photos and want to point out that the puffin photos were with a regular lens, not a zoom lens-imagine how close they are and they are just the sweetest cutest little birds. oda accommodated my sister's vegetarian needs (we got a glorious lunch from the local cafe) and she also took care of my fear of heights without a hint of judgement. she showed us around the beautiful village in mykines, brought us to see a ton of puffins, took us to a nice remote spot to eat lunch, and also left us alone for a bit to enjoy a bit of time roaming. she was also very responsive to emails and messages and very organized and helpful with our plan. i highly recommend a tour with her.

my sister and i went diving 4 days with odyssea dive and we had an absolutely fantastic time. we are very thankful, especially to jorge, mathias and rafael. with odyssea dive, you have a perfect mix of a professional and fun team. they will ensure that you are well-taken care of and they are very attentive about helping you with the gear and that you have everything you need to dive with safety. but the team is also very friendly and funny, ensuring you have a good time in-between the dives and during the dives. after almost 3 years without diving, my sister and i wanted to have a refresh in the pool before going in the water which had to be cancelled due to the weather. they directly offered that we go with mathias (the instructor of the centre) the next day and be only with him for the dives of the day at no extra cost. this really helped us to feel confident and do a few exercises (even though we realized diving is like riding a bicycle so the refresh wasn't that necessary in the end). so thank you for the flexibility and for making us very comfortable, it helped us enjoy ourselves from the start. the dives themselves were really great, we even saw some dolphins and a dugong from the boat. the lunch break on the island and the homemade cake at the end of the day are also really nice! they are all very helpful for any tips or support you might need during your stay in vilankulos. thanks again for the positive vibes and all the good laughs! we also really liked how mathias and jorge are passionate and how we were all very excited to share what we saw underwater after each dive!

my sister and i were visiting bariloche and walked into guru travel and were greeted by emi (emilia) the owner, we felt like home she explain the best packages to visit places taking under consideration the amount of time we have, the weather conditions and our age. it was perfect! buses and the tour guide guys were amazing and very knowledgeable. emilia was available(practically on call) via text and voice call all the time and made sure we enjoy every step of the way! laura (her assistant) gave us tips about restaurants (they call them resto). thank you emilia for such a wonderfull experience! you can find her office next to the lobby of the hotel design suites bariloche an amazing place by the way!

my sister booked the brewster lake louise stables, 2 hour trail ride for my 30th and it was worth every cent! we were blessed with a perfect day ☀️ all horses & tack were in great condition, helmets were optional. horses knew their job and just went by single file and all very well behaved 🐴 our guides jonah and marie were very knowledgeable but a special mention to rachel who answered our 101 questions and made the ride so enjoyable. amazing views which i’m so glad we got to see lake louise on horseback as we walked down to the lake after our ride and it was over run by tourist and you could hardly see anything! recommend brewster’s 🤗 5/5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

my son & i wanted to raft the grand canyon as a bucket list trip. when i began investigating options, i was soon overwhelmed. clint at rivers & oceans knew the questions to ask me and began narrowing down the various options. we ultimately decided on a four day wilderness river adventures whitewater rafting trip and hike out at the bright angel trail. the experience couldn’t have been any better, exceeding all expectations. thanks clint for your assistance through the whole process and follow up along the way to make sure all was great. wonderful service.

my son (16) and i had the best two hours kayaking around the old town walls, visiting the island and seeing the caves. we arrived quite early and the lovely owner and his son very kindly let us take the kayaks out when we arrived which was so helpful. they shared a map and suggested route, which was perfect for the two hours they also gave us a dry bag for my phone! we wanted to kayak on our own, rather than in a group tour, and we were out so early we didn’t see anyone else, just some jellyfish and fish!! we loved it and would recommend!

my son (9) and i absolutely loved this rafting trip. it was his first time and it was pretty gentle and easy. there are only a few trip that his age could go on but this allowed for him to experience this great activity. the staff was super friendly right from the beginning with informing us about all the safety and the guide was translating our moves we were to do into english, but after a few times we figured out what the spanish words were for right, left.. etc. after the rafting tour we are invited to have a snack and tea with the owners and staff. the place is magical, and the hosts even informed us that their son lived in or home town in canada, while giving my son a gift. what a trip to remember! thank you.

my son absolutely loves sea surf & fun surf camp! fabien and his team of instructors are incredibly patient, supportive, and encouraging. he’s been attending this summer camp since he was very young, and each year we see his confidence and skills improve. the camp not only helps him grow as a surfer, but it also keeps him excited and motivated to stay engaged with the sport all summer long. we’re so grateful for this amazing experience year after year!

my son and i did the abraham tour of the dead sea and masada. the tour was great and our tour guide, ariel, was brilliant! he was very knowledgeable and very friendly, chatting with everyone in the group and getting to know them. i highly recommend using this company, especially if your guide is ariel!

my son and i had a fantastic experience on the sunrise kayak tour this morning! the views were stunning, the waters was serene, and the early start was absolutely worth it. our guide fab, was truely fabulous, friendly, and made us feel safe throughout. a memorable bonding experience – highly recommended!

my son and i had an incredible day with fraser and the crew from helibike nz. we did peak vert, combining coronet and bowen peaks with a flight in the middle. at 13 years old, my son was stoked at the combined christmas presents from the family, and absolutely couldn't believe how amazing the flight was between the bottom of coronet up to bowen. huge thankyou to ryan for hanging back with us as we made our way down bowen, and what a way to finish down the qt bike park. i highly recommend helibike nz. they really looked after us through the whole day, had a great guide ratio, and knew everything about the trails we were about to descend. i and my son felt comfortable and confident with the organisation and the setup. thanks again to fraser, ryan, and katie for an incredible day!

my son and i had an unforgettable experience at dolphin discovery! from the moment we arrived, the staff was welcoming and professional, ensuring we felt comfortable and excited for the adventure ahead. the dolphins were absolutely amazing—so intelligent, gentle, and playful. we loved every moment, from the dolphin kiss to the thrilling ride. the trainers were knowledgeable and made sure we had a safe and fun interaction. my son was beyond thrilled, and it was a truly magical bonding experience for both of us. the facility was well-maintained, and everything was well-organized. i highly recommend this experience for families looking to create lifelong memories.

my son and i went for a short trip in the park. oh what an awesome view and amazing animals. from one side the volcano, from the other side arenal lake. the nature at it's full glory, all done to make sure humens will not interfere the wildlife. enjoy!

my son and i went on a fun dive with one of their dive masters, noki. it was such fun that we booked for the next three days. we got our open water license with them taught by john queron, who is an excellent instructor and extremely knowledgeable about the reef and the environment. we ate sumptuous lunches on each of these days prepared by the staff on a beach of one of the islands. they even brought towels for us to shower and dry after the dive. these guys are the best! you cannot go wrong with them.

my son and i were blessed to be able to stay at galicantu during holy week in 2023. it was the most profound experience of my life! it was holy week and passover and ramadan so everyday was filled with pilgrims and prayers. it was a blessing to be within walking distance of the holiest of holy places where jesus walked, suffered, died and rose. the accommodations were comfortable and the people were welcoming and friendly. i can’t recommend highly enough that everyone should visit and walk in his footsteps!

my stay at amantani lodge was outstanding. henry and mariluz provided exceptional hospitality and service, and the delicious meals were definitely a highlight. they were very accommodating and helped with all my transportation and other needs. the room was fantastic, featuring hot water, clean towels, comfortable mattresses, and cozy duvets that were perfect for the cold. the view was incredible, and i experienced the best starry sky of my life. all these elements combined made my stay at their lodge a dream, offering both comfort and warmth on the island. i highly recommend it! for reservations and logistics arrangements, i suggest contacting henry directly. he is the best!

my stay at dunia exceeded all expectations in every way possible. the women that run this camp were so clearly engaged in ensuring i had the best experience possible in every aspect of my stay - the safari, the meals, the accommodations, and the fellowship. my safari guide had a wealth of knowledge on so many topics - animals, ecosystem, culture, etc. there was so much to learn and no matter how many questions i asked or whether i asked the same question multiple times she answered them with interest and patience. the daily trips she planned were incredibly engaging and educational. the meals were so yummy with a variety of food that was all seasoned well and served with warmth and care. the staff ensured that any food sensitivities were accommodated. when out in the bush i had the opportunity to compare what i was served to other camps and my multiple lunch options appeared way superior. my accommodations were incredible. the tent felt luxurious, with the house keepers always providing little touches here and there to truly make me feel comfortable and taken care of in the day and night. and the shower was so welcome at the end of each day with hot water and water pressure that was no less than what i get at home. the staff also ensured i was and felt safe. escorting me at night and checking in on me throughout my experience. lastly, as a solo traveler i am use to dining on my own when i travel though sometimes feeling lonely and yearning for a bit of company. not a dunia!! there was always a staff member to keep me company when i desired, to share stories or experiences, and discover commonalities or differences. yet they also gave me space when i preferred it. i am already planning a return trip with my kids and will absolutely book an asilia property. i cannot think of a single reason why i would look anywhere else. the staff and leadership at dunia truly provided me a home away from home and i am forever grateful for the experience.

my stay at wadi rum desert dunes luxury camp was truly unforgettable. from the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warm hospitality and genuine kindness. the camp offers the perfect balance between traditional bedouin charm and modern luxury. the tents are clean, spacious, and beautifully decorated, with comfortable beds and private bathrooms available in some units. waking up to the stunning desert views and the silence of the wadi rum landscape is an experience like no other. the sunset views are breathtaking, and the night sky is filled with stars—perfect for stargazing. the camp also offers amazing activities like jeep tours, camel rides, and traditional bedouin dinners by the fire, complete with music and tea. the food was delicious, especially the traditional zarb (meat and vegetables cooked underground), which was a highlight of our stay. everything was freshly made and served with care. what truly makes this camp special is the staff—friendly, helpful, and always ready to make your stay as comfortable as possible. if you're looking for a peaceful, unique, and luxurious desert experience, i highly recommend wadi rum desert dunes luxury camp. you’ll leave with amazing memories and a deep appreciation for jordan’s desert beauty.

my teenage son is a big fan of model ships and naval history - he loved this museum and got a real sense of the history in this part of the world. he said afterwards that he wished he could go back in time and be a merchant, with a ship in this port, trading spices etc. i’ve rarely seen him so enthusiastic about anything! highly recommend this museum for history fans! €10 for adults, €7 for kids. you can visit this museum without paying for a ticket to the walls.

my time with dragon dive in komodo island wasn’t just a diving trip—it was a transformative experience, all thanks to their incredible team. let me start by saying: i can’t swim. and i’ve always been terrified of deep water. but my 11-year old son was dead set on getting his open water certification, and i wanted to share that milestone with him as a family . so, i signed up, heart pounding, not sure i’d make it past the first pool session. enter dragon dive—and karin. from day one, karin saw my nerves and met them with a perfect balance of patience and professionalism. she never rushed me, even when i fumbled with my regulator or panicked a little during surface exercises. but she was also unwaveringly strict when it mattered: drilling safety protocols until they felt like second nature, making sure i understood every hand signal, and never letting me skip a step. that mix—kindness that put me at ease, and rigor that kept me safe—was exactly what i needed. by the time we hit open water, i wasn’t just following instructions; i felt more confident. she stayed right by my side during every dive, checking in with a calm nod, guiding my buoyancy with gentle adjustments, and celebrating small wins (like my first successful descent!) like they were big deals. thanks to her, i didn’t just keep up—i enjoyed it. and then there’s leo, the diving master in training, who made the whole process feel like a team adventure. he’d help me haul my gear (no small feat for a nervous newbie), laugh with my son between dives, and even sneak in little tips—like how to relax my shoulders to float better—when i needed them. his energy kept things light, even on days when i was stressing, and you could tell he genuinely cared about making sure both my son and i felt included. by the end, we all got ow certification—and i walked away with so much more: a newfound trust in myself, a love for the underwater world, and memories of watching my kid beam as he showed off his new skills. none of that would’ve happened without dragon dive. karin’s expertise turned my fear into confidence, and leo’s warmth made the journey feel like fun, not work. if you’re diving in komodo—especially if you’re a nervous beginner or sharing the experience with family—look no further. dragon dive doesn’t just teach you to dive; they make sure you feel safe, supported, and excited every step of the way.

my time with naturalist was something i'll never forget! they were a wonderful bunch of people who were all both kind and super knowledgeable and passionate about wildlife, both marine and on the island. the briefings were great before each boat trip where we got to learn about each species we might encounter and we got to learn about all of the ongoing scientific research projects that the team is working on. we saw whales, dolphins, turtles, man-of-war's and many sea birds. absolutely nothing can beat being on the water and seeing these animals! there are almost too many things to mention that set naturalist apart for me - fast communication with the team, educational talks from researchers themselves, kind and accommodating, full gear provided to keep dry and safe, perfect amount of time on the water, respectful of the animals and following the regulations, warm tea and a little complementary gift at the end of the bit trip and the range of tours offered. there's boat tours for the marine life, day tours around the island with super knowledgeable and lovely guides and an absolutely magical overnight tour to see cory shearwaters coming in from the sea to roost on the volcanic cliffs at the right time of year - unforgettable experience! i recommend going with naturalist out to sea multiple times if you can because that really improves the chances of seeing different species and improves the odds of good weather. fantastic experience that can't be beaten!

my two sons and i enjoyed the 6:30pm vivid tour last wednesday evening. the pre-paddle facilities were great and shannon and crew were very efficient in organising our group of eight. the spray jackets and life jackets were good quality, as were the 6 m long sea kayaks that we launched from a sheltered spot next to one of the ships at the maritime museum. i’ve a canadian style canoe and have previously disliked kayaks, but these were comfortable to sit in and enjoyable to use - very stable and quick. although the air temperature was cool, the water felt warm on the few occasions my hand dipped into the harbour. we weren’t cold at all. the short journey to balmain east ferry terminal went via several historical ships of the museum, and we were treated to spectacular views of the various vivid light shows, including the harbour bridge. i’d recommend this experience to anyone - and not just during vivid!

my visit to aquila private game reserve was nothing short of spectacular. from the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm hospitality and an atmosphere that blended luxury with a deep respect for nature. the reserve is beautifully maintained, offering breathtaking landscapes that stretch as far as the eye can see. the game drive was the highlight of our stay. our guide was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the wildlife and conservation efforts. we were fortunate enough to spot the big five, along with a variety of other animals in their natural habitat. it was both thrilling and humbling to see these magnificent creatures up close. the accommodations were top-notch—comfortable, stylish, and well-equipped with modern amenities while still maintaining a rustic charm. the food was delicious, with a great selection that catered to all tastes. i also appreciated their commitment to sustainability and responsible tourism, which added to the overall experience. whether you’re a first-time safari-goer or a seasoned traveler, aquila offers an authentic and enriching escape into south africa’s natural beauty. i wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable and meaningful adventure.

my visit to place vendôme in paris was nothing short of spectacular. this iconic square, renowned for its elegance and historical significance, left a lasting impression on me. as i approached place vendôme, i was immediately struck by its grandeur. the square is surrounded by stunning neoclassical buildings, each with its own unique charm. the centerpiece, the vendôme column, stands tall and proud, adorned with intricate carvings that tell the story of napoleon’s victories. the architecture alone is enough to take your breath away. walking around the square, i couldn’t help but feel a sense of history. place vendôme has been a witness to many significant events over the centuries, and its timeless beauty has been preserved impeccably. the luxury boutiques that line the square add a touch of modern elegance, making it a perfect blend of the old and the new. one of the highlights of my visit was exploring the high-end jewelry stores. each boutique showcases exquisite pieces that are true works of art. even if you’re not in the market for jewelry, it’s worth stepping inside to admire the craftsmanship and opulence. the staff in these stores are incredibly welcoming and knowledgeable, adding to the overall experience. the atmosphere in place vendôme is both serene and vibrant. despite being a popular tourist destination, it never felt overcrowded. there are plenty of benches where you can sit and soak in the surroundings, watching the world go by. the square is also beautifully lit in the evening, creating a magical ambiance that is perfect for a leisurely stroll. in addition to its visual appeal, place vendôme is conveniently located near other major attractions in paris. it’s just a short walk from the tuileries garden and the louvre museum, making it an ideal starting point for a day of sightseeing. overall, my visit to place vendôme was an unforgettable experience. the combination of its historical significance, architectural beauty, and luxurious atmosphere makes it a must-visit destination in paris. whether you’re a history buff, a lover of fine jewelry, or simply looking for a picturesque spot to relax, place vendôme has something to offer everyone.

my visit to the camp nou museum was an unforgettable experience. although i had the basic ticket, which didn’t include access to the autonomic robot keeper game, it was still fun watching others try it — definitely tougher than it looks, even with three attempts! since i went during the holiday season, it was quite packed. luckily, the venue has thoughtful features like umbrella-shaped structures that release a refreshing water mist to help keep everyone cool in the spanish heat. after entering (note: the ticket counter is at the back, close to washroom & exit but i’d highly recommend booking online in advance), you’re handed a card with a qr code for the audio guide, which really enhances the tour. there’s also the opportunity to take professional photos that can be purchased later for around £11.75 (price may vary by currency). despite the large crowds, everything was very well-organised — people were respectful, and everyone took their time enjoying and capturing the moment. the museum itself showcases the rich legacy of fc barcelona, with a stunning trophy display that truly highlights the club’s legendary status. you’ll learn about iconic players like johan cruyff and lionel messi, who have played a huge role in shaping barça’s incredible history. to round off the visit, you can grab a bite at the on-site café or pick up some gear at the official barça store. with certain ticket types, you even get free name and number customisation on your merch! overall, from start to finish, the experience was fantastic — definitely a must-see for anyone visiting barcelona, whether you’re a football fan or not.

my visit to the sydney harbour bridge sydney harbour bridge is an engineering masterpiece & it's a must-see destination, if you have time, try the bridge climb for an unforgettable experience! totally worth it and highly recommended. the view from the bridge is absolutely stunning

my visit to the white museum and winery in santorini was absolutely unforgettable! from the moment i arrived, i was captivated by the stunning views and the serene ambiance that perfectly blends tradition with elegance. the wine tasting experience was exceptional, offering a wonderful selection of local wines that truly showcase the island’s rich heritage. each sip was paired beautifully with their carefully curated bites, making it a delightful journey for the senses. a special thank you to my server, eri, who made the experience even more memorable. her warm hospitality, deep knowledge of the wines, and genuine passion for her work truly stood out. she went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect and answered all of my questions with a smile. if you’re visiting santorini, this is an absolute must! whether you’re a wine enthusiast or just looking for a unique and beautiful experience, the white museum and winery will not disappoint.

my visit to the zoo showcasing animals from the arctic circle was a wonderful and unique experience. although not all the animals were visible that day, there was a rare opportunity to see creatures that are usually hard to spot in the wild. the atmosphere was pleasant, and the way the animals were presented highlighted their uniqueness and the special habitats they require. definitely a recommended experience for any nature lover or curious explorer!

my wife and did a paddle tour of the nearby lagoon and had a great time! we would definitely do it again. our host mauricio treated us so well! next we go back will definitely book another adventure or try some kite boarding!

my wife and i (who had never climbed outside before) got a four hour climbing experience with sara. what an amazing experience! even before we met up with guide sara, they were super communicative and accommodating when our timing got a little mixed up. sara was wonderfully supportive and helpful as we tackled the rock walls. we always felt 100% safe and her demeanor made the whole thing feel like we were out with a dear friend. the next time we are in jasper, we will be calling again.

my wife and i booked a flight out the grand canyom, with a return to las vegas around sunset, with gc flight. from the moment we booked the excursion we were impressed with the reservation process and our pilot, tucker. from the time we were picked up at our hotel the waiting time at the terminal was minimal, and we were off in no time! tucker flew us out to lake mead, past hoover dam, and to our inner canyon landing site. once on the ground, we explored the site, sipped champaign, and were off for vegas. we cannot thank tucker and gc flight for a memorable experience.i

my wife and i booked a trek the day after our wedding in queenstown. we ended up being the only riders on the day , we had the english gent taking us. ( apologies we forgot your name and have been racking our brains). the experience was beyond expection. the training was thorough and the ride then after was such an incredible time. the trails are super fun to ride and the machines more than powerful enough . my wife has more experience being from florida and all so she was back in the saddle fast and i twisted behind . the views were staggering and the trials so much fun and challenging enough to make it fun . we both got off and couldn’t stop raving about the whole experience. we can’t recommend this enough - but be prepared to be tested before you take off , it’s not mucking around and your up real heights but if you can handle the handle you won’t regret it and the head rider adapts the trails to fit your level . we had a real blast and would gladly do it again when we come back down . gavin and laura - the newlyweds .

my wife and i booked a trip over an agent today (17.5.2025), the trip started in a good way, all seemed to be perfectly fine. after going to the waterfall and the boatchange to the aquasails cataspeed we waited around 1 hour to start our tour due to additionally booked passengers onto the boat. driving to the snorkeling spot was good, the guides were nice, was great fun. at the snorkeling site we stopped and the equipment was handed out to us - snorkle and glasses full of mold, really disgusting. we did not go snorkeling, the rest of the tour has been fine, enough drinks, the food was ok. nothing special but ok. finally we arroved back at the pier 1.5 hours late, letting the driver wait. as a commercial gesture they came back offering us parasailing, bit we let that pass, since we did not want to do that. overall we would definitely bring our own rquipment next time and look for a different provider for the tour.

my wife and i booked captain salim on a 4 hour private fishing and snorkelling trip during our stay in muscat oman. our experience was excellent and couldn't have asked for a better day. he arranged pickup and drop off from our hotel to the marina. started the day dropping baits deep on different reefs and caught a very nice sized grouper and some smaller species. he then took us to bk islands where we snorkelled in the amazing water. we were in the water for 20 mins and counted 10+ turtles swimming all around us. we were then treated with delicious omani tea. we spent the rest of the day trolling and landed a very good size emperor and a few big barracuda. service and knowledge was 10/10. he also arranged to have the fish cooked for us oman style and delivered to our hotel! highly recommend for anyone looking to book a snorkelling/fishing tour in muscat !!

my wife and i booked this for our honeymoon after reading several phenomenal reviews---phillip, elias, our guide robert timon, and the rest of the staff completely exceeded our expectations from the moment we arrived through dropping us back to the kogatende airtrip on our last day. rooms: the tents, dining/lounge tent, infinity pool, and essentially any communal area on the property were clean, extremely luxurious, and thoughtfully designed for convenience and pleasure whatever the time of day. witness, our room attendant, always made sure there were no insects before closing the tent and added warm bags that kept the bed extremely warm throughout the night. service: we regularly spend on experiences in this bracket and had not seen such attention, care, and genuine desire to make us feel special until this trip. for our safari robert timon went above and beyond by bringing us extremely close (within 5 feet!) of all of the big 5 animals as well as multiple prides, he was extremely informative and tenacious about making sure we saw everything serengeti had to offer. the chef personally tailored the menu to our vegetarian and spicy tastes, regularly coming personally to ask about exactly what to pack for our safari meals. philip additionally helped reschedule our flight back within 24 hours notice to make our journey to zanzibar so much more convenient. location: the view from any of the tents and common areas of the northern serengeti plans and kenya side is breathtaking because bushtops is located on a high point. we saw everything we wanted despite not being directly near the migrations and this is all because of the amazing team at bushtops. we won't forget this trip and can confidently say that any guest staying here will feel the same. thank you serengeti bushtops for an unbelievable series of moments during our honeymoon.

my wife and i decided to take a last-minute canal cruise during our visit to amsterdam and chose flagship amsterdam canal cruise because of their open-air boats — perfect for enjoying the beautiful views. we were warmly welcomed by oliver, who was incredibly helpful, as was the rest of the staff. oliver also served as our host during the cruise, providing fascinating insights into the architecture and rich history of amsterdam. the route included plenty of picturesque photo spots, and gerrard (apologies if i’ve misspelled his name) did an excellent job navigating the boat, often pausing to allow everyone to get great photos. drinks were available on board, and oliver even took the time to snap pictures for each guest, making the experience feel very personal and enjoyable. the entire cruise was informative, relaxing, and a highlight of our trip. highly recommend flagship amsterdam canal cruise if you’re looking for a fun and memorable way to explore the canals of amsterdam!

my wife and i did a 90min couples massage and it was amazing 👏. the deep tissue massage was a perfect way to relax and we left feeling very refreshed. all the employees were nice. we didn't have to make a reservation, just walked in and they took care of us. good prices too

my wife and i did a night photo tour during our honeymoon, and it was an incredible experience! although the sky was cloudy that evening, mike made the most of it by walking us through the fundamentals of night photography in a clear and engaging way. we still managed to capture some beautiful shots of the athabasca river and falls. mike even offered to reschedule the tour due to the weather, which we really appreciated, but unfortunately, our tight itinerary didn’t allow it. highly recommended!

my wife and i did the cooking class with the morning market visit. t was our guide for the day. he picked us up promptly at 7:30 am with a tuk tuk driver to head to the morning market. he provided cold waters and taught us about cambodian history and explained a lot of the sights to see on the way out of town towards the morning market. once we got to the morning market t walked us around and showed us all of the ingredients the cambodian people use to prepare their traditional foods. we also tried cricket, beetle, meal worms, and lotus flower seeds. all of them were great! after the market we headed back to the cooking class. t had us prepare the pumpkin dessert to start things off because that required the most time to cook and it would be ready by the time we’d be done with the rolls and amok. the dipping sauce with the chili peppers were great! next we made chicken amok which was my favorite. we hand ground the amok paste which was more difficult than i had imagined but well worth the hard work. folding the banana leaf bowl was fun too! t showed us around the property while we waited for the amok and pumpkin dessert to finish. we got to meet a couple of the cows and one of the kittens named “chicken”. t also took time to explain ben, the owner, story which was fascinating. all of the work that ben has done for the cambodian people is heart warming and honorable. such a cool story that a young boy trying to run into the tomb raider film crew to practice his english has spawned an organization that touched so many lives is truly amazing. after the food was done we ate the results of our own work which was fantastic. this was both my wife and i first time having amok and we both loved it. the pumpkin dessert was a nice way to finish the meal as well. t was very hands on and was a great teacher. he is certainly a very skilled chef. he spoke great english and taught us a few words in cambodian as well. they emailed us the recipes so we can try at home and said to reach out if there’s anything we can’t find and need to substitute which was nice. overall a great experience and i recommend choosing countryside cooking class because not only is it a great experience it supports a great cause. thanks again we loved it!!

my wife and i did the self guided tour. it was truly spectacular to see this historic site and all the artifacts. we were very happy with how knowledgeable the staff were giving us some back ground knowledge about the history.

my wife and i enjoyed a magical 4 night stay at kadizora, bookending what was a magical first experience of safari in botswana. we chose to take our first trip to botswana during their low season but we loved how dry the floodplains were and how open the landscape had become, as it afforded us numerous additional routes within the concession to explore which would not have been feasible during high flood due to the water levels. a true benefit to low season at kadizora and to the delta in general are the low occupancy levels evidenced by the fact we were the only guests in camp throughout our 4 night stay, which was as welcomed as it was unexpected and an anomaly which only served to enhance our holistic experience of kadizora further. in essence, from our arrival to our departure we had the whole camp to ourselves, including private game viewing activities throughout with timings/routes tailored to our own preferences. similarly our daily itinerary was made flexible by matthew and aidan, our personable and highly capable camp managers, who gave us the autonomy and freedom to truly feel at home in camp from the moment we arrived by empowering us to feel comfortable in tailoring each day to suit our own preferences and sensibilities. one notable mention must go to the food in camp which was consistently the best we enjoyed throughout this trip despite strong competition from the other camps we visited prior. kadizora is truly remote and intimate camp located in the northern delta with the selinda spillway dissecting its vast and exclusive ng concession, sharing as it does with only two other camps. this exclusivity was notable in providing a true authentic botswana safari experience as we barely encountered another game vehicle (or human) throughout our stay. similarly, the sightings we were fortunate to witness, predominantly were ones we had entirely to ourselves with no time limits to concern ourselves with. for me this was a noticeable and welcome discrepancy from previous safari experiences we have had in other countries and destinations. as avid wildlife enthusiasts, the opportunity to spend over an hour with a pack of wild dogs while they readied themselves to hunt or spend half a day with a female lioness and follow her journey from sunrise to sunset culminating in watching her make not one but two successful kills of a late afternoon, is one of countless examples what i feel separates kadizora as being somewhat of hidden gem on the much heralded delta safari circuit. of course none of these sightings and none of these experiences would be possible without the skill, intellect and expertise of our indomitable guide, oc, who was a lovely, unassuming, personable man but equally highly capable, someone who took his job extremely seriously and was at the top of his game throughout. his diligence and professionalism served to maximise our ‘out of camp’ safari experience in a similar vein to how matthew, aidan, kenny and every other member of the kadizora team looked after us ‘in camp’ in a such a meaningful fashion that it left us with only cherished and fond memories of what was a private and memorable 4 nights we enjoyed at kadizora camp. i cannot recommend kadizora camp highly enough in all aspects. we would love to re-visit as return guests going forward and have already begun discussing how we might plan to do so in the near future and for years to come.

my wife and i got the steak saj and the chicken platter. for the price of $23 canadian, i could not have been happier with the results. the hummus was flavorful and creamy. the garlic sauce was rich and not too overpowering. the chicken and the steak were flavorful and thinly sliced! what put this over the edge was the kindness of the people working there (they got me a delicious hot sauce cup) and the food tasted so good the next morning after sitting in the fridge from not being able to finish all the food they provided the night before!!!! ps. $17 us is even better of a deal but who’s counting

my wife and i had 2 days / 6 dives with dive master khim. he was an amazing dive master and we had some great dives. the whole staff is great and friendly. we will definitely return to boracay and we will only dive with island staff. we’ve already recommended them to several friends.

my wife and i had a great time on our trip with eli and the crew. they worked extremely hard to make sure we were having a great time and most importantly that we were catching tons of fish. arys who organized the trip for us was super friendly and quick to respond to any and all questions we had as well as organizing pick up and drop off from our hotel. highly recommend! and look forward to going fishing with them again!

my wife and i had a lovely visit to skyspa. the thermal spa is excellent and easy to spend a couple hours rotating around. we had lunch at the bistro which was quite nice and well priced. philip was my masseuse and gave a great massage. i would recommend skyspa to locals or anyone visiting quebec city.

my wife and i had a wonderful hike in the woods with our puppy, and we met many people with friendly dogs on the trail. we later had a late lunch at únětický pivovar, where the food was delicious and the beer was very refreshing. i buy beer from únětický pivovar whenever i get a chance; it was nice to get it fresh from the source. i really enjoyed our day here; we'll definitely return.

my wife and i had a wonderful time exploring the museo nazionale romano in rome, which offers an incredible collection of ancient roman art, culture, and history. established in 1889, the museum is spread across several historic sites, including palazzo massimo alle terme, palazzo altemps, the baths of diocletian, and crypta balbi, each offering a unique perspective on rome’s vast archaeological heritage. we were especially impressed by the beautifully preserved frescoes, intricate mosaics, and lifelike marble sculptures, many of which date back to the height of the roman empire. the museum’s thoughtful layout and detailed explanations brought the ancient world vividly to life, making it a must-visit for anyone interested in the grandeur and daily life of ancient rome.

my wife and i had an amazing time at *wreck bay diving center*! from the moment we arrived, we felt really safe and well taken care . the dives were incredible, and we could tell we were in the hands of true professionals. this agency is truly one of the best i’ve dived with. the owner was not only welcoming but also gave us excellent recommendations for exploring all of the galápagos. the dive instructors were 5 star deserved, providing us with the best diving experience we could ask for. from the captain to the whole team, everyone had great vibes. we truly appreciate everything the team did for us, and we’re so grateful for the unforgettable diving in the galápagos. highly recommend wreck bay diving center to anyone looking for a safe, professional, and amazing diving experience!

my wife and i had an incredible experience with axel fishing under the midnight sun. he was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, and we were on fish from the first cast. we caught a bunch of coalfish right off the bat, and could probably have caught 1,000 of them if we had kept fishing. we decided to try for some halibut but they eluded us this time! we also saw a group of puffins flying along the water which was a very cool experience. overall it was an unforgettable evening on the water, and i would highly, highly recommend booking a trip with axel. thanks again, and we’ll be back for the halibut!

my wife and i had an incredible time earning our padi advanced open water diver certifications with fisheye divers in boracay! over two unforgettable days, we explored stunning dive sites and gained a wealth of new diving knowledge. the team was professional and passionate, making every moment enjoyable. our instructors were patient and thorough, breaking down each skill so we felt confident and ready. the dive locations were spectacular! the wreck dive was a standout—exploring the sunken structure felt like an adventure film. the underwater wildlife was equally stunning, with vibrant coral reefs teeming with turtles, parrotfish, and a sneaky moray eel. we brought some new gopro and camera gear we’d bought before the trip, and we captured some amazing footage of the dives ourselves, which made the experience even more special. fisheye’s small group approach ensured personalized attention, and their top-notch equipment and safety focus made us feel secure. the service was seamless, and their underwater photography complemented our own shots, giving us memories we’ll treasure forever. we highly recommend fisheye divers to anyone diving in boracay, from beginners to advanced divers. we’re already excited to dive with them again!

my wife and i had an unforgettable time at the everglades alligator farm during their valentine’s day sunset tour! the airboat ride through the everglades was thrilling, with breathtaking views of the marshes and wildlife as the sun set, casting a gorgeous glow over the landscape. our guide was knowledgeable, sharing fascinating facts about the ecosystem and pointing out wild alligators and birds. the highlight was the baby gator holding at the end—such a unique and fun experience! the champagne toast added a romantic touch, making it a perfect evening. the staff were friendly, and the entire tour felt well-organized and safe. highly recommend this special tour for couples or anyone looking for a memorable everglades adventure!

my wife and i had the most incredible time with santosails! from start to finish, everything was absolutely perfect. we were picked up right on time from our villa and brought to the beautiful catamaran, where the amazing crew welcomed us. the boat was spotless and very comfortable, and the food and drinks were delicious. the crew went above and beyond to make us feel relaxed and taken care of the entire time. what made the trip even more special were the fascinating stories they shared about santorini’s history and how the island was formed. this was hands down one of the highlights of our trip. if you’re visiting santorini, don’t miss the chance to sail with santosails it’s an unforgettable experience!

my wife and i had the pleasure of traveling to kenya and exploring the country with wildlife safari kenya. they planned out our entire itinerary in-country and handled everything from lodging to airport transfers and travel. as part of our visit we spent about 4 days in the maasai mara with our guide leonard. leonard was incredibly knowledgable not only of the mara, but of every corner of the country. leonard used this knowledge to ensure that my wife and i saw everything we wanted to see on our game drives, and more. he had an incredible knowledge of the wildlife on the reserve, their habitats and normal ranges, and at one point even stopped to help a national geographic filming crew find big cats. even more importantly, and this goes for every wildlife safari employee we interacted with, leonard went above and beyond to ensure that we had a comfortable and effortless trip. he spoke to us and treated us like family (although over the years i know he has met and guided countless people). reflecting on our time in kenya, my wife and i have repeatedly stated that we wouldn't do the trip with anyone but wildlife safari, and that we are counting down the days until we get to go again!

my wife and i have been diving with many shops around the world. acuatic tulum is the real deal: one of the cleanest, most organized operations we have ever experienced. the staff is highly knowledgeable, focused on safety above all, and incredibly welcoming. alex and orlando led us on several dives throughout the week, and they were all amazing. what impressed me the most is the commitment and passion theses guides have for our beautiful sport. alex worked with me directly on my photography, and as an added bonus, orlando took our little guy on his first dive ever! i cannot recommend acuatic tulum more highly, especially if you want to truly feel the special magic of the cenotes. this is the only place we will dive when we’re in tulum.
my wife and i have had very good experience and trip to “prison island” and “vanishing island” with these guys and we can highly recommend their service and hospitality.

my wife and i have ordered numerous mask from the original venice shop because their quality and craftsmanship are second to none. we have had no issues with postage or shipping and we hope to keep buying the creative masks you guys loving craft. always a pleasure to do business and shop here.

my wife and i recently had the pleasure of escaping to the sun-drenched shores of isla mujeres, and it was a day we'll long remember. the island offers a perfect blend of laid-back charm and breathtaking natural beauty, with two particular highlights that made our trip truly special: a delightful golf cart adventure around the island and the awe-inspiring vistas from punta sur. from the moment we hopped onto our golf cart, a sense of freedom and adventure washed over us. cruising along the island's winding roads with the warm caribbean breeze in our hair was an experience in itself. this mode of transport is not only practical for navigating the island's charming streets but also allows for spontaneous stops to capture the perfect photo, dip your toes in the turquoise waters, or simply pause to appreciate the vibrant local life. the journey itself became a cherished part of our exploration, offering a unique and personal way to discover the island's hidden gems at our own pace. the culmination of our island tour was arriving at punta sur, the southernmost point of isla mujeres. here, at the "cliff of the dawn," we were greeted by some of the most stunning panoramic views we have ever witnessed. the dramatic cliffs meeting the endless expanse of the turquoise and sapphire caribbean sea is a sight that truly takes your breath away. we spent a considerable amount of time simply mesmerized by the scenery, watching the waves crash against the rocks below and feeling the immense power and beauty of nature. the area is also home to a fascinating sculpture garden and the remnants of a mayan temple dedicated to the goddess ixchel, adding a touch of cultural intrigue to the natural splendour. for any couple seeking a romantic and memorable day trip, we cannot recommend this itinerary enough. the combination of the fun and freedom of a golf cart ride with the sheer magnificence of punta sur creates a perfect blend of activity and serene contemplation. it's a day that encapsulates the very essence of a caribbean paradise.

my wife and i recently returned from our 60th birthday bucket list trip to africa, and we truly could not have asked for a better partner in planning it than kay theron of timeless south africa safaris. from start to finish, kay delivered an experience that was seamless, thoughtful, and incredibly well-executed. her attention to detail and responsiveness gave us complete confidence every step of the way — from planning safaris and cultural excursions to securing world-class accommodations and handling all the logistics behind the scenes. one highlight of our time in cape town was being connected with abul, a guide kay recommended. abul was an absolute pleasure to work with — incredibly knowledgeable, engaging, and just a great guy all around. he added so much depth and color to our experience, and we feel fortunate to have had him with us during that part of the journey. what truly set kay apart, though, was the personal care she brought to the experience. while we were wine tasting in stellenbosch, she went out of her way to visit us in person — a wonderful and meaningful touch that made the trip feel all the more special. this journey was everything we had hoped for and more; we are deeply grateful to kay for helping make it a reality. if you're considering a trip to south africa or beyond, we cannot recommend timeless south africa safaris and kay theron highly enough

my wife and i recently rode the arrowtown to queenstown trail on e-bikes, and it was an awesome way to spend the day. the trail winds through some seriously beautiful scenery—think rolling hills, river gorges, native bush, and stunning mountain views. we really appreciated how well the trail is maintained. it’s a good mix of easy gravel paths and a few slightly more challenging sections, but the e-bikes made it all very manageable and enjoyable. we could take our time, enjoy the ride, and soak in the views without worrying about getting too tired. some highlights included crossing the swing bridges, following the kawarau river, and that final descent into queenstown with lake wakatipu coming into view—just amazing. this was a seriously scenic and fun ride that we’d definitely recommend to anyone looking for a relaxed and memorable outdoor experience in the area.

my wife and i recently visited a remarkable gallery in rome, and it was an experience to remember. the ticket price was relatively modest, yet the visit was absolutely worth it. the gallery featured an impressive collection of sculptures and paintings, each piece captivating in its own way. what stood out even more was the fascinating exhibition showcasing the development of modern science and technology. the combination of art and innovation made this gallery a truly enriching destination. highly recommended for anyone visiting rome!

my wife and i recently went on the furnas night-time experience with the thermal baths and diner. our guide was filipe and he was great. very personable and knowledgeable. the dinner was very good with lots of food and drinks. the stop after dinner for tea at the outdoor thermals was a pleasant surprise as well. the thermal baths at night were magical with the lighting and gorgeous surroundings. would highly recommend this tour group and filipe!

my wife and i saw several classical music concerts during our trip to austria in november of 2024, and the konzerte karlskirche orchester 1756 was by far our favorite. the performances were wonderful and the venue amazing! the ensemble were very engaging and excited to be performing for us. the lead violinist, martin osiak was very talented and fun to watch. if you’re looking for an excellent performance, a wonderful set of music (vivaldi’s four seasons), and a gorgeous venue…and at an affordable price, konzerte karlskirche orchester 1756 is definitely worth seeing.

my wife and i spent 3 afternoons kiting and 2 afternoons surfing with daniel while on our honeymoon. we got in touch a few months before we arrived so daniel kept availability for us, and when we got to mauritius daniel actually got in touch with us to schedule the sessions. super proactive comms which we really appreciated! coordinating sessions was really flexible based on conditions and timing preferences, and daniel was super responsive via whatsapp. daniel's teaching was also excellent: very laid back, friendly and spot-on instructions. while kiting we both had a radio strapped to our helmets so he could talk to us which made it so much easier to learn and progress. the lagoon around le morne is also a perfect place to learn kiting, very safe surroundings, flat water, and waist-depth which makes it super easy to walk upwind a bit while learning. even on good wind days it was not too busy with plenty of room for beginners. after 3 days we were both riding upwind and transitioning, something we haven't managed to do anywhere else we took lessons. we stayed at lux le morne and daniel picked us up and dropped us off for all the sessions. surfing was also great, daniel picked us up on the beach and took us to little reef by boat. he constantly got us in the right positions to catch waves and gave us great guidance, resulting in both of us properly surfing our first wave. we will definitely go back to mauritius and when we do, we'll be back at pryde club. if not for lessons, then for equipment rental. in short: if you're looking for a great place to learn, progress or rent gear, look no further.

my wife and i spent 4 nights here in november 2024 and had an incredible experience. the accommodations were great, staff was very thoughtful and friendly, and our guide, bee, was phenomenal. he did a great job of explaining his tracking methods and giving us so much interesting information about all the animals we came across. we saw lions, hyenas, hippos, leopards, giraffes, zebras, elephants, baboons, and more that i’m probably forgetting. would highly recommend this camp for your botswana safari.

my wife and i spent 8 days in the faroe islands and this was the highlight of our trip. the fishing with samson was amazing and he told us many stories about the islands. we caught lots of fish and samson was very helpful in showing us how to use the equipment. the stunning landscapes surrounding us during the entire fishing trip added to the amazing experience. after fishing, we drove a short distance to myrna and kristian's house where they hosted us for dinner and gave us a walking tour of their village. they were both extremely nice and made us feel as if we were part of their family. we got to sample so many faroese foods and the food was amazing. we cannot say enough about samson, myrna and kristian! do not hesitate to book this trip. you will not regret it!

my wife and i spent five amazing days at ecocamp tdp this week. we did 3 days of puma safari and 1.5 days of touring tdp and its surrounding areas. we stayed in a suite dome with private bathroom. we had never done camping in our adult livesbut this camp is at another level. beautiful architecture, tasteful interior decorations, and eco friendly. it is possibly the most beautiful and luxurious accomodation that we have stayed in. service is great. always smiling staff, ready to go an extra mile for you. now comes the real treat, the food. where to begin? the kitchen staff is extremely organized. breakfast tables set up and ready to go at 6 am for minimum 40-50+ folks. make your own lunch for hikers and others alike, ready at 6 am. packed lunch, if requested, ready for you to pick up outside at 6 am. you can even come back for lunch as we did at 1pm. quality of food: outstanding!!! we literally wondered if they have a michelin star chef. creative dinner menu that leaves you in awe. my wife is a vegetarian and she went gaga over the flavors, chef's selections, creativity and presentation. the kitchen manager, osvaldo ( forgive me if i am spelling his name wrong) is on top of things in the dining area. puma safari: ecocamp is not a good option for puma safari. morning and evening safaris will cost you 6 hours of drive time each day. even though the private ranch on which puma safari hapems is close to ecocamp, the actual puma safari area on the ranch is 1.5 hours away. el overjero may be a better option for puma safari. in addition, ecocamp does not have an in house private puma safari program. it outsources it to leona amarga. read my review of leona amarga expeditions. but if you are hiking or visiting tdp, ecocamp is the best option. we stayed at las torres last year and we think it is way overrated. javi was our sightseeing tour guide for tdp and its adjacent areas, she was excellent!! sweet and professional! will definitely stay at ecocamp again.

my wife and i spent our 20th anniversary here. if you are going to stay near kantishna in one of the lodges, and your goal is to experience the mountains and wildlife of denali np, this is by far the best choice. there is a view of denali from each cabin. the food was outstanding. the naturalists know their stuff and greatly enhanced our outings. they staff were beyond kind and made us feel very welcome. i believe this is also the only lodge that currently has access to drive vehicles on the back 60 miles beyond the landslide. we were able to access parts of the park others weren’t. during this time of the road closure there is a magical window where the western park is nearly empty of people. we saw more bears than other people on all of our outings. if your goal is to experience the wilderness of denali np with a luxury cabin experience, i can’t recommend camp denali highly enough.

my wife and i stayed at hanging gardens of bali for our honeymoon. the location is stunning, the food is delicious, and the staff are friendly. however, we faced several issues that affected our stay: 1. the honeymoon cake and welcome drink we were expecting upon arrival were not provided. the hotel later explained that the cake was planned as a surprise for the last night, but this was not communicated to us, which led to disappointment. 2. the air conditioner malfunctioned twice and still did not cool the room properly, which was uncomfortable. 3. most importantly, despite requesting full privacy for cultural reasons (as my wife wears a hijab), parts of the outdoor area were visible to others. this made us feel quite exposed, which was very disappointing for a honeymoon. the hotel responded to my concerns and explained their side, which i appreciate. however, these issues did impact our overall comfort. we had stayed in other hotels during the same trip that provided full privacy without any problems. overall, it’s a beautiful resort, but for honeymooners seeking complete privacy and seamless service, i recommend clarifying your expectations very clearly in advance.

my wife and i stayed here for five nights in july. from start to finish we found everything to be well organized, professional and personable. we opted for the boat ride to and from the island. the crew were all very helpful and ensured our transition from the boat to land was smooth. we had an ocean front room with a private pool. the view was stunning and the access to the beautiful beach was only a few steps away. there is plenty to do there and scheduling activities is easy. we mostly chilled at the spa, but we went snorkeling as well. again, the boat crew were great as were the reefs and fish. the water was a little chilly for us and we should have taken the wet suit. next time. the food was great and the service was impeccable. they go out of their way to individualize each experience. if we every make it back to mozambique we will be sure to stay here again.

my wife and i thoroughly enjoyed our experience at west thumb geyser basin! we found a handicapped parking space easily. my wife was able to use her electric scooter on the boardwalks. the area was beautiful! we liked the various geysers and mud pots and the view of yellowstone lake was breathtaking! the walk was not overly taxing. it started snowing when we were about halfway through and was really coming down by the time we got back to the parking lot. i highly recommend this site!

my wife and i thoroughly enjoyed visiting tvrđava minčeta tower during our walk around the old town of dubrovnik. as the highest point along the city walls, the tower offered absolutely stunning panoramic views of the adriatic sea and the historic rooftops below. its impressive medieval architecture and well-preserved structure made it a highlight of our stroll. be prepared for a good walk...and it was not bad as we took our time and did it slowly taking lots of pictures and videos.

my wife and i took the full day daintree rainforest and cape tribulation tour. as with many tours in australia, be prepared for time spent riding. the nice thing about this tour was the small group/vehicle quaintness. we were there in june, thus the vehicle was not full. we met several people on the tour and were able to share highlights of our travels. several stops at lookouts, beach, rainforest walk, etc. gavin was our driver/guide and he was very knowledgeable and interesting. lunch was at the heritage and very good for a tour group type of serving. we had the steak and fish. river cruise was fantastic, got to see several crocs. our captain was very funny.

my wife and i travelled to namibia in june 2025 for a 3 week self-drive safari which took us the length and breadth of namibia, from fish river canyon to swakopmond, skeleton coast to opuwo and finally etosha. namibia tours and safaris were awesome! from planning the trip even with multiple changes to our itinerary (thanks julia and kim), to picking us up at the airport, to our arrival/departure orientation, to being available on a sunday afternoon when we had vehicle issues, namibia tours and safaris was absolutely top notch. the accommodations they chose were amazing. if we could give them a 10 out of 5, we would. we would completely recommend this company, especially if you are a first time traveler to africa.

my wife and i visited bariloche for the first time and stayed at huinid pioneros. by chance we met agustin at the hotel reception as he was working from there. after asking a few questions about places to visit, agustin helped us with ideas about where to go and what to visit. we ended up visiting puerto cántaros, puerto blest, lago frias and puerto frías. it was a wonderful experience! after we returned, agustin was eager to get feedback about our experience, which in my opinion shows a genuine interest in helping visitors with the best suggestions about places to see. i highly recommend barlan travel & adventure and will for sure use the agency services again when we eventually return to bariloche.

my wife and i visited hell’s gate during our time in rotorua, and it ended up being one of the highlights of our trip. the geothermal park is incredibly unique—walking through the steaming landscape, bubbling mud pools, and sulfur lakes felt like stepping onto another planet. the guided walk was informative, and we learned a lot about the history and māori cultural significance of the area. the facilities were clean and well-managed, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. it’s a perfect blend of natural wonder and cultural insight. if you’re in rotorua, hell’s gate is definitely worth a visit

my wife and i visited here and the food was great especially the burger, it was delicious, the wings was great also, my only complaint is that we sat down ate our food finished our food then sat for another maybe 20 minutes and some friends joined us, the waiter charged an extra gratuity for 4 other people joining us, i thought that was pure greed, i did not contact the manager or the restaurant cause nowadays i'm like nothing is gone get done all these restaurants say is contact this person or call this number i felt like he should have given us our ticket and cashed us out cause it was 2 of us my wife and i to put an extra charge for us to watch them eat was insane, would have gotten a better rating the waiter messed that up, i rate on service, food and now restrooms which i didn't visit follow me on instagram docccwayne_reviews

my wife and i visited in early july with our three kids, (18, 16, 14). i would not recommend for young children unless they are able to sit still for three hours. we were blessed with clear skies for dinner as it had rained most of the day. the staff were friendly and very accommodating. we arrived at 745pm per the reservation instructions and were about 8th in line to be seated. they seat groups one at a time due to the boats limited spaces. boarding was quick and the greeters very friendly chatting with guests in both english and french. our dinner service was excellent and the food was delicious. the menu has options for vegetarians. highly recommend the dinner cruise as it times perfectly with the lighting of the eiffel tower in the evening. over all a wonderful way to end our first day in paris.

my wife and i visited punta sure on may 3,2025 and it was a journey we will never forget it was absolutely amazing and so much fun. beautiful landscapes, great places to take scenic photos. you can see a lot of wild life just roaming around. great snorkeling, a light house that over looks the coastline in the park.

my wife and i visited the roman forum, which can be conveniently combined with the colosseum for €18. the site is huge and exploring it is easy to combine with some relaxing moments, enjoying the atmosphere and views. we spent about two hours before closing, and even in that short time, we were absolutely amazed. the ancient ruins, the history in the air, and the stunning views of rome make it a truly unforgettable experience. we’re already planning to return with a guide or audiobook to learn even more about this incredible place.
