one of the most peaceful and scenic spots in rome. the view from the terrace is absolutely stunning, offering a perfect panorama over the city including a unique view of st. peter’s dome. this garden, also called the orange garden, sits on the aventine hill and was originally part of a dominican monastery in the 13th century. the orange trees were planted by saint dominic himself, according to tradition. it’s a great place to relax, enjoy some shade under the trees, and capture beautiful photos. i often bring my photography clients here the light and atmosphere are perfect, especially in the early morning. highly recommended if you’re looking for a quiet escape and breathtaking views in the heart of rome.

one of the most peaceful places in vienna. the atmosphere is amazing all year round, with the soothing sound of the water adding to the calm vibe. it’s also a great spot for kids — they’re always so happy and excited when they see the fish. truly a relaxing and joyful place for all ages.

one of the most peaceful spots in the city. the toronto music garden feels like a hidden gem right on the waterfront. it’s beautifully designed, with winding paths, lush greenery, and views of the lake. each section of the garden has its own character, inspired by bach’s music, and you can really feel the intention behind how it’s laid out. it’s a great place to walk, read, sit with a coffee, or just clear your head. you’ll see a mix of locals, tourists, and even musicians sometimes. it’s quiet, clean, and well cared for. definitely worth stopping by if you’re in the area it’s one of those rare public spaces that actually makes you feel more grounded. we were lucky to catch sounds of story indian fusion

one of the most photogenic places in el nido. i visited this cave while on the eponymous beach. can be a difficult for tall people to get into the cave, but once inside the instagrammable photos will be worth it.

one of the most picturesque spots in the bukchon hanok village area, bukchon yukgyeong offers a stunning view of traditional hanok rooftops framed by seoul’s modern skyline. it’s a perfect blend of old and new, ideal for photography and a quiet moment to take in the city’s rich heritage. a must-visit photo spot for those exploring bukchon.

one of the most popular and famous weekend markets in berlin. i really like to walk around here. the market has a lot to offer, groceries, flowers, artwork, decorations, and so on. there are some food stands for the foodies to try out. it is located in the gay district. after the market, why not discover the neighbourhood a bit more.

one of the most unforgettable views in new york! i visited the edge on a warm summer day and discovered a great insider tip: instead of paying for the regular observation deck ticket, i went straight to the bar upstairs. that way, i skipped the entrance fee—but yes, you must order something to stay. totally worth it! i had a refreshing cocktail with stunning panoramic views of manhattan, hudson yards, and beyond. the vibe was chic but relaxed, and there were fewer crowds than i expected around midday. the glass floor and angled windows give you that adrenaline rush without the line. if you want the experience without paying the full ticket, head to the bar, enjoy a drink, and soak in the views. highly recommended for travelers who want the view and a cocktail to go with it!
one of the most unique and beautiful spots in yellowstone — far more stunning in person than in photos. the steamy, colorful landscape feels otherworldly.

one of the most unique exhibitions i’ve ever seen. body worlds amsterdam goes beyond anatomy — it shows, using real human bodies, how happiness impacts our physical health. it’s educational, emotional, and just the right amount of dark — perfect for science lovers and curious minds. the theme “the happiness project” is beautifully presented, with interactive sections and powerful visuals. i left genuinely reflecting on how our emotions shape our physical well-being. the experience is well-organized, the space is clean, and the staff is super friendly. highly recommend it for young people, travelers looking for something different, or anyone interested in the connection between mind and body. tip: take your time and go with an open mind. this museum gets under your skin — in the best way possible.

one of the most unique hotels i've ever stayed in! this place is truly peaceful and full of history, an oasis right in the heart of quebec. our room was fantastic: super clean, bright, and comfortable. the breakfast was delicious, with plenty of healthy options to choose from. on top of that, the hotel offers divine massages and other mindful activities that really elevate the experience. truly a must-stay when visiting quebec!
one of the most unique parks in singapore. very calm during weekdays but slightly crowded during weekends.

one of the most unique spots in the french quarter. the courtyard is cozy, lush, and perfect for intimate ceremonies and the string lights make it feel super romantic at night. inside, there’s a whole museum of old apothecary stuff your guests can check out during cocktail hour. if you want something that feels like classic new orleans without being overdone, this is it.
one of the most visited and popular sites in havana. great place to see the sunset. there are people fishing, singers and guitar players, rose vendors, and couples romancing.

one of the most wonderful places i've ever been, with first-class service, attentive staff, and exceptional cuisine. i've done several recreational activities at the center and haven't had a single complaint. i would like to congratulate the center's management for all the attention they provide.

one of the must visit chapel in israel. this is the place from where jesus ascended into heaven. it's a heavenly feeling as you enter this place of worship. serene and peaceful meditative atmosphere. very few are blessed with the opportunity to visit this place. should this blessing shine upon you, please don't miss it.

one of the must visit places in the uae when you're around. if you want to understand the country's culture and catch real old dubai vibes this is the right place. the best time is obviously evening as all lights are up and the weather is pleasing. number of authentic restaurants and coffee shop will definitely add the mood to the overall atmosphere so you will definitely stop in one to try some arabic coffee and sweets.
one of the must-see natural wonders of azores! the hike up to the lake takes about 20 min but don’t rush to get back, just sit down and enjoy the magnificent scenery.

one of the must-visit places in bali! the lights were so beautiful, and the staff were very friendly. the whole place had a magical atmosphere, and it was a really nice experience. it’s a perfect place for anyone who is looking for a memorable evening in bali.

one of the must-visit places in vancouver. the public market is full of fresh fruits, veggies, and all kinds of local goodies, with some vendors even offering free samples to try. parking can be a bit stressful, especially on weekends, and even on weekdays it can be hard to find a spot. still, it is definitely worth the visit. i loved walking around, exploring the shops, and enjoying the beautiful waterfront views. it is a great spot to soak in the local vibe! things i recommend trying/visiting: • lasagna at the market • creative craft shops • lee’s donuts • flower shops • the crystal chandelier under the overpass

one of the nice market in berlin where you always can find your favorite korean or italian food stand, or your favorite french "saucisson" and orange wine. a big choice of fruits, vegetables, flowers and a few food stands including coffee and turkish delicious food. it's located right in the middle of the busy area and a couple of nice streets where you can spend your afternoon easily

one of the nicest parks in paris with lot of statues and a wee lake and a pyramid! there's a grand playground for kids,too. there's free toilets that were quite all right when i was there. the garden was quiet (if you stay away from the kind corner), lush and we'll maintained.

one of the nicest spas i have been too in iceland, everything is immaculate - lovely changing area and showers and then several pools to relax in - all at different temperatures. as a bonus - a steam room, infrared sauna and a relaxation room. it was very quiet when we were there (sunday morning in january) so it was very peaceful indeed. not sure it would have the same relaxing vibe full of tourists all taking photos for their insta! we stayed about 3 hours then went for lunch in the restaurant/bar - also highly recommended. good service and fantastic food.

one of the nicest walks in rio or anywhere in the world. an absolute treat for any nature and exercise minded lover. a most pleasent trek amidst exotic gentle jungle with well kept and safe tracks plus beautifully 117 sculpted steps all the way up. highly recommended for anybody or any level of fitness and greatly rewarded with the most magnificent 360 degree views of rio and beyond that only a helicopter can afford. not to be missed!
one of the numerous gates into the medina. on its southern side. located on a hill with pleasant views of the surrounding area.

one of the oldest levadas in madeira, full of history, it was built by slaves during the time when portugal was a slave-trading country. from a landscape perspective, there are more impressive levadas, but it’s still a beautiful walk.

one of the oldest parts of the city is the heart of medieval prague. the most significant square of historical prague, founded in the 12th century, has witnessed many historical events. in addition to the old town hall and the church of our lady before týn, the square is dominated by the baroque church of st. nicholas, the rococo kinsky palace, the gothic house at the stone bell and the jan hus monument. on the pavement of the square there are memorial stones commemorating the execution of 27 czech lords in 1621 and the prague meridian. perhaps the most beautiful square in the whole city. gothic houses and churches; cobblestone streets and squares; stone towers create an amazing historical atmosphere. and all kinds of bars, restaurants, dance clubs, shops of international brands, galleries and hotels give energy to the old city, presenting its modern face.

one of the oldest watch tower in dubai. very beautiful and relaxing park build around the watch tower.

one of the places i really enjoyed visiting was the royal botanic garden in sydney, australia. it’s located right next to the opera house and overlooks the sydney harbour, so the views are absolutely stunning. the garden is huge and beautifully maintained. there are colourful flower beds everywhere—pink, purple, yellow—really vibrant and full of life. you can also see tall palm trees and massive green trees that give you a lot of shade. in some areas, there are big open lawns where people sit, relax, or even have a picnic. the best part is how the garden blends with the city skyline—you can actually see modern buildings peeking through the trees, which makes it feel peaceful but still very urban. when i went there, i just walked around and took photos. the weather was really nice—bright sky, cool breeze—and it felt very relaxing. there was a small lake and also some benches where i sat for a while and just enjoyed the view. i also passed by fields of yellow flowers that were really eye-catching. i loved it because it gave me a break from the busy city without needing to go far. it’s clean, spacious, and very well-designed for both tourists and locals. i would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting sydney.

one of those places in london that blends character, culture, and creativity all under one roof. nestled just a short walk from liverpool street station, it’s a covered market buzzing with energy — whether you’re into quirky finds, top-notch street food, or just fancy a bit of people-watching in a vibrant setting. the variety of stalls is genuinely impressive. one day you’ll find vintage clothes and handmade jewellery, the next it’s local artists and antique maps. thursdays are especially worth a visit if you’re into antiques — loads of proper old-school stalls with unique treasures. the mix of independent traders and small boutique shops gives it a refreshing edge over your typical high-street fare. food is a big part of what makes spitalfields special. the central food court has options from all over the world — think neapolitan pizza, ethiopian curries, bao buns, gourmet burgers, and more. whether you’re in the mood for something quick or fancy sitting down at one of the surrounding restaurants, you won’t leave hungry. the atmosphere is what really ties it all together. you’ve got live music or djs some weekends, and events like the monthly colour walk give it an extra layer of creativity. it’s not just a market — it feels like a little pocket of london where fashion, food, and community come together. facilities are clean and well-maintained, with toilets and accessible access throughout. you’ll also find plenty of spots to sit and recharge. that said, it can get quite packed on weekends, so if you prefer a bit more space to browse, try popping in on a weekday. if you’re in the area or just fancy discovering something different, spitalfields market is well worth a detour — especially if you’ve got an eye for the unusual or a craving for really good street food.

onguma bush camp in namibia is a truly remarkable destination for those seeking an unforgettable safari experience. nestled on the edge of etosha national park, this charming lodge offers a perfect blend of comfort, adventure, and breathtaking natural beauty. from the moment you arrive, the warm hospitality of the staff makes you feel at home. the service is impeccable, with friendly and knowledgeable guides who enhance your experience with fascinating insights into the local wildlife and environment. the accommodations are beautifully designed, offering a mix of modern amenities and rustic elegance. whether you stay in a luxury room, a tented camp, or a family unit, you’ll enjoy stunning views of the surrounding wilderness. one of the highlights of onguma bush camp is the incredible wildlife. the lodge overlooks a watering hole, where you can watch elephants, giraffes, and antelope gather, often just a few meters away. guided game drives into the onguma reserve or etosha national park provide thrilling encounters with lions, rhinos, and other iconic african animals. the food is another standout feature. each meal is a delicious fusion of local and international flavors, prepared with great care and creativity. dining under the stars adds a magical touch to the experience. overall, onguma bush camp is a perfect retreat for nature lovers, photographers, and anyone looking to immerse themselves in namibia’s untamed beauty. highly recommended!

only ruins remained, not as great looking as the other things along the way but impressive in size. this was an ancient public fountain dedicated to water nymphs, a common feature in greco-roman cities and a symbol of prosperity and abundance. located near the main colonnaded street of petra, this semi-circular structure was likely a central gathering spot for the nabatean people, offering a refreshing place to rest in petra’s desert environment. originally, the nymphaeum would have been adorned with lush greenery, mosaics, and possibly sculptures, with water flowing from an aqueduct-fed basin. though much of its decoration has faded over time, remnants hint at its past elegance. the nymphaeum showcases the nabateans’ engineering skills in water management, as they developed intricate systems to capture, store, and channel water throughout petra. today, it stands as a reminder of how vital water was to the thriving life of this ancient city.

onofrio's large fountain – a timeless landmark in dubrovnik located just inside the pile gate at the western entrance of dubrovnik's old town, onofrio's large fountain stands as a remarkable piece of 15th-century engineering and design. constructed in 1438 by the neapolitan architect onofrio della cava, this fountain was part of a sophisticated aqueduct system that brought fresh water from the dubrovnik river, approximately 12 kilometers away, into the city. ​ wikipedia the fountain's circular structure is adorned with 16 carved stone masks, known as mascarons, each with a spout through which water flows. although the original ornate sculptures were damaged in the devastating earthquake of 1667, the fountain remains a testament to the city's resilience and commitment to preserving its historical landmarks. ​ wikipedia beyond its architectural significance, onofrio's large fountain serves as a popular gathering spot for both locals and tourists. its location at the beginning of the stradun, dubrovnik's main thoroughfare, makes it an ideal meeting point and a refreshing stop, especially during the hot summer months.

opened on 10 january 1977, ocean park became popular, but 28 years later, it was unprofitable and widely expected to close due to the new hong kong disneyland. however, the park responded with a hk$5.5 billion development plan that saw it expand to over 80 attractions and rides, and steadily grow visitor numbers to 7.6 million in 2014, making it the world's 13th most visited theme park, and one of the largest theme parks in asia. the park is separated by a large mountain into two areas, the waterfront and the summit, which are connected by a cable car system and a funicular. the summit, which consists of several hills, has an outdoor escalator that was previously the world's longest. the theme park has various attractions and rides, including four roller coasters, and also animal exhibits with different themes, such as a giant panda habitat, rainforest, and polar displays, as well as an aquarium featuring the world's largest aquarium dome. between 1979 and 1997, ocean park was most famous for its signature orca, hoi wai. the park has housed giant pandas since 1999 and was previously home to the world's oldest male and female giant pandas.

our (myself and my mom) trip to tanzania was nothing short of unforgettable, thanks to the incredible hospitality of the siringit villa and siringit serengeti camp. every detail was thoughtfully arranged, from the luxurious accommodations to the warm, attentive staff who made us feel at home every step of the way. a special shout-out to max, our guide in the serengeti — he was absolutely phenomenal. his knowledge of the wildlife, the landscape, and tanzanian culture brought our safari experience to life. max had an amazing eye for spotting animals and made sure each game drive was exciting, educational, and personal. we can’t recommend siringit enough. if you’re looking for a truly immersive and high-end safari experience with world-class service, this is the place. we’re already dreaming of coming back!

our 3-day visit to masai mara was a unique experience for me. starting from nairobi, we can go on a game drive on the first afternoon. we saw elephants, giraffes, lions, and even leopards. the second day was the sunrise game drive - the opportunity to see a unique form of nature in the morning. i also had the opportunity to visit the maasai village and learn about their culture. the guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. the safari jeep was nice and comfortable. this trip exceeded my expectations in a short time.

our 3-person group did a private 3 day, 2 night trip with komodo boat trip departing from labuan bajo in july, 2022. we had a great time and i would recommend the company to most people. i feel like we got a fair price considering we booked a private boat, many companies quoted us at around double of what komodo boat trip did. however, the boat was very basic. they had a more luxurious boat available but we decided against spending more for it. the activities on the trip involved mostly snorkeling and trekking in the various islands in the area. we got to see tons of wildlife, the highlights being snorkeling with sea turtles and of course seeing the komodo dragons. the food was excellent and better than we were expecting. we couldn't have been happier with the meals and felt like we were well fed. most of the meals were traditional indonesian food. our tour guide marsel was great, he had a lot of knowledge and his english was also very good. overall, it was really a great trip. marsel was easy to communicate with ahead of time via whatsapp and be made our trip enjoyable. we were happy with the basic boat that we stayed on for the trip, people wanting a bit more of a polished boat would be wise to pay for the upgrade.

our 4 elements retreat was just amazing as were our massages. the entire experience was 5 stars al the way. our 4 elements was highly personal so i don’t want to get into the details but it was truly perfect timing and we got a lot out of it. balance has been brought back and that was just awesome and special. the massages were exactly what we needed as well—our therapists talked with us ahead of time and knew exactly what our bodies needed. i could speak volumes about everything we got to experience but i will just leave it at this—-give yourself the gift of a retreat with spirit quest. it will do more good for you than you can imagine!!

our 4d/3n cruise from lombok to komodo was one of the most beautiful moments of our trip. the activities and landscapes were breathtaking, the food was tasty, and the crew, especially hendra and deni , made everything extra special with their warmth and attention. sadly, the boat was in very poor condition: our showercabin was constantly flooded with dirty water, had cockroaches, and a broken window. on deck, there were too few clean spots to relax. with a bit of care and repairs, this cruise could easily be a 5-star experience.

our absolut highlight of the myanmar trip. i was hesitant because of the hefty pricetag, but in the end it was worth every dollar. very high level of professionalism, stylish from the early morning pick up to the breakfast afterwards. dont miss this experience, when you are there once in your lifetime!

our afternoon with the ocean safari crew, brandon and kody, was amazing! the mackay reef was well sheltered so our beginner swimmers felt comfortable and got a good view of giant clams, a green sea turtle, an abundance of coral and fish, and an octopus. kody was so helpful in making a fun upbeat family oriented environment for our boys. our two boys were laughing and teasing with him the whole time. he took time to fit our boys to their snorkel gear and pointed out the animals in the water. brandon was so good with our children. when one of the boys wanted a break he offered him watermelon on the boat and talked to him about his snorkel. he handed him a book with the different animals and our son got to point out the ones he saw. brandon also allowed our boys to help him on the boat. they got such a kick out of it! our boys loved laughing and teasing him. the whole rest of our holiday i asked our boys for their favorite activity and they kept repeating ocean safaris. this small family highly recommends it!

our boat driver tallon & guide/bartender alexandra did a fantastic job! they were very knowledgeable & personable, with lots of great info and stories about what we were seeing. i’d take the same canal ride with them again, because there is so much to take in on the ride.

our boat guide, kelly, is a great driver and very knowledgeable on the swamps. he loves what he does, and it shows. he stopped several times to welcome alligators close up for photo ops and talked about other wildlife and vegetation. i was there with my work group and we won't forget the bonding time. great experience for all ages!

our bucket list adventure to gbr had a slight hiccup as our 5 year old daughter had to remain in her long leg cast for trip. despite the setback, she had an absolutely amazing time on reef magic and even got to experience the ocean in its entirety. we were pleasantly surprised with the smooth boat ride in both directions, sitting on the top deck as well as the bottom on the return. the coffee was so good and kids went nuts over the donuts. the lunch buffet was stellar and kid approved! they devoured the cheesy pasta and curry rice dishes along with a plethora of watermelon. the cheese, meats and crackers on the return were a delightful touch to end our excursion. the highlights are all the included activities on the pontoon and every detail was accounted for. my husband and i were ecstatic to have the ability to book a last minute certified dive while on the boat as it’s been 3 years since our last. there were only 2 of us and we cannot thank lisa enough for her patience and her friendliness. she calmed all of our nerves and explained our trip, got us suited with weights with effortless ease. the kids got to fully enjoy the marine life in the glass bottom boat and the semi-submersible where my daughter looked for mermaids. they possibly had the best time of our trip playing with the pool noodles in the gated kids swimming area. we do have to give credit to chatgpt for recommending reef magic as it suggested the perfect excursion for our family.

our cape point and peninsula tour was amazing! we had a great time with the driver/tour guide - pedro, he was one of the best entertainer i've ever seen, also very informative, told us a lot of interesting stuff about the place, the people, etc. i would absolutely recommend this tour, and, especially this company, to any of my friends visiting cape town. i'm also very thankful to the reservation department for making it possible to book and pay for a tour that started the next day, and at 6 pm in the evening! that's how business is done!

our catamaran sailing tour was nothing short of spectacular. from the moment we stepped aboard, we were welcomed with warmth and genuine hospitality. the captain was personable, engaging, and clearly passionate about what he does, creating a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere throughout the journey. what truly elevated the experience was the second captain, who doubled as an extraordinary chef. every dish served on board—from the snacks to the lunch and even the dessert—was absolutely delicious. the flavors, presentation, and freshness of the food were outstanding and far exceeded our expectations. i wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this experience to friends, family, or anyone visiting santorini. i would absolutely return for another tour—this was truly a highlight of our trip!
our coastline stretches endlessly, but every beach has a different rhythm. oman teaches you that beauty isn’t one note.

our company had a great time with dragon zone - our two guides were top tier in keeping us comfortable on the water, and angela was great to work with to set us up. would recommend this as an active, team-building activity for any group.

our couples retreat with sedona soul adventures was exactly what we needed. the practitioners were awesome and explaining their purpose and its relation to our custom retreat. we came to ssa, somewhat skeptical, but open minded because we had never done a healing retreat before. we came away, feeling renewed, refreshed and more positive with each other. there was cleansing and healing, taking place every day and our mental, emotional and spiritual selves soared. we started our retreat with negative and frustrated hearts, and left with peace and joy. each practitioner touched a different pain point and we are grateful to them. this was an amazing experience and we highly recommend!

our crew/guides were very friendly and entertaining! since this trip is in the newer area of cairo, most of the landmarks are hotels and banks, so i wouldn't recommend this as a daytime activity since there are no historical sites to see. however, the atmosphere at night, when everything is lit up, makes the trip a lot more enjoyable!

our cruise ship stopped in cartagena in early december 2024. we are very happy we chose skykitchen cartagena. romario is a world-experienced chef and was completely fun to work with. we learned many new things and enjoyed completely authentic, and delicious, colombian cuisine. we left with everything we need to repeat our success at home. the thing we like the very most was that the activity was a very “connecting” activity between us as a couple. it felt nice not to be in the jumble of ‘tourist activities’. it was the most favorite shore activity we have ever done in many years of cruising. you will not be disappointed!

our day here was everything we could have dreamed of. elephants are well cared for and the staff and caretakers show genuine love for these incredible animals! we were educated on how to identify the differences between indian and african elephants and also told the history of each elephant, behaviours they show and why they do certain things. highly recommend visiting this sanctuary as they are an incredible cause. they also offered a pad thai cooking lesson and provided a delicious lunch before departure. thank you again to the entire team!

our diving experience with global scuba oman was truly exceptional. the island itself was stunning and perfect for scuba diving, but what really made the trip unforgettable was the crew. billy, our dive master, was amazing—highly professional, patient with everyone, incredibly kind, and always ready to explain everything clearly. he made sure that each diver was comfortable, safe, and truly enjoying the experience. mandy may be small in stature, but she has a huge heart. she tirelessly helped everyone get their equipment ready, carried heavy tanks with ease, and still kept a big, genuine smile on her face the entire time. her energy, dedication, and positivity are the mark of a true professional. both billy and mandy were the real highlight of our dives. we saw incredible things underwater, but the warmth, care, and professionalism they showed us made the whole experience truly unforgettable. i highly recommend global scuba oman—you won’t just discover amazing underwater beauty, but you’ll also be guided by an exceptional team that makes the journey even more special.

our driver bo was wonderful, he was full of knowledge and good vibes! very little off-roading (i was expecting more), but bo was great. the energy from the vortex trees was exhilarating. i was so relaxed and enjoyed the land when we stopped to view the trees and scenery in sedona, arizona.

our driver gracie is a great tour guide. we took the two hours tour which was fun and learned a lot of small facts about sedona. she is very knowledgeable about this place in az called sedona and her love of it is reflected in the tour she provides. i would recommend taking this tour and make sure your camera/phone is charged as the sites are incredible.

our dubai safari trip with ibrahim was absolutely fantastic! from the very beginning, his excellent communication skills put us at ease. he kept us informed, was super friendly, and ensured that we knew exactly what to expect throughout the day. what really stood out was his personal touch and genuine care for our family, especially the kids. he made sure they were comfortable, relaxed, and entertained the entire time. the dune bashing was thrilling yet safe, and he checked on the kids often to ensure they were having fun and feeling good. his ability to keep the trip both fun and family-friendly was amazing! ibrahim also shared great insights and stories about dubai’s culture and desert life, which made the experience not just exciting but also meaningful. the evening entertainment, bbq dinner, and the camel rides were perfectly planned. we also appreciated some personal moments he helped us capture – from beautiful sunset photos in the dunes to sweet surprises for the kids that made them smile all evening. overall, it was a 5-star experience across the board – top-notch service, lots of laughs, and beautiful memories. we highly recommend ibrahim for anyone looking to enjoy dubai safari with their family. he's simply the best!

our e-bike tour in banff was absolutely incredible! the scenery alone was breathtaking, but what made the experience truly unforgettable was our tour guide, finn. he was super knowledgeable, sharing so many fascinating facts and hidden gems along the way, and he was so friendly and welcoming. he made the entire tour feel fun, relaxed, and engaging. we saw elk, coyotes, deer, & so many amazing places! we felt completely comfortable the whole time, and his passion for banff really shone through. if you’re visiting, this is a must do experience and if you can, ask for finn!!!

our entire family stayed at this beautiful hotel back in march, and we absolutely loved it! the serene atmosphere, abundant wildlife, and spacious swimming pool made it a truly memorable stay. the breakfasts were unbelievably delicious… some of the best we have had. i would definitely return here when i'm back in singapore.

our excursion by car, along the dirt road that leads to the estancia. here a manager, staff who follows the livestock, sheep, horses and cattle. a splendid route with lake, mountains, fragrant bushes... we can't wait to return. it is also possible to walk from the park to the estancia. december 2022

our experience at kilima was seriously lacking, but i’ll start with the pros before the cons. pros: the view is sensational and the tents are very nice. and carin is the absolute best! she is so sweet! cons: we paid extra for the horseback ride and our guide never spoke one word to us. he didn’t go over any safety and my sister had never been in an english saddle before. we filled out the client survey about our food allergies and they still tried feeding us the food we are allergic to. there wasn’t much variety in food either. same meal every morning and pasta at every meal. we also paid extra for a night game drive which was not cheap. it immediately started to downpour and immediately asked if we could try tomorrow night instead. unfortunately our guides were very pushy and insisted we keep going. they then needed to put down the flaps because the rain was coming down so hard. the guides said we’d go back and try again tomorrow but at the last minute decided that we’d stay out in the weather. we spent the entire game drive either stuck in the mud or dealing with putting down or up the flaps to deal with the torrential rain. yes we understand that you can’t control the weather but it was a very uncomfortable situation and we had asked to go back several times. on top of that we were told the game drive would be 3-4 hours and it was 1 hour and 40 mins. not worth the money we spent at all. then they sent us to our tent without so much as offering us a drinks. we also paid extra for the bubble bath which was not on the spa menu listed as a charge and we were under the impression it was complimentary. it was not and it was not communicated to us until checking out. hospitality in general was lacking here and we couldn’t wait to leave. as someone who travels often and to africa i’ve never experienced any of this before.

our experience at kroya restaurant was absolutely wonderful. our server, liza, explained the six-course menu thoroughly, making it easy to enjoy each dish to its fullest. solin also checked in on us and chatted warmly, adding a personal and friendly touch to the service. the food was truly exceptional—each course beautifully presented and delicious. to make my visit extra special, they surprised me with a cake and flowers for my birthday, which was such a thoughtful gesture. the afternoon tea was also delightful, with a lovely selection of treats. the staff even helped us take a nice photo to remember the day. overall, the service at kroya was impeccable, and the combination of beautiful food, attentive staff, and thoughtful touches made our visit truly memorable.

our experience at mara serena was absolutely fantastic! the lodge had great views of the masai mara. our 2 toddlers had the best times staying there. the rooms are spacious, well-designed, and very comfortable. the bathrooms were spotless, modern, and maintained to a very high standard — something we really appreciated after long game drives. we also enjoyed the delicious food — there was a great variety at each meal, with plenty of options to suit every taste. everything was fresh and well-prepared. they went above and beyond to accommodate our kids needs. the staff were incredibly warm and welcoming, always ready with a smile and happy to help with anything we needed. their friendliness added a special touch to our stay and made us feel at home. if you’re looking for a beautiful, comfortable, and memorable place to stay while exploring the masai mara, i can’t recommend mara serena enough!

our experience at the hotel was amazing. the location is perfect, and it is extremely quiet, perfect for relaxation. the museum in the hotel and it s history is also beautiful. the crew is also very thoughtful of yiur experience, and they even had a breakfast prepared for us when we were leaving at 3:30am to the airport. it was totally worth staying here, and super recommended!

our experience at the log, well where to start. calling it transcending would be a gross belittling, we felt the aperture in our being that could only be filled by the log. we set foot leaving our hamlet located in the south most point of england, and what we felt cannot be described with words, it’s an experience that will deem all future experiences disenchanted. visit at your own risk, you will not return as your past self.

our experience was amazing with this team of experts. two of us did hang gliding and one did paragliding, they made us feel so at ease. they put safety first but also want you to have fun and enjoy yourself. they all made our experience one to remember!!! thank you so much giovanni, klaus and andre for an amazing experience!!!!

our experience was amazing! we couldn’t find the station where they were going to pick us up and carey the dispatcher talked us through every step on the phone and got us there safely. marcus was our driver and he was excellent! the dinner was sooo good at pampas- i highly recommend the package. the flight was gorgeous and dalton was an amazing pilot.

our experience will always be remembered… it was educational fun. the zip line was both an adrenaline rush and an invigorating experience. the height added to the majestic views seen. the atv was a vibrational ride through twists and turns of dust. good experience too. the cenote was truly awe inspiring within the darkness of nature and its resourcefulness of the tree of life. loved the cold dip after an exciting day. last but not least, the mayan ceremony was quite humbling and educational.

our experience with angel tours was absolutely amazing! from start to finish, everything was well-organized and full of unforgettable moments. a special shoutout to felicity - her positive energy, helpfulness, and genuine care made the tour even more enjoyable. she truly went above and beyond. we had an incredible time snorkeling in crystal-clear waters, shared a unique lunch experience surrounded by giant tortoises, and even got to taste takamaka while enjoying vibrant creole dances. it was a perfect blend of adventure, culture, and fun - one of the highlights of our trip to seychelles!

our experience with caldera yachting was absolutely fantastic! the entire staff was not only professional and knowledgeable about the area, but also incredibly warm and welcoming. a special thank you to aphrodite, who truly went above and beyond—offering thoughtful recommendations for places to visit and stay beyond the cruise. she’s no longer just a helpful guide; we now consider her a friend. we highly recommend the caldera sunset cruise—it’s a breathtaking experience that creates unforgettable memories and stunning photos. don’t miss it!

our experience with helder and his team was amazing. he went as far as to utilize his four clean, safe vans to transport our guest to and from our wedding. he was punctual and on time and got everyone to our ceremony and got everyone home safe. he even helped some of our guest with tour's around the island the week after our wedding. i can't speak highly enough of how smooth of an experience his transport services were! you will not be disappointed to use island hoppers for any of your services and needs! don't look anywhere else!!!

our experience with lubaacris tour was great! tourist guides really gave their best to offer us excellent experience, finding perfect spots for swimming with dolphins, scuba diving with fishes and beautiful spots in the middle of the ocean where there is no crowd. we got snorkeling masks, fruits and water for free. highly recommend!!!

our experience with my blue cruises in santorini was unforgettable. miltos was an incredible guide—warm, friendly, and genuinely passionate about what he does. from the start, everything was smooth and organized, and we felt completely taken care of the entire time. the cruise took us past stunning cliffs and the iconic red and white beaches, giving us an amazing view of the island’s unique coastline. one of the most fascinating parts was when miltos explained the history of the volcanic eruption and how the caldera was formed. he was super knowledgeable and made the geology of santorini come to life in a way that was really easy to understand and engaging. we stopped for a swim in the clear blue waters and were treated to a light meal, including a refreshing fruit salad, which was perfect after being in the sun and sea. it felt really personal and thoughtful. the highlight of the evening was watching the sunset from the boat, with the sun setting over the caldera and the cliffs of oia in the distance. it was one of those surreal, peaceful moments that make a trip truly special. this boat ride was absolutely worth it—beautiful views, great company, and memories that will stick with us forever. if you’re in santorini, this is a must-do experience. thank you, miltos!

our experience with northern alpine guides was truly memorable and a once in a lifetime experience for me and my daughter. seth was both professional, knowledgeable and friendly. his experience made our rock climbing adventure smooth and manageable. seth was able to keep us focused and confident. i highly recommend using northern alpine guides. if we return to the lofoten islands i will definitely book another trip with them!

our experience with oahu ocean adventures was absolutely incredible! from start to finish, the crew went above and beyond to make sure we had the best time. the boat was super comfortable, offering plenty of seating options so everyone could relax and enjoy the stunning views. the highlight of our trip was the whale watching—seeing multiple whales up close was truly breathtaking! the crew was so knowledgeable and knew exactly where to take us for the best experience. they even went the extra mile to search for other wildlife, and we were lucky enough to spot a beautiful sea turtle! the captain and crew were outstanding—friendly, professional, and passionate about what they do. this was, hands down, the best tour i’ve ever been on. if you’re looking for an unforgettable ocean adventure, oahu ocean adventures is the way to go!

our experience with riding dinner’s culinary horse-drawn carriage tour in vienna was absolutely magical and one of the highlights of our trip! we booked the hour-long tour with champagne service, and it was a beautiful way to take in the breathtaking charm of the city. from the moment we climbed into the elegant carriage, we were transported into a world of timeless viennese sophistication. the horses were impeccably groomed, and the carriage was comfortable and beautifully maintained, adding to the luxurious feel of the experience. sipping champagne as we rolled through vienna’s historic streets felt like something out of a dream. the tour offered incredible views of the city’s iconic landmarks, from the hofburg palace to st. stephen’s cathedral, all illuminated in their evening splendor. the gentle rhythm of the horses and the glow of the city made the experience incredibly romantic and serene. the service was impeccable—warm, attentive, and clearly focused on making the experience as special as possible. every detail was thoughtfully handled, and we felt like vips the entire time. this tour is a must for anyone looking to add a unique and unforgettable experience to their vienna itinerary. riding dinner has perfected the art of blending culinary indulgence with the elegance of vienna’s carriage traditions. we’ll treasure the memories forever!

our experience with the serengeti balloon safari was extraordinary from start to finish. paul, our pilot, was fantastic—calm, professional, and made us feel completely safe throughout the flight. the post-flight breakfast in the middle of nowhere was nothing short of magical, with breathtaking views and even a toilet with a view! and the champagne flowed generously, making it a truly unforgettable adventure. the day before, a representative came to see us, personally delivered the tickets, and explained everything clearly, which really put us at ease. we were staying in a very remote lodge, yet they picked us up as promised, and everything was perfectly organized, just as they had explained the day before. what also made the experience special is knowing that a portion of the ticket price goes directly towards the conservation of the serengeti. this not only justifies the price but makes it all the more worthwhile, knowing we're contributing to the protection of this incredible landscape. highly recommended!

our family did the private snorkeling tour with jairo and nine. it was absolutely amazing. we used another company last year and this was better. we saw some beautiful fish and enjoyed the boat with just us. highly recommend
our family had a fabulous day island hopping and swimming, with zoran as our captain on his beautiful boat. we highly recommend him. our kids said it was the best day of the whole vacation.
our family had a fantastic time at the rainforestation nature park the staff were friendly, informative, and joked with our two boys. very good family environment! we would highly recommend.

our family had a great experience with dolphins and you today. we saw several turtles and dozens of dolphins. we had a great time swimming and snorkeling with them today. the crew was very friendly and accommodating. my kids loved getting the temporary dolphin tattoos. the lunch was simple (sandwich and chips) but delicious. we would 100% do it again. highly recommend it.

our family had a great time getting tour of vienna. gary, our fiaker driver, was very friendly and gave us lot of history facts and tidbits as we went through the sites. we took the 60 min tour, great way to get overview of major vienna sites.

our family had a great time on the e-bike tour with outdoor - interlaken. we really enjoyed seeing parts of the interlaken valley off the beaten path and especially liked the stops at the local dairy and brewery. west was a knowledgeable, fun, and personable guide. highly recommend!

our family had a wonderful bicycle tour of barcelona with sandy! sandy’s knowledge of history and architecture is impressive and she is able to provide the historical background that helps you understand and appreciate how and why barcelona is laid out as it is. sandy also brings along maps, drawings, and photographs that bring the rich history of the city to life. we could not recommend this fascinating tour enough!

our family had a wonderful experience at waikite valleh hot pools! the staff were nice and it was not crowded on a tuesday in mid-march. there are 4 pools and 2 tubs along with a nice 5-10 min trail to the hot spring source. there is free parking at the car park too.

our family had a wonderful experience with their aurora hunting tour with michael! he was so kind and helpful throughout the tour and thanks to his effort, we could catch pretty aurora and which made our whole trip. would definitely recommend to everyone who goes to lapland soon!

our family had an amazing experience at the mardi gras museum of costumes & culture! we spent several hours trying on the most vibrant and fun costumes, learning about the fascinating history behind mardi gras. the staff was extremely friendly and helpful, and they were fantastic with our two daughters (ages 8 and 3). they made the experience so enjoyable for everyone, taking extra care to engage with our kids in a fun and educational way. this museum is a must-visit for families, both young and old. highly recommend!

our family had an exceptional time at the four seasons. the staff was amazing ! top notch service! brigitte was so good and had the best communication. thank you for making our entire family have the best memories .

our family had the most unforgettable experience at wildlife safari in winston! before our visit, the staff was incredibly kind and understanding of our situation, and they went out of their way to support us. we are deeply grateful for their generosity. we came on friday, august 15, and the emotions we all felt are beyond words. the kids were absolutely thrilled, and our grandmother, who is visiting from russia, was in complete awe — she had never seen anything like this in her life. we were lucky enough to see cheetah cubs, a giraffe came right up to our car, and the sweetest little deer licked our hands. we all had goosebumps from the excitement! thank you, wildlife safari, for giving our family such a magical and once-in-a-lifetime experience. we will cherish this memory forever!

our family had the most wonderful day at rancho terremar. it is like stepping into jurassic park with giant beasts lumbering around the dramatic landscape against breathtaking views. the lava tunnels were enormous and spectacular, they seemed to go on forever. we had a beautiful lunch and enjoyed tasting the fruits growing on the property. you can stay overnight too! we got the bus there and back from santa cruz for $1pp, send the lovely owners a message to find out which bus drops you at the door.

our family just completed an incredible 6 day rafting trip through the grand canyon with wilderness river adventures. i can’t say enough great things about our experience. our guides richard, wilbur, lori, and sierra were wonderful! they provided a once in a lifetime adventure for our family we will never forget. the views, the rafting, hikes to see beautiful waterfalls, delicious meals, and exhilarating rapids made for an exceptional family trip. thank you for providing us with a trip of a lifetime and memories we will cherish for years to come.

our family of 2 adults and 2 teenagers loved this zip line experience. fast, long runs. scenic views of lake arenal from the zip lines. very little waiting. no hiking. super safe they take care of everything equipment is top notch. wish the handles were longer and braking was easier but not necessary to do any yourself either. shuttle was luxury van with excellent wifi.

our family of 2 adults and 2 teenagers loved this zip line experience. fast, long runs. scenic views of lake arenal from the zip lines. very little waiting. no hiking. super safe they take care of everything equipment is top notch. wish the handles were longer and braking was easier but not necessary to do any yourself either. shuttle was luxury van with excellent wifi.

our family of 5 had an absolute blast on this jeep tour! mr. ray was so much fun and very knowledgeable of the history and geology of our gorgeous surroundings. he had us laughing the whole trip! definitely don’t miss this adventure in sedona!

our family of 5 was lucky enough to have andy as our guide. he was incredibly knowledgeable of the area as well as plant and wildlife. we all had different ideas and expectations and amazingly andy met them all. the hike was strenuous but the views made it well worth it!! if you are looking for an adventure that gives you a unique perspective of denali backcountry, this is the guide service that will make that happen!!

our family of 6 (2 active grandparents, 2 parents, and 2 boys ages 5 and 8) had a fantastic time with matteo. we previously spent 2 days wandering venice, and a tour of the other islands with him was like stepping into a completely different world. matteo was very affable and quickly made us feel like we were good friends- and he introduced us to his friends/acquaintances at our stops on the tour. he was full of facts about both historical and modern venice, was willing to share personal anecdotes from his own life, and the entire tour felt like one awesome story. he was great with our boys, including letting them drive the boat, and our youngest cried that we can’t go back to see him tomorrow. when we travel, we are always looking for experiences that are authentic and take us off the beaten path, and teach us something, and this tour is all of those things. matteo, thank you for everything!

our family of 8 had an amazing time on the dahabiya nile sailing cruise. the boat had many spots for relaxing & lounging, the rooms were comfortable & clean. the crew were attentive and looked after us so well throughout the trip. some of them were especially great with our kids. sammy’s smile was infectious and was always friendly to everyone. mahmoud & ashraf were lots of fun and we enjoyed doing a climb near aswan together with them. the experiences in the itinerary were unique and well planned out. we especially loved getting to experience the local culture at various stops along the way. food was fresh & delicious for every meal. we also had an amazing guide, shaimaa, who is so knowledgeable & passionate about egyptian history. she always answered all our questions with a smile. we were so blessed to have her for our group. getting the afternoons to unwind & relax while we sailed along the nile was so special and making new friends was definitely a highlight too.

our family of five (with three teenage boys) enjoyed a wonderful week with sailing phuket private yacht charters. steve and his crew did everything to made us comfortable and to offer us the most relaxing time in an outstanding environment. the organization, the accommodation, the food, the crew, the diving experience, the itinerary..everything just perfect. we will never forget this amazing journey with the lovely hosts in beautiful andamanen sea.

our family of five had a fantastic time on our boat tour with patrick today! he was incredibly knowledgeable, sharing detailed and fascinating history about paris, its iconic buildings, bridges, and local customs. we highly recommend picking up some cheese and parisian treats to enjoy during the ride—it made the experience even more special. patrick also brought us to some perfect spots for amazing family photos. this tour was such a fun, comfortable, and relaxing way to see paris. highly recommend—and be sure to ask for patrick!

our family of five had a great three-hour plus tour with adonis yesterday. he is an excellent guide; very knowledgable about the island and he kept us entertained with his stories and sense of humor. i would definitely recommend the tour for families as it's a great way to see the white, red and black beaches, the cliffs as well as some hidden caves and coves. he took care of our group effortlessly, gently motioning the way we needed to go and skilfully getting us all in and out of the water. we would definitely do the tour again!

our family of five had a wonderful day with allie and paw paw on the little mulgrave river today. allie is knowledgeable, fun and a wonderful teacher. we have done lots of sup-ing before but still learned many new skills and techniques. the serenity and natural beauty of the goldsborough valley we’re breathtaking. we recommend this tour for all and we look forward to coming back again soon.

our family of five had an absolutely unforgettable day with oxbow adventure co. we tried both clay shooting and the ultimate off-roading experience, and it was nothing short of amazing! skinny, who taught us how to shoot, was incredibly friendly, patient, and knowledgeable—making the clay shooting fun and accessible for everyone in our family. the off-roading adventure was thrilling, and our driver was fantastic, expertly guiding us through rugged terrain with enthusiasm and skill. it truly felt like an adventure of a lifetime, filled with excitement and breathtaking scenery. if you’re visiting queenstown, this is a must-do activity. we can’t recommend oxbow adventure co. enough for an action-packed, family-friendly day out that you’ll cherish forever!

our family of five loved the makapuʻu point lighthouse trail! the paved path was easy and safe, with breathtaking ocean views the whole way. the lighthouse, turquoise water, and even a whale sighting made it unforgettable, a must-do in oahu!

our family of four did a 3d/2n trip on narasea with boat komodo tour. it was amazing. communication with angel from the office was prompt and accurate and once on board, everything went really well. our guide, sony, was incredible, as was his assistant kristin (apologies if spelling is wrong!). it was a large crew for the four of us, and they all did a great job to make sure we were comfortable, safe and had a great time. special mention to the chef and his assistant. every meal was a banquet! narasea was a large, comfortable boat. our rooms were air-conditioned and the beds were as good as hotel beds. the snorkelling locations were first class. probably the healthist reefs we have ever seen (and we've seen a few...). we swam with turtles, sharks (friendly ones) and more fish than i've ever encountered. if you're coming to labuan bajo, get angel to organise your boat trip for you. you won't regret it!

our family of four had an incredible first-time snorkeling experience, thanks to nyle! she went above and beyond to ensure we felt comfortable, safe, and had an amazing time. her patience, expertise, and enthusiasm made the trip truly special. we couldn’t have asked for a better introduction to snorkeling—highly recommend!
