our family recently stayed at a wonderful hotel in phuket, thailand, and it was an unforgettable experience! the hotel is conveniently located near the beautiful beach, making it perfect for those who love the sun, sand, and sea. additionally, it’s just a short distance from the famous bangla road walking street, which is great for evening strolls and exploring the vibrant nightlife. for shopping enthusiasts, the hotel is also close to central and big c supermarkets, making it easy to grab essentials or souvenirs. one of the highlights of this hotel is its warm and welcoming atmosphere. the staff is incredibly friendly and goes above and beyond to ensure guests feel at home. they are especially great with kids, making it an ideal choice for families. for our little ones, the hotel was a paradise! there are plenty of cats roaming around the property, which our children absolutely adored. they spent hours playing with the friendly feline residents, and it was heartwarming to see how much joy it brought them. the hotel also has a dedicated play area where kids can have fun and make new friends. overall, this hotel is a fantastic choice for families looking for a relaxing and enjoyable stay in phuket. its prime location, excellent service, and family-friendly amenities make it a top pick. we highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area, especially those traveling with children who love animals!

our family thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! it had been recommended to us be several extended family members and we are sure glad we followed their advice. the rooms were nice and well-kept, the beds were comfortable, and we especially enjoyed the dinner we had at the on-site restaurant. we liked that the resort was further back into the jungle and outside of actual la fortuna as it felt a bit more private and secluded. the service was excellent and we loved greivin who helped us with our bags and also provided lots of recommendations on things to do and places to visit! our favorite part was probably the hot springs themselves, which was such a unique and fun experience! lovely water temperatures and lots of little path ways and different pool areas to explore.

our family tried out both the jet ski and kayaking. we had a great time. the staff is very nice and very professional. the equipment are quite new and well maintained. the location is also great. we enjoyed the grand view of both volcano and the arenal lake. the price is also very reasonable. highly recommended!

our family went birding with andrew. he was so knowledgeable and enthusiastic. we really enjoyed our time with him. andrew has tons of knowledge about wildlife and birds and we highly recommend him. andrew was so personable and his genuine enjoyment and enthusiasm comes through.

our family will never forget earth wisdom's 'ancient ruins tour'! our guide tom's knowledge of indigenous culture was truly impressive - he took us to explore hidden cliff dwellings and captivated us with stories about the ancestral pueblo people. the sunset views from secret mountain took our breath away! after the tour, tom recommended we unwind at sedona tai chi massage & foot spa nearby. it absolutely lived up to the hype! the 'hiker's recovery' package (peppermint oil foot soak + professional calf massage) worked wonders on our tired legs. the therapists' techniques were precise and effective, and the tranquil atmosphere with soothing aromatherapy helped us completely relax. best of all, our teenage daughter said her treatment was the most enjoyable part of her trip! we'd suggest booking a 5pm session after the 2pm tour - the perfect way to end the day…

our favorite neighborhood corner store - they have most of what you need from the basics for grocery, but the key is their chicken sandwich and fries. a+ meal to bring to the beach (sandwich is huge and bread is amazing!).

our favorite park in manhattan! madison square park is truly our favorite park in the city. we love walking there — it’s always a peaceful, beautiful escape right in the heart of manhattan. we enjoy it so much that we even decided to start making monthly donations to support the park’s foundation. it’s always a pleasure to stroll through, whether it’s spring blossoms, summer shade, or crisp autumn air. and during the holidays, watching the christmas tree lighting there feels absolutely magical — such a warm and festive atmosphere. a gem of new york!

our favorite shop in denali! picked up some canned cocktails and snacks, as well as late lunch and some gifts to bring home for friends (they have souvenir ulu knives). marissa was very helpful and friendly - helped us figure out why we couldn’t track down the spruce tip gin we were looking for!

our favorite spot in paris. i can not recommend this enough, me and my husband talk about the inside of this place all time. it is our top spot to go back to in europe. it is breath taking walking in and see the stained glass! the area is beautiful and clean and it’s quiet inside and just all around lovely! i seriously cannot recommend this enough, tickets aren’t a bad price and it tops a lot of the other attractions in paris!

our favorite thing we did in rio! the hike isn’t too hard and the experience getting there is so much fun! plus, the view from the top is equal to the one you get from the more popular locations in rio with significantly fewer people. we also saw lots of wildlife like monkeys and toucans!
our favourite gay bar in tokyo. staff super helpful friendly crowd nice atmosphere. came here for pride week and had a great time. we definitely come again.

our favourite museum in mexico city. we loved the second floor about popular mexican culture withe día de los muertos and the alebrijes. some very good parts wirh videos and original costumes. they also do kids activities sometimes worth checking out. we just walked in and bought tickets (students with cards can get in free even if they are not from mexico)
our favourite place in north zanzibar and the kindest staff

our first night in paris was extra special thanks to our my paris river private cruise on the seine. from start to finish, it was an unforgettable experience. ✨🚤 the meeting location was super easy to find, which helped ease any first-night travel stress. our guide was absolutely incredible—knowledgeable, funny, and warm. he shared fascinating stories and history along the way, and somehow timed it perfectly so that we were gliding past the eiffel tower just as it began to sparkle at sunset. truly magical. 🌅✨ this tour was worth every single penny. not only did it help us get our bearings in terms of where major landmarks are located, but it also gave us a peaceful, beautiful introduction to the city. floating along the seine, with the city glowing around us, was the perfect way to kick off our paris adventure.

our first night in seoul on september 18th n we dived right in. when comes to food, we yearn for authenticity, cooking methods unchanged for centuries, that’s we always look for. worth a visit and close to myeong-dong station, come after sunset.
our first ride inside the summit. reason: this is the best ride with the view u had to know. it helps u to know the places and rides and how to reach them. i would say, go here first.

our first time in wadi rum and rum magic nights made the experience so much better. the location and tent were already outstanding, we had the tents with ac and private showers which was a plus. the activities were amazing, we did half day (4 hours) exploring the desert then finished the day with a camel ride under the sunset. and lastly the food, this was some of the best i had whilst in jordan, better than some 5 star hotels we stayed in, especially the bedouin style dinner. overall it was a very peaceful place and the staff were the best. i would recommend a minimum of 2x nights here to be able to absorb everything in and make the most of it!

our first time on a buggy in marrakech was an incredible ride. the emphasis on safety, even for young children, really reassured us. the buggies were in perfect condition and the guides were very professional. we were able to enjoy the magnificent landscapes in complete peace and quiet. an unforgettable family experience to repeat with your eyes closed!

our first time on a zodiac and it was the highlight of our trip. simon, our guide, was absolutely fantastic! fun and informative, he gave us amazing insight into the areas we visited along with historical background of each place he took us to. there were 4 in our group and we all agreed it was one of the best experiences we've ever had. my youngest was a little worried about being on the open water in a zodiac but that soon faded and she had the time of her life. weather was a bit drizzly once out on the water, and we wore the full body suits just in case, but we were nice and warm throughout the whole adventure. if you do this tour, definitely ask for simon as your guide, you'll have the best time!
our first time to ride cable car. nervous at first but it was such an amazing experienced. we had fun strolling in ocean park and tried the rides too.

our first visit here to see the highland coos that we had adopted. despite not being able to get onto a guided tour, we were not disappointed. the staff were so friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. i was even allowed to feed and stroke the coos, along with a couple who were on the tour. had so much fun. the place is beautiful and so calm. would definitely recommend this place to anyone who likes a countryside stroll.

our first visit here to see the highland coos that we had adopted. despite not being able to get onto a guided tour, we were not disappointed. the staff were so friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. i was even allowed to feed and stroke the coos, along with a couple who were on the tour. had so much fun. the place is beautiful and so calm. would definitely recommend this place to anyone who likes a countryside stroll.

our friend diane took us as a surprise to this amazing murder experience. we loved every second of it. the performers were just brilliant and we were made to feel so special. the food was really lovely. we are definetly coming back in a few weeks time with family members. 10/10 👏👏👏

our friends were booked at the fancier and more expensive hotels here in bora but they liked my room here more at watercolors! location is perfect. service is topnotch. best part is waking up to the beach view and having a balcony where you can enjoy the sunset at the comfort of your own room. definitely coming back here.

our friends were booked at the fancier and more expensive hotels here in bora but they liked my room here more at watercolors! location is perfect. service is topnotch. best part is waking up to the beach view and having a balcony where you can enjoy the sunset at the comfort of your own room. definitely coming back here.

our girls trip to rotorua was made a whole lot more exciting and relaxing with the warm welcome from the team. we had plenty of laughs, we had the best service, everything was detailed and thorough. my daughter and i enjoyed the spa whilst waiting for our friends to get their signature mix treatment. i had the 60min massage and daughter the 60min facial. she even gave my daughter tips for her acne. i can't rave anymore than i already do about this place. you just need to come to experience this yourselves!. reasonable price and for the warm welcome and hospitality these beautiful ladies gave us its all worthwhile!

our glacier tour with discover banff tours was absolutely one of the highlights of our entire vacation! jeff was an exceptional guide and driver - his knowledge of the area was impressive and he shared fascinating insights about the glaciers, local geology, and wildlife throughout the trip. jeff's expertise really enhanced the experience, making it both educational and memorable. he was friendly, professional, and clearly passionate about the region, which made the tour even more enjoyable. the tour itself was well-organized and the views were breathtaking. if you're visiting banff and considering a glacier tour, i highly recommend discover banff tours and specifically asking for jeff as your guide. this was definitely money well spent and an unforgettable part of our trip. thank you jeff and discover banff tours for such a wonderful experience.

our go-to place in rotorua! we’ve stayed at silver fern motel multiple times, most recently with my parents-in-law, and it never disappoints. the rooms are always cozy, clean, and comfortable. the large spa bath is a real highlight — perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring rotorua. the staff are consistently professional, welcoming, and friendly, which makes all the difference. it’s clear they care about their guests and take pride in the place. if you’re visiting rotorua, this is the place to stay. we’ll definitely be back.

our grand canyon helicopter tour with papillon helicopters – boulder city was nothing short of spectacular! from the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly professional, ensuring a seamless and stress-free experience. but the real highlight of the trip was our amazing pilot, devon—a true expert who made the journey both thrilling and informative. devon’s smooth flying and in-depth knowledge of the grand canyon’s history, geology, and breathtaking landscapes added so much to the experience. the rim landing was absolutely surreal—getting to step out and take in the vast beauty of the canyon from such a unique vantage point was unforgettable. the helicopter was comfortable, the views were jaw-dropping, and the overall experience was worth every penny. if you’re considering a grand canyon tour, papillon helicopters is the way to go—and if you can, request devon as your pilot for an even more incredible adventure! highly recommend!

our granite falls tour was great! captain cassidy was very friendly and professional and had interesting tidbits about the various areas, history and waterfalls. it was neat to see things from the perspective of the water and have a great tour without walking or getting on a bus! the warm survival suits were awesome. i’d like to thank the company for letting us reschedule last minute.
our group catamaran cruise, snorkeling, and party boat was extremely fun! the trip was well organized, a great price, and they kept us hydrated. i would definitely recommend this to others!!
our group had a very informative tour, lead by john. so much history and such a large building. thanks old government house!

our group of 15 did the 4 hour sunset catamaran cruise with dinner on our recent visit to santorini on our cruise. safe to say, that the group said that this was by far the best excursion we did on our vacation. captain pablo, and his crew were awesome. from the time we got on board to the time we got off, these guys did not stop moving. we had a great time relaxing, laughing, swimming and even dancing a bit. it was so great that we had three different stops to jump in and enjoy the water. the dinner that the crew cooked and served to us was one of the best meals we had during our entire vacation. it was also great that the drinks were flowing freely during the entire time we were on board. safe to say, i will recommend this excursion to anyone i know that will visit the beautiful town of santorini. it is an incredible way to see the area. thank you so much for having us, and our best to captain pablo! this tour was a highlight of our vacation and something we will remember forever.

our group of 4 adults (age 34-66) really enjoyed the wagon ride and cowboy grilled steak meal. the staff were informative and also fun. the food was delicious and our steaks were all cooked perfectly. the scenery was beautiful. i highly recommend it!

our group of 6 booked two different tours with 5 star marine. our crew, and guide, alex, were phenomenal. communication with them was timely and spot on. we cannot thank alex enough for our 2 wonderful days. he made us all feel very safe in the water, especially during our night swim. the craft was clean, modern and comfortable. because we had two bookings, some of the itineraries overlapped, so they were able to customize the tours. i would highly recommend them.

our group of 8 had a wonderful time on this tour. our tour guide, daigur, was informative and so much fun, and all the food was delicious! it was an excellent way to experience icelandic specialties and to enjoy the company of other visitors. bring your appetite - the tasting portions are substantial!

our group of 9 booked a hummer for the gambler trail with our guide donnie, and we had the best adventure with him! he was extremely knowledgeable, and knew exactly what kind of fun our loud and crazy group needed. wouldn't hesitant to book again for a more rugged trail next time we're in town. #tequila

our group of five took a private sunset cruise with green river a couple of nights ago. i wanted to take a moment to recognize the exemplary service we received from the company and our guide. the boat itself was very nice - clearly new - complete with plush leather seats, music and a nice bimini top to protect from the weather. our guide, charles, was friendly, professional, and engaging. he pointed out the sites and monuments along the route and was quick to answer our myriad of questions. the booking process was straightforward and easy and the pricing more than reasonable. oh, and two bottles of wine were included! i would recommend this company to anyone looking for a relaxed cruise down here seine without the madness of the big tourist boats. thanks green river - we’ll be back!

our group's parasailing adventure was experienced by 3 adults (1 in early 60s and 2 in mid 30s) and 1 eleven year old boy. once our reservation was made, their communication with us before hand was excellent with everything from proof a purchase to reminders to evergreen directions how to drive to their location. upon arrival, the lady who met us at their dockside point was very friendly and professional as she walked us through signing the pre-trip safety documents. once it was our time to 'sail', we were welcomed aboard by the boat's captain and his crew member. these gentlemen were outstanding in their explanation of what would happen and making sure we were outfitted equipment wise very securely. they took extra time to make sure the young boy in our group was very comfortable and ready to go. we had booked the highest/longest line at 1000ft and soon we were off taking our turns in side by side tandem rides. wow! what a ride and view! we evergreen for a couple of 'dips' into the water and raised back up. bottom line is we had an outstanding time with absolutely incredible views. we really recommend then and would not hesitate to use their services again. a side note is they allow you to bring your own camera phone on board but they also take at least 100 pictures of their own (160 with our group of 4) which they show you at the end and seek you for $40). a great time was had by all.

our guide alexander z. is great and knowledgeable! his way of storytelling makes us easier to understand the history of old city! we feel like meeting a friend in jerusalem and he can share with us a lot! great job, alex!

our guide is a native of the rum village and we think there is no one who knows the desert better than him. we had a perfect safari trip with perfect timing. he is a real gentleman and a very good cook. you should definitely do the full day safari with him.

our guide is a native of the rum village and we think there is no one who knows the desert better than him. we had a perfect safari trip with perfect timing. he is a real gentleman and a very good cook. you should definitely do the full day safari with him.
our guide jann was very knowledgeable, especially on locations and the terrain to best see northern lights. trip was also smooth and comfortable. we had a wonderful experience.

our guide karlie was amazing. she was caring, thoughtful, and incredibly knowledgeable on yellowstone. the grand canyon tour is a must. we lucked out with weather and had a gorgeous day. our group was small, only 5 people, so we got an intimate experience with our guide where she provided us with loads of information on the park. karlie took loads of pictures for us and even packed us a lunch, bear spray, and hiking poles. highly recommend!
our guide richard was very good. the whole trip was seamless and educating. would highly recommend richard for a english speaking guide
our guide was great. bit of a sweaty hike but the views were great. probably better to go on a scooter as you'll be stuck in traffic for hrs on the way back to kuta area

our guide, alfie, was the best! she’s funny, rn, knowledgeable, and easy to talk to. the walk was well organized and flowed well. the food was all very delicious (or in one case interesting). thanks alfie for making the food walk experience really fun!

our guide, mario torres, has 30 years experience on these beautiful waters. we saw crocodiles, herons, frigates, ospreys, and other birds. he took us to several underwater cenotes. he is very knowledgeable and happily shared the unesco efforts to protect this amazing place. this tour is worth the price and every second you spend in this incredible area.

our guide, tyler, was amazing! he transported our party to several sites for the scenery, or animals, he was thorough, and very patient, in helping us with settings and composition! this was the bar that we based the rest of our excursions on, and very few other trips came close!

our guided tour in yellowstone was amazing! our tour guide matt is an incredible human being. he is kind, humble and knowledgeable. he answered all of our questions and took us to the best spots in yellowstone! the lunch and the snacks provided by the company were so good! thank you so much! matt, you’re awesome!

our guides were really friendly and casual, and we were lucky enough to see spinner dolphins, bottlenose dolphins and 2 humpback whales. on top of this they offered us a fully halal non seafood menu upon our request while booking. would recommend to all.

our holiday was beyond expectations and a perfect holiday. the hotel is superb. it is well appointed, with friendly and helpful staff. location is great, being not far from airport and town, but a nice distance away to feel quiet. lots to do. easy taxi ride to town. the breakfast was next level! we loved swimming off the end of the jetty. rooms are beautiful and a good size (we were in deluxe ocean room) we loved it and hope to stay again!

our instructors were punctual and brought an assortment of surfboards for our private group lesson of 5 teenagers. that particular day, the surf was a little rough and a couple of the kids were struggling, but they were very patient and adjusted the lesson to ensure they were still having a good experience.

our jasper raft tours experience on the athabasca river was absolutely incredible, and we thoroughly enjoyed every moment! it was a fantastic way to immerse ourselves in the stunning natural beauty of jasper national park. a special shout-out is absolutely necessary for finn, our captain! he was outstanding. not only did he keep us all safe throughout the journey, but his experience truly shone through as he masterfully navigated some of the shallower parts of the river. thanks to him, we avoided getting excessively wet or stuck, which made for a much more comfortable and enjoyable ride. finn's calm demeanor and evident expertise made us feel completely at ease. beyond finn, all the other staff we encountered were incredibly nice and pleasant. they really gave off the impression that they genuinely enjoyed their jobs, which added a wonderful, positive vibe to the entire operation, from check-in to getting geared up. and of course, the scenery was simply breathtaking. rafting down the athabasca river offered a unique and truly special vantage point. being on the water, looking up at the towering mountains, lush forests (unfortunately after wildfires), and crystal-clear skies, provided a perspective that you just can't get from the hiking trails or roads. it was truly majestic. we highly recommend jasper raft tours for anyone visiting the area. it's an unforgettable adventure with amazing views and an even more amazing team!

our jeep tour was nothing short of amazing. from start to finish, the ride was exciting, scenic, and perfectly tailored to our group’s interests. adam, our guide, did a phenomenal job keeping the energy up and sharing tons of fascinating information about the area - there truly was never a dull moment. what made this tour even more special was the personal touch that comes from being a family-owned business. you could feel the passion and care in every detail, from the route selection to the thoughtful storytelling. adam went out of his way to make sure everyone had a memorable time. if you’re looking for a fun, adventurous, and meaningful way to explore, this is it. highly recommend!

our kayaking tour with ozpaddle was the absolute highlight of our time in sydney—even though the weather wasn’t on our side, we had an incredible time. sophie was an outstanding guide: warm, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about the city. her insights into sydney’s architecture and history added so much depth to the experience, and she made everyone feel comfortable and safe on the water, despite the drizzle. the photos sophie took were sensational—capturing the beauty of the harbour and the joy of the moment, even under grey skies. we’ll treasure them forever. ozpaddle is the original and the best. it’s incredible value for money and far more personal than the typical tourist offerings. whether you're a local or a visitor, this is a must-do activity in sydney. highly recommend—don’t miss it

our kilimanjaro climb would not have been possible without the incredible support of our mountain team from kili backcountry adventure (ig: @kili_backcountry_adventure) two guides, one chef, one camp manager, and thirteen porters walked alongside us—quiet heroes who made sure we could focus on the climb while they took care of everything else. every morning, they greeted us with warm water to wash our faces, delicious meals to fuel our bodies, and encouragement to keep going. by the time we reached each new basecamp, our tents were already set up, meals were cooking, and smiles were waiting. they checked our health every morning and night, making sure we stayed strong enough to continue. through the cold, the altitude, and the long days, this team became our backbone—lifting us up when we felt like we couldn’t go any further. summiting kilimanjaro was a team victory, not just ours, but theirs too. ps: they speak swahili and most of them are tanzanian soccer players ❤️

our last minute booking for a light festival tour on jan. 2020 with rock that boat did not disappoint! friendly and knowledgeable staff (both about the festival and the city), intimate atmosphere within the boat and lovely experience altogether. we were served mulled wine and given blankets if cold. boat was covered and despite the rain, we had a great view of the art sculptures while also enjoyed the city at night time.

our main purpose when we came here was to watch the friday fireworks. this park is big and has nice views of the city. it’s also a great place to relax, hang out, read a book and walking or jogging it’s a great place for kids to play in the playground or run around. it’s has plenty of parking too and it’s also free but keep in mind that it gets busy during special events like the fireworks. best to get there early. i recommend bringing picnic blankets and chair if you’re going to hang out for a bit. we were there a couple of hours before the fireworks mainly to get a good spot and get a good view. we brought some food and enjoyed an early dinner. overall a nice park however just be aware of your surroundings as we’ve seen people with carts and tents on the other side. the public washroom wasn’t as great either, not well maintained but i guess it’s just like any other public park.

our morning out to mackay reef with josh and fabian was the highlight of our east coast trip so far. they were both brilliant, brought great vibes and were super funny too! we had the perfect weather for our day, mackay reef was honestly incredible, best snorkelling we have ever done. i couldn’t recommend this trip enough, make sure to do it whilst you’re up in cape! you won’t regret it :)

our multigenerational family (ages 6-74) joined the wildlife safari at ecocamp in mid april. we had an absolutely wonderful time at ecocamp and highly recommend it. autumn was a great time to visit. the winds were quieter, the sunsets and sunsets were long, the leaves were beautiful and trails less crowded. our group was able to pick-and-choose daily hikes that varied in intensity; this worked great for our family with varied interests and abilities. collectively we did french valley, the base of the towers, grey glacier, sarmiento/little sarmiento, lazo weber and aonikenk hikes. we saw loads of wildlife (rhea, caracara, guanacos, condors, even a mama puma with cubs!). our group of 8 stayed in 2 loft domes. the beds were cozy and showers refreshing after a day of hiking. the dome lofts were plenty spacious for 4. we did the 30 min ecocamp tour on our arrival day and enjoyed learning about the conservation practices of the company. i was able to join a yoga class one morning which was great for stretching after several days of hiking. the food was absolutely delicious, plentiful and healthy. ecocamp will feed you about every 2 hours, so don’t worry about going hungry! the staff even carries hot water for tea and fresh baked goodies to share during the hikes (in addition to the personal lunch you pack in the mornings). the community domes were a fun place to gather in the evenings, and we enjoyed live music one night. hands down, the best thing about ecocamp is the staff. every single person we interacted with was curious, engaging, kind, helpful, joyful, and deeply passionate about protecting the natural lands of patagonia and educating visitors. the staff were such amazing role models for my kids. i highly recommend ecocamp patagonia and would love to return!

our mykines private hike and tour adventure was fantastic. a great tour starts with a great guide and our guide, hans was wonderful. patient & kind, hans was also very knowledgeable and eager to share all things faroe islands. as a native faroese, hans embodied the spirit of the islands. pickup from hotel hafnia was prompt at 12:15 (the morning ferry was fully booked). we were able to book the 1:30 ferry. the drive to the vágar island ferry terminal provided views of the stunning faroe countryside. we passed by deep fiords and high cliffs with waterfalls cascading down to form streams which lead to the fiords. ferry ride to mykines was 45 minutes and pretty smooth. i’m prone to seasickness but did not suffer on either trip. along the way we saw towering sea stacks, dramatic rock formations & more waterfalls. from the mykines ferry terminal we climbed stairs and walked through the old village. there is a free public toilet in the village center. we began the ascent to the puffin colony following the milder incline along a ridge. on the way we saw more spectacular views of mykines and the surrounding coast. the hills have many grazing faroese sheep which climb to great heights. shepherds have dangerous work gathering them. when we reached the puffin colony it was well worth the hike. hundreds of nesting puffins, many were only a few feet away. we were advised to stay 6 ft away from the puffins and not to enter their burrow nest areas. it was a great experience standing in such close proximity to the little guys. my wife took many photos and she was extremely happy. we walked a short distance further to a memorial plaque. from there we had the option to hike further up to the viewpoint and chance to see even more puffins. my son with autism had anxieties about further climbing so we chose to walk down the return route to the village. this route was more steep than the ascent but we managed. we enjoyed katrin’s fish soup in the cafe and returned to the ferry terminal. the 6:15 ferry (last of the day) returned us to vagar just after 7 and hans returned us to the hafnia around 8 pm. this tour gave our family a lifetime of great memories. i highly recommend it. footnote: hans returned to our hotel to to give our son a faroese mountain rock from his personal collection. what a kind gesture. thank you, hans!

our nature guide led us on rocky trails around this and north seymour islands. we had to walk very slowly, quietly and carefully. there were blue-footed boobies courting and nesting with their eggs close to the rocky dirt trail. the boobies showed no interest, nor fear of us as they snuggled each other. the highlight for me was seeing male frigate birds for the first time. a solitary male frigate was courting a female in a nearby tree. the male would inflate its red throat pouch and drum to attract her attention. we didn't stay long enough to see the outcome. our guide explained that frigates have one of the longest mating and incubation periods for seabirds, at 60 days. the female will build her nest and lay 1 egg, but frigates don't mate for life. we also spotted a variety of iguanas in the brush, or sunning themselves on rocks. when we reached the beach, we encountered clusters of sea lions on the sand or rocks as the sun was setting. it was the perfect end to our tour of the eastern galapagos islands.

our paragliding experience was postponed due to bad weather and had to be rescheduled for another day. the staff were very helpful in assisting us with the change. although we had to make a bit of a detour to accommodate the new schedule, it turned out to be the best decision we made! i was paired with tai as my pilot—he was incredibly experienced and made the entire flight feel safe and enjoyable. he kept things light with his jokes and, most importantly, captured plenty of amazing photos and videos to document the experience. the photo angles were great too! 😄

our private boat tour with matteo was a truly exceptional experience—one of the highlights of our entire trip. his attention to detail, kind heart, and deep-rooted connections to the local community made this tour authentic and personal. from exploring murano, burano, torcello, and san francesco the peaceful monastery, every stop felt thoughtfully curated and far from the typical tourist path. matteo is not only a professional guide but also someone who clearly values and respects the history and people of the region. his passion and care made our day unforgettable. this experience exceeded all expectations and gave our trip a unique and lasting memory. we especially enjoyed matteo’s attention to detail, thoughtful conversation, and local connections. highly recommended if you can get on his calendar.

our private tour with herman in sandwich harbour was absolutely incredible! herman's detailed explanations and wonderful photography truly enhanced our experience. we laughed a lot and had an amazing time. highly recommended!

our quad biking experience in palmeraie, marrakech, was absolutely fantastic! from start to finish, everything was well-organized and loads of fun. the adventure took us through beautiful desert landscapes, and it was an exhilarating way to explore the area. the staff was incredibly attentive, making sure we felt safe and comfortable throughout the entire ride. they provided clear instructions and were always nearby to assist if needed. their friendly attitude added to the overall experience, making it even more enjoyable. if you’re looking for a thrilling and unique way to see the stunning palmeraie, i highly recommend this quad biking experience. it was one of the highlights of our trip!

our ride with charlotte and enrique was truly unforgettable. they are the perfect guides—warm, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do. the horses were gentle and well cared for, and we felt completely at ease from the start. the views? absolutely breathtaking. riding through wide open valleys, forests, and along mountain ridges with the andes in the distance felt like a dream. every moment was picture-perfect. this wasn’t just a ride—it was a deep, soulful experience that connected us to the beauty of patagonia. we left with full hearts and memories we’ll never forget. highly recommend!

our safari experience with safari soles was absolutely incredible, thanks to the outstanding team, especially our guide ernest and the amazing trip coordinator irine. from start to finish, everything was flawlessly organized, and the entire journey exceeded our expectations. ernest is, without a doubt, one of the best safari guides we could have hoped for. his professionalism, deep knowledge of wildlife, and sharp eye for spotting animals made our experience truly unforgettable. it was obvious from the start that he is highly experienced—not only in tracking wildlife but also in ensuring a smooth and comfortable ride throughout. his driving skills were exceptional, making even the roughest terrains feel effortless. he also went above and beyond to make sure we had the best game-viewing opportunities, positioning the vehicle perfectly for breathtaking views and photos. one of the most special parts of the trip was the birthday surprise arranged for me at one of the accommodations. it was such a personal and thoughtful touch that made the experience even more memorable! every accommodation we stayed at was excellent, offering great comfort, delicious food, and beautiful surrounding irine, who helped organize our trip, was equally fantastic. her communication was excellent from the moment we inquired about the safari. she was responsive, informative, and made sure every detail was taken care of, ensuring a seamless and stress-free experience. i cannot recommend safari soles enough! if you’re looking for a top-tier safari experience with a knowledgeable, skilled, and passionate guide like ernest, and outstanding service from a professional like irine, look no further. this was truly the trip of a lifetime!

our second time here with the kids and definitely not our last. we were here during the term break so there were many other families with children same age as ours. adults made friends, kids made friends. the resort was cosy in size (that might be a plus if you wanna let the children get loose without having to worry too much about them). the food and drink is amazing. for buffet you might get king crab, great steaks, sushi, sashimi, the nicest dessert and soft serve ice cream etc). the activities are aplenty from ski lessons, different night performances and parties but the highlight is definitely the g.o team. everything they did, from teaching us and our kids how to ski, taking care of us with the warmest smiles, to performing on stage and engaging with us, was done with heart. we all missed our time there, and even the team there when we had to leave and that meant a lot. thank you, logan, khoa, rata, jock, luca, miguel, figo, patrick, yuko, max, craig and many more :) you made our week.

our seven day trip from baguales to rio serrano through the torres del paine national park was brilliant. the landscape was breathtaking. our horses were well trained and perfect for the challenging terrain. they enjoyed their work and were still full of running after 150kms. osvaldo our guide was very engaging and entertaining for the whole trip and passionate about sharing all aspects of life in patagonia. a fabulous experience which we would highly recommend.

our short hiking that really fit to my family in new year day. i bring my mom (senior) and my 4years old. they really like it. not too steep and perfect weather not make it too muddy. the falls so stunning. water so clear too. much hiker bring their furry baby too..

our stay at &beyond grumeti serengeti river lodge was an incredible highlight of our safari — and an experience we won’t soon forget. the lodge is beautifully designed, with a modern and luxurious feel that blends seamlessly into the surrounding landscape. our suite was stunning, with sweeping views of the grumeti river and open-air elements that made us feel fully immersed in the wild. we could hear hippos right from our room at night — an incredible (if a bit loud!) reminder of where we were. the service throughout our stay was exceptional. our guide, waziri, was incredibly knowledgeable and experienced. thanks to his expertise and instinct, we had some of the best wildlife sightings of our entire trip: cheetahs on the hunt, lions on a fresh kill, multiple leopard sightings, a hyena stealing a cheetah’s kill, and big herds of elephants and giraffes. it was nonstop action in the middle of the great migration. we also enjoyed our walking safari with godliving who helped us better understand the smaller animals, plants and the ecosystem. the food at the lodge was excellent, and the team made sure every meal felt special. we didn’t get a chance to use the in-suite spa services, but it was a lovely touch to have that option — and the onsite gym was a great surprise as well. our butler, mike, was warm and attentive. our housekeeper was so awesome in keeping our suite clean, taking care in laundering our clothes, and drawing us a surprise bath. the entire lodge team made us feel truly cared for. we’ve stayed at some of the best properties around the world, and this one absolutely stands out — for its elegance, its setting, and most of all, its people. we would return in a heartbeat!

our stay at arenal springs resort was nothing short of fantastic! from the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly attentive—always friendly, helpful, and genuinely eager to make our stay enjoyable. one of the highlights for our family was the kids area. it’s well-maintained and thoughtfully designed, providing plenty of entertainment and space for little ones to have fun safely. the resort also features a well-equipped gym, which was a great bonus for staying active during our vacation. but the true standout was the hot springs. they’re spacious, beautifully landscaped, and the perfect temperature for soaking and relaxing. whether you're enjoying them in the early morning or under the stars, the experience is truly rejuvenating. overall, arenal springs resort offers the perfect mix of relaxation and family-friendly amenities. we’ll definitely be coming back!

our stay at ashnil mara camp during our masai mara safari was nothing short of exceptional. this resort offers a truly luxurious glamping experience that blends comfort with the raw beauty of nature. the expansive lobby overlooks the mara river, where you can watch hippos play in the water and hear their calls echoing through the air—an experience we’ll never forget. the evenings were especially magical, spent around a warm bonfire on the beautiful deck, the perfect way to unwind after a thrilling day on safari. the bar served a wide variety of drinks, and the hot dawa became our favorite companion for the cool nights. the camps are luxurious and spacious, and the hospitality was top-notch, and special thanks to kennedy and john for their outstanding service—they were friendly, polite, and always eager to help. the food was delicious with plenty of options, and we were pleasantly surprised by the generous spread of indian cuisine. highly recommend ashnil mara camp to anyone looking for a comfortable, immersive, and memorable stay in the heart of the masai mara!

our stay at bitu samatha was truly memorable! the property is spacious, clean, and surrounded by breathtaking mountain views. the host was incredibly friendly and made us feel at ease from the moment we arrived. the camp room was neat, comfortable, and well-maintained. we especially loved the delicious home-cooked dinner and breakfast — it really added a personal touch to the experience. a great place to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the region. would definitely recommend!

our stay at damaraland camp was brilliant! while i'll admit the scenery isn't exactly stunning, it is impressive in its own way. but the highlight of the stay was the staff! what an amazing group of people who wanted nothing more than to make us feel welcome and comfortable. sadly, i may never visit namibia again, but if i do i would return to damaraland camp without hesitation.

our stay at ella flower garden resort was amazing! the view from the hotel is simply beautiful, and the environment is so peaceful and relaxing. the rooms were cozy and very clean. i want to especially mention chamathka, who gave us such kind and friendly service. she was always helpful and made sure we were comfortable during our stay. thank you for making our visit extra special! would definitely come back.

our stay at hoanib skeleton coast camp was truly incredible. located in one of the remotest corners of the world, you really feel like you are on a different planet. not only are the landscapes incredible - dunes leading to the coast, rocky mountains into flat plains - the national park also has a healthy and diverse wildlife population. during our stay - we saw so many desert adapted species including springbok, oryx, giraffe, elephants and the most famous desert adapted lions in the area that have learned how to hunt seals on the beach - a truly spectacular sight. the rooms are incredibly luxurious and located at the base of the mountain - with a waterhole that is frequented by all types of wildlife throughout the day. you don't even need to leave the lodge to see elephants and lions. for such a remote camp- they somehow mange to bring in the freshest food, and have incredible diverse menus for all meals. nothing seems like too much effort for this team. all food is also recycled in a sustainable way, and the camp is 100% solar powered. what really makes this camp memorable are the people who work there. by the time we left at the end of three nights, we felt like family. thank you to our brilliant guide, william and camp managers, jonathan, hilde and lizelle. our camp staff - phiroza, limbo and mcdonald. all of you made this trip one of our best yet!!

our stay at jw marriott masai mara was nothing short of magical. from start to finish, everything was seamlessly comfortable — far beyond what i had imagined for a safari trip. i thought traveling in kenya would be a bit rough around the edges, but this experience proved me completely wrong. it was easy, relaxing, and incredibly well taken care of. the staff were outstanding — warm, attentive, and genuinely passionate about making our stay special. every little detail was thought through, and we were treated like family. we were also extremely lucky to witness all of the big five, plus so many other incredible animals in their natural habitat. the game drives were exciting yet safe, and our guides were knowledgeable and respectful of the environment. and the food — wow! the hotel fed us like royalty. every meal was a delight, beautifully prepared with fresh ingredients and served with care. if you’re dreaming of an african safari but worried about the challenges — don’t be. jw marriott masai mara makes it an effortless blend of adventure and luxury. highly recommended!

our stay at mara kimana camp was nothing short of exceptional, and we would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to emily and dennis for their outstanding service. their warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail made our safari experience truly unforgettable. from the beautifully prepared camp to the seamless organization of meals, every moment was thoughtfully taken care of. we left with wonderful memories and a deep appreciation for the team’s dedication. highly recommended to anyone visiting the maasai mara!

our stay at offbeat mara was absolutely magical. from the moment we arrived everything was seamless and nothing was too much to ask, we felt very well looked after throughout our whole stay. the tent was immaculate and very comfortable, the perfect place to relax and unwind between our game drives and meals with fantastic views from our porch way. all meals were really tasty and beautifully presented, with 3 courses for dinner being a pleasant surprise. the bar was also very well stocked with drinks for all tastes available. tony's cocktails were exceptional, we would definitely recommend trying a few! the game drives themselves were also perfect. our guides stella and martin were extremely knowledgeable, answering all questions we had along the way no matter what they were. we saw everything we hoped to see and more, even a brief glimpse of the very elusive leopard! there were also a range of optional activities available which were varied to cater for different interests. we particularly enjoyed the walking safari and the night drive as they both gave us different perspectives from the daily game drives. thank you to all the team at offbeat, you made our honeymoon such a special occasion!

our stay at olive bush camp in the masai mara was nothing short of exceptional. the views were absolutely breathtaking, offering a front-row seat to the natural beauty and wildlife of the mara. the facilities were brilliantly maintained, blending comfort with an authentic safari experience. every detail was clearly cared for, from the well-kept tents to the communal areas. the staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive, making us feel like family from the moment we arrived. the insight and suggestions they provided on the area for best wildlife viewing were remarkable and showcases their knowledge of the area. the hospitality extended during the stay whether it was a simple request during meals or a packed lunch for a game drive added a special touch to the entire experience. what truly set this camp apart was the warmth and attentiveness of the staff, especially mrs. deepa, the owner. she welcomed every guest like family and went out of her way to make us feel at home. a highlight of our trip was the thoughtful celebration she arranged for our daughter’s 10th birthday — complete with a special song and dance performance by the masai people that made her feel incredibly loved and celebrated. it was a memory we’ll treasure forever. lastly, the food and beverage service was fantastic — fresh, flavorful meals and thoughtful menu made every meal a delight. highly recommended for anyone seeking an unforgettable, luxurious safari experience in the heart of the masai mara.

our stay at siringit serengeti camp was truly special. the tents were comfortable and beautifully set up, blending perfectly with the wild surroundings. the staff were kind and welcoming, always making sure we were well taken care of. we enjoyed delicious meals under the stars and had peaceful nights listening to the sounds of the serengeti. it was a unique and memorable experience that we’ll always treasure.

our stay at teman exceeded all our expectations! everything was incredible, and it truly became one of the greatest experiences of our lives. starting with the crew, moses and his team were exceptionally friendly and always ready to help. the itinerary was thoughtfully designed to balance diving with other activities such as hiking, trekking, snorkeling, and relaxing on beautiful beaches. when it came to diving, moses and alwin proved to be highly skilled and experienced guides. every dive felt carefully planned to let us safely and joyfully discover the wonders of komodo’s underwater world. the rooms were spacious, comfortable, and clean. there was enough space for our luggage, the bed was cozy, and the crew tidied up the room every morning. the boat itself was also very comfortable, with plenty of shared spaces to relax during the day and a large dining table where we enjoyed all our meals together with the rest of the group. last but not least, a special applause to the kitchen crew, who delighted us with delicious and tasteful meals throughout the entire journey.

our stay at the enchantment resort was incredible. the views from our room were absolutely stunning. the service was top-notch, and every staff member we met was friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. they made us feel genuinely welcomed and taken care of. from the scenery to the hospitality, everything exceeded our expectations. we can’t wait to come back!

our stay at the fairmont mara safari club was incredible. the service truly sets this place apart. the staff feel like a family and go out of their way to make your experience special and fun. we had a surprise river side dinner and bush breakfast planned by the staff. our game drive guides worked tirelessly to make sure we saw all the big game. the cars were comfortable, the food delicious and the tents were impeccable. we’ll be back.

our stay at the lodge was sensational. well beyond our expectations. the staff, the food, the location, our guide, the drivers all perfect. we had issues with bugs, lots and lots of bugs falling on our heads which made our first night stay unpleasant. i requested a mosquito net and once it was in place and managed the bug situation better. we loved exploring the grounds using the motor scooters, but you need new batteries. often, we were left stranded.

our stay at this hotel in ella was truly memorable. the first thing that stands out is its breathtaking location — perched on a hill with panoramic views of lush green valleys. the scenery alone is worth the stay. the rooms have been recently renovated and are beautifully decorated in a modern style. everything was spotlessly clean and well-maintained, giving off a fresh and welcoming atmosphere. the open buffet breakfast was delicious, offering a wide variety of options including fresh tropical fruits and local specialties. the staff were extremely friendly and attentive, always ready to help with a smile. but the highlight of our stay was waking up to the view from our room, accompanied by the peaceful sounds of tropical birds. it’s a magical way to start the day. if you’re looking for a comfortable stay immersed in ella’s natural beauty, this place is a perfect choice.

our stay at this hotel was truly extraordinary in every way. from the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warmth and genuine kindness by an exceptional team who seemed to anticipate every need before we even expressed it. their friendliness and dedication created an atmosphere of care and ease that made us feel not only like valued guests, but almost like part of a family. the location itself is magical — right in the heart of the jungle — and the way the hotel blends seamlessly with nature is remarkable. everything has been designed with such sensitivity and respect for the environment, allowing us to experience the jungle’s beauty without ever feeling like nature was compromised. it’s rare to find a place where comfort and authenticity meet so perfectly. the décor is tasteful, stylish, and in perfect harmony with the surroundings, creating a space that feels both elegant and soothing. the food was outstanding: fresh, flavorful, and presented with such care that each meal felt like a small celebration. what impressed us most was the attention to the little details — every corner, every dish, every gesture showed thoughtfulness and love. throughout our stay, nothing ever felt impossible; the team continuously went above and beyond to ensure we had the most memorable experience. this was far more than just accommodation — it was an unforgettable journey filled with joy, relaxation, and deep appreciation for both people and place. we left with full hearts and the strong desire to return as soon as possible. truly one of the best experiences we have ever had.

our stay here was truly magical. the staff are so warm and friendly. any requests we had they were more than happy to cater for our needs. the chef is extremely talented and makes delicious meals every evening and we also had some requests to try some more localised cuisines which he was more than happy to make especially for us. the rims were in a beautiful setting in the middle of the savannah. the rooms were clean and had plenty of amenities. we would definitely return. thank you to all of the serengeti ikona family for your hospitality.

our stay here was truly magical. the staff are so warm and friendly. any requests we had they were more than happy to cater for our needs. the chef is extremely talented and makes delicious meals every evening and we also had some requests to try some more localised cuisines which he was more than happy to make especially for us. the rims were in a beautiful setting in the middle of the savannah. the rooms were clean and had plenty of amenities. we would definitely return. thank you to all of the serengeti ikona family for your hospitality.

our stay was absolutely perfect. from the moment we made our reservation, mohammed was incredibly kind and attentive. the camp was spotless and well-maintained, with excellent facilities, including free parking. we also had the amazing opportunity to take a complimentary tour of wadi rum, which made our experience even more memorable. dinner at the camp was nothing short of incredible—every dish was delicious. truly, everything exceeded our expectations. i highly recommend this place!

our stay was fantastic due to the super comfortable and aesthetic rooms, as well as the very hospitable and helpful staff. the vibe is very cozy yet intimate with nature. we even saw some wildebeests from our room amidst the lush green surroundings. chef moses made one of the best vegetarian quiches we have ever had, and he used local ingredients. he was very attentive to our dietary needs and we had some amazing picnic lunches in the masai mara thanks to that. we also really enjoyed the sundowner with the masai dancing.

our sunny sunday adventure led us to cypress waterfalls in bc, and what a day it was! hiking with friends was a blast, and this trail was just right – short, easy, and full of natural beauty. the round-trip to the falls spanning about 3 km made for a perfect hour-long trek. the highlight? the falls, of course! nature's spectacle, the cascading water was a sight to behold. but what added magic to the hike was the small stream on the way back. we paused there for a lunch break, and the stream's vivid green hue was absolutely breathtaking. this trail isn't just about the falls; it's about the journey. the lush surroundings, chirping birds, and the serene atmosphere made the hike a memorable experience. plus, taking a breather by that stunningly vibrant stream was a picture-perfect moment. cypress waterfalls is a gem for an easy yet enchanting hike amidst nature's splendor.

our sunset coastline trip turned into a bonanza of spotting dolphins and whales! also a string ray too! all feeding on the mix of sardines and mackerel. great knowledge and hospitality from captain salim going the extra mile to share these seas with us. this is not my first visit. i've been numerous times and all experiences have been memorable. thank you salim

our swamp tour with captain jacob was the absolute highlight of our trip. from the moment we stepped onto the boat, jacob’s professionalism, warm personality, and deep knowledge of the louisiana bayous made this an unforgettable experience. captain jacob wasn’t just a guide, he was a storyteller, a naturalist, and a passionate protector of the ecosystem. he explained the history of the region with clarity and heart, including how early settlers survived off the land and the ongoing battle against invasive species. you could tell he genuinely cared about the environment and wanted us to leave with a better understanding of its beauty and fragility. and the wildlife? incredible. we saw tons of alligators, up close but always safely. we also encountered raccoons, egrets, great blue herons, blue herons, the elusive “swamp chicken” (i wish i remembered its real name!), lubber grasshoppers, giant snails, and so many more species i lost count. the boat was comfortable, the pace was perfect, and the entire experience was both educational and entertaining. we left with amazing photos, better appreciation for louisiana’s ecosystem, and a ton of fun memories. highly recommend this tour and if you can, ask for captain jacob. he made it magic.

our tao expedition was pure magic, a true bucket list item, and 100% worth its premium price! everything was seamlessly organized, allowing us to fully surrender to the moment — zero stress, just adventure. vince and leo led with energy, humor and heart, while chef doy & his crew served up the freshest, most incredible meals. every day felt effortless, yet full of excitement. beyond breathtaking islands and camps, it was the people who made this journey unforgettable. this is a social trip (!), and that’s what makes it so special. our group was filled with inspiring, positive characters, and the crew brought us together through games, music, and spontaneous moments. the inside jokes, the “otso-ing,” the animal charades — every day felt like a celebration of life. and the food? absolutely next level. fresh, local, healthy, and bursting with flavor, every meal was an experience in itself. looking back, we realize just how lucky we were to share this adventure. knowing that some of the cost goes back to supporting the local community makes it even more meaningful. if you’re looking for a journey that blends adventure, joy and connectedness with the present moment, look no further ♥️ thank you, tao!!

our time at the jw masai mara lodge was absolutely incredible!! mike & liz were fantastic guides and worked really hard to give us an amazing safari experience. we got to witness all of the big 5 except for the rhino and got to see a large wildebeest crossing. we got excellent photos and appreciate the camera service. the property is also spectacular - beautiful tents and common areas. we also participated in the activities offered including archery and a village visit. it was so great to experience the local culture. the food and drinks were great. we enjoyed seeing nicherwa at the restaurant each day and victor was a fantastic bartender / great to chat with. overall, the staff is absolutely amazing. everyone we met from the front desk to housekeeping were so welcoming and kind. a top notch experience we will remember for a lifetime!

our trip was completed in july, 2023. we were an international team with extensive experience trekking and mountaineering in multiple ranges, including the himalayas. the objective was to piece together a challenging zanskar trek that avoided as much as possible any roads. in short, we partnered with zanskar kanishka expeditions to make the trip a reality, and that all began with a visit to their brick-n-mortar office in leh, ladakh. i characterize the operator as: - professional - patient - respectful - knowledgeable - friendly - fairly-priced in sum, competent at executing a fully-supported expedition in remote areas of zanskar and broader ladakh, including a highly professional and diligent expedition support crew. -- the longer, more personal version: i discovered zanskar kanishka expeditions on a whim. i walked by, looked in, and kept walking by...and then turned around and went in for a chat. within 3-5 minutes i understood i had finally discovered a genuine, experienced expedition operator. lobzang is zanskari himself, the founder of this outfit, and in the office. over the course of multiple meetings and before any commitment from our team to employ his services, he patientily listened to multiple potential iterations of the expedition. we explored success and failure scenario based on variables any expedition should consider. he is knowledgeable of zanskar, and yet when he was uncertain about a variable, he was immediately transparent about his uncertainty and worked his contacts on the ground in zanskar to identify updated information (snow levels over a pass, for example.) when information remained unknown, he was transparent about this, and, as is expected from a pro operator, we collaboratively worked through possible failure scenario and what the implications of this would mean during the actual trip. a support crew is the backbone of any expedition and if this team falls through, then the entire trip can quickly spiral into failure. zanskar kanishka expeditions provided an exceptional support crew. the expedition team itself was comprised of two zanskari cooks who spoke far more english than anticipated, a humble and hardworking horseman, 9 horses (1 of which ran away/home) and a zanskari guide. in practice, the team of 4 was highly cross-functional and effective in their daily tasks. they set up and broke camp, including the kitchen and dining tents. they cooked incredibly good food for 4000m+ in highly remote areas. they were a hardworking, diligent crew, especially the cooks and horseman. as with any expedition, there were hiccups along the way too, most of which were weather-related phenomena. despite these challenges, the support team overcame them with efficacy and professionalism. in particular, after a miserable, rain-soaked day that forced us to take a rest day, we woke to similar conditions yet needed to press on. the support team broke camp in the rain at 4400m+ and then crossed a 5000m+ rarely-used pass in a snow storm, doing their job and doing it really well despite the daunting prospect of doing so. this was no easy task — everyone was exhausted — and i personally thank them here again for their efforts. that said, i personally was not partial to the zanskari guide and feel he would benefit from improving his english skills and the ways he navigates group dynamics. perhaps my view is biased by the somewhat vast experience of our team, which is a fair assessment/response to my observation. our experience with this operator was unexpectedly overwhelmingly positive. thanks lobzang, genuinely.

our trip with colombia luxury group was outstanding. the boat was pristine and luxurious, and our captain was professional, knowledgeable, and accommodating. stunning views, smooth sailing, and top-tier service made it an unforgettable experience. highly recommend! special mention to melanie and the crew.

our trip with hatch river expeditions was absolutely unforgettable! the scenery throughout the grand canyon was breathtaking and awe inspiring. what really stood out was how organized everything was. the crew had all the camping gear perfectly prepared and made setting up each night super easy and stress-free. the food was another unexpected highlight — delicious, fresh, and way beyond what we imagined for a river trip. our guide was fantastic — incredibly knowledgeable and engaging. he brought the canyon to life with fascinating facts about the geology, rock formations, and history of the area. it made the journey so much more meaningful and memorable. if you're considering a trip through the grand canyon, i can’t recommend hatch river expeditions highly enough. they made every moment count!

our trip with thorshavn sea adventure to nólsoy was absolutely incredible! even though we live in iceland and have seen plenty of puffins, this was something else—literally thousands of puffins and over 20 seals made it a truly unforgettable experience. the guide was excellent—knowledgeable, friendly, and struck the perfect balance between sharing interesting facts and letting us take it all in. we explored beautiful caves, stopped at just the right spots, and felt completely safe and well cared for the entire time. highly recommended for anyone visiting the faroe islands!

our visit to argyros winery was one of the highlights of our santorini trip. the vineyard offers beautiful views and a unique wine tasting experience. we were guided by dimitrius, who was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about winemaking. he provided insightful information about the unique volcanic terroir and the history of the winery which is now 4 generations old with vines of 300 years in age. the wine tasting featured a selection of their wines, paired with local cheeses and delicacies. the assyrtiko grape indigenous to santorini, stood out with its crisp, refreshing taste. the usage of both modern and traditional techniques with great attention to detail and perfectionism made this a wonderul experience to end the trip with. tl;dr :the combination of excellent wines, stunning views, and warm hospitality made our visit unforgettable. highly recommended

our visit to blue planet diving center was nothing short of spectacular. from the moment we arrived, the team greeted us with warmth and enthusiasm. this was my son’s very first dive after getting certified, and every member of the staff went out of their way to make him—and the rest of us—feel completely at ease. the pre-dive briefing was thorough and engaging. safety protocols were explained in clear, friendly language, and we had ample time to ask questions. dive master michele stood out immediately: patient, knowledgeable, and endlessly reassuring. he guided us through every step, checked our gear meticulously, and customized the pace to match my son’s comfort level. underwater, michele’s expertise shone. he pointed out playful fish, and we went in hidden cave that we never would’ve discovered on our own. my son surfaced beaming with confidence, already talking about his next adventure. blue planet’s top-quality equipment, combined with michele’s attentive care, made this milestone dive both safe and unforgettable. i wholeheartedly recommend blue planet diving center for families, beginners, and seasoned divers alike. their professionalism, genuine passion, and personalized service turned our first dive into a lifelong memory. if you’re looking for a team that treats you like part of the family—especially when introducing a young diver to the wonders beneath the waves—look no further than blue planet.

our visit to estancia cerro guido was a top highlight of our argentina & chile vacation. it is a fabulous place to base yourself for a visit to torres del paine national park. from the incredible staff, the truly amazing food-what a garden!, the well-appointed rooms, and unrivaled views, i really think you can’t go wrong choosing cerro guido. the number of different activities you can do through the ranch’s excursions or your own choices is vast. i will say upfront that the majority of our time exploring during our stay was with a private guide we arranged to take us into the national park. the ranch folks did not seem to have any issue with this as we were not the only ones. though at times there seemed to be some confusion on what our plans were during our stay. not clear how that came about but it worked out in the end. we did take two excursions from the list of options offered through cerro guido which were informative. we can not praise the dining staff enough. from the fantastic dishes and desserts coming from the kitchen to the service staff that learned our names, drink preferences, and even our normal pace of dining, it was an immense pleasure at every meal. the wednesday evening bbq buffet was a highlight. to enjoy this level of cuisine in a location like this (which is two hours from any semblance of a city) is a true testament to the chef and his crew and to the level of service this establishment provides. lots of wildlife visiting the property-guanaco, rhea, foxes including one who enjoyed a sunbath in a field with one of the resident horses. if you are a birder you’ll love the condors, carcara, and other unique avian species. we learned many details of the history of the estancia, how the property works now, the gaucho life, and the puma conservation work being done on the ranch. very commendable. our guide, aurelie, was an excellent resource for answering questions. if you are planning a trip to patagonia, do yourself a favor and look into staying at this beautiful place. i can say without reservation that you will leave happy and impressed.

our visit to madame tussauds london was an absolute delight! we reached early in the morning which turned out to be the perfect decision as the place wasn’t crowded, so we could take our time exploring and clicking photos without rushing. the wax statues are incredibly life-like! from royalty to hollywood legends, sports icons to world leaders. every figure was crafted with such stunning attention to detail that you almost expect them to blink! i especially loved sitting down for a afternoon tea with queen elizabeth, it was such a fun and regal setup! apart from the wax figures, the attractions inside are equally impressive. the spirit of london ride was a surprise! a black cab-style journey through london’s historical moments. it was beautifully done, with animations and audio that brought the past to life. this space is so much fun not only for adults but for kids too. the entire place is vibrant, well-organized, and interactive, making it more than just a museum — it’s an experience. you would need at least 2 hours to visit the entire space. if you're in london, madame tussauds is a must-visit for both first-timers and anyone wanting a bit of star-struck fun!

our visit to plitvice lakes national park was absolutely wonderful – a reminder of how incredible nature can be. we bought our tickets online on the same day (july 10), at €40 per person, and scheduled our entry for 3:00 pm through entrance 2 (there are two entry gates). there are large paid parking areas near the entrance (€3/hour). we chose route “h”, which takes about 4–6 hours to complete. we did it in 4 hours, including a 20–30 minute break at one of the park’s fast-food spots. the route included a mix of walking, bus rides, boat trips, and more walking before returning by bus to the starting point. transfers by bus and boat run every 30 minutes. the park is well maintained and even though we visited in mid-july, the weather wasn’t too hot – in fact, my wife, who usually feels cold, ended up putting on a light sweater at the end of the walk. the lakes, waterfalls, cliffs, and vegetation are stunning – hats off to the croatians for how well they preserve and promote this natural gem. we highly recommend a visit, and we hope to return someday to see its beauty in another season.

our visit to the grand palace was truly memorable. after a short 150–250m walk from the entrance gate, we purchased tickets for 500 baht per person (approx. ₹1250). while it might seem pricey, it’s worth the experience — especially if you visit bangkok for the first time. the grand palace is not just a tourist spot — it’s a spiritual and historical icon of thailand. built in 1782, it served as the official residence of the thai kings for over 150 years. the palace complex is home to several impressive buildings, gardens, and temples — the most famous being wat phra kaew (temple of the emerald buddha), which houses thailand’s most sacred buddha image carved from a single block of jade. one of the highlights for us was the gallery of murals depicting scenes from the ramayana, delicately inscribed in gold along the walls. it’s a storytelling and artistry masterpiece reflecting deep cultural and religious significance. pro tips: * the weather was hot and humid during our visit, so we highly recommend wearing an umbrella, comfortable clothing, and sunscreen to avoid sunburn. * dress code is strict: shoulders and knees must be covered, or you may be denied entry. * visiting early in the day is best to avoid crowds and heat. the grand palace is a must-see if it’s your first time in thailand. it offers a breathtaking introduction to thai history, craftsmanship, and culture. worth the time and ticket!

our visit to the sacred monkey forest in ubud was one of the most unforgettable highlights of our trip to bali as a couple. from the moment we entered the lush, green sanctuary, we were transported into a magical world where nature, culture, and wildlife coexist in the most serene and fascinating way. the towering ancient trees and moss-covered statues created an almost otherworldly atmosphere—perfect for strolling hand in hand and taking in the beauty and spirituality of the space. the balinese architecture and sacred temples scattered throughout the forest added a deep cultural richness to the experience. the monkeys themselves were a joy to watch—cheeky, clever, and completely in their element. we followed the guidelines and kept a respectful distance, which allowed us to enjoy their antics without feeling uneasy. watching them play, groom, and leap through the trees was pure entertainment, and seeing the babies clinging to their mothers was heart-melting. what made it extra special as a couple was how peaceful and bonding the experience felt. it wasn’t just a tourist attraction—it was a walk through living, breathing spirituality and nature. we took time to sit on a bench together, surrounded by ancient trees and the sound of the forest, just soaking it all in. truly a memory we’ll always share. highly recommend visiting early in the morning to avoid the crowds and enjoy the quiet majesty of the place. whether you’re seeking connection, culture, or just a bit of cheeky monkey fun, this sanctuary is a must-visit. a perfect stop for couples exploring the heart of ubud.

out of all the places i’ve seen in costa rica this has been the only dirty and unkept one. definitely don’t come on a sunday or holiday. we saw several people including adults changing right by the water so if you come with children be aware they’ll see a lot. there were people smoking and drinking in the water and discarding their cigarette butts right in there next to everyone else trying to enjoy the springs. there were food wrappers on the mud and beer cans everywhere. you could hardly walk without seeing some trash or stepping on it. the parking is alongside the road and they will try and scam you. we had someone trying to charge us $12 to park on the side of the road and someone further down charging $4, this is supposed to be free public parking, it’s the road. they tell you they “watch” your car if you pay, so if you don’t pay don’t leave anything inside your vehicle. if you have the means, pay for a more private place or definitely come in a slow day where everyone is a work and school. such a shame to see the place so trashed. there is a fenced parking that has a different cost and offers bathrooms and stairs down to the water across from tabacón. we didn’t ask for the price as we had paid to park and then upon getting to the area left as soon as we could.
