this trail was nice though when we were there in early june, there was quite a bit of drizzling on our hike. we turned around mid-way due to time reasons, do also note that there's a cut off time for the entry time around 3pm. there's also a parking area right in front of the entrance to the trail and there are people letting you into the parking area. note that this trail doesn't take you to the summit and crater. you have to book the trail tickets for 2 other tickets if you want to go up the summit and see the crater.
this travel agency give you the best tour in island of boracay. the are caring and accomodating to us. and help us to enjoy and relax.

this trip is for young women who like loud pounding spanish dance music. definitely not enjoyable for 50 year olds. the drinks are given out in tiny 5 oz plastic cups that require a refill every 5 minutes if you're drinking beer. the crew was very good and we had no complaints about them at all. the snorkeling was good but the best part was stopping at a sand bar where there were a bunch of other boats anchored and people partying in the water. they ran out of beer and the only other option was rum.

this trip started its idea phase back during covid and planned knowing it would happen. traveling across the world to meet up with two outstanding individuals that have been my 2nd family and brothers since grade school, could not have gone smoother. all of that was made possible by axel and his arctic spearfishing guide services. his services are expertly applied and professionally carried out. never did we feel unprepared for this epic adventure. first meeting us at the airport, stopping at the grocery getting us settled into our accommodations (which he provided(top notch)), halibut burgers prepared by chef axel and a briefing started the trip. 3 spearos hunting 4days 6plus hours/day, hungry for some halibut and i think we earned our place out here and gave it our all. 5 halibut, 2 cod and 1 pollock filled our coolers. many thanks to the arctic spearfishing videos that are on youtube. 7mm cressi seppia wetsuits, g2 dive mitts and yazbek socks made the temps easily tolerable. 200yrd fish drags through the bogs will make you appreciate a boat dive but the true way of walking out from the road and getting into a drift really makes you feel you’ve earned your spot in spearing these powerful fish. all we can hope for is valhallas approval. of course we intend to revisit lofoten for another fish camp or a family visit early/late summer with axel for a bit of spearing and time exploring the islands. hands down perfect delivery on arctic spearfishing 10/10 incredibly well done!

this trip was a great experience! we were on shared trip to 5 islands. our guide was really engaged but at the same time laid back. we had a lot of luck because we saw the monkeys up close, dolphins and a big turtle. we really liked the music on the boat and "short party" on the board :) we landed on two islands and we saw from the water remaining three islands. moreover we saw the waterfall, we snorkeled near blue bay, and we had tasty bbq lunch on ile aux cerfs. we highly recommend this excursion with tino boats :)

this trip was amazing. be prepared for tuff hike to get to the waterfalls. if you are out of shape or overweight, you might not make it. there are areas you might have use both legs and hands to climb through.

this trip was fantastic! it was really nice and the tour guides were very sweet and helpful. they provide snorkeling equipment, fins, water and snacks. the water was incredible, very cool and clear. i saw a lot of turtles and different fish! then they took us to another area with a shore that u can swim up to. the trip and the price was worth it!!!

this trip was my best trip ever. loved it every second. osvaldo and clementine were really nice and sweet people, we were felt so welcome. they took good care of us. the horses were perfect and friendly horses, felt save even when the conditions of the underground were tough. the landscapes were almost unreal, never seen so much beauty in 7 days, the views were amazing. the stays during the week were fantastic as well, every sleeping place had the most amazing views from the bed. we've met a lot of nice and friendly people during the trip (the owners of the accommodations where we slept), they're all from patagonia, that's what i really like, to met people from that place and not being in any tourist environment. and last but not least, the food was brilliant, i'm not that easy with food, and i liked it all, so that means a lot. osvaldo and clementine, thank you so much! thanks for giving me this experience , i'll never forget this trip. it's almost two weeks ago now and i'm thinking of it every singel day.
this used to be my favourite hike but now it is so popular and too many people on trail. hard to park as well now. but will fun to do once in awhile for the magical views at top.

this used to be the site of a hotel, before president roosevelt sent in the army to take back the land, and they took down buildings so that the wild life there could come back. and oh, it came back! it was breath taking. this is a definite must see!

this venue is a stunning, particularly for those passionate about music, theatre, and the performing arts. i found it to be a delightful experience. would recommend to join a guided tour for the best experience. during the tour, participants will receive ear pieces, which allows you to explore the space while still hearing the guide's commentary. in an added bonus, our guide played the pipe organ for us, enhancing the experience. the entire visit lasted around an hour.

this venue is fantastic and a great spot to visit with friends. we played the alien amplitude test, which was a lot of fun. it’s definitely worth every penny, and you’ll have a great time here. emma was an exceptional hostess—warm, welcoming, and very accommodating. she explained the games clearly, making us eager to return for another visit.

this very unique plaza runs east and west in the center of several districts in seoul. entry into the area is a ramp down or stairs along the length of the attractive. several over-hangs can provide shade and several visitors had their feet in the water. would recommend this area for light meal, quiet social visit, or some peaceful meditation.
this view point has a short trail to a great lookout, worth the stop.

this viewpoint is the highest vista viewpoint on the south rim of the canyon and another excellent location to witness where the colorado river carved out a masterpiece over millions of years. standing here at the edge of this natural wonder, the vast expanse of rusty red and burnt orange hues that stretches out before you are a breathtaking testament to the power of erosion. what we love most is the crisp and clean smell of the air, filled with the sweet scent of pine and the sound of ravens calling in the distance. there is a circular parking lot, which is safely located off desert view drive and is one of the larger viewpoint parking lots along the east side of grand canyon national park. the parking lot only has a limited number of oversized or small rv parking spaces, and we did not see any handicapped parking spaces. the parking lot is open 24 hours with a few recycling bins but there are no restroom facilities. whether you're a seasoned hiker or just looking for a scenic drive, this viewpoint has something for everyone. take a deep breath, grab your camera, and get ready to be awestruck by one of the most iconic views in the american west.

this viewpoint offers a magnificent view of the grand canyon and has several viewing areas including taking the trail for a short distance for even a closer look at this marvel of nature. just a short distance from the parking lot, you will walk through a small teardrop park area before reaching the viewing area for a stunning view. there are several recycling bins in the parking lot but there are no restrooms at this location. the parking lot is limited with only a few spaces for oversized vehicles or small rvs. the viewpoint is open 24 hours, but no overnight camping or fires are allowed.

this viewpoint provides a variety of different angles to capture the beauty of this canyon. from this area, you are offered a panoramic view along the south rim of the grand canyon, including the canyon ridges and colorado river below. you can reach this viewpoint by private vehicle, hiking along the rim trail or taking the shuttle bus yellow route. in the area you will find a restroom, parking lot and a geology museum with a gift shop. yavapai point is truly a geologists and nature enthusiasts dream spot, to examine, study or simply stand in awe of mother nature’s beauty and its extraordinary geological history.

this vineyard was excellent. the pairings went very well with the food and i remember enjoying the dessert wine a lot the setting and background for the vineyard is beautiful, and it wasn’t too busy so lots of space to yourself which is nice. i recommend asking to walk around as well as a mini tour. cool stuff.

this walking area is insanely awesome. especially when netflix is putting out the squid game promotion. there were people everywhere, the dolls were standing around, even the guards were there. there are sitting areas and there's all these famous buildings around the plaza. it's a must for any visitor to seoul. it takes you straight to the royal palace and the royal museum. easily get here using the subway which by the way is very easy to ride.

this walkway along the side of el morro and the ocean is so beautiful and i would recommend it to almost everyone! it takes maybe 15-25min depending on your speed and if you like to take lots of pictures. fyi: there is no shade along the whole walkway, make sure to be prepared for the sun if it’s a hot and sunny day. there will be stairs up to el morro at the end of the walkway.

this walkway connects cronulla park and it's beach where the lifesavers club is located to shelly beach and oaks park. beautiful homes and condos lined up the path with excellent view of the sea and the soothing sound of its waves pounding the beach.
this was 1/2 marathon race that took place. it's a great place to walk and chill. you can hire a bike or skateboard on the promenade.

this was a beautiful azorean experience!! delicious local food and drink, history and culture plus amazing singing from our great hostess

this was a beautiful place to stop for pictures. i really appreciate the spanish architecture of the chapel. built in the 1800s, it's younger than a lot of the other landmarks but it looks just as old.

this was a challenging but rewarding hike. it takes about 4-5 hours and traverses a lot of different terrain. quite steep and narrow as well as wet and slippery in many places, so dress appropriately and recommend wearing proper hiking shoes/boots.

this was a cozy place. veronica, the massage therapist, was very attentive and kind. the space was clean and had a pleasant atmosphere, including the bathroom, which also served as a storage area. it’s a small place—really small—but well-maintained. the main downside for me was the beds; they weren’t very comfortable and felt quite firm. the room was also cold, which made it a bit uncomfortable after the massage, even though the sheets were slightly warm. adding diffusers could enhance the experience by making the room smell more inviting.

this was a fabulous hike, well worth the fee. our 9 and 6 year old were able to keep up with ease; at the end it does get steep to get to the famed view points but not so difficult it's unmanageable. highly recommend - for those questioning the fee, other locations you travel to will have you pay for parking (think iceland) and it's pretty much the same thing. this is a grand trail to maintain, as is the car park and the toilets etc. definitely a worthy excursion to get all the views and vibes in, rather than parachuting in and out of location to location via helicopter, etc. oh, and you can see the witch's finger from the car park on a clear day if you don't have time for both trails.

this was a fantastic company to deal with. over the 4 day tour everything was exactly as we asked for, taking into account the specific requests we had for both snorkeling and accommodation. it is a very rural area but the guide made us feel secure the entire time. i highly recommend raja ampat, but i would not return without raja ampat biz.
this was a fantastic experience! andy skipper was very helpful, kind and patient with all his passengers. he made us all feel at ease and was very skillful handling the speedboat.

this was a fantastic museum nestled just off of the víkurgarður square. really cool to see the excavation site and explanations around what the site would have looked like. the rest of the museum was also really interesting talking about the development of reykjavík and iceland. i also appreciated getting to learn about the more recent history as far as how like ww2 impacted/accelerated development. the little shop and house interior recreation was neat as well. you can also pick up reykjavik city cards at the front desk here! definitely recommend if you’re hitting a bunch of museums/galleries during your stay.

this was a fantastic tour! elizabeth was our guide and she was so knowledgeable and we really enjoyed her! we stopped at all the hotspots and saw so much hydrothermal activity! she perfectly planned our old faithful experience and we had the best lunch along the lake. the wildlife and scenery were an added bonus! she knew exactly where to park to let us have the best experience! i would highly recommend this tour!

this was a fun game. puzzles are not too challenging, but orient you to several features of the kuhio beach area. nice to motivate you to take a pleasant stroll along a beautiful strip of waikiki. try to go on a sunny day!
this was a fun trip to see a unique spot on the island. the liqueur was interesting, but i loved the pineapple sangria. the gift shop had really cute things to purchase all in pineapple theme!

this was a fun trip. we drove over instead of taking the train or the gondola. it gave us more freedoms to have a vehicle. the hike was really good. the trail was really well done and my wife commented on how easy it would have been to have a pram/baby stroller on that hike. good experience!!

this was a good hike with nice views but the path was not clearly marked. once you enter from the parking lot, after walking about a kilometre, you would reach a bench. you can find hidden path around these benches. there are no obvious starting point marked here.

this was a good visit. the views were spectacular and the ride up was fun. the whole setting is good. different foods and dessert along with drinks and souvenir shops. they had a party in the night and the vibe was really good. there is a nature trail and it was beautiful. the reataurant is so so but fine.
this was a great area to walk around to see the walls of this beautiful city! definitely worth the time to just enjoy the history.

this was a great evening activity, hosted by a lovely family who are very passionate about organic rice farming and preservation. they were very knowledgeable about the fireflies, assisting us with plenty of videos and food/beverages. we were able to explore the grounds and spend as much time as we liked watching the fireflies. thank you for having us, and looking forward to coming back one day (to see the population increase).
this was a great evening cruise. the jazz band was nice and the mississippi provided a very tranquil and romantic experience.

this was a great experience, jorge was a great guide, patient and concerned with safety. this isn’t true rappelling, but you have two layers of safety on the descent as you climb down the ladders into the bottom of the cave. as you go the steepness increases until it is vertical, this gives you time to acclimate to the equipment if you aren’t a climber. the cave is amazing and huge and was only discovered 12 years ago by the rancher who owns the land. great views of the south side of the island (even on a cloudy day, which is the norm in june) as you tour the area before descending.
this was a great experience, we went during songkran and it just felt even more special

this was a great experience. the diver stays with you for the whole time you are underwater. we saw many fish closeups and even a turtle. the whole process was very efficient and professional, they do take video and photos you can purchase at the end so you don't need to worry about taking your own.

this was a great jungle/rainforest experience. the flowers and varied vegetation were fascinating. we saw some small lizards, a few birds, squirrels, and friends 10 minutes behind us saw two groups of different types of monkeys quarreling over a tree. the area is very well maintained. the path, however, is inherently uneven and has elevation changes, some a little steep - it's not super difficult, but it is not a casual walk. there are several places all along the way to take a shortcut to the exit though if it gets to be too much. the bridges are rather thrilling. they're safe, but visually very open - the sides are chain link, and the 'floor' is metal grates. they flex a bit and bounce and sway as people walk. it's fun, a bit scary, and a touch hard to keep balance sometimes (a hand on the side rail takes care of this). well worth the visit and one of my favorite activities in la fortuna.

this was a great mountain biking trail. to hit the dead man's pass trail it's a rather rocky uphill but worth it ! you get to ride along a narrow trail along the mountain - it was quiet and included breathtaking views! make sure you bring enough water because there's no stops with water as far as i could tell.
this was a great place to snorkeling. however, there were not many fishes to see.

this was a great spot to visit while in san francisco. we had seen the videos online of the friendly stingrays and it was one of the major draws. great for families and aquarium enthusiasts like myself! the staff were lovely, the aquarium was relaxing, and it offered great educational opportunities on the local wildlife. special mention goes to the river otters and the stingrays they keep there. the otters were actually asleep when we first encountered them but ten minutes later they sprung awake. be sure to stop in if you can!

this was a great tour! first time going snorkeling! the crew was phenomenal and they should get raise. kept everyone safe and 10 feet away from.the turtles. aloha!😊

this was a great trip. we have only ever snorkeled off a beach many years ago. the captain and crew were very knowledgeable about the turtles and where they would be. being an older couple the crew were very kind to help my wife back on the boat and checked back on how my wife was doing. we can recommend this tour to everyone who wants to see turtles and fish.

this was a great visit. came in to get a free tour of the history of the famous sazerac cocktail, and ended up being pleasantly surprised beyond our expectations. effective concept of a combination of guided and self guided tour. interesting displays on the historical background of cocktails, and sazerac products. and then professional bartenders would give you a sample of different drinks at different locations of the tour-very interesting and tasty. the tour finishes at the gift shop and liquor store. i really liked the easy carry gift box which contained the three things you need to make your own sazerac cocktail. outstanding! friendly, knowledgeable staff!

this was a great way to get out of the heat of the day. also the experience was worth the price of admission. what we really liked was the vr experience. in fact, the entire museum had free wifi and a video guide for each of the models. another point of interest was when the lights in the room would dim and the lights of the models would turn on. if you are in athens this is a good place to spend a few hours.

this was a great way to see parts of denali that are not accessible by car. we chose the afternoon tour and was picked to take the 1:30 bus. wanted to get a later bus as wildlife is more active in the am and evening but we still saw a male moose, caribou and dall sheep. only wished you could pick a specific leave time but understand the need to fill all the buses before sending out another to reduce effects on the environment. be aware the sheep were high on the mountain and looked like little dots in the binoculars. we heard other tours saw a bear but we did not. the scenery is amazing nonetheless. our tour guide kevin has been doing these tours for about ten years and could answer all the questions about the area. the snack boxes had a variety of trail mixes, chips, granola bars and brownie bites. we are before going on the bus so this was a nice snack to hold us over. i was reimbursed the park entrance fees due to having park pass and the process was super easy! i recommend this to anyone who wants to see more of the park.

this was a great way to see so many buildings in paris. i would recommend evening into night so you can really see the city of lights. our guide spoke fluent english. he was delightful as well as knowledgeable about all the sites. you get to see so many things including my favorite effel tower. they supply blanket if you are cold. i had a heavy scarf and fingerless gloves which was all i needed. they also gave a special treat which was unexpected.

this was a highlight of our barcelona visit, such a friendly family company. we stuffed up our arrival and they were so sympathetic and accommodating, thank you faith. once onboard, bliss!!!! captain ricardo and crew sima were so engaging, informative and fun. a dip in the ocean 2kms out is a 'must do'

this was a little silly. first, you have to park in a parking lot so the “hike” is primarily just a road that only locals are allowed to drive on. (this part is of course fine.) second, you bareeeeeeely get much closer to the trollkonufingur. if you have time to spare and blow, not a bad one. maybe 30 mins total.

this was a long time goal to raft the colorado. not a big ww guy, but love it. couldn't do the 2 day overnight for multiple reasons. booking was easy online, asking questions before hand were impossible through the call center. call the wualipia resort front desk directly and have them transfer. now to the trip. the bus rides are brutal, but that's just part of it. driver did the best he could and pointed out historical places. the river was running normal about a ft low. the rapids were to great, maybe a little less than class for the water level. i had never power whitewater'd. it was different, but i kind of liked it. you do cover 58.5 miles and half is a slow float. the scenery was as expected, absolutely amazing. we saw a number of birds and longhorns. i loved the hike, climb to the waterfall. if you are physically able do this! all this would have been worth the price. i can't speak for the other 2 boats (they all seemed happy), our guide kyle was great. who knew every curve, sandbar and every rapid and really dug into them, all of them. he was extremely knowledgeable of the history of the canyon and the geological key points. kyle knew the wualipai. during the trip he told us he was apache, brother tribe from other side of the grand canyon. told us he did not grow up a river runner and only started about 2 years ago. i would not have believe it had he not told us. kyle made the trip so much better than it already was. thanks to all the support and staff it took to give us a great day.

this was a lovely surprise. we were told about davies creek and falls by a local in town. the drive out is on a dirt road so take it easy. we passed the camping area and just before the falls was a nice spot for our picnic. swimming here was awesome. some people chose to park here and walk up to the falls which seemed to have a bigger swimming hole. this would be a better idea than driving up to the falls. we did drive up, but then hubby said it was a steep climb down and back up again with a lot of steps. i was glad to sit in the car and do my code cracker puzzles. don't bother visiting granite gorge as they now charge $15 per person. visit here instead.

this was a mesmerizing palace with a lot of history and views. it costs about 3000 krw to enter, however, if you rent hanbok(about 18000 krw for 2 hours) you get a cool fit and get to skip the line even though it isn’t that long. there isnt many cool places on a hot day so check the weather when coming. overall pretty cool.

this was a mixed experience for me, so let me explain. i had an overall fun experience despite the shortcomings of this place. but let me explain why i say mixed. we had a young family in our group with a daughter roughly aged 11. she became hesitant to go down the first run and eventually refused. this was actually not the problem, but a symptom. the course is not very well designed for first-timers. in many other courses i have visited, there is a warm-up run which is very short near the base. this gives participants a chance to gain trust in their gear by understanding how it feels to use it in it in a low danger way. unfortunately, this course has no such thing. instead, the first run is relatively intimidating. the platform space is high and simply way too small for a party of 9 people plus 2 guides. there is no railing and nowhere obvious to grip, so everybody is rightly aftaid of slipping off the edge. you wouldn't die if this happened because you are harnessed into the cables, but the lead length is long. if you slipped, you could suffer a nasty scrape and potentially a broken bone by the contact with the wooden edge. so i guess i am trying to say i totally see where this young girls fear came from. this was a design problem, not her problem. for some people, this won't be an issue, and my experience was good despite the shaky start. but i have experienced many better course designs. the views were nice and the weather was great during our visit. we had one guide i loved and one that was not my favorite, so mixed there as well.

this was a must do in interlaken. we went during the high season so it was fairly busy, but we got up and back in only 2 - 3 hours including eating at their restaurant up top. amazing view of interlaken and the lakes. the majestic jungfrau peaks off in the distance. if it is good weather, the view is hard to beat from up there. musicians were playing traditional style music live. we ate the raclette and the fondue. i preferred the raclette but both were delicious. pricey, but not ridiculous for switzerland.

this was a must on our to do list this time in cuba. as we had no time on our last visit we were thrilled to get here this time. our guide jo was excellent. as a graduate in history you could tell he had a passion for his country. by the time we arrived we already felt we had become part of that history. the place did not lose any of our expectations. although looking a little tired and needing a bit of tlc it was quite wonderous. you could almost feel his presence. we were given 30 minutes to view everything which was probably not enough as it became more of a photo session and not enough to take in the atmosphere. all in all a great adventure

this was a nice place to stop and is only about 30ish to the main lodge. beautiful geyser fields with boardwalks. plenty of "satellite toilets" and parking. there are rangers at this location who talk about the different geysers. there is a gift shop here with lots of fun souvenirs. be sure to wear a hat or bring a umbrella as the geysers are in the wide open sun.

this was a nice place to stop in at for a bit while seeing the sites around the harbor. there are a few exhibits in the building along with the living art museum. building itself is worth a stop in, lots of light, open spaces, beautiful lines and views. and art! stop in, cool place!
this was a nice stop between view points. had some interesting formations. would recommend for a quick stop from either way since there’s not much else for another 5-10 minutes in each direction.

this was a once in a lifetime experience at the kempinski. the service was incredible. every single person from the second you step foot on property was so accommodating and friendly- wanting to go the extra mile to make our stay unforgettable (shoutout to: linet, kelvin, hezron, dominic, leakey, erick and paul who made our stay extra nice). the game drives were truly the highlight. duncan was an incredible guide from the second he picked us up- knowledgeable, kind, and funny- he made our time absolutely worth every penny. he is maasai himself and grew up in the nearby town- he knows this area like the back of his hand. he not only could tell you everything you needed to know about the animals but his love of the animals shone through as he would playfully tease the hyenas with us or when he was equally as excited as we were when we got to see a leopard- named akira. duncan spent so much time calling other guides and gates just so he could get a better sense of where orsupat (the main lion) would be so we could catch him before we left. he was of course successful leaving us with an unforgettable encounter. on our very last drive, we were already extremely satisfied, but as we were driving back duncan noticed that all of the herbivores in the area were staring at this bush- meaning there must be something there. of course we went to go explore and found a big pride of lions in the bush! his care and thoughtfulness was beyond. thank you to the entire kempinski team for making our stay so memorable.

this was a once in a lifetime unforgettable experience. the guiding was top notch. we were well cared for by the crew. meals were excellent! camp was pristine yet basic. we felt that every basic need was well covered including safety. horses are excellent and best for experienced riders. our group formed a tight bond molded by shared adventure. this trip is for well seasoned adventurers who are adaptable to circumstances, good team players, can pack light but right, and advanced horsemen and horsewomen. if you are, go for it! you’ll have no regrets. i was fortunate that my fellow travelers were all those things.

this was a perfect hiking experience, with a thoughtful guide and a friendly trekking team. the food and campsite were top-notch, and at night we enjoyed a cozy campfire for chatting. the well-organized itinerary allowed us to witness the most stunning sunrise view of mount agung. the only tour company i would recommend for mount agung!

this was a pleasant and relaxing trip. there was plenty of excitement on the trip. this is a great side trip from mexico city and i would recommend a boat ride of 2 to 3 hours. if you want to do a lot of drinking, then you can make it longer. but if you're just cruising for a relaxing trip, 2 hours would be the best. you can also take your own food and beverages. we took the boat ride on the weekday, i'm sure it's more crowded on the weekend and if you can, the weekday would be the best.

this was a real highlight of our stay. the staff are so helpful and pleasant, the rooms are lovely, and the bucket showers warm! it was a real highlight having zebras and giraffes wander near to our camp. i have some food allergies and was worried about being so remote, the chef alex was so thorough and explained every single dish to me and kept me safe and well fed. thank you!

this was a really nice camp at first glance with a great location and attentive staff. however, the food safety was unacceptable. 4 out of 5 people in our family got very bad food poisoning on our first night, which is the last thing you want when spending so much money to sit in a jeep where bathrooms are rare. we ended up at a local hospital for two of our kids. those of us that got sick were vomiting and had diarrhea. it took the adults a week to get back to normal and our kids two weeks. to drive home the fact that their food sanitation practices were unacceptable, the sliced watermelon served for dinner on our second night tasted like onions. there were other dishes with onions so they likely didn't clean utensils, cutting boards or serving dishes between uses. our entire vacation was ruined due to their poor food safety and all we got from them was a "it is probably just the weather." to add insult to injury, the shower leaked onto the the bathroom floor creating a huge pool of water so we got to wade through that while on our way to vomit in the toilet.

this was a seminal life experience. the resort has curated an exceptionally thoughtful, beautiful and finely wrought encounter with an element of nature unlike any other. our dining experience was just as exceptional as the waters, and the service was attentive to dietary restrictions and any other stated preferences. the food was delicious with excellent variety of options flawlessly prepared. i simply cannot recommend tabacon in terms strong enough. it is a moment in time i will always cherish.

this was a spectacular hotel in a fabulous location. the service was everything you expect from a ritz. the food was wonderful. the room was great. the couch was so awesome. we are still trying to figure out how to replicate it, build it, or buy it. would not hesitate to return to this property on your next visit to the magnificent island nation. extra points for having a really great pool as well. we had a perfect view of the entire city from our room, including a panoramic shot of the marina bay complex. we also especially like the dale chihuly sculptures.
this was a stop during our cairo tour. there were drinks, great music, and great photos.

this was an amazing adventure. i highly recommend this for everyone who's traveling in the area of seward alaska. our group went out on the boat to experience the glacier. what we experienced was not only an amazing glacier but other wildlife including whales, seagulls seals. this was an amazing experience and i highly recommend this for everyone. the photos don't do the area justice as it is the most beautiful area i've seen in alaska. you're definitely immersed into the sea with nature.

this was an amazing area to look out at the natural landscape. there were two goats on the side of a steep incline and it was wonderful weather that contributed to the majestic area. it was an easy walk to the look out area, and had a great view. this is an epic stop along the ice fields parkway.
this was an amazing day! everything was super well planned and flexible at the same. the subwing was like flying underwater. can't wait to do it again!

this was an amazing experience i did the snorkelling and it was so much fun. the staff are very friendly and there’s even free food and drink on the boat. you get snorkelling gear to view the fish and turtles, as well as we saw a sea cucumber and star fish. additionally it was very well priced and worth it. i would recommend anyone on a vacation in hawaii to come check out this place it is my favourite activity i’ve done here!

this was an amazing experience! hands down my favorite thing i’ve done in sedona. the staff was super nice and helpful. the atv was just what we needed and being able to play our music through bluetooth added to the experience. seriously so much fun and already wanting to do it again.

this was an amazing experience! i got a package that included a body scrub, massage, and facial. the specialist was polite & very very good!! my skin was left so smooth and all the products they used smelled very good. one of the best spa experiences i have ever had. i arrived 30 minutes early to my appointment and they saw me within 10 minutes, even though i was completely okay with waiting until my appointment.

this was an amazing experience! the cocktails (and mocktails for people who can't drink!) were delicious. what i really enjoyed most though was the entire performance: i loved how the actors ran with the comments the participants made and created such an amazing experience. definitely would do it again

this was an amazing experience, definitely book this if you have the chance. the huskies are very friendly and playful and they enjoy running. you will see they can't wait to start running, they're very joyful. the actual duration of the safari is approximately 3-4 hours (including transport, change to/from winter clothes, the instructions and safety guide, husky ride - which is 30 minutes give or take, saying hello and thank you to the pups, the presentation and warm drinks and biscuits after)

this was an amazing experience. the crew guy was so friendly and funny. he had us laughing the whole time. the captain was a great driver and navigated the rough water well. my son and i went together and it was so beautiful and peaceful. the dip in the water was fun and i would definitely recommend this company. i felt safe the entire time and they are very efficient getting people up. i also loved that they took so many pictures for us. they took 120 pictures and loaded them on my phone immediately after we got back. the pictures were a bit pricey. however i'm happy that they took pictures for us.

this was an amazing temple. probably my second favourite of the two tours we did. it ended up bucketing down with rain during our visit but it was the last one of our tour. this meant there was no one there and we could explore in peace and quiet. we also saw a frog on our adventures. definitely set aside at least an hour to fully explore this temple.

this was an authentic local market. great experience for a tourist or visitor that have not experience the traditional wet asian markets. not that i could buy a fresh duck to cook that night... but i still managed to get a nice local shirt (top) at one of the garment stores as a souvenir. totally impressed with it! you can really buy anything here!

this was an awesome and unique experience. we went out for the 9am tour. after check in you board their boat, we 5 in our party and there were another 12 or so people on the boat. you go out into the ocean approximatey 1/2 mile to a turtle breeding ground. they can accomodate up to 5 people at one time in the water if your not using the scooter your free to snorkel around the boat. the current was very strong and made it hard to snorkel but there was plenty of marine life to look at. once it was our turn to use the scooters the staff was very helpful and showed us what to do. the scooter was pretty awesome as you do not need any experience but it allows you to get up close and personal. we saw tons of fish and turtles one even swam about 6 inches away from my son and his eyes about popped out of his head. all in all a great experience and i highly recommend it.

this was an awesome experience. i bought the ticket at the station, and i found the train to be cheaper than the taxi out at the entrance. i took the train up to the statue, and then we climbed a few stairs. let me tell you, if you are not fit, you are going to feel the burn in your thighs. once at the top, it is a beautiful site, and it is worth the burn 😁. there is even a small chapel at the base of the state, which is cool. once there, you will see a view of the rest of rio.

this was an awesome experience. we choose the premium package which included swimming with dolphins, aquarium trek, and the dolphin show. we didn't stay for the dolphin show since we went so early in the day. we arrived around 11am. a line started forming right after that. you can book online or at the door. i highly suggest everyone to try this if they haven't. this was one of our favorite activities while on vacation. as i always say don't take my word for it. try it for yourself. happy vacationing!!

this was an awesome hike, but every hike in banff was awesome. this hike took about 11 hours but i did have lunch when i got to the top. the beginning of the trail was a little hard to find... but it's right across hole one. take your bear spray!

this was an awesome spot to hang out in berlin. a gastronomy experience for fans of street food vendors. it's definitely worth a visit if you are in berlin sightseeing. a highlight was schöner trinken wine bar. the tacos and samosas were delicious too!😋

this was an awesome spot to visit in the park! it is one of the most famous attractions for a reason. the geyser itself is cool, but not so impressive after we saw the steamboat geyser erupt, but for the reliability of this one is impressive! there was a visitor center with incredibly knowledgeable rangers to help with questions. they gave us a map and some amazing recommendations for things in the area. this location also has one of the best general stores in the park. tons of selection, and very reasonable prices unless you’re buying cafeteria food. the boardwalk trail to morning glory is just as mesmerizing as old faithful itself. the anemone geysers were so cool, and there is a beautiful river running through the area. i would definitely budget a few hours here, so much more to see than we thought. a real highlight of our trip!

this was an awesome tour. my kids and i just loved it. this was my kids first time snorkeling and the staff were great! we sat at top of the boat in bean bag type chairs and that was wonderful. this tour is family owned and they do a great job and very knowledgeable. highly recommend.
this was an excellent experience! jet ski here next time you’re in santorini (if you’re as lucky as we were today)!

this was an excellent first liveaboard experience! i did the 7 day central route and every dive site was just incredible!! the maldives has spoilt me for diving forever and so has this liveaboard experience! the staff was all nothing less than incredible!! i cant recommend thos trip enough.

this was an exceptional experience for me who was a first timer. tyler and mahea were prompt in picking us up at the nearby station to our hotel. from there, tyler gave us a great overview of what to expect, additional photo packages, and supplies. there was a smaller group today, which suited us as brandon and kainoa were able to quickly issue guidance, vests, and expectations for both us and them. once underway, brandon performed admirably as a guide. he ensured to point out areas of cultural significance, as well as more contemporary landmarks. we did see dolphins and turtles today (thanks cpt zach for your connections!) once at the snorkeling spot, we were able to quickly disembark and get started. silas got the slide up very quickly and tyler took numerous, outstanding photos. all that to say, i will definitely look at using this company again in a return trip! the professionalism and friendliness made this an unforgettable trip!

this was an exceptional experience!! best of the best! miguel and rita are professional biologists that are so knowledgeable and made the trip very memorable and fun for our whole family! we saw hundreds of dolphins and two different whale species- memories that we will cherish for a lifetime! you have to do this in sao jorge - enjoy!!

this was an exceptional experience, especially spending time with the giant tortoises. the guide, who is also a scientist, made it all the more fascinating. the tour was translated by a very friendly interpreter, making it accessible and enjoyable. it felt more like a journey of discovery than just an ordinary tour. i highly recommend visiting this place!

this was an extraordinary experience. we had a traditional hamam followed by a serenity massage and it was pure bliss. we came out feeling reborn. the staff were so talented, friendly and attentive. perfect experience in marrakesh.

this was an incredible day out with shay and ksena, one which i would highly recommend!! there are many rides to choose from for all levels of experience. the atmosphere was relaxed and friendly, a family business and shay self admits that he just loves riding. the gear was all in fantastic condition and well maintained and while the company on the ride was brilliant, the views were simply epic!! i'd do another ride with this team in a heartbeat next time i'm in town. thanks shay and ksena for a great day out!!

this was an incredible experience! they run a totally smooth, fun, and professional service, from pickup to the actual rafting to getting off the river. the rafting itself was a blast. plenty of rapids! our guide - nate - was a total pro; funny, experienced, and informative. highly highly recommend doing this.

this was an incredible experience, and so much more than a tour. as a solo female traveler safety and comfort are top priorities for me. habis and his family take care of you with sincere hospitality. from before i arrived, habis was making sure i was safe. he offered inexpensive travel options to and from wadi rum for me, and went the extra mile to make sure i was comfortable when i arrived. the accommodations were top notch, in a beautiful corner of the desert. the food they prepared was tasty, with vegetarian options. the tour was spectacular - the guides took me to the most famous places at times of the day that were less busy, and also took me to places that are off the beaten trail. they offered so many wonderful stories of their lives growing up here, and plenty of sayings and jokes that i’ll never forget. the whole time i felt safe and taken care of. wadi rum stillness embodies the saying, “come as a guest, leave as a friend.”

this was an incredible experience. the staff were so helpful and supportive! they followed you and took pictures along the whole tour and half way through there was a drink station with local sodas being made. probably one of the coolest tours we have done while on vacation! the hike after zip lining was also very beautiful! we opted to have someone pick us up and drop us off and that was a pleasant experience too. if you can don’t include lunch in the repurchase. it’s limited on what you can order, the full menu at the restaurant is much better and the same prices or less. and if you pre order the lunch portion and you want to have a cocktail you have to pay additional and they don’t subtract what you already paid for drinks. well worth it.

this was an incredible hike! we arrived at the trail head first thing in the morning around 8a and we were the first people there, there was a good amount of parking available. starting in the gravely fields you would not think a couple hours later you’d be climbing up to those viewpoints. you see a nice variety of the endemic plants throughout the hike, the views are unparalleled, it’s a must if you’re looking for a hike on terceira. a nice pretty well marked loop, we followed a trail map on alltrails, cell service the whole time as well so no worries.

this was an incredibly special experience. we started with a trip to the local markets to see all of the amazing fresh produce and learn about the food we would cook. when we got to the venue there was a traditional cambodian wedding taking place and we were invited to meet the bride and groom and their families. they were very generous and welcoming and the wedding was beautiful. we then spent the morning cooking some traditional wood fired changkran stove. our teacher tuy was very knowledgeable, kind, helpful and patient with us. for the level of the experience, i would expect to pay 3x what this cost in australia. don't hesitate to book.

this was an interesting place to visit. i have a feeling we didn't really explore the expanse of it. it was nice to see some chaaggaa (one of the tribes in tanzania) artefacts. there were quite a bit of nice sculptures and it was calming to behold the water fall. not very big but nice all the same. would not mind visiting again to go through the cave passage. bring good shoes, the moss on the path makes it awfully slippery. bring a camera!

this was an overall wonderful experience! they were so caring and considerate (it was chilly out and they gave me a jacket to wear). they stopped at certain places i found interesting and were very accommodating and genuine throughout the entire experience! i suggest to book a tour with them today, you won’t be disappointed!

this was an unexpected gem during my visit to mexico city. the museum itself is pretty small, so you don’t need to plan much time here. but the architecture of the buildings, as well as the garden grounds where much of the art is housed, were both beautiful. it’s nice to stroll outside while enjoying the sculptures.

this was an unforgettable adventure! amazing experience, friendly quide, wonderful wadi rum landscape, great food. we slept in a bedouin cave under the stars and i will remember that feeling of freedom and happiness for a long time!
this was an unforgettable safari. thanks to all the lovely people who introduced us to their beautiful delta so pleasantly and with so much knowledge

this was another great hike. there were some hills, and some uneven ground, but overall it was low on the level of difficulty. everyone in our group, including our older members, we're able to do this hike. when we got to the beach, there were plenty of animals to see. i recommend for the animals, including the birds. and the hike.

this was awesome! especially worth it after 6pm when they turn the lights on as for us it made it more special and gave us more photo opportunities. they have a lot of different sections that you can explore and walk around in.

this was beautiful and a lot more fun than we thought it would be for a gondola ride and a luge ride, especially since i'd never done a summer luge before. the gondola was really well run, easy to get on and off, and the staff were very accommodating for those of us who were slower. the breakfast buffet was *amazing*. the chef behind the breakfast bar was making these astonishing fried eggs, and there was actually black pudding along with most of the rest of a great british style-breakfast. lots of fruit, including the local canned plums, and all one might want for breakfast. the luge was super safe, actually. i loved that if you accidentally let go of the handlebar it would automatically brake you to a standstill. the courses were clean and clear and easy to follow, the higher ranked courses had good banking, the easy one didn't have any banks, but i suspect they assumed you weren't going to be going that fast anyway and it brought me through some beautiful forest spaces there. it was fun to see the wildlife that had come to exist there as the people were pretty much stuck to the courses but the wildlife were content to just be clear of the tracks. we also found a nature walk, that had quite a few detailed signs for the kinds of wildlife, plant life, and features one should be able to see in the area. that was more fun than i thought it would be and the walking trail is actually quite a good distance and up a good grade.

this was by far my favorite excursion we did in chile. we booked our half day trip with lynn expecting just a classic horse trail ride. boy, were we wrong. the entire day was one big spiritual journey. we were taught how to connect and bond with the horses and learn from them. lynn was so kind patient and knowledgeable about not only the horses but patagonia in general. she made the experience so unique and special. if you’re looking for a horseback riding experience, look no further. you have hit gold with this one!!!!

this was by far the best thing we did in our 2+week long tour through the south. the airboat was a lot smoother than i expected & they provided heading protection. the swamp was so beautiful and calm- just incredible! our guide bobby was fantastic. if you’re in the nola area and want to see the swamps-go here! also highly recommend you grab one of the gator bite drinks -flavorful & refreshing.

this was by far the most incredible camp we visited during our safari—truly unforgettable. we’re already planning to come back. manager eric was exceptionally welcoming and accommodating, and we were so fortunate to have amos as our driver and guide. he was not only kind but incredibly knowledgeable, enriching every game drive with fascinating insights. we saw an abundance of wildlife, and every detail of the camp—from the service to the accommodations—was pure luxury. couldn’t recommend it more highly!

this was by far the worst hotel experience i have had in the past few years. we are very looking forward to spending time at this hotel with our whole family. but the hotel was overcrowded everywhere – from the lobby to the restaurants – making it feel chaotic rather than relaxing. service was extremely poor. nobody helped with luggage, when the room was cleaned it was always around late afternoon around 3pm-4pm. the room itself was very old, with a tiny bathroom and a low ceiling. the bathtub was partially blocked, and despite informing the front desk multiple times, nobody came to fix it. communication was another huge issue. hardly anyone, including the front desk staff, spoke proper english. every question had to be answered via a translator app, which made even simple requests frustrating. there were many activities, including welcome drinks, that seemed to be for japanese guests only, as all information was in japanese with no english version. if this hotel is designed only for japanese guests and the staff is not trained to communicate in english, they should make that very clear on their website to avoid misleading international travelers. additionally, the hotel was overcrowded all the time. breakfast at some restaurants had a 30-minute wait, and many restaurants required reservations. however, by the time we arrived for our four-day stay, it was impossible to get a reservation at any of them. overall, this was a terrible experience, and i would not recommend this hotel to anyone expecting good service or an international standard of hospitality.

this was definitely an interesting place to visit! but we found that a donation is essentially required, we were not told it was optional, rather we were told "we dont sell tickets , instead we ask for a donation" it was still a very neat place to check out. but it is also self guided!

this was definitely one of my favourite hikes i did from my week on the island. we were there in june, and barely encountered any other people on the hike. the sign states that it takes 2 hours but we took just over an hour and a half (without stopping to swim in any waterfalls). there is no official parking, just park on the street by the trail sign, and then you can go in either direction. if you turn right (looking at the sign) you'll go into the forest first, and if you turn left, you'll be in the town / out by the ocean first. there are washrooms right by the trail sign.

this was exactly what we wanted and hoped for. their team was very friendly and helpful, the vibe was pretty laid back. it took about half an hour to see the ruins and get out to the reef. once we got out to the reef, the experience was amazing. we saw a lot of beautiful fish, we swam above a sea turtle for a couple minutes, and someone from our group saw a big stingray. we loved it and we highly recommend this company!

this was great fun to do. i went during the day it wasn't to hard. anyone could do this walk. you can take your time and go at your own pace. the david truebridge art was great but doesn't hold a candle to the amazing redwood giant trees that you are walking thru. the punga tree's look awesome from an aerial view. the staff are friendly and welcoming. great experience also you can go for free bush walks thru the area. so feel free to make a day of it.

this was hands down my favorite museum in paris. i didn’t even have to wait in line to get in—maybe i just got lucky, but it made the experience even better! the highlight was, without a doubt, monet’s water lilies. standing in those oval rooms surrounded by his massive, serene paintings was absolutely breathtaking. the atmosphere was calm, the layout beautifully curated, and the overall experience unforgettable. i 100% recommend visiting—especially if you appreciate impressionist art or just want a peaceful, inspiring break from the city buzz. if you are a student the museum is free.

this was hands down one of the most incredible experiences i have ever had! flying over the grand canyon was absolutely breathtaking and it was made even better by our pilot sarah! she was so professional, friendly, and knowledgeable. the information she provided as we crossed over the landscape helped me appreciate what i was seeing so much more. i highly recommend this tour for anyone in the grand canyon/las vegas area. i will definitely be booking another tour next time i'm in the area!

this was hands down the best thing i did in rio! marcos is amazing—super professional, kind, and fun—and dudu was also fantastic. from takeoff to landing, everything was perfect, and the views were absolutely unreal. i felt completely safe the whole time and had the time of my life! if you’re thinking about it, just do it—and make sure to get the 360° and side cameras. totally worth it for the incredible footage! huge thank you to marcos and dudu for an unforgettable experience. i’d do it again in a heartbeat!

this was honestly one of the best trips my family has ever taken. everything was well organized and comfortable. the crew was very patient and hospitable and everything we did on the trip was enjoyable. from the boat to the dolphin viewing to the food and the personalized attention, i highly recommend this company and will personally return for another adventure with them. we hired a private boat just for the family and preferred that a lot more than doing a public boat with strangers.

this was included in our valle de luna ticket. we arrived about 40 min before sunset and it appeared so did every tour bus in town. easy to park. a vast area to view the sunset. was much more rambunctious than i like my relaxing sunsets and would chose one of the many other areas around spa if you are self driving as most are free to go to and you will see people scattered around the area looking for the best view. staff was nice.

this was included within the dubrovnik pass otherwise i would probably not seek it out to visit. it's quite small, one long room, however the maritime museum in split is actually far superior. whilst there is plenty of information to read about dubrovnik's seafaring past, there aren't that many physical exhibits. a number of items are displayed recovered from shipwrecks under the sea. i did like the collection of old atlases and interesting to see the trade routes used for different commodities. visit if you have a three or seven day dubrovnik pass as it's included.

this was incredible and a must see if you have the opportunity while in vienna. the venue is stunning and really sets the scene for the expertly played music you'll hear. the choice of music really complemented the setting, and the quartet were amazing.
this was literally the greatest thing i’ve ever done. we were a little worried about safety, but it’s probably safer than walking on the streets of rio (you probably know what i mean!)

this was my absolute first time being adventurous. i was so afraid but max ensured me that it was water patrol at all times. he ensured me correctly! i felt so secure and safe the entire time. this was the absolute perfect key skill rental 10/10.

this was my favorite view spot of both old town and lesser town. i think you get a good view of the charles bridge from the lower platform, and you ah e great views of castle and other lesser town sections from the top. i also thought you had a more panaramic view of old town than from the other towers on old town side other maybe than the astronomical tower associated with klemnetinum

this was my favourite area visiting petra. a quiet, shady temple off the beaten track with few other visitors. you can see the old cistern and living green wall. wonderful place to pause whilst having a break.

this was my favourite place after exploring tokyo for 6 days. it was so peaceful, i felt relaxed. the park was built hundreds of years ago and has some interesting history tied to it. there is a small set of stairs by the lake where you can sit beside the water beside the carps, i really enjoyed that.

this was my first experience of kitesurfing. i was delighted! kristina is a top professional: all stages of training were analyzed in the most detailed and accessible way. clear instructions, attention to detail and an individual approach helped to quickly master basic skills and feel confident on the water. i was especially impressed by the concern for safety - kristina controlled the process, corrected the technique and patiently answered all questions. thanks to her support, even beginners like me will be able to enjoy riding without unnecessary stress. i recommend everyone who wants to learn kitesurfing, regardless of the level, to trust kristina with such a reliable mentor, no gusts of wind are scary! kristina, thank you very much for a great experience! thanks to you, i found my new hobby ☺️ 🌊🪁

this was my first experience paragliding and to say i was extremely thrilled with it would be an understatement! any nerves i had melted away when i knew i was in great hands with my experienced pilot. brendon was absolutely amazing! this is for sure an experience i will never forget. the views are simply breathtaking. so happy i was able to check this off my bucket list with paragliding interlaken. highly recommend!

this was my first experience paragliding and to say i was extremely thrilled with it would be an understatement! any nerves i had melted away when i knew i was in great hands with my experienced pilot. brendon was absolutely amazing! this is for sure an experience i will never forget. the views are simply breathtaking. so happy i was able to check this off my bucket list with paragliding interlaken. highly recommend!

this was my first helicopter ride ever, and going into it i was a bit hesitant and scared. but i ended up feeling completely safe the entire time and i would attribute that to the excellence of this company and particularly our pilot. they explain everything really clearly in terms of safety and rules, and the ride is just really cool. we had raphael as our pilot, and he was kind and helpful with getting in/out of the plane and telling us fun facts along the way. the people who helped outside of the plane as well were all helpful and patient with anyone who needed extra assistance. all of the staff checked in routinely to make sure we were hydrated, safe, feeling good, etc… the view was breathtaking and incredible on all fronts. i 100% recommend this company to anyone planning on visiting the grand canyon!! i would honestly come back just for this, and request the same pilot again! such a great experience!

this was my first hike up a mountain. bryn, our guide, made the experience a wonderful one. he was knowledgeable and offered a wide variety of information. he explained every step of the way which helped ease my nerves. the views are absolutely spectacular. we began the hike early in the morning and got to see the sunrise over the mountains. it was a breathtaking view. as we climbed higher and higher the views just got better and better. i would recommend cool and comfortable clothing, lots of water, some quick snacks and sunscreen. bryn takes beautiful photographs throughout the trip so you don't even need to really take your own. he even made us a video of the whole experience which will be a lovely keepsake. the descent was trickier than climbing up, in my opinion. to be honest, i wasn't wearing the best shoes for the occasion so i am sure that that played a role in my discomfort. however, the whole trip was a great experience. i thoroughly enjoyed it and am very thankful to bryn for all his patience and guidance.

this was my first hiking experience in a long while. the scenery kept changing throughout our 7 day trip and that was the highlight for me. i didn't look at the map a whole lot so every time we took a trail, there was always something new to discover. this was a great place to find quietness and peace, and the people we came across shared that same energy. i would suggest visiting it one month earlier, the weather is likely to be more stable and warm. though i've heard that there are a lot more people at that time. the wilderness huts were well equipped and they serve a traveller that likes comfort. the mice do enjoy them as well, so always hang your food sources when entering those. i would suggest taking luirojärvi as a goal for the trip. it's the heart of the park for wanderers. a lot of people recommended visiting sokosti on a clear weather, it's nearby. there is also possibility for sauna and ice cold swimming. i'll be recommending the park to everyone i know who likes to hike a little longer and enjoy silence. i'll be coming back here myself for sure!

this was my first horse riding adventure abroad and it was amazing. the horses are very well trained, surefooted and beautiful. the scenery by the ocean is amazing, and the gallops on the beach were memorable. our guides abdel and mohammed were professional and very knowledgeable, the horses listened to them completely and i learned a lot of new things. over all i feel amazing after this trip and inspired to be a better rider.

this was my first multi-day trek, and i have no words to express how grateful i am for choosing experience jordan adventures. everything was just perfect, and i cannot thank you enough for all the support. a very special thanks to dalia, our guide — what a human being! she is such an amazing person to be around. dalia became a part of this unforgettable moment in my life. she’s simply incredible: attentive, charismatic, and always looking out for us. more than just a guide, she became a friend — a close one. i truly have no words to describe how wonderful she is. i’d also like to highlight aid and his wife, who managed the campsite and supported us with food and care throughout the journey. everything they did was perfect and filled with kindness. and of course, our local guide atalla, who was always kind, patient, and helpful. this entire experience was absolutely wonderful, and i would happily recommend it to all my friends.

this was my first time being picked up from the dubai mall by careem. the instructions in the careem app were clear, and the instructions in the mall itself were even clearer, written on the walls and stairs. i didn’t get lost, but i found out very late that there is a golf cart available to take you across the bridge if you want to. the taxi pick-up area is separate from the careem/limo area, which is less crowded. the waiting area has a vending machine, comfortable chairs, a great mall-view, and a long glass panel to see your driver approaching before they reach you. there is also an outdoor seating area if you prefer. one last thing, please add instructions asking people not to sit directly next to someone when there is plenty of space available, like exactly near me with no space, i faced this 3 times less than 5 minutes, while all the chairs offer a clear view of the glass. kindly include these reminders as most of the visitors are tourists and might not be familiar with local etiquette.

this was my first time here and the wagyu ragu pasta alone was so so good! i started with a $5 glass of veuve (yes, $5) which you can get from 4pm-5pm. gabby was my waitress and she was very kind and attentive. next time i’m in miami, i will definitely be back.

this was my first time paragliding and what an amazing experience it was.wow!! my pilots name was florent and he was awesome.made me feel comfortable and calm since it was my first time and also shared some laughs on the way,so thank you florent.the views of interlaken were also absolutely stunning. would also like extend my thanks to the wider team that were in the van on the way up the mountain.great smiles and service. fa’afetai lava ma ia manuia.☺️

this was my first time paragliding in brazil and i must say the whole process was very well put together and they even offer an uber driver that will pick you up for your flight date so trying to find the place is no issue at all. when you arrive your flight instructor will be there waiting for you and from there they will take you up the mountain where you will be taking off from. this whole experience was very amazing and i definitely would do it again. if you are ever in brazil and want to paraglide don’t hesitate to book with these guys because they will take care of you and make you feel right at home.

this was my first time visiting punta cana, and we booked this excursion through our hotel. the experience included five main activities, each offering something unique. we began with the **buggy ride**, which was advertised as a muddy adventure where you'd come out soaked. however, i barely got any mud on me, which was a bit unexpected—but still enjoyable overall. next, we visited a **local plantation**, which turned out to be one of my favorite parts of the tour. we interacted with guacamayas (macaws), milked cows, fed baby goats, and learned about the production of coconut, coffee, and hot chocolate. as someone who enjoys retaining knowledge, i found this portion both educational and fascinating. afterward, we explored **caves** that were impressively large and home to sleeping bats—a very cool and memorable experience. exiting the caves, we arrived at a **cenote** with freezing cold water. despite the chill, it was a once-in-a-lifetime experience. for those who can't swim, life jackets are provided, so everyone can participate safely. to conclude the tour, we visited **monkeyland**. while i was excited for this part, i was slightly disappointed by how rushed it felt. i had hoped for more time interacting with the monkeys. overall, the experience was excellent and i would highly recommend it to others. one thing to note: professional photos are taken throughout the tour, but they are quite expensive—so be prepared if you plan to purchase them.

this was my first time visiting saatchi gallery. i was pleasantly surprised by the size of it, so much larger than i expected. the exhibition was very good, flowers – flora in contemporary art & culture. many different artists were displayed in large airy galleries, and two of the exhibits were in their own galleries. well worth a visit at £10.

this was my first time visiting the capilano suspension bridge, and it was such an unforgettable experience! i was a little scared at first, but once i got on the bridge, it was absolutely amazing—a true once-in-a-lifetime moment. besides the stunning views, it was also really educational. there were staff sharing fun facts about local wildlife like banana slugs, owls, and eagles, and we also learned about natural processes like erosion. the park has gift shops, ice cream stands, and at the end, you even get a certificate for crossing the bridge! a beautiful mix of adventure, nature, and learning. highly recommend it!

this was my first time visiting the theatre and i had a mostly really positive experience! it was easy to access by foot and well signposted inside. the show itself that i saw (my neighbour totoro) was an easy 10/10 - absolutely fabulous production. i liked the decorations around the theatre to the theme of the show, too! my only niggles would be that the theatre seats were too upright and caused my partner and i backache - we found that we had to keep repositioning ourselves. also, i wish they wouldn’t advertise vegan vanilla ice cream everywhere but never even had a single tub of it on sale that day; this was a disappointment!

this was my first trip to namibia and after some searching around online, i found namibia tours & safaris. they get excellent reviews, and now having dealt with them i can certainly understand why. lucinda, clarens, lesley, and the team provided us five-star customer service from the planning stage, right through to when we were in namibia and then the end of our trip. lucinda took the time to understand us and our travel goals, and promptly answered all our questions. lucinda took the time to put together several options for us to choose from. we ultimately chose a self-driving tour, which gave us the sense of independence and adventure, while ensuring we had the certainty and security of a tour company vehicle and preplanned accommodation and activities. we were met at the airport by clarens who helped us get sim cards and then transported us to our accommodation. lesley met us the next morning and talked us through the details of our trip, even taking the time to show us how to change the tyres on our 4wd vehicle. all the accommodation and activities that lucinda booked for us exceeded our expectations – giving us a little luxury while exploring the stunning landscapes and seeing the interesting wildlife of namibia. lucinda knows all about her beautiful country and everyone at nts is obviously proud of the treasures of namibia and is so enthusiastic about sharing the beauty of this country with others. everything went so smoothly, with no hiccups at all. i cannot overstate how easy it was to deal with this tour company. i highly recommend them to everyone and would not hesitate to use them to book any future trip in southern africa.

this was my first visit to israel. first it is very safe and we did not feel a war. we booked a tour of yafo and it was so beautiful and the skyline of the coastline is incredible. i loved the tour. we may join them for the carmel food tasting tour on friday the guide said friday was the day to go. great tour and thank you

this was my first visit to the national theatre, and prior to this evening i hadn’t realised what a huge, sprawling complex it was! there are several auditoria in one building. i saw nye in the olivier theatre and i was staggered by how big the house was- much bigger than many west end theatres. the production was at scale; massive moving sets and a large cast. very effective lighting and music- the production felt epic in many ways. michael sheen was the star in every sense, although the cast were very solid with a few stand out performances he was in a league of his own. the space itself is great, so well designed. fabulous bookshop on the ground floor with many signed editions available and a beautifully curated selection overall. it was all a little bit on the expensive side, even for london. the upstairs bar led onto a balcony with a stunning view of the thames, london eye etc. after the performance when it was all lit up it was especially beautiful. there’s a lovely terrace with street food, cocktails, tapas etc- many options!- available outside the theatre. i liked that they offered free water and reusable plastic cups too. it’s about a ten minute walk from waterloo. if you haven’t been before it’s a bit disorientating- i had to use my phone maps to get there, and then i still needed to ask a security guard where to go once i was on site. i think next time i’ll have a better idea of where everything is.

this was my first-ever zipline experience, and i couldn’t have chosen a better place than flying ravana zipline in ella! as someone who loves adventure, this was an absolute thrill from start to finish. the moment i took off, i felt an incredible rush of adrenaline as i soared over the lush green landscapes of ella. the breathtaking view of ella rock and the surrounding mountains made this ride even more special. the feeling of gliding through the air, with the cool breeze and stunning scenery all around, was simply unforgettable. the zipline is well-maintained, and the staff ensures all safety measures are in place, making the experience smooth and secure. i highly recommend this to anyone visiting ella, whether you’re an adventure seeker or just looking to try something new. the mix of excitement, natural beauty, and a touch of fear makes it an experience worth having. this was definitely one of the best adventure moments of my life, and i can’t wait to try it again!
