we booked last minute due to issues with another resort and they were very accommodating. great service especially the dive team. rooms small but alright if you are diving most of the day anyways. a few suggestions to make it even better and attract more divers: 1. nitrox for diving- more and more divers use nitrox 2. provide a proper camera room 3. provide a drink package since the drinks are too expensive even non alcoholic. you could save money by not having such big food portions ( very generous and good) 4. provide more drink options or have staff that can mix other drinks off the menu if you have the ingredients 5. we are suggesting that you ask guests to order lunch at breakfast if doing an afternoon dive to help speed up and assist kitchen staff their process at lunch. and do the same thing for when guests are doing night dives . overall we were happy with the resort and these are just suggestions to attract more guests.

we booked last minute with kruger africa and went for the 10h shared safari. we had the most wonderful experience together with our tour guide reinhard. we know it is never guaranteed to see any animal but reinhard made sure we got the best sightings the whole day. giraffes, elephants, lions, cheetah and even a rhino. absolutely incredible. he is so amazingly passionate about his profession, we were sad when the tour was over and would have booked ourselves in for another day if there was time. thank you reinhard.

we booked on get your guide, what an amazing catamaran cruise it was. we got picked up and dropped of few meters from our hotel in fira. the greek barbecue was amazing and a quite a few stops that allowed for dips in the beautiful mediterranean.

we booked on the vip a smaller boat experience and had a superb time led by captain barry. we were spellbound by the myriad of wildlife we saw on the tour including alligators of all sizes , ospreys hunting, raccoon foraging and ,any many fishing birds. this was the highlight of our trip to nola and if you need convincing of going elsewhere i would say don’t - the pick up by brian to coach driver was informative on the way to the swamp and barry showed us so much of the river and the areas impacted by hurricane katrina. an absolute delight and great value for money ! thank you barry and brian

we booked our excursion through aj. he was very helpful and informative about the experience. the day of the excursion came and we didn't really know what to expect but, this trip far exceeded our expectations. we saw dolphins, we snorkled, and got to hang out on the sandbar. i doubt we would have had such wonderful things to say if it weren't for our amazing captain and tour guide, victor. he was the best! if you have a chance to do this excursion..do it and maybe you'll be lucky enough to get victor to guide you!

we booked our river cruise a couple of weeks earlier. we ordered the 5 course meal with wine pairing. the food was michelin star quality and the wine pairings perfect. the staff were incredible and made this an incredible experience. we were allowed to go out to view the sites along the seine river during the service. there are different menu options available. definitely recommending all to try out.

we booked our safari today morning only and we were bit anxious to go for it. but it was just fabulous and awesome - all credit goes to our guide mr. mubashir about the rich culture and local customs. starting from picking us , to dune bashing, to camel ride , bbq, tanura show, fire show - just fantastic. go for it - without a second thought - we are sure to recommend you to everyone who’s travelling to dubai.

we booked our stay through phoenix safari and everything at the mara siria camp was comfortable, clean, delicious, and service oriented. the game drivers are so experienced and knowledgeable on finding and getting you as close to the animals as possible. i loved the open air safari vehicles they were comfortable and allowed you to move about from left to right as the animals crossed the roads. all the staff at the camp were so helpful. the tents themselves were very clean and comfortable. i felt safe and protected while in my room, but still at one with nature. food is absolutely delicious. the made to order breakfast was perfect at the camp but also they packed wonderful meals for us to have out on the road.

we booked the "sea eagle/nature safari" for 2 hours. during the trip, we saw only one sea eagle (not their fault), but the guide didn’t seem to make much effort to look for more wildlife. he didn’t explain what he was doing or where we were going, and he didn’t seem very knowledgeable about the animals. instead, he talked a lot about mountain names and the history of fishing villages. that might be interesting on a cultural tour, but not on a "nature" safari. also, we were back in the harbour after only 1.5 hours. i can’t recommend it.

we booked the 3d2n tour from el nido. everything was very well organized and the food is great!! the 3 chefs on board make the best meals of our trip. also the rest of the crew made us enjoy this tour so much, and the captain and anchor ⚓️ men made us feel safe. we have done a lot of snorkelling at beautiful spots, volleyball and football with the crew on the beaches, live guitar music in the evening and a fire show on the last evening! 🙏👍. thanks team wind! you are great!

we booked the 5 bridges maligne canyon tour. paula was great as a guide, very helpful and explanatory. we even saw a black bear on our tour. paula picked us up from the hotel and made the walk a great experience. would book again

we booked the atv 2-hr tour and it did not disappoint!! maui was an amazing tour guide. he made us feel special and well taken care of, and he knew so much about the local fauna and wildlife in the area. he even made us flowers for our hair, as well as crowns and bracelets from local plants. he was also an incredible photographer and made the experience so much fun by keeping it interactive. we did not just ride atvs. there were stops along the way where he explained the area, shared about the culture, and made us laugh with his jokes. there was a cute food stop where we enjoyed ice cream and drinks. it was lively with music and photo spots.

we booked the aurora snowmobile safari and it was perfect. the staff were very nice but also professional. the tour was good selected and the spot to view the aurora was perfect. we definitely recommend doing this snowmobile safari with lapland safaris.

we booked the class 2-3 balsa river. our guide dider was excellent taking us down safely but still with a lot of adventure and fun drops. we didn’t lose anyone overboard but did manage to rescue someone from another raft. the first half is real whitewater, last half is like a river float. pineapple break in middle is nice. highly recommend.

we booked the copper quay for our spring staff social and had the best afternoon thanks to yan and hannah. they gave us the best welcome on board, making sure we had everything set up whilst also managing to make sure we felt like the boat was very much 'ours' for the two hour trip. can't recommend this enough!

we booked the copper quay for part of our 30th birthday celebration's and we loved it! had an amazing time for the two hours we were there, got to play our own music, bring our own food and drink and just in general have a nice time. would reccomend to anyone for private parties to work functions - it's a lovely few hours on the water (even if the weather doesn't play ball)!! thanks so much to the amazing team who kept us safe and able to enjoy our time on the boat with no worries! :)
we booked the dome access a month in advance and it was well worth it. recommend to get the free audio guide which gives you a guided tour overlooking the city. highly recommend

we booked the elephant half day tour through an app and it was at this reserve. it is pretty close to phuket center. the have a family of elephants with the youngest just 1 year old. our guide explained to us about elephants and how they are raised. we then made a souvenir napkin and then went to feed the elephants. we then walked with them in the forest and took plenty of pictures. finally, we bathed them and had lunch and were taken back to the hotel. it was a pleasant experience overall. my only comment is the high numbers of tourist groups which leaves no rest time for the elephants.

we booked the full day rainforest tour. the communication from our tour guide shalomir was excellent regarding the reservation. the van pickup was on time and our group was 6 persons which was just right. shalomir was very knowledgeable about the rainforest and puerto rico in general. she made the trip fun and relaxing. we took a dip in the river and climbed to the top of the local tower. it was a great tour and highly recommend it.

we booked the full day tour at xtreme buggy and it was the best tropical adventure excursion we’ve taken! our guide was fun and engaging, taking the time to ensure our driving experience was awesome, and that we were involved in all the learning and experiences happening around us. from the roadside stops to swimming on a deserted beach to the delicious food — we enjoyed every single minute. we will not hesitate to book again if we visit the dr again! thanks to the whole team — it was amazing!

we booked the garden pod (maple room) for a party, and the location was great — peaceful, away from the city, and surrounded by nature. the maple room was big enough to fit 5 of us for a 1 night stay and it was beautifully designed, making it a great spot for our gathering. nonetheless, since it's still a container building, the toilet felt abit small. lorraine was amazing from start to finish—she helped us with check-in, sorted out our parking issues, and even prepared the electric grill for us. her warm hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable. highly recommend this place for a unique and serene getaway!

we booked the grand canyon trip with floor landing. our pilot, kane, was wonderful in every respect. safety was his top priority, and kane was a consummate host. everything was smooth and easy - from the booking process to the landing! i highly recommend gc flight - first class organization.

we booked the guide in advance in order to get in. truly iconic. make sure you book early ahead of time. the moment you walk through its grand entrance, you’re surrounded by centuries of masterpieces – from the notorious mona lisa and venus de milo to egyptian mummies and royal french artifacts. lhooq mona lisa try to say it in french real quick. the museum itself is a work of art, with its elegant palace architecture and the striking glass pyramid in the courtyard. it’s massive!! you could spend days exploring and still discover new rooms. my tip: plan your visit, wear comfortable shoes, and focus on a few sections you’re most interested in to avoid feeling overwhelmed. whether you’re an art lover or just a curious traveler, the louvre is an unmissable paris experience. every hallway tells a story, you would learn more if you had the tour guide explaining the history. every priceless piece connects you to a moment in history. the visit, a walkthrough a thousand years of history, made us appreciate the evolution and intelligence of humankind.

we booked the history and culture tour the day before. we got picked up from the hotel in open jeep like transport which was authentic and great fun. because it was open at the sides you got to see everything you past. it was naturally air conditioned too. if you are looking for a luxury coach this is not the mode of transport for you. also if you have back problems you need to rethink as roads in dr are not smooth. the first stop took about an hour to reach. this was a short horse ride . the horses appeared well looked after . we had a stop in a local shop where we tasted mamajuana, local drink. the next stop was 20 minutes la basilica de higuey, interesting architecture. we then briefly walked through a typical dominican market .the next stop was lunch which was local delicious food with drinks. we moved onto a dominician house where a brief talk about the process of chocolate and cocoa making. we got to try samples at different stages of the process. the tour rounded up with a visit to a cigar factory and the beautiful macao beach. our guide franklin spoke many languages and used english on our tour. he was knowledgeable, charasmatic and had a great sense of humour. the company are lucky to have such an excellent guide. our drive sandy also spoke some english and was helpful, friendly and a good driver. we had a fabulous day ❤️. this was a cultural tour with plenty packed in , so visits were short but we felt there was enough time to get an overview. • la basilica de higuey • flea market • anamuya river (optional swimming or walking) • lunch at the restaurant over the anamuya river • dominican style house (learn the process of cocoa and coffee) • cigar factory • macao beach

we booked the kayak adventure and we were incredibly lucky with the weather as it was cool and warm. our guide was passionate about her job and knew many facts and good stops along the trip. we learned about sea urchins whilst looking for edible and non edible seaweed. this was an incredibly fun experience and we highly recommend this company.

we booked the kayak adventure and we were incredibly lucky with the weather as it was cool and warm. our guide was passionate about her job and knew many facts and good stops along the trip. we learned about sea urchins whilst looking for edible and non edible seaweed. this was an incredibly fun experience and we highly recommend this company.
we booked the musical one hour river cruise. it was affordable, great scenery and smaller than most boats so had lots of room. i recommend seeing paris from the water.

we booked the palm discovery tour for my mothers 50th birthday and it was perfect. our captain, zetu, was fantastic and so friendly, showing us all the different buildings and sights to see. we connected our music to a bluetooth speaker, and listening to coldplay as we sailed out of dubai was a memory we will never forget. zetu offered to take lots of photos for us, whilst moving the boat to get the best angle. i would highly recommend this trip to anyone and it’s more than worth the money!

we booked the paper eatery cooking class through klook, and it was easily one of the best experiences of our siem reap trip! chef sinoun was incredibly cheerful, bright, and helpful. she provided a wonderful tour of the local market, explaining all the ingredients, and then guided us through the cooking process. her instructions on cutting and cooking were clear and easy to follow. it was a truly enjoyable and memorable experience, perfect for friends and family. we also appreciated the opportunity to meet and interact with people from various countries. highly recommend!

we booked the parasailing, snorkeling, boat party and sandbar party with another couple. we went up first parasailing and received no instructions at all and the crew spoke no english whatsoever. once in the air i noticed that the equipment was very old and frayed. the ride went fine for us but i was worried about equipment failure the whole time. when our friends went up they only had about 1 minute in the air before the boat suddenly stopped and they ended up in the ocean being dragged by the canopy. we asked what happened and one said something about the winch. luckily a nearby boat was able to come and try to rescue them as they we getting dragged under water. there was a bunch of yelling and confusion as one guy jumped in to save them. instead of cutting the harness off the ended up getting dragged back in every time they tried to pull them into the boat. they finally were able to get free and on the boat but were obviously shaken up as they could have drowned. very unprofessional. they offered no concern or refund. do not book with them

we booked the sauna and stayed after for dinner. i could not recommend it more highly. they have a place to shower after your sauna and provided us with towels. the barrel sauna is beautiful and wood fired making for an excellent experience with access to the beach for cold dips. the restaurant was amazing as well. if it is a clear night in winter this area would also be great for northern lights viewing. our evening sauna/dinner was one of our favorite experiences in lofoten and the area up there was uncrowded (in winter). worth the trip.

we booked the self driving utv tour for the 3 of us. lasted about 2.5 hours and had a great time sight seeing and learning about the history/movies made there. the views were stunning and we had great guides.

we booked the three-region winery tour, thinking, “why settle for one when you can do three?” haha! we did through city sightseeing we started our day early with a pickup from our designated stop. our first stop was at a historic dutch colony, where we grabbed some snacks and tea/coffee. our guide gave us an interesting rundown of the area’s history and even took us inside one of the heritage homes, offering a glimpse of what life was like back in the 1800s and early 1900s. from there, we headed to our first winery: blaauwklippen in stellenbosch. it had a beautiful setup and lovely ambiance. we were welcomed with a glass of champagne, followed by a tasting of four wines, served with bread and crackers. next, we visited the franschhoek cellar—a charming location with great vibes. here, we sampled five more wines, accompanied by olives and crackers. we also had our lunch break at this winery. the food was delicious, and the portion sizes were generous for the price! our final stop was the rhebokskloof estate, where we enjoyed a unique wine-and-chocolate pairing featuring five wines paired with different types of chocolates. it was a fresh and delightful experience—definitely something new for us. overall, it was a great experience, and we thoroughly enjoyed the day. one thing we did miss, however, was getting a behind-the-scenes look at the winemaking process. none of the wineries showed us how wine is made or gave a tour of the production area. at each stop, we went directly to the tasting room and were offered wines with the option to purchase. just a note: the tour includes all wine tastings, but lunch, wines, and other purchases are not included in the cost.

we booked the tour at last minute and we had the best time. hector our guide was really nice, he did his best to find us crocodile and lamantine. but more than this, it’s the beauty of the place that made our day amazing. we were alone, no tourist, just us 4 on the boat for a reasonable price (less than 100usd per person) for a private tour. we loved everything.

we booked the tour to curieuse island and had an amazing time. everything was well organized, right from the pick-up from our accommodation. the crew was super friendly, fun and genuinely nice. we also received a ton of interesting information. recommending 💯. the tour includes a couple of swim/ snorkeling stops, a hike across the island through the mangrove forest, (very tasty) lunch and time with the giant tortoises. you can bring your own mask for the snorkeling. the hike is quite chill, can be done with flip-flops, too, just make sure you have enough water.

we booked the trip at the end of april, and the weather was still beautiful; not too hot because the breeze from the sea kept us cool. the crew was excellent, as was jithu, who handled our reservation. the company provided tea, omani coffee, water, soft drinks, and fruits. we were fortunate enough to see dolphins not once, but five times! what a beautiful day it was. they also provide snorkeling equipment, which enhances the overall experience. i will definitely return in the fall for another ride.

we booked the trip from aswan to luxor and would repeat 1000 times. if you are searching a dahabiya experience, this is the best you will get. room & bathroom were incredibly clean, big, modern and comfortable as well as the deck, always ready, tidy and clean and the meals & tea time instructions (thanks to emad in the bar and the housekeeper hassan). food was amazing and they could adapt to our vegetarian diet incredibly (thanks to mohamed, the chef). the whole crew made the trip an amazing experience, far away from the rush of the crowded cruises and in constant contact with local communities. last but not least, our guide mahmoud hassan, he is an incredible guy with tons of knowledge ready to share. every afternoon in the dahabiya we had history lessons and in the visits he was giving any detail and answer with exceptional professionalism. he is a well of knowledge with excellent communication skills. best guide in egypt without a doubt! 10/10, could not be better!

we booked this on the day we left to return home. what an amazing experience!! booking was efficient and easy, loved the fact that there are a small number of people as well. this was the most fun i had in man, many years!! great hosts, professional and friendly and they really put you at ease. i am coming to mauritius just for this. highly higly recommended.

we booked this tour as a way to end of our faroe islands journey and it did not disappoint! samson was great at finding spots for us to fish and we were rewarded (maybe too easily) with fish the moment we set our hooks down. his expert steering and understanding of the waters also ensured my seasickness did not act up at all during the few hours we were out. the meal we had at frida and poul’s was like dining with old friends. we were treated to traditional dishes, as well as the fish we just caught! highly recommend this tour to anyone who is interested. you will not regret it!

we booked this tour super last minute on our last day in alaska and we’re sure glad we did. learning about the iditarod and dog mushing in general was easily one of the highlights of our trip! dylan and kelsey were such amazing and knowledgeable tour guides. they answered all of our questions and definitely kept us engaged when preparing for the atv dog ride. thank you guys for providing us with one of the best hands on tour experiences we’ve ever had!! not to mention the puppies!! highly recommend!!

we booked through a third party but dove with aquas claras. the dive leaders were excellent. they were very friendly and knowledgeable. i loved that they were patient and flexible to meet the needs of all the divers on the trip.

we booked through get your guide for our family of 4, 2 adults and 2 teens. everything was provided as described: wifi, device chargers, a large variety of snacks, hot and cold drinks (even a container of tiny marshmallows for hot cocoa) and fantastic celestron binoculars for each of us to use. eric was a fantastic tour guide, providing commentary over a small microphone and amplifier that was not noisy or intrusive. he described and discussed with us local history, notable areas, wildlife and plants and trees. he was a subject matter expert who easily answered all of our questions. eric was attentive at scenic overlooks, pointing out birds and vegetation and various points of interest throughout the canyon. again, he was knowledgeable and easily answered every question. at the last stop, as the sun was setting, he advised that he would hang back a bit. i had expressed at the previous stop how much i enjoyed having him guide me around, so while my husband and son went off to find a quiet place to watch the sunset and my daughter walked around on her own, eric followed me to continue to provide guidance, tips and tricks. he actually showed me settings on my phone that i didn't know about in google photos to help me get better pictures. i loved that extra care and attention. after our tour ended, eric drove us to the pizza/pasta place and advised us on various menu options. again, nothing but friendly and helpful and never annoying or intrusive. we ate a late dinner together, happy to have him join us for that. overall, it was just a great, great experience. a bucket list kind of thing that was worth every penny. we didn't have a single complaint and can't think of a thing he could have done better. he has all these 5 star reviews for a reason. book this awesome guy for an unforgettable tour. you won't regret it.

we booked two day trips and had the best guide and boat crew so many laughs, very caring and professional took us to the least crowded spots. really tailored our tour to what we wanted and the food was delicious. the best guide on our month on the philippines. easy communication and booking too! would recommend.

we booked two land tours and two whale watching trips through futurismo and they were all excellent. well organised with knowledgeable friendly guides. with lots of boats and land spotters they are really well set up to find whales and we saw loads of dolphins as well as flying fish. on the land tours we definitely felt we saw more than driving around ourselves and leave a lot about the island and culture.

we booked two land tours and two whale watching trips through futurismo and they were all excellent. well organised with knowledgeable friendly guides. with lots of boats and land spotters they are really well set up to find whales and we saw loads of dolphins as well as flying fish. on the land tours we definitely felt we saw more than driving around ourselves and leave a lot about the island and culture.

we booked two separate packages for different days, my favorite was by far the snorkeling package. as a first time snorkeler, it was the perfect length and not too difficult. the current was pretty gentle and not hard to swim. our guide took us around spots and made sure to point out when we were by particularly interesting sea life, and there was plenty of it! photos were an additional cost, but there were some cool shots and i think worth it to have the memories. i thoroughly enjoyed this!

we booked vienna: secrets of the fiaker & horse-drawn carriage ride through get your guide. we weren't sure exactly what to expect but we thought it looked like fun and would be better than just riding around the town center. we were surely correct. quite a fun and interesting experience. meeting at the stables first thing in the morning as the horses were being prepared for their day. a tour of the facility and a lesson on the history of the fiaker before we took a nice long ride into town. great opportunity for lots of pictures!

we booked with green river our first morning in paris, and it was the absolute perfect choice! this was the highlight of our trip, and such a relaxing way to see all of the sights in a calm and relaxed way. our captain, jean-sebastian, was friendly and informative while still allowing us to enjoy the calm of the cruise. we got a preview of all the incredible sights of paris, while relaxing without any crowds, and snacking on delicious pastries, coffee, and juice. the boat was clean and comfortable. if i could give this more than 5 stars, i would!

we booked “the handmade tea tour” with the tour guide parami and she was amazing. she had so much knowledge, engaging a lot and attentive. she also helped to take photos of us. we made our own tea from plucking the leaves, drying it and then we got to bring it home. we learned a lot about tea, the factory etc and then we tried lovely tea afterwards. i’m so satisfied with this and would recommend it to anybody, even ones not liking tea.

we borrowed bicycles from hotel cumbres as suggested by jla max, and he escorted us on the 5km largely flat ride. (be en route by 9.30am latest to avoid pre-sun heat). once you’ve got in (after ‘normal for chile’ bureaucracy which adds ten minutes of form-filing to the simple process of buying a ticket) the archeological site is well-organised. the pathways are in good condition and wind upwards through the terrain. sadly the route close to the ruins was closed (why?!), so one has to make do with long-distance views. but with a mobile camera the photos enable a good look at the structures. we wondered what the roofs would have been made of? so we looked forward to seeing a scale model reconstruction in the little museum…but a 2cm photo tucked away in a corner is all there was. all-spanish information about the contents of the glass-topped cases, and not much of that. disappointing given the undoubted expertise of the archaeologists who’ve uncovered the ruins and found the objects. whinge over. the main thing is that the integration of habitation with landscape is well worth seeing. and if you’re a walker it’s a rewarding route whether you take in a couple of sections or do the whole traverse.

we borrowed the discs for disc golf in queenstown gardens. it costs 5$ for each disc and you also get a map with a point chart and the rules for an extra 3$. it's really worth the money and we had a great time.

we both enjoyed the time at the spice garden a lot. lovely plants and lovely turtles. i also can highly recommend the cinnamon ice cream. we had good 2 hours there and would come back again. only the plants could be marked a bit better than just via a map.

we bought a combo ticket to visit both the flower dome and cloud forest(46dollars), and it was such a beautiful experience. the cooling environment was a perfect escape from the hot singapore weather. the flower dome was filled with vibrant flowers, while the cloud forest felt like stepping into another world, with its lush greenery and misty atmosphere. on top of that, there was a jurassic world exhibition going on and it was absolutely incredible. the life-sized realistic dinosaurs looked like they could jump to life at any moment. it was like stepping back in time all while being surrounded by nature’s beauty.

we bought tickets on the day and there was a small queue but it was ok, it did get very busy when it got to around 1pm so best to go earlier. the palace was lovely but there is some construction that is still going on. me and my sisters just wandered around the fascinating palace and took lots of great photos.

we cafe-hopped during a week’s stay in vienna, visiting at least ten different cafes. this café was the least-mentioned in guidebooks/websites, but it was our favorite by far. during the third week of january it was quiet, most of the clientele were local, and we felt most welcome and unhurried. we visited again and were even more welcomed by our waiter who remembered us, remembered our previous orders, and warmly greeted as if we were regulars. most highly recommended.

we called an uber to drive us here. he dropped us off at the entrance of the trajineras. the street vendors kept trying to to lure us in to their boat, expecting us to pay per person as opposed to the entire trajinera rental price. be ware, there are signs posted stating that the fee is an entire boat rental and not a per person fee. the tourist trajineras ride which takes you through the backyards of peoples homes as you travel through murky waters, is pretty short! i think it was definitely less than an hour in total, from point to point including the short shopping pit stop. we still had time to exit the trajinera, take a restroom break and shop for some dresses. we found the iconic letters, took a few pics and made our way back to our trajinera. it is imperative that you carry pesos. it’s better and smarter to buy your food and or drinks before boarding. the vendors along the narrow murky river sell things from their back yards which happens to face the river. it’s nice to help the locals, but for the penny pincher, their merchandise comes with a steep price. some other vendors come around on their own trajineras selling corn and other stuff. their prices are also somewhat steep for a mexican treat. all in all, fun way to spend the afternoon. we headed to a local mercado a few blocks down the street afterwards. then called an uber to take us back into town.

we came across this museum while on a trip to barcelona and walking down to the sea front. we went in for a look round and it was excellent for finding out about the history of barcelona. there were a couple of floors or items which were really well presented and each had explanatory notes in english and i think catalan, spanish and i think french too. there is a restaurant on the top floor and a separate viewing area to look out over barcelona. they have their own website, it's inexpensive to enter, and is really worth a visit.

we came across this place by chance after the other restaurant (which my wife recommended) was full, but we don't regret it at all. they accommodated us without a reservation. the goulash soup was very tasty. i recommend it to everyone. the schnitzel (original viennese) was also good. however, i don't think its price is justified.

we came across this place completely randomly while doing a hike across the angkor complex. it's just a dam. nothing special. the area around it is quite nice. the most important thing you need to know: you can walk across it. there are easy to follow paths on both sides which lead you back to civilization. impossible to get lost.

we came all the way from kuta for the park and the playground. visited the playground twice recently after a major renovation. they have removed all the broken, chipped, unsaved play spots with new safe ones. they spread imitation grass on the ground so it's clean for kids to play. lapangan puputan is a big square. particularly the corner where this playground is always busy with kids, parents, and food sellers. this playground is always crowded during the day and especially afternoons, couple hours before dusk. i could only think of more sitting place for parents while attending the kids playing.

we came as customers and left as friends. made over 30 dives with githa over two weeks, and none has disappointed. the secret is not come to the very end of the world map with expectations of 24/7 client service. the resources are very scarce there and githa and her team are doing a great job at making the dive center work and at getting you underwater. do not request certain dive-sites, leave them decide what the next site will be and you will most likely have a pleasant surprise. this is certainly not the place to come with your own agenda. the surface and underwater currents change constantly, and so does the weather and the fish behavior so it is just better to leave the planning to pros. stay for at least a week, not for one day or two, so that you can start to get a sense of the place. we've had tens of manta encounters, dolphins, sharks, turtles, you name it, and we were grateful for each of them. the communication with the team was brief, concise and to the point. do not come if you still need lots of attention, baby-sitting and cannot handle yourself underwater in demanding situations, there is still egypt for that.

we came first thing in the morning when it was cooler as we hoped animals would be more active. we got lucky, we were the first airboat ride out and saw a wild alligator, turtles, and iguana. we had fun seeing the gators and tyler hosting the feeding and learning experience. definitely recommend.

we came for a wine tasting and ended up staying for a full dinner, it was incredible! don’t miss the beef carpaccio! sliced so thin and tender, not fatty. the star was the fennel risotto with cuttlefish. even if you don’t want the cuttlefish, it would be easy to pick around (or ask for it without) the risotto is so excellent and flavorful it’s worth it!

we came here to see and hear the famous sea lions. there is actually someone whose job is to keep shooing the sea lions away from the docks. it seems like a futile job as shortly after she shoos them away they wait then gradually come back. it is amazing how loud they are with their barking. some of the large males would challenge each other for spots before one would eventually give up and slide into the water. some of the ones swimming in the water seemed very playful as they swam around. there was lots of room to view the sea lions but probably the best spot was on the 2nd level deck overlooking the docks. i could watch them for hours as they are like a big, dysfunctional family, playing and fighting! worth a look since they are free and you can get pretty close to get great views of them!

we came to this gorgeous temple twice when we were in hk. this beautiful buddhist nunnery is a rebuilt temple which replicates the "seven-hall" of the tang dynasty. its construction followed the dang dynasty building techniques, design and using the traditional building materials to construct the building. the whole temple was built with only wood and not a single nail was used. every part of the temple was constructed with the "interlocking" technique to hold the woods in place. it has more than 33,000 sq meters and it houses a series of temple halls and side wings rooms which filled with gold and wooden statues. some of the best statues are such as the "sakyamuni buddha" and "guanyin". the whole site took 10 years to build. one of my favourites is the beautiful lotus in the 2 ponds in front. the temple halls are free for entry but the nunnery area is closed for visitors. chi lin nunnery is just opposite the hollywood plaza, adjacent to the nan lian garden and a few minutes walk from the diamond hill mtr station. highly recommended for anyone who lives in / visits hong kong. (please note that pictures are only allowed at the small garden outside but not inside the temple.)

we chose enchantment resort because of its spa reputation, but our stay was filled with issues and ended in a serious security violation that management has failed to address. we had repeated problems with our room keys and were initially blamed by staff for deactivating them ourselves by storing them with our cellphones. we had three keys which all stopped working. we didn’t store them this way. only after returning for the third time were we told there was likely an issue with the door lock. they told us to use a different door and that security would come look at the lock but gave us no we chose jambiani over kendwa or nungwe in the north because it’s said it’s less touristy. there are plenty of hotels and resorts so there is still lot of tourism going on but the beach is so vast and there’s so much space for everyone. in the evening the locals are coming to play soccer on the white sands which is fun to watch. there are many kite surf shops for hiring equipment and one can take classes. the wind was pretty good when we were there in july and many people came to kite. there’s an abundance of nice restaurants and bars along the beach and one holiday is not enough to try them all. almost endless walks along the beach are possible but at high tide sometimes there’s no space left to walk. at low tide the water leaves big puddles behind and the local women are wading through them to collect crabs and shells. snorkelling is offered by tour operators but the reef is unfortunately not healthy and there’s not that much to see.

we chose motema for our namibia trip in january 2025. we’re really happy with the choice and our six days guided tour. our guide gad was fun, nice and knowledgeable. he made us feel safe and he drove cautiously. we made some memories together that will last a lifetime. our main stops were etosha national park, swakopmund, sossusvlei and deadvlei. we also got to see many interesting places on the way. i would have wished for some more time in swakopmund since it felt like there was more to see than we had time for. the accommodation during the tour was great. overall professional tour company which i strongly recommend.

we chose not to pay extra to enter the palace as all palaces look the same for me. we went early in the morning around 7am to see the famous stonewall. this is a must see for kdrama fans of goblin. i didn't get to see the corner where the goblin was looking at.

we chose the high tea kayak. it was a relaxing paddle around lavender bay. the views of sydney harbour bridge and the opera house were breathtaking. laura and tejas were great guides. the information they shared was interesting and added to the uniqueness of the trip. the scones were delicious, great choice of teas available, it all added to the experience. thanks again for the experience, would recommend it to friends and colleagues.

we chose the night cruise so we could see the eiffel tower alight, and it didn’t disappoint. after a short wait to board , we were welcomed by the friendly staff and then chose our seats downstairs at the front - highly recommend. we were surprised that we set off in the opposite direction of the eiffel tower , but then were greeted by the first wonderful moment of seeing the moon hanging directly ahead of us. staff quickly announced that we could come to the bar for our chosen included drink. additional chargeable drinks were available. we passed notre dame, then turned back along the seine towards le louvre and onto the grand finale , eiffel tower. a cruise with vedettes is a must do activity to see magical paris.

we chose the wind dancer tour that *actually lands* in the grand canyon — and it was absolutely worth it! arriving at the airport yourself (rather than taking the shuttle) saves time; the tour takes about 2 hours this way. there's free parking and we even walked over to see the iconic las vegas sign before check-in. everything was very well organized. the staff was friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. the flight accommodates six people, and they rotate seating at the landing site so everyone gets a chance at the best views — although, to be fair, the helicopter offers stunning views from all seats thanks to its large windows. if you're looking for a truly unforgettable experience of the grand canyon, this is it.

we chose this hotel because it is one of the best-looking hotels around plitvice park — and we were satisfied. the service was quite good, the staff were attentive and caring, and the food and bar services were more than adequate. although the rooms have an old-style concept, they were clean and comfortable, with nothing to complain about. overall, it is a successful nature hotel. the only thing to watch out for is that there is another hotel with a similar name. make sure to double-check the address when heading there.

we chose wolf trail for our husky experience in lapland and we could not have chosen better. everything was right on time, well explained, safe. stephane is a very good guide. but the dogs are just amazing, they just love to run, to play in the snow. it was by far the nicest trip we had in lapland, one that i would repeat many many times.

we come here once a year , and everytime is as amazing as the last if not better ! the spa is wonderful , their staff is warm and friendly , and very accomedating. the rooms are very nice , modern and comfortable . the bedding is soft and the bed is comfortable.and the price cannot be beat for a hotel 5 mintures out from the old city and all the attractions ! the only down size is their elevator is really outdated ... more like a service elevator then one for the public . you have to try their mocaccinos ! amazing .

we completed five dives with eclipse diving center between july 11th and july 18th, 2024, and it was an outstanding experience. andrew, our guide, was exceptional. he provided detailed briefings, clearly explaining the dive plan each time. the team took care of all the preparations, making the experience seamless. diving in a small group allowed us to thoroughly explore the ocean floor without feeling rushed. i highly recommend eclipse diving center for an unforgettable diving experience in boracay.

we consider our tundra walk with courtney and her sled dogs as one of the top highlights of our trip to alaska. this is one of the first things my family talks about with other people when they ask about our trip. we learned so much about the amazing tundra from courtney. the dogs were so joyful and friendly, we loved playing with them. courtney was so kind to give us suggestions for other references in the area and quick to reply to all communications. it is indeed happy trails and wagging tails!!!

we could have a photograph with the iconic landmark of raja ampat and see waisai city from above the hill. local government should repaint and renovate this place so it would be more beautiful. be careful when you are taking pictures, because it is located on the crossroad with many motor cycles and cars turn around.

we could not have asked for a better experience with snorkeling at turtle canyon pink sails. captain jaime was awesome along with peter and mike! peter was a great guide, full of energy and helped us see some turtles and amazing fish. the crew so accommodating. my wife and i have six children, 16 years old down to five years old. we felt safe the whole time and my kids absolutely loved it!

we could not have asked for a better trip! our family of five just rafted the grand canyon last week with dave, mackenzie, maddie, and sedona. what an incredible crew — they worked tirelessly to make the adventure fun and safe, and they fed us so well. we ate fresher food at the bottom of the canyon than we do at home. and more importantly, they were all delightful humans who love this beautiful world and are thrilled to share it with others. it was a trip of a lifetime, and we are so grateful to everyone involved.

we could see rangdum gompa straight ahead, and it becomes visible from quite far away. but we were real hungry, so we headed just ahead to. alpine hut. not much of a choice, so we ordered noodles with egg, and it sure tasted awesome. the food was steaming, and once finished we felt all fired up to continue to panikar. the route is all gravel, but is still good, and one can drive at 60 comfortably. the best part is there is no entry fees.

we couldn't have managed without them. stephanie, before we arrived, was so helpful in booking our stays and trips. she listened to what we were hoping yo experience and her recommendations were perfect. omar and daniel greeted us and checked on us throughout our stay, checking our experiences on the tours and offered great restaurant recommendations. the point hotel is incredible in the evenings for watching sea life. the tour to santa fe for snorkeling and lunch was brilliant. the boat was the perfect size for a small group, we met lovely like minded people. isabela was wonderful and the hotel chosen for us was beachfront and very comfortable. from our tiny flight to accommodation and trips they were all arranged by guiding galapagos, thank you for all you did for us, giles and sarah
we couldn't see the waterfalls very good but we were probably standing at the wrong place. anyway, the place is beautiful.

we couldn’t have been more pleased with classic boats venice—for our boat tour to islands surrounding venice. our captain claudio was very informative about the venetian history, friendly and an all around great host. we visited murano island where we toured the murano glass factory and its gallery, visited burano island with its beautiful colorful houses and many lace shops, lunch at torcello island at villa 600 (spectacular service and fresh whole fish) and then to orto winery on san erasmo island where we had a private wine tasting and received a warm welcome from owner michael and his daughter matilda. we highly recommend victoria:sales, administration, tour manager as coordinator—she truly assisted us well as we coordinated everything from the united states and claudio our boat captain—he made the experience fantastic!

we couldn’t have chosen a better place for our first discover scuba diving! everything was well-planned, well-scheduled, and clearly explained. we had an amazing time with breathtaking views. i highly recommend this place to anyone looking for their first dive! special thanks to our instructor, meen!

we couldn’t have had a better time. it was the best diving of our lives, we booked another trip to come back in two years time, and made some friends during our time there. the staff is incredible in all aspects of your stay, making a westerner feel right at home. the beds are comfortable, food is good, cocktails surprisingly good. i was weary about not having air con but it was not a problem. we got a 2nd fan and slept well each night with them set up on either side of the bed. the bungalows are over the water so mosquitos weren’t an issue at all during our march stay. we brought malaria pills but ended up leaving with them. the back decks of the cabana offered almost all day shade and beautiful sunrise yoga views. the diving is just next level. we have our advanced but are still intermediate divers and were very comfortable here. the dive shop on site was the best we’ve experienced with quality rentals, attentive staff, and great dive guides. shout out to naomi, caterina, and niko for keeping us safe while seeing incredible marine life. we met the owners and the gm, apo, while there and you can tell they’ve worked hard to build trust with their local community and team. they care and have built a strong culture with intention.

we decided on the “secrets of the fiaker” tour. the start was at 8:45 a.m. we really enjoyed the tour and information about fiaker and were thrilled. the subsequent horse-drawn carriage ride to stephansplatz was very nice, lasting just under 45 minutes. a great addition to the normal fiaker tour in vienna!!! also particularly interesting for families. the horse-drawn carriages are simply part of a visit to vienna 🥰

we decided to climb. yes. climb. not hike. climb bell rock... what an unforgettable experience. heart pumping. you may experience a bit of anxiety if you're afraid of highs. it also requires some good orientation skills, and very good memory as well. so you can remember which way you went up, so you're able to descend the same way. i recommend hiking boots, and hiking trekking if you want. but once you reach the top. the reward is very gratifying. you'd feel on top of the world, and very satisfied.

we decided to do the hike to the bottom of the natural bridge on a whim and were pleasantly surprised by how nice this bridge is. the hike was fairly level and you can climb right underneath the bridge. a nice hidden jewel.

we decided to head out to visit the tokyo skytree to compare the views with those from tokyo tower, which we had visited earlier in our trip. after a quick and easy train ride, we arrived and had dinner in the surrounding complex before heading toward the ticket counter. unfortunately, we arrived just a few minutes before closing and missed the last admission time, so we weren’t able to go up the tower that night. even though we didn’t make it to the top, the visit still turned out to be worthwhile. the tower itself is massive and really impressive, especially at night. it was fully illuminated and the colours changed periodically, cycling through purples, blues, reds, and a stunning rainbow display at one point. i was able to get several photos from different angles on our walk up to the tower, and it still felt like a great experience even without going to the top. the whole area around the base is clean, modern, and easy to navigate, with shopping, restaurants, and a very open plaza for photos. i’ll definitely come back earlier next time to enjoy the observation deck and views over tokyo, but even just seeing the tower up close was worth the visit.

we decided to walk at random and choose a gondola, we agreed on the 30-minute ride - 90 euros - which was very pleasant, the gondolier was very kind and explained many details of the city and the buildings, the history behind them and unique views, i recommend the ride

we did 3 days of diving with dive komodo and had a really good experience. the dive sites they took us to were some of the best in my experience and they were well organized and helpful. sofie also was kind enough to help us organize a private tour to see the komodo dragons and give us pointers for the area of labuan bajo. i will definitely come back if i find myself in indonesia again :)

we did 3 hikes in lofoten and agreed that this trail to ryten was the most difficult one for us. the views were amazing though, both during the hike and at the top. especially view to kvalvika beach. the hike was quite challenging maybe due to the fact that there was a strong cold wind and a very steep ascent during 2nd part, closer to the summit. 1st part was challenging in a different way - wooden trail was very narrow and everyone had to stop and wait to let other people pass in the opposite direction all the time. then, there were medium size random rocks and a steep part. later, there was some bigger rock climbing which i found fun. the trail has many different parts, sometimes it's muddy. i definitely recommend this trail to anyone who has at least some experience in hiking. bring some food and water, wear good shoes and dress in layers because the weather can be felt differently in different parts of the trail.

we did a "feed & eat" tour in may 2024 and it was such an awesome experience! definitely one of the highlights of our trip to the faroe islands and something we would recommend to everyone, who is genuinely interested in learning a bit more about the islands, the culture and people here. berghild and klæmint were wonderful hosts, they shared a lot of information and stories about sheep farming, animals and the way of life in the faroe islands. we got to actively participate in the feeding process. may is also the perfect time to see the little lambs. after the feeding and the tour of the farm, we were invited for a delicious, traditional, home-cooked meal in the amazing, historical house that's belonged to the family for generations. the farm is also very conveniently located, only a short ride from torshavn (via the sub-sea tunnel). a truly unforgettable experience!

we did a 3h quad and sandboard tour and it was excellent! the views and the ride was well worth it, especially once you move deeper into the desert. sandboard is exciting downhill, but going back up is challenging, even more so if there is strong wind. weather was a bit windy for us so pants and a jacket were a must, as well as some sunscreen and sunglasses. would recommend a buff also if you go sandboarding.

we did a 3h quad and sandboard tour and it was excellent! the views and the ride was well worth it, especially once you move deeper into the desert. sandboard is exciting downhill, but going back up is challenging, even more so if there is strong wind. weather was a bit windy for us so pants and a jacket were a must, as well as some sunscreen and sunglasses. would recommend a buff also if you go sandboarding.

we did a 4 day live aboard with my wife and 2 kids. the weather was variable but the snorkelling was fantastic. the crew were wonderful. captain matt made sure the girls didn't get bored. dive master rodrigo knew the girls name by heart as they were the only kids on board. claire always spoke in french to the girls and maria made sure everybody had plenty to eat. the food was great and we always felt taken care of on this trip. many thanks to the great crew.

we did a 6 day hiking focused trip. the guides were very friendly, fun, and knowledgeable. sleeping under the stars was a real treat and riding the river was fun and exciting. would definitely recommend this company and this adventure.

we did a 6 day kilimanjaro trek with mafie adventures and it was incredible! our guides were oliver and msafiri and we had 9 porters and 1chef. they really did make it feel like we were part of one big family and they really looked after us during the whole trip. the crew are all so friendly and respectful and will literally do anything to help you! the food was beyond our expectations and we loved the little touches like a tablecloth and candle! summit day was difficult due to the altitude but oliver and msafiri encouraged us and motivated us the whole way..and we reached the summit! we booked via whatsapp and the communication was great from booking answering any queries we had promptly. highly recommend mafie adventures!

we did a 6-day kilimanjaro hike with mafie adventure followed by a 4-day safari, and everything was truly amazing. communication was smooth with quick responses, the food on the mountain was great, and the whole team, especially our fantastic guides and porters, helped us achieve our summit goal. they were knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate, making the experience unforgettable. the safari was equally incredible, staying in luxury tents right in the heart of nature. transfers and logistics were perfectly organized with zero issues from start to finish. to improve: tipping transparency the evening before we started the trip, we were surprised with the expected “standard” kilimanjaro tips which had never been mentioned at booking. while we gladly gave the team what they deserved, this was a significant expense we had not budgeted for. it would be much better if this cost was clearly communicated in advance or included in the package price to avoid surprises for future clients. overall, the guiding team is 5-star without question, but the company should be upfront about all costs including tips from the start.
we did a 9km hike with 800m of hight and it was amazing to see how well the park is kept even at 800m the paths were being maintained amazingly. i would definitely go back!

we did a beautiful scenic flight over the okavango delta with helictoper horizon. couldn’t have been easier, our pilot, bradley, met us at our accommodation gave us a very clear and concise safety briefing before embarking on our flight. his knowledge of the delta was fantastic and was able to give a smooth and relaxing flight while conversing and pointing out a variety of animals and information about the delta. he truly is a credit to the team at helicopter horizon and his experience shone through making this the highlight of my trip to the delta. couldn’t recommend helicopter horizons enough.

we did a boat trip. they picked us up at the pousada and the boat left the port at 8:45 (there is a boat queue). it was a sunny day and the trip was nicely done and explained, from the secondary islands on one corner of the island to the ponta da sapata on the other. we had 40 min to snorkel in sancho. rômulo was really funny in giving information. we arrived back at the port punctually at 12 am. carol from the agency was friendly. they gave us a transfer to the airport free of charge

we did a canoa havaiana tour with atalaia and it was great, well organised and fun! we were attended by camila by whatsapp before our trip and she was lovely and super helpful answering all our questions and helping to clarify all the doubts we had about our stay in fernando de noronha. they also provided a courtesy transfer from/to the airport which was a great extra! we loved our stay on the island.

we did a canoa havaiana tour with atalaia and it was great, well organised and fun! we were attended by camila by whatsapp before our trip and she was lovely and super helpful answering all our questions and helping to clarify all the doubts we had about our stay in fernando de noronha. they also provided a courtesy transfer from/to the airport which was a great extra! we loved our stay on the island.

we did a circular walk up to the green loch and it was beautiful. we did it in reverse so the way down was pretty steep but beautiful views down and of the mountains as well as really good for hearing birds like crossbills but didn’t manage to see any. the loch was so beautiful and vibrant, the only downside was how busy it was with groups of people who used it as a loud chatting station. the walk back on the main path was much easier and flatter but still beautiful forest. we also stopped in the cafe/visitor centre on the way back and had cake which was really good and lovely staff.

we did a day tour on one of the boats and nelson and mario were super nice ! we had the best time. the food we had for lunch was also super good. i definitely recommend booking with them if you want to do a day boat tour on bazaruto archipelago!

we did a day trip, my wife, 2 kids and myself. in the morning the ride in the "camels" (dromedary in reality), lunch and quad ride in the afternoon. the camel is a short and slow ride nearby the installations, was like 90 minutes ride and to be honest was enough, after certain time was getting uncomfortable due the position. the lunch was typical and basic moroccan food but was good, very taste. the best part in my opinion was the quad ride, where we could see the agafay desert from several points.
we did a first tour to see mirror stone cave and rangko cave, and a second one to rinca island. great authentic experience! people were really nice and helpful. thank you!

we did a full day jeep tour with abdalsalam exploring the sand dunes, mountains and canyons and spent one night in the camp and one night in a cave under the stars. abdalsalam is a wonderful guide and we really recommend booking - mohammad the chef also made delicious dinners and breakfasts. shukran!

we did a full day jeep tour with abdalsalam exploring the sand dunes, mountains and canyons and spent one night in the camp and one night in a cave under the stars. abdalsalam is a wonderful guide and we really recommend booking - mohammad the chef also made delicious dinners and breakfasts. shukran!

we did a full day moremi with mosu safari tours. communication with kemy went perfect. had a great safari in moremi, we saw a big pride of lions with cubs, they even climbed in a tree. and we saw a leopard try to hunt a warthog, but it was to big for a succesfull hunt. also the food during the trip was very good. there was a small accident when they took the table for lunch from the car wich resulted in my camera taking a fall from the seat, luckily only an adapter broke and not the camera itself. mosu safari tours responded very professional on this incident with a refund of the adapter. kemy once again was top in the communication afterwards. would definitely recommend mosu if you're looking for a safari into moremi.

we did a full day tour with captain tzannes and deck hand karem. this is the absolute best way to see the island. the private catamaran was much better then the larger group trips and we got to choose what we wanted to do. captain tzannes is a born and raised santorini local and knew everything about the area. karem was an amazing chef and our lunch was the best food we ate on the islands. this tour was 100% worth the money and i could not recommend it more. after spend 2 months traveling europe this is my absolute favorite day of my trip.

we did a full day tour with livia last week up to the jungfrau, etc. livia was terrific. super nice person and extremely knowledgeable about the region. we loved our day with her. it was a highlight of our swiss vacation.

we did a fully supported package with mike and the team at atm cycle tours. it was super easy as accommodation and shuttling of bags, and us was organized seamlessly. we used our own bikes but hired an ebike for one of our team who had not done a lot of cycling. mike was awesome and accommodated our requests without a problem. i would highly recommend atm cycle tours if you are looking to do this trip.

we did a game drive here after experiencing one at west coast safari. positives: the booking process was smooth, with clear and efficient communication via email. we appreciated the honest advice — we were recommended a half-day drive, which was indeed more suitable for our young children. the guide was very friendly and gave us lots of interesting information. we saw plenty of animals, and often from very close up. negatives: the experience lacked authenticity. many animals were seen right next to their feeding stations, and we drove past the lion enclosures — it didn’t feel natural at all. the guide knew exactly where to find the animals, so there was no sense of “search” or discovery, no scanning the bush with binoculars like we’ve seen elsewhere. it felt a bit like a guided tour in a zoo. for those doing the full safari, the break didn’t make much sense either — just a coffee stop at the estate’s restaurant. the surroundings of the estate also lacked charm.

we did a great boattrip to cousin, watching birds, to curieuse for bbq, hiking and the turtoises. finally we were showed a great snorkeling spot. the best spot of our holidays. lots of different fishes of all sizes. the tour was well organized, not so much people and very friendly staff. can strongly recommend that.

we did a half day tour with seaoman and it was one of the best experiences of our travels. we were lucky to come across a load of whale sharks along the way where we got to swim with them before we went for our dive. the crew were all amazing and we felt so safe and comfortable. we made friends for life.

we did a half day wine tour and half day eco boat tour. in both cases we had an amazing time. the guides were knowledgeable and friendly. we had the opportunity to taste some amazing wine and cheese. when we were on the boat we spotted some whales about 300 meters away. while taking pictures of them one literally broke surface 15 feet off the starboard side (the right). unfortunately, google doesnt let me upload video or you would see a close up for about 40 seconds of it at the surface then it drives and its tail breaks surface. amazing. even the guide was surprised by it coming so close. go and have a good time.

we did a helicopter jump (amazing) and multiple dives with trident. steve (owner) is an american patriot having served our nation as are many of his employees. great dive shop - ladies there were great to work with. highly recommend.

we did a hot air balloon safari over tarangire national park in may, and it was nothing short of magical. i went with a party of 8 that included my wife, our two toddlers, and 4 friends. the miracle team truly outdid my expectations. we were nervous about doing it with toddlers, but the miracle team was very reassuring and attentive. one thing that stood out in particular was when our briefing guide, mr. kipuyo, gave us the excellent recommendation to bring along headphones for the kids because of the loud noise produced by the burner, which was fantastic. we couldn't have asked for a better experience. it was unforgettable from start to finish. there’s something incredibly serene about silently gliding over the landscape at sunrise, watching the world come to life below you. the views were breathtaking — we spotted hyenas moving through tall grass, ostriches running across open plains, elephants crossing the river, and even monkeys perched high in the trees. seeing wildlife from a bird’s-eye view adds a whole new dimension to the safari experience. the staff were amazing, warm, professional, and great with our little ones, and our pilot, cesar, was exceptional, making us feel safe and relaxed throughout the flight. cesar even served us adults' coffee while on the balloon ride. talk about service! 🙌🏿 the spectacular experience didn't end in the sky; we were treated to a champagne toast and hearty bush breakfast there after - such an all-around great experience. if you're considering doing a balloon safari in tanzania, i highly recommend it, and i highly recommend doing it with the miracle company. it’s a unique and peaceful way to witness the wild, and an experience we’ll treasure forever.

we did a lot of research so you don't have to! this company was faultless, from initial planning to execution of our trekking experience. at altitude plans can change very quickly and our guide, chozang, was quick to recognize and react to the problem advising us of alternatives when one member of our party needed attention in the middle of a cold night. it's essential to know you're in experienced hands in this environment. the food was amazing too which added to the enjoyment of our trek even comping up with pizza and a birthday cake one evening! i can't really imagine a better company to work with to create your own tailer-made trek. a thousand thanks to everyone in the company that was part of our memorable trip.
we did a one day hike to rong valley with children and it was fantastic trip. the trek leader was well experienced.

we did a paddleboard cenote tour and it was awesome! mauricio was informative and taught us new paddle skills. the centoe was so quiet, do the early tour, we left tulum at 8am. the tour ended with delicious tacos in town, such an amazing experience. would 100% recommend :)
we did a private boat tour with them. excellent boat crew. and went to some very private beaches. we combined tour c & d. also the captain was part of mtv challenge tv show.

we did a regular river cruise. i love the fact that by buying online, i could walk up to the dock and get on the boat at whatever time i was ready. i chose a day and had from 10 am through 10:30pm to show up. this eliminated a lot of stress of trying to rush other activities to arrive at a certain time. the dock was easy to find due to plentiful signage and there was a ride every 30 minutes. the cruise is relaxing but 1 star gets knocked off as we could not hear any of the audio about the city. i imagine there are plenty of people who do not care about the history or facts and just want the cruise and if so that's fine. my wife is a major history nerd however and was disappointed in not being able to learn anything about the city from the cruise. if you just need an hour to relax your sore feet but still want to sight see, you can hop on for around 20 euros. i paid 17 by purchasing online. you pass by most of the major sites.

we did a scouting of a lot of places before booking our hammam and these had the best packages and competitive prices. it was separated male/female and we shared our hammam with 2 other ladies. the staff doing the hammam were very lovely and caring, they could see my friend was struggling with the extreme heat and took extra care of her and made sure she was okay. a good scrub! the massage part was very relaxing, only downside is that our masseuses kept on talking for the entire time between each other so ruined the relax. we also got served lovely tea and got to keep the scrubbing glove! would recommend!

we did a scuba dive and snorkel and it was an incredible experience ! both dive sites were stunning, with great visibility and amazing marine life. a huge thank you to perrine, our instructor, who was absolutely fantastic – very professional, kind, and reassuring. she quickly made us feel comfortable and showed us lots of fish and beautiful giant clams. we highly recommend her!

we did a seven night mobile safari starting from maun all the way up to kasane with overnights in different parks. our guide voice went above and beyond to fulfill our wildlife sighting wishes. you can truly feel his appreciation for guests and genuine passion for his work. the camp team was friendly, attentive, and helpful. also, the food exceeded expectations, especially given the limitations you have on a mobile safari. communication with the administration was fast and responsive, and they accommodated our needs to tailor the trip accordingly. i can wholeheartedly recommend shipungo safari.

we did a small airboat tour with capt. brady and that’s definitely the way to go. he took us through canals that the larger pontoon boats can’t make it through, and we saw so much of the flora and fauna. capt. brady was super knowledgeable and the tour was informative and amazing. loved the bayou, the adorable gators, and all his food recs!

we did a snorkeling excursion on 7/30/25 and it was incredible!! the crew was exceptionally attentive, ensured everyone was safe and comfortable and went out of their way to help everyone into the water. the boat was beautiful and the awesome and talented female captain was a bonus ✨appropriate for all age and experience levels!

we did a sunset camel ride on day one and a sand boarding adventure on day two. salman and his cute four year-old daughter were fantastic hosts who arranged everything at short notice for us. highly recommended for a fantastic trip with fantastic people!

we did a sunset camel ride on day one and a sand boarding adventure on day two. salman and his cute four year-old daughter were fantastic hosts who arranged everything at short notice for us. highly recommended for a fantastic trip with fantastic people!

we did a sunset hike from 2000-2130. plenty of parking at that time and not too crowded on the trail. some of the best views we’ve seen!

we did a sunset hike from interlaken to a beautiful spot and then flew down over the lake with the paraglider. snacks and drinks were provided. was a lot more than expxect3d, very friendly and great communication.

we did a tour from a cruise ship headlined as the living namib desert and delivered by charly's desert tours. the tour was a highlight and the staff were fabulous. shoutout to ernst, nick, and bjorn! really well organised, and we got to know the desert, its inhabitants, and the area. if it lived in the sand, ernst could find it — and he kept everything moving along well. nick gave a wonderful overview of the desert and its place in namibia, and kept up a very informative spiel throughout the tour. bjorn was very helpful and always at hand to find an animal track or offer insights. the equipment, organisation, and staff are a credit to charly's tours.

we did a tour from a cruise ship headlined as the living namib desert and delivered by charly's desert tours. the tour was a highlight and the staff were fabulous. shoutout to ernst, nick, and bjorn! really well organised, and we got to know the desert, its inhabitants, and the area. if it lived in the sand, ernst could find it — and he kept everything moving along well. nick gave a wonderful overview of the desert and its place in namibia, and kept up a very informative spiel throughout the tour. bjorn was very helpful and always at hand to find an animal track or offer insights. the equipment, organisation, and staff are a credit to charly's tours.

we did a turtle snorkel tour with marcus, avery, captain jeff, and cora the boat dog and had an amazing time! the honolulu snorkel tour crew was super friendly, helped us see tons of turtles, and ran a very safe, tight ship! plus, their office/boat slip was super easy to get to and find. so glad we had the chance to go out with their team!
we did a uros tour with alfredo. realy nice after noon on the titi kaka lake with his family. we recommend it !
we did about 45 mins hike/walk towards the view point and sat next the waterfall edge. weekday trip with not many people. great view and safe conditions.

we did an 3d2n expedition from coron to el nido and it was an amazing experience. we had a lot of fun, visit some amazing beaches, did a lot of snorkeling and had one of the best food in the philippines. team kalaw was so friendly, funny and available. jeffrey is an awesome guide and chef kit is a really really good cook (and karaoke singer). thanks to all the team for this unforgettable experience :) the campsites are very clean and new, the boat has good conditions and we always felt very safe. they also provide snorkeling equipment. bonus points for the karaoke machine and the coke+rum 😄 thanks again team kalaw!!!

we did an advance course and fun dives with blue marlin, our instructor was ak. best instructor ever, very energetic, a cheerful person. she did a v excellent job in delivering the lessons, she also gave us her gopro to take videos when we didn't have one. highly recommend.

we did an impromptu visit and had an excellent time! we got a great tour from elizabeth and we learned a lot about toronto’s history. it was clear she is passionate about her work and it made touring the site that much more enjoyable. thanks again!

we did forest ski with héléne and snowmobile, lake fishing and snowshoeing with javier. we had the best time with them and enjoyed very well-planned activities and all their explanations and fun, and we even got to see three rock ptarmigans after finding and going after their tracks on the snow! thank you 🙏🏼 ✨

we did island hopping private tour and we end up here and didn’t go to the other islands my kids loved the jumping area. the water is so clear and you can do snorkeling and see fish and beautiful corals. the food is great too. they also have fresh sea urchin. i highly recommend doing the stop here even if you don’t jump just swim and snorkel. the lifeguards are very helpful and friendly and one of them was kind enougj to show his talent in making bubble rings, just amazing. don’t miss this place when you go island hopping in boracay!
we did it in 2 days , 2 night , real big fun , the seconds days snow , we love the experience about +-45klm
we did magnetic hill trekking in leh, in the morning time of may ending. nice experience. though the roadway is downhill, it looks like vehicles are going uphill due to gravity.
we did not include the meal with our ticket as i was told that food is buffet style and mediocre. the two hour trip was very nice.
we did not try the food. we had fresh strawberry juice and it was really nice beautiful music, lighting and atmosphere. nice friendly staff. i definitely recommend.

we did parasailing, jet skiing and banana boating. they were all super fun with great views but very expensive. staff were kind except one girl who was quite passive aggressive and strange. i’d recommend for some family thrills - we bought the professional photos they took for €40 but they didn’t turn out that amazing as some were blurry.

we did seymour and daphne, the dives were nice but sad we saw no hammerheads the organization was okay but the we had the feeling that everything was in a rush, we didn’t have enough time to enjoy our meal because we already had to go of the boat and also between the 2 dives they said 45min but it was maybe 25 check also mawen travel on tiktok
