we did some wine tasting here booked through ef ultimate break. it was a great experience even though they give you very little wine to taste, the snacks were good tho! plus the view here is amazing.

we did sunrise sup with michael recently, and it was a really special experience. he is so patient and present, we were mostly beginners and he was gently encouraging throughout. we even had time for some breathing at the end, which was such a nice addition. wish i could do it everyday - 11/10, i couldn't recommend sup addict more!

we did sunrise sup with michael recently, and it was a really special experience. he is so patient and present, we were mostly beginners and he was gently encouraging throughout. we even had time for some breathing at the end, which was such a nice addition. wish i could do it everyday - 11/10, i couldn't recommend sup addict more!

we did the 1 hour ride for $190 each. make sure to bundle up with multiple layers! especially on your hands and feet. you’ll meet up in a heated yurt before heading down to the sled. for a two person group, one will sit in the back of the sled and the other will sit in front between the legs of that person. the sled ride was beautiful through the snowy forest. the dogs were barking the entire time as they were so excited to run. after the ride, you can love on all of the dogs which i highly recommend doing. they are all entirely sweet and cuddly! i gave some pets to every single dog there. then you will head back to the yurt for some hot chocolate and cookies before you go home. definitely a once in a lifetime thing to experience. the mushers know the dogs very well and the dogs we met will be racing in the iditarod this year!
we did the 1.5 hour desert tour with our guide santos. what a pleasure he was. overall very good value and worth every cent. we have done this before but this time was special!
we did the 1hour evening snowmobile safari. it was great. we were well looked after. the gear was in good condition and we had a very fun time. would recommend

we did the 2 day overnight trip and it was incredible, easily the highlight of our southwest trip. the guides are very knowledgeable and we had a lot of fun learning about the people, plants and animals that live around the canyon and history of the canyon. we stopped at some breathtaking spots for short hikes and had the opportunity to swim through rapids at one point. the provided food was great too, better than expected for an overnight camping trip, fresh sandwiches and fruit for lunches and dinner we had grilled steak and potatoes. i would definitely come back again it's quite the experience!

we did the 2 hour cabbage tree basin trip as a family of 4 (2 kids aged 9 and 11). this was a totally stunning trip and bruce was a fantastic guide - a great mix of letting us enjoy the experience and incredible scenery, providing local knowledge and making sure the kids were having a good time. i can't recommend enough - a really great experience and something we will definitely do again. thankyou bundeena kayak crew.

we did the 2 hour kayak tour with adventure dalmatia. i thought this was a very good tour and good value for money. you basically start by pile gate, kayak over to the pier area, on towards a cave area where you can swim and snorkle and then briefly across to lokrum before heading back. at €35pp for over 2 hours i thought this was good value. my only slight comments are that the guide seemed somewhat disinterested, it was a bit unclear at times where we were headed for, at times i felt we could have gone a little faster / less waiting around (albeit i understand there can be different levels) and i would have liked a bit longer actually kayaking (e.g. i would like to actually kayak around lokrum and spend a bit less snorkeling). however, for the price, it was very good and i enjoyed it.

we did the 3 day/2 night boat trip with melvin and the crew and it was by far the best thing we did in the philippines! everything was on point, the whole crew did an amazing job. we sailed, snorkeled, cliff jumped, visited a fishing village, ate amazing food, camped in beautiful huts, made jewelry, and made a million memories. this company has it down, they provide an amazing tour experience. you always feel comfortable and enjoy every minute of your journey. we have done a lot of trips like this in our 7 months in asia, this one stands out. i appreciate the fact that the beginning of the trip you get to meet the whole crew and introduce yourself to the tour group. the spread of food is truly amazing, flavorful, and every meal is delicious. sooo much food! melvin is a great guide, his energy is wonderful. he is always there to answer questions, share a joke or make a happy hour cocktail. happy hour starts @3, and it’s open bar. the overnight stays are beautiful, our first night we had a private acoustic performance and our very own fire dancing show. it was perfect. don’t think twice, book this trip and have an amazing time.

we did the 3 days tour from el nido to coron and it was truly the best experience of our entire trip (and if we dare to say even life). this is the best company you could go for! from day one, everything was perfectly organized. the crew was absolutely incredible — kind, funny, and always making sure everyone felt safe, happy, and included. the food was fresh, local, and delicious (so much better than we expected on a boat!). every stop along the way felt like a dream crystal-clear waters, untouched beaches, stunning snorkeling spots, and magical sunsets. sleeping on remote islands was surreal. they are extra careful about the environment which is also a very big plus! we had such a great group with french and filipinos which made the experience even greater. i don’t think i could recommend it more! thanks again so much to the entire team for making this journey so special! 🫶🏼

we did the 30 minutes sled ride for \$70 per person—definitely a once-in-a-lifetime experience! actually it’s our second time here! and i would do it again) bundle up well, especially your hands and feet. you start in a cozy heated yurt, then hop on the sled (one sits in back, one in front between their legs). the ride through the snowy forest was magical. the dogs barked nonstop—they were so excited to run! once they start running- they’d are content and not harming anyone-just doing what they like-running! afterward, we got to cuddle and pet every single dog—so sweet and affectionate. we ended with hot chocolate and cookies back in the yurt. the mushers were amazing and know their dogs so well—some will even race in the iditarod! olaf was our msged once and told us how he trains them and lives with them in the heart of alaska. have a ton of photos! it’s so exciting!! i was worried for dogs- but they are happy and well taken care of.

we did the 4 waterfall hike without a guide in about 4 hours with breaks at each waterfall. we went without a guide and followed the paths and a gpx route. there was some rain the past couple of days and it was slippery, but it's definitely doable. if you do want a guide, research a good one, not a hawker. we passed a couple of groups with guides and you can tell that some are much more useful than others.

we did the 4-day dessert tour with family-owned local company atlastrekkers and loved it. mahjoub was super accommodating and helpful when planning the tour as well as when we suddenly ran into some unexpected changes. such great service and kindness. same goes for our super driver abdo who took care of us with great kindness and attentiveness. he, for instance, proactively suggested additional tourist sites along our route when we were a bit ahead of schedule (which my history-nerd partner loved). the tour included amazing stays along the way in locally-owned guest houses and hotels off the beaten path which served amazing food.

we did the 4h snowmobile tour and it was amazing! i can 100% recommend it - our guide anne was absolutely amazing and provided an incredible experience while also telling us about some local points and everything we needed to know about the snow mobiles. we also stopped at a reindeer farm and could watch some reindeers in a beautiful snowy forest while eating chocolate and drinking tea. furthermore our group concisted of only 4 people - making the tour really exclusive.

we did the 5 islands activity by cataspeed twice during our trip to mauritius because we loved this excursion so much! there is nothing to say about value for money! we have time to swim with the fish, drinks are unlimited, we saw dolphins, the meal on the deer island is great as well as the boat finally, the crew is welcoming and attentive thanks again

we did the 5d4n cruise at the beginning of january and to this day it's our philippines highlight. dadu and his crew were very hospitable and paid attention to the small details to make sure that everyone had a great time on board. even though the cruise might seem a bit pricey, we recommend everyone to invest into this awesome experience. some of the stops were in bays with boats from the 3 day cruises but the two extra days allowed us to also explore more remote islands and enjoy snorkeling, kayaking, cliff jumping, fishing and beach walks. the beach camps were simple but nice. we could charge our electric gadgets in the evening and were served delicious food 3-4 times a day by chef nino. bring your own fins or rent them for 500 pesos in the office the day of the briefing. 10/10 worth it. ask for dadu and benji to be assigned on your cruise, they're the best. ☀️

we did the 5km tour and it was awesome, loved every second of it. yeah you can then spend time in the park, but really it's looking at dogs in cages. if you like patting dogs through a cage you'll hang around for a while. really it's all about the sledding experience, it really is very good!

we did the 5km trail which i can definitely recommend. some parts are more open like the viewpoint, while others are more dense jungle areas. the black lava rocks are beautiful to walk through. bring good shoes!

we did the 6 night trip in september 2023. what an experience!! the beauty of the grand canyon is breathtaking. our guides made the trip so enjoyable (ben, dan, paco, and hank). this trip is no stay at the hilton. you need to be able to tolerate being outside for a week and all that comes with that, and being cold and hot many times a day. you are well fed and provided for by the guides. there is plenty of space on the boat for your favorite beverages. the river can be intimidating at times, but the boats and guides are trustworthy. the stops and hikes along the way are spectacular! we highly recommend this trip for the adventuresome. check out our trip on youtube. https://youtu.be/xwjzkkypsw8?feature=shared

we did the 6pm hummer jeep tour. our guide was so fun. he knew a lot about the area and encouraged questions. the views were beautiful. the seats were comfortable. i found that the middle row was the best. the back row was the most bumpy of that's what you are going for. would highly recommend

we did the a day tour to cape tribulation, mossman gorge, daintree rainforest including the river crocodile cruise these guys are amazing! especially our young tour guide ...i think tom (hope we are right) before we describe our experience in great details, let it very clear, this was amazing tour as per what they are offering..including the crocodile river cruise. the reason we chose this one was that it almost includes everything that we would like to do in cairns / port douglas other than the great barrier reef, of course. also, it allows us to reduce our carbon footprint and last and definitely the only other reason was that we did not have much time on our hand. the itinerary is just correct, and offers you exactly what they have mentioned. the guides are fantastic and knowledgeable and friendly, with plenty of stories to learn and know. now, our only personal disappointment with regards to the tour was the lunch. the quality of food was very average (not to forget the portions as well). one can argue that during covid lockdown that's what the cafe could offer...and.the only cafe open yet the morning toasties at the mossman gorge were way better and filling than what we ate. now the disappointment that has absolutely nothing to do with the tour or the company. we take full responsibility of this disappointment, and are only mentioning for those who would ideally prefer some longer trail-walks / trekking opportunities: if you have time constraint and book this one then don't expect lot of walking and quality breaks and if you have lot of time on hand, please don't book this one, and try finding an itinerary that does all these places in a span of two days. since this itinerary covers up everything that is a must see around the area in a day's time, it was unjustified for us to.expect more than what we already did. also, because it was during summer season we did the crocodile cruise, we did not get to see much action, nevertheless we enjoyed if.

we did the all day great barrier reef dive. we chose the open water two dive option. from the time we got on the boat to when we got back it was absolutely wonderful. the guides and staff were a blast to be around and so helpful. the breakfast and lunch were great and the dives were insane. there is truly nothing like it and if you’re looking to dive in cairns i would 100% recommend going with divers den!

we did the architectural guided tour. huw was fantastic. informative, honest, witty and extremely personable. taking us to parts of the barbican you would never see without a guide. providing information about the architecture and the architectural team who designed it. showing us hidden secrets. huw also brought the tour alive by giving an insight into life, birth and death at the barbican. all delivered in his unique and humorous style. we learnt so much and it makes you look at buildings in a more educated way. the tour does not cover any internal theatres. the conservatory had been hired out so we were unable to enter but we had reasonably good views from the outside. the kitchen restaurant has a very good selection of reasonably priced food. if you do a tour you get a 15% discount in the shop. if you get the chance to go to the amazing st bartholomew the great church nearby. beautiful 11 c church used in many films. ( 4 weddings & funeral) also damien hurst sculpture of st bartholomew.

we did the athabasca falls trip with jasper rafting adventures on aug 3, 2025. our guide was ollie and our bus driver was aaron. they were amazing! our kids are 7 & 10 and this trip was the perfect mix of beautiful views and exciting rapids. huge thank you to ollie for being so engaged with our curious and chatty 7 year old. ollie was kind, funny and shared some great facts about the area. our whole family loved being able to jump overboard and float along side of the boat for a little bit. we felt safe the entire time (even when our bus driver aaron had to take extra precaution to avoid selfish drivers in a hurry). we had so much fun that we purchased all of our pictures so we would be able to share with friends and family and remember it forever! we absolutely recommend jasper rafting adventures!

we did the bauhaus tour and i was very impressed. there is an informational video at the beginning, a tour of the gallery, and then a self guided tour with audio guides around the city center. it was so fun and there were definitely great photo opportunities. not to mention, the tschokes in the store are great purchases.

we did the bear and wolf tour with our guide, parker. he was the absolute best at making this day one we will remember for a lifetime. this was our first visit to the park, and it was so enriching having a guide to navigate us through and educate us on its history, wildlife and geology. of course on this trip, we were there in hopes of seeing a grizzly bear, and having a guide that knows their likely sighting spots is key. parker made an early decision to try a new area since the bears had not been seen in their usual spots over the past few days, and within the first 30 minutes, he had us on a mama bear and 3 cubs playing in a field. we watched them for a good half hour and moved on to another spot where he spotted a couple wolves. then we found another grizzly by the lake. we also wanted to do a little hike, and parker took us on a fun walk, and we at lunch at a scenic spot around the lake. i could go on forever about the day, but i'll wrap it up by saying yellowstone wild has great guides that are friendly, passionate and knowledgeable about the park. whenever we book another tour, yellowstone wild will be our go-to, and we would certainly request to have parker again. thanks for a great day!

we did the bear and wolf tour, parker our guide was fantastic, very friendly, really knowledgeable and happy to answer all our questions. we were not disappointed with what we saw - black bears, wolves, bison, elk, grizzly bears and a bald eagle. there were plenty of opportunities for drinks and snacks. to finish off we stopped at a lovely view point for lunch and saw trumpeter swans on their nest, a great way to finish off a fantastic day. thank you parker for an experience will never forget.

we did the blue safari tour with them. rally nice whole day experience with 2 snorkeling locations, lunch on the beach (lobster slippers, griller fish, curry, chips, etc) included in the tour price, sailing around island beautiful areas.

we did the canyon swing as a group of four, and honestly, we were terrified! standing on the edge with our hearts absolutely racing, we were all questioning our life choices 😂 but once we were off the platform, it was hands down one of the most insane and unforgettable things we’ve ever done. and the best part? we didn’t get pushed... they cut the rope. slowly.... that moment of suspense was so intense, we were screaming before we even dropped and laughing right after. kayla and her team were absolutely amazing. their energy completely transformed the whole experience. joking with us, hyping us up, and throwing in just the right amount of chaos to keep things exciting. you get to choose how you want to be sent off, which makes it super fun and personal (and maybe a little chaotic, in the best way). if you’re anywhere nearby, do it. you won’t regret it. huge thanks to kayla and the crew, you guys made our trip!!

we did the canyoning tour at heart creek canyon with max and it was absolutely amazing! max was such an incredible tour guide - he was friendly, super knowledgeable, gave great instruction, and was fun to hang out with for the day. we had such a blast learning how to rappel and getting to experience such a unique thing in the middle of the beautiful canadian mountains.

we did the complimentary tour (booked online in advance) and it was a great experience. beautiful displays inside and we got a taster of 3 delicious cocktails, including the sazerac which was the best we had in new orleans! the souvenir shop is great too, we bought a few little bottles to take home.

we did the cookie cruise with the family, including grandparents and a kid. everybody loved the experience. the hosts were friendly and fun, they shared lots of fun and interesting facts (in english). the route is beautiful. there is a choice of drinks to buy in the boat, and the best part is receiving the freshly made and delicious cookie 🍪 still warm handed over from a bridge. the boat could be a bit tricky to get to/out from for people with limited mobility, but the staff helps and makes it easy. there are umbrellas in the boat in case of light rain for the unpredictable weather at amsterdam. a very recommended experience.

we did the cooking class with chef omar and nelson as our host. it was the highlight of our stay. great way to experience the culture. they were attentive, thoughtful, and a joy to learn from. the meal and drinks we made were delicious too. highly recommend

we did the daintree tour last week and it was a great day, the pick up from port douglas was on time which surprised us as there is so many roadworks between cairns and pd 😊 our guide/driver was a font of knowledge and information about all aspects of the area, made the trip so interesting. morning tea and lunch were very nice and the ice cream to finish the day was yummy 😋 the only small disappointment was that when i booked our trip i looked at the detailed itinerary and part of the bloomfield track was included which we were looking forward to, i understand that circumstances have changed but it might pay to amend that diagram. all in all a great day, thank you cheers lizzie

we did the daintree tour with uncle brian’s and had an unforgettable day. the whole experience was fun, well-organised, and full of good energy. our guide will made everything even better with his positivity, humour and care for everyone in the group. he was very thoughtful with a deaf participant, making sure she felt comfortable and included, which really showed how much he cares. on top of that, he even brought back my flip flops to our hostel after i left them on the bus. we had such a great time and we’re really grateful. uncle brian’s is lucky to have will on the team, we wish him all the best!

we did the denali peak experience. it was absolutely amazing. chris was our pilot from denali air. he narrated along the way about what we were seeing and told some great stories. he went out of his way to create as smooth of a flight as possible.

we did the denali peak experience. it was absolutely amazing. chris was our pilot from denali air. he narrated along the way about what we were seeing and told some great stories. he went out of his way to create as smooth of a flight as possible.
we did the diamondback gulch trip. our driver, white wolf (nate) was great. he was knowledgeable of the area and made the off road trip tremendously exciting.

we did the dolphin and snorkeling tour at bandar khiran today. highly recommend this one the snorkeling was very nice and very different from dimaniyat island. we were especially impressed by the great boat crew and wanted to thank ibrahim for his hospitality. we did hotel pick up and return. our driver isham did a great job too, and took us by the presidential palace on our way back to the hotel which we really appreciate it. overall, highly recommend this one, and it was a great value for the price.

we did the donut, flying fish, and parasailing. the three experiences were amazing but we liked most the donuts and the staff there were amazing as well. idha, prima, mario, feri, and batur were amazing people very hospitable and very fun. thank you so much for the best experience. 🫶🏼

we did the drangarnir boat and hiking tour and it was truly amazing. the boat ride was well organized, easy to find and board. the company gave us enough time to explore the place and take photos. awesome and must do experience when in faroe.

we did the excursion june 4, 2025 and would highly recommend. in addition to scuba helmet experience we also did snorkeling, swimming with bull sharks/stingrays, and picture with sea lion. the pricing was great for the time spent and activities you get. super friendly fun staff on the boat! 10/10

we did the excursion june 4, 2025 and would highly recommend. in addition to scuba helmet experience we also did snorkeling, swimming with bull sharks/stingrays, and picture with sea lion. the pricing was great for the time spent and activities you get. super friendly fun staff on the boat! 10/10

we did the excursion to catalina island and absolutely loved how they combined nature, a bit of dominican republic history, and great energy throughout the trip. a perfect experience for anyone looking to enjoy an unforgettable day.

we did the farm tour and it was lovely! great for 5 year old boy to see and walk around. not too long of a walk. great for kids! the dogs are so sweet and cuddly. would definitely come back to do other tours! thank you!

we did the four day three night trip starting at bar10 and ending at lake mead. the scenery was great, the guides were awesome, and we enjoyed all the food. would highly recommend this rafting company and the smaller rafts. thanks walker, abe, steve, john and all the other guides!

we did the free 2 hr walking tour (6-8 pm) with matteo from our hostel (backpackers villa). it was really great and i highly recommended it. matteo was very knowledgeable, fun and engaging. he took us to places that we would’ve never gone on our own and took some great pictures of us.

we did the free walking tour as well as the mount of olives tour with shahkar today and it was just incredible. he's a real treat for the ears and the eyes ladies! excellent knowledge and very well presented. he gave us tips on where to eat and all in all, we enjoyed both tours very much. can highly recommend! we've booked a few different tours with this company. looking forward to the rest!

we did the freedom tour on the loch ness cruise boats which included a 50 minute visit to this castle. lovely green space full of plenty of things to see. information boards around the ruins that give you an insight on what the castle would have looked like. great shop and cafe a slight walk up the hill but definitely worth it. we enjoyed going to the loch edge which is down a few steps at the entrance of the castle. overall a lovely little vist

we did the full day buggy tour and had an amazing time! angela was our booking point of contact and answered my many questions quickly and completely! charly did our hotel pick up and drop off, he was timely and personable. marianne was our guide for the day and she was a 10/10! we saw parts of dr that we never dreamed of being able to experience. marianne has a close bond with the locals and was knowledgable about the culture and land. she also took great photos through out the entire day for us. the entire process including the route they travel as well as their association with locals makes for a truly wonderful day filled with culture, fun, and beautiful views. we researched excursions at length before deciding and could not recommend xtreme buggy enough!

we did the full day cape tribulation tour with tomas as our guide. he was very diligent and funny. the weather wasn't great but that just makes me want to go again. we saw crocs, snakes, spiders, beautiful plants butterfly's and awesome scenery. thank you tom number 1 you made us have a great day with your humour and kindness.

we did the grand tasting, and it was really great. excellent value for money, and the wines were delicious. the tasting expert was lovely and really knowledgeable. the sea views whilst tasting were also really special!

we did the guided 90 minute tour and then the 30 minute cultural experience. both were great, but the tour was amazing. there was no portion that felt slow. it was very informative and fun. the kiwi birds, the maori culture, the geothermal features all came together to create an all-in-one experience.

we did the half day nature ride atv tour (3 hours), and it was really great! small group, perfect for 3 hours, with intense secret passages! we had a great time special mention to alex for his kindness and good humor! i'd recommend

we did the hike to the falls yesterday after a couple of days at yosemite valley and other popular yosemite spots…but the views here did not disappoint and were equally majestic! from the sparkling clear water of the reservoir, the granite domes/rocks, multiple footbridges, the tunnel, the waterfall…this hike was quite amazing! ps: i did spot a snake on the trail (see video attached), so pls be careful and keep an eye out just in case!

we did the hour bike trip with our teenagers and loved it. our guide (willy) was very friendly and and the route he chose was great fun. his video taking skills while driving was also impressive. definitely worth booking this. especially if you have a bit older kids.

we did the isla mujeres catamaran with round trip transfer. we snorkeled, drank, ate a buffet lunch and for to have free time for a couple of hours. the tour was affordable and everyone was helpful and friendly.

we did the jasper skytram today with our guide pete. whistler’s mountain is incredible and so beautiful. the views of the area are breathtaking, but it wouldn’t have been as enjoyable without our guide pete. he made it an incredible experience; there was nothing he didn’t know; his knowledge of geology, climate, wildlife, botany and personal experiences truly made it a memorable experience. from before you even step on the mini bus till after you step off pete is so welcoming, friendly, attentive, obliging and you can tell that it is not just a job for him but something he truly loves sharing with visitors.

we did the jetski croc- spotting tour and it was my sister and i’s first time being on a jetski and we had a blast. the jetskis are very stable and go up to 80km/h which made it so much fun. the guide was thorough with safety measures and made sure we were comfortable before proceeding to the tour. we managed to see 3 crocs which was awesome and got photos taken off us which we paid for. we got really close to the crocs in their natural habitat which was really exciting. the mangroves and scenery are so beautiful. highly recommend doing this while you’re in cairns!

we did the kayaking tour with javier and it was a phenomenal experience. he was so knowledgeable and kind. we are not super experienced kayakers but he made us feel comfortable and gave us helpful tips. the mangroves are beautiful to experience via kayak, i would highly recommend this tour!!!

we did the kicker rock snorkelling tour with this company. they were great! entirely fluent in english and spanish and very friendly and helpful. we had tons of snacks and a tasty lunch and spent the afternoon on an amazing beach.

we did the living dunes tour with our guide thorsten. they go out with 2 groups in 2 vehicles. together with the driver of the other group johnny they made a wonderful team. johnny would scout out the reptiles and insects. thorsten told us that johnny's nickname was "johnny walker" because of that. thorsten provided a wealth of information throughout the tour of all of johnny's findings plus a great deal of geological and historical information at times in 3 different languages. i nicknamed him "thorsten talker" lol. he was super knowledgeable. i absolutely recommend doing this tour and it is definitely worth your time and money!!! the namib desert is so beautiful! a word of caution though. if you have back issues know that the 4x4 ride can be a bit rough especially in the very back row. i had to move to the middle row, which was much better. also of course there is no toilet, so be sure to use it before the tour departs.

we did the long tour with 3 kids (youngest 6yo). took us 2.5 hours. nice walk around the volcano base with nice views. the walk might be challenging for the soundest one if they are not used to walk. we definitely enjoyed it ! don’t forget to bring water

we did the midnight sun excursion (10:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.). amazing views with the surrounding scenery and midnight sun. the halfway point was stopping on a wild island to enjoy the views with tea or hot chocolate & biscuits offered by the guide. our guide, lea, was great!

we did the muyil trip with this agency. lovely escape into the nature. we booked the tour through a hotel, were picked up at 7am and returned to the hotel at 2.30pm. the tour was very well organized, we picked up other participants, had breakfast at their out-of-town headquarters and continued with a 5-minute ride to muyil side of the sian kaan reserve. we embarked the boats (groups of 6) and explored around the canals. the highlights of the trip were floating down the canal, seeing a crocodile from up close and catching the sights of the manatees. the downside was that we didn’t get to see the mayan temple, but rather a very small monument. all in all, i highly recommend the trip. however, i must point out that it is slightly overpriced for a half-day trip (promoted as full day). we paid 2200 m$, but i know the price is very comparable to other providers.
we did the noche de museos and had a fabulous visit. great place!

we did the open door helicopter for three plus the driver over the delta and had a great time. beautiful views. felt very safe. friendly pilots. easy process from the hotel to check in to flight. we had a wonderful time! lots of animals viewings and a beautiful sunrise.

we did the paddleboard/kayak tour and it was legit one of the best ways to start the day. super chill, great vibes all around. todd was our guide. super awesome guy. he showed us the ropes, made sure we were good to go, and by the end we actually felt like we knew what we were doing. big thanks to todd! highly recommend this tour 💯🤙🏽

we did the party cruise with snorkeling and a visit to a calm lagoon for rum and cokes and music. for 49 per person,a 3 hour tour, it's great value and we enjoyed it thoroughly. this is a legit tour operator focused on customer satisfaction and safety.

we did the puno food tour with richard. what a great evening! we sampled various local specialties and enjoyed chatting and joking around with the vendors. richard facilitated everything and we were confident to try all the street food offered. he knows what vendors are hygienic and you can taste everything without worries. the food was a bit heavy on the sweet side but perhaps that is the peruvian palate. get out of your hotel and live like a local for an evening!

we did the raptor tour and we had a blast! the staff is really friendly and pleasant to talk too. they will accommodate you and guide you so you can enjoy the experience to the fullest! they will tell you interesting facts about the location throughout the tour. definitely give them a try if you are in the island! they also really try to conserve the natural beauty of the place and keep the ecosystem alive. just make sure you make an online reservation even weeks in advance if possible because they book out really fast.

we did the sunset cruise. the dinner while not exceptional, but was good. the live music was quite enjoyable. the tour was narrated and i got many of my questions answered about nola, but it was not so jammed with facts and dates that it made your head spin. the sights were beautiful! this was our last night of our trip and was a relaxing, wrap up to an amazing trip to louisiana.

we did the sunset paddle and had a great time. i took my two teenage daughters and it was the highlight of their weekend. alex was our guide and he was knowledgeable, fun and professional - and watching the sun set over the pacific ocean from a kayak is something everyone should do once.

we did the tea tour which i really enjoyed. we did do the full process, from plucking some tea to tasting it. the guy explains it very well and is enthusiastic about tea. he is that much into tea that he wakes up each morning before sunrise to make his own white tea. if you want to know more about tea or want to try to make it at home (like us) i would definitely recommend this tour. ofcourse , if you want to buy/drink some tea you can go here as well.

we did the teotihuacan tour and we enjoyed it very much ! our tour guide alan was amazing , passionate and knowledgeable and we learned a lot from him especially the way he was explaining the history and the culture . the bus seats were super comfortable , our driver herman was very polite and we felt safe all the time . it is a long day but you do not feel bored not even for a second ! the restaurant even a bit touristy, had delicious food , enough options for every palette, they also offer buffet options , drinks were good and so was the service . the workshops and souvenir stores next to it did not feel like a tourist trap at all and we had fun tasting tequila, pulce and meszcal ! i recommend doing this tour first and then visit the anthropologie museum and the centro so you have a better understanding of the exhibits

we did the tour to mykines with outdoor today and it exceeded all our expectations! :-) on the ferry ride to mykines you pass drangarnir and tindhólmur and get to see them from very close. from mykines port we were picked up from our local guide guðmundur and were warmly welcomed in „mykinesstova“ where we enjoyed a nice cup of coffee with homemade cookies. „mykinesstova“ is a traditional faroese house and is owned for generations by guðmundurs family. nowadays, it is a little café, freshly renovated and lovingly furnished. you feel like home. :-) when heading out of the village we also had the chance to watch the shearing of faroese sheeps who live on mykines. afterwards, guðmundur presented us the best puffin spots on the island. he hiked with us off the beaten track which is only allowed for local people and so we could happily avoid the crowds in the main puffin colony. in a short lunch break we enjoyed the lovingly prepared lunch package with traditional faroese sheep ham. on the way, guðmundur told us a lot about the birdlife on mykines, the history and the life of faroese people nowadays and in ancient times. after thousands and thousands of puffin sightings we headed back to the lovely small village where we enjoyed homemade fish soup and freshly baked cake in „mykinesstova“. to top it all, before the ferry brought us back to vágar, guðmundur showed us around in the village and we got to see some traditional faroese houses even from the inside. guðmundur is a experienced local guide and really gave his all to make this trip outstanding and unforgettable for us! if you would like to visit mykines with a local and off the beaten track, we highly recommend to book the tour with outdoor! :-)

we did the tread lightly glacier hike at athabasca as part of our trip to jasper national park. we had don and myriam as our guides who were fantastic, knowledgeable and very cool people to go hike the glacier with. the hike was amazing as with the rockaboo team they really take you out and away from the main trail to show/teach you about the amazing glacier. once on the glacier itself that’s where the team really really come into their own. being able to experience this and see so many features on the glacier itself made this an experience of a lifetime. it’s also helpful that don is a great photographer and sets you up where there is a great shot to be had! if you’re thinking of booking a trip onto the glacier, ditch the bus or another company and book with rockaboo. you won’t regret it!

we did the tulum & snorkeling with turtles and had a great time! the transporters were easy to find and transitioned well from one van to another. the guids at tulum were very knowledgable, the restaurant we stopped for food was fantastic (authentic mexican food), and the snorkeling was so much fun! it's good for beginners too, they give you a quick lesson on how to use the snorkeling equipment. will definitely do this again!

we did the walk in bad weather, cold and wet but it was well worth it. we hadn't done a hike before so if your unfit or not so nimble on your feet beware because it's quite hard. not sure what it's like in the spring/summer. definitely worth it as it's an experience. only gripe we had was the sign posting for it is non existent but the trail itself was pretty clear on the floor.

we did the workshop here and had a great time — the instructor was fun and engaging. you get to make your own chocolate bars, and the quality is excellent. we also tried their chocolate-covered strawberries and two fantastic coffees — everything was top-notch. great memories made.
we did the zip line experience with anna and brandon, lots of fun and pretty views.

we did this as a group of 10. the name of the company alters expectations a bit. there is not much extreme too it. that being said, once we settled into the realization of what the actual experience would be - it was amazing. it is a an open air tour of small towns, highways, back roads, and some beach trails. there are many stops along the way where you get an immersive experience of the dominican culture. it was absolutely great. beyond great actually. one of the best tours i have ever done. it just should be marketed properly, and they would probably get even more business. highly recommended for what it is. it must be noted that the owner is a bit grumpy and tends to bark at you when you spend the first 30 minutes or so in their orientation. not accustomed to this after handing someone nearly $2000. just grin and bear it. he is evidently smart enough to know that customer service isn't his forte. he stays behind; his wife does the actual tour; and she is awesome!

we did this beautiful hike just after the rains to see the waterfalls. we did not hike up to devils peak - we walked the lower contour path. beautiful scenery of table mountain and the city below. the path is well maintained. a few big rocks to climb and some little streams but all very doable and safe .

we did this hike 10 years ago and it’s still difficult. it’s an immediate decent and it does not stop. no matter how hard it gets, just keep going as the view will be worth it. make sure you have plenty of water, wear sunscreen and have a cap/hat for sun cover. there is no shade. take your time, enjoy the different views. knees sleeves are recommended if you have knee issues.

we did this hike quite quick because we had good hiking boots. it becomes quite vertical from the very beginning but since it hadn’t rained the ground was dry, having good traction. the hardest part is the sun blazing on you. have plenty of water and good shoes and you’ll get there quick. the breeze at the top was absolutely amazing.

we did this walk on a nice bright day, and it's a comfortable walk, with a variety of paths, a couple of tunnels where you will need your phone lights. it is interesting to see the historical water infrastructure. make sure you have water with you. at the start/finish there is a small but very good food truck, so you can get a reviving expresso

we did tour a with haqqy life and enjoyed the day very much. the day consisted not just of travel destinations and snorkel spots, but of fun activities with the group as well. the animators did a great job, the music on the boat was awesome. after the tour you can exchange some prices won during the activities at the friendz hostel rooftop bar for shots, great way to end the night with new friendz. ✨

we did two excursions with wild about lapland: ski trekking and visit to korouoma canyon on two separate days. ski trekking took place around saarenkylä and our guide guillermo certainly knew his nature, with this being his 5th season. the start was a bit chaotic, as every excursion was getting suited and booted. boots and overalls were provided and the option to leave bags/coats (at your own risk) was possible. the ski trekking was 4/5, i felt that it was a bit gimmicky as walking similar (if not easier), but my partner enjoyed it. this was not cross country skiing, we were not sliding on pre existing ski tracks (go to pyha or lusto for that). furthermore, if you have big feet (size eu 45 or above), you can't really use the ski's as you can't secure yourself onto it as i found out. they were kind enough to refund me 50% back. guillermo was brilliant with telling us the background nature, flora and show us fire making finnish style for a standard sausage lunch. our 8 hr excursion to the frozen waterfall was certainly one of the most memorable elements of our trip. angelo was a good guide, who helped us with the icy path and more difficult treks down. the journey to the waterfalls is about 3 hrs, there and back, and we hiked for approx 4 hrs with a lunch break in between. there angelo gave each of us to create fire and cook the standard sausage lunch. spikes were provided. 5/5 also you can store your luggage there safely for €5 if you were a customer and €10 if you weren't.

we did two private tours with these guys this week. c then a. can't say enough about them. the staff at check in was super friendly. the boat crews and our guide, ollie were fantastic. beautiful beaches, awesome lunch and a few killer snorkeling spots. oh, and kayaking in big lagoon. we had so much fun and can't wait to do it again.

we did two snorkeling boat tours (one in flic-en-flac with another company) and the 3 islands boat tour with ocean's whisper. the difference between the two was heaven and earth. alex was an incredibly kind & wholesome guide. we had a great time with him. and that "mauritian coffee" was something else 😅 merci à nouveau alex, c'était vraiment magnifique ! 😍

we did two tours with this company - both great tours. we did the cape peninsula and wine lands tour. our guide and wellington were amazing the whole time. very informative and gave us a lot of time to look around on our own as well.

we did whale watching and snorkeling with dolphins and were incredibly lucky with the animals - what an experience! the guides were fantastic and very caring when some people got seasick. they also provide free drybags as well as water- and windproof jackets, which was super convenient. communication beforehand and the booking process were also super easy and reliable. highly recommended!

we didn't do the full trail: we walked about 3.5 miles then turned around and came back (making 7 or 8 miles total and 1059ft elevation gain). it took us 3 hours. overall this can be up to about a 20 mile, out and back trail with a campsite at the end. you can walk as far as you want but there is not a lot of shade so bring sunscreen and water. if you go the right way and go far enough, there is a petrified redwood you can crawl inside but we didn't see it. mile 0 - 1.5: along the edge of the river where you can see plenty of birds. you cross through a marmot colony as you go. at mile 1.5 or so you turn inward, toward grassy plains. we saw a herd of bighorn sheep just before we got to the turn. after this point there is basically no more shade for the next 2 miles. around mile 1.75 you go uphill. the gravel was slippery in place so you will want grippy shoes. you will see tons of marmots here too. the trail splits here, potentially from people losing track of the blazes as they go uphill. we followed orange blazes to the right, but accidentally ended up off trail a couple of times. the trail is clear and well-marked though, you just have to keep your eyes on it and don't follow others mistaken footsteps. mile 2 - continuing through grass, the trail narrows a bit, it seems like most people turn around before reaching the top of the trail. around mile 3 - there is a big boulder. you can't miss it. good place to get shade, but there are lots of insects. from here we could see 2 big bison sitting on the hills. just past the boulder is a sign where the road forks. we went left to see the bison. we turned around shortly after, for 7 miles total.

life. we recommend them 100%, and would book with them again in a heartbeat.

available, responsive and offered unmatched flexibility in everything: from dates, routes, accommodations, and even last-minute changes during the trip. we booked a private luxury safari through them — and i can honestly say it was significantly more affordable than going through any european agency. the whole experience was perfectly tailored to us. our driver and guide, godson, was simply outstanding. he knew every corner of tanzania like the back of his hand and always managed to find the best spots to observe wildlife, even in the most remote areas. his driving, tracking skills and warm personality made the entire journey even more memorable — a solid 10/10. the agency also organized our mount kilimanjaro climb, and once again, everything was handled with the same level of flexibility and professionalism. we chose a 6-day trek and were supported by a fantastic 13-person crew, including: • 2 amazing guides (special thanks to ami, our lead guide — highly skilled, encouraging and kind), • a summit guide, chef (the food was unbelievably good every day), • assistant and several porters who made us feel completely safe and supported the entire way. we are not experienced trekkers, but thanks to the team’s careful pacing, encouragement and care, we reached the summit comfortably and without any major issues. they truly helped us push beyond our limits in a way that still felt manageable and enjoyable. as we were on our honeymoon, they surprised us with thoughtful gifts, including personalized t-shirts and even a celebratory cake. it was a lovely touch that made us feel special and appreciated. to top it all off, the agency even arranged a charter flight for us from the northern serengeti back to arusha — seamless and perfectly handled. in summary, if you’re looking for a local, trustworthy, flexible and highly professional team, serengeti safari wildlife is a hidden gem. we couldn’t be happier with the service and the memories we now carry for life. we recommend them 100%, and would book with them again in a heartbeat.

we didn’t ski here but it looks like a fun, if very small, slope. (only one lift.) we will definitely come back for a run here if we can. probably good for early season skiing. there was a great view from the roof of the terminal and the food in the restaurant was top notch. i’d like to see it in summer.
we didn’t take the boat or kayak experience. was on the way to lunch so brought kids to stop by the black beach… nice windy weather and cool space for kids to run around or play with rocks/pebbles

we discovered bmr dive & water sports through google maps reviews. the staff was accommodating and willing to negotiate pricing. the experience was reminiscent of purchasing a car in the usa, where the sales representative frequently consults with their manager for approval. we participated in parasailing, banana boat, sea walker, and flyboard activities. overall, it was an excellent experience. the staff was friendly, cordial, and professional, and they maintained a strict focus on safety. for the sea walker activity, i highly recommend purchasing the photo package. although it may seem expensive at first glance, the gopro9 with dual screens captures stunning photos and videos that you can cherish forever on your own phone.

we discovered this dense green area of scrubby trees, bushes and plants on our walk back from the national gallery. the park is free, dog-friendly and spans multiple city blocks in the heart of torshavn. it is surrounded by a stone wall and has winding dirt walking paths.

we dived with jonathan and the team at dive resort seychelles again this year. the first time we dived with the team here was easter 2024 and the experience we had then was the main reason we decided to return to the seychelles. although the diving conditions are much better in march (we had some unbelievable dives - shark point being a real highlight), we still had an amazing time with dive resort seychelles this july. the vis was only about 5 - 8 mtrs but the dive centre picked suitable dive sites and made sure everyone from experienced divers through to total newcomers had a fun and really enjoyable experience. a great team, a great set up and the ideal choice for new and old alike. we highly recommend this centre. stuart, leanne & louis mcpherson
we do ziplining experience here!

we drove all the way up to the parking space and walked for 10 minutes. recommended to be 30 minutes on top before the sunrise. you have to be lucky due the weather, but it’s a really beautiful, not too crowded, spot!

we drove from british columbia to see old faithful. and like the name says… she was on time and what a sight! dang! well worth the drive . there are many to see in the area! walking around you will see many! lots to see . lots of shops to buy stuff . hotels to stay at. lots of parking! but busy on the weekend. still was easy to get a round. definitely stop here and expect to spend the day or more for sure!
we drove from greenwich towards the eye and it was very interesting with stories about the history of buildings and of the london itself

we drove from sacramento for a relaxing day in san francisco and decided to visit the botanical garden. the weather was perfect — sunny and clear, and the $15 entrance fee felt reasonable. we even found free parking along the park, which was nice. but overall, i expected something more impressive. the garden felt quite simple and we walked through it fairly quickly. there weren’t many areas that stood out or left a lasting impression. i thought we’d be amazed by unique sections or vibrant landscaping, but it all felt very average. also, the restroom situation was a letdown — only portable toilets were available, which made the experience feel less comfortable and not well maintained. it’s a peaceful place for a walk, but it didn’t meet the expectations we had coming all the way from out of town. i’m glad we saw it once, but we won’t be returning.

we drove here from the cancun hotel zone. on weekends, the area comes alive with vibrant shows and entertainment. it’s a safe and welcoming place, and the local mexican community is exceptionally friendly to visitors. parking is easy—you can leave your car on the street without any trouble.

we drove right to parking 2 to hike the lava trails. magnificent views and. great workout. yes, it is heavy stuff, but i’m a big fluffy guy (110kg / 240 pounds) but i made it without problems. 1 bummer, the young lady at the entrance was absolutely not friendly

we drove up to canada and spent one day in montreal and the 4 days in quebec city. lots to see here. in qc, we stayed at a small hotel in the old city so easy to walk around the frontenac and old city area. near the frontenac, the place de’armes is a beautiful little park with statues and many things to see. one night by champlain statue, we saw a circus act free. very nice.

we ended up getting lost and took the long route around the entire mountain. thankfully it was a beautiful day but once you find the janky fence that marks the trail towards the cave be careful on the slippery incline at the top. the views are epic and totally worth the hike.

we enjoyed a beautiful sunset kayak and snorkel and traditional greek meal with trekking hellas. the staff were so knowledgeable and accommodating. it was a beautiful way to spend the day in santorini. would highly recommend!
we enjoyed a nice morning with them. despite not optimal weather conditions, the team was able to find a group of (pilot) whales for us. thanks!

we enjoyed a one-hour round trip cruise on the seine. it was a smooth ride with beautiful weather, which made the experience even better. although there were quite a few people, there was still enough space, and boarding was quick and organized. the boat has two levels – the lower one is enclosed, and the upper one is open-air. most people aim for the upper deck, so if you want a spot there, make sure to be among the first to board. one great thing is that you can join the cruise at any time during the day, depending on your ticket, which gives you flexibility. overall, a pleasant and relaxing experience.

we enjoyed a trip with sean and his lovely dog suka in september 2022. we went into the backcountry of mount robson, on an overnight hike. sean took perfect care of us, really understood what we wanted from our description of the sought out adventure. his knowledge is impressive and made the entire trip so much more fun! we always felt secure around him, and would definitely book a trip again with him if we're back in bc, canada. i can only recommend doing a trip with sean !!

we enjoyed an hour long visit on our way to returning our rental car for our onward flight. entry is free; parking nearby is hit if miss. there were multiple pathways at various levels around the garden, which offers wonderful shade, calming water features, and some simple stone grottoes. some of the trees are spectacular and the different examples of blooming plants during late june was amazing. there were chickens and ducks, along with a couple of cats snoozing in shady corners of the park. as we didn’t have time enough to explore the entire garden, next time we’re on são miguel, we’ll build a long visit into a broader visit of the northwestern part of the city.

we enjoyed and relaxed two days over there. the trail was amazing on the upper yosemite falls and you can get an amazing view from there. the trail took almost 5 hours but really worth it. there are many parking lots in the valley but sometimes it’s not easy to find a spot if you go late afternoon.

we enjoyed coffee lab vienna. the coffee was great. there's clean restrooms for customers, too. we a chicken pastry that was so flavorful we shared it because everywhere we go, the portions are large.
we enjoyed kayak, owner is polite and nice person, highly recommended
we enjoyed our day at palawan waterpark by astoria. lots of activities to choose from. kids and kids at heart will have fun here.
we enjoyed our explorer package at bali exotic marine park so much, which included a lovely high tea and beautiful photos of the experience. would highly recommend it.

we enjoyed our full day tour to fitzroy island, the staff was really friendly, my husband and 7yo son had an amazing time at the snorkeling safary, they learn lots and also found nemo...the island is beautiful, the hike to nudy beach although a bit tricky in so parts, was totally enjoyed by my 4yo, lots of fish to see snorkeling close by. we hired kayaks on the island and had the best experience with the sea turtles popping up close to our kayak. the picnic lunch offered was generous and fresh with a chicken wrap, ham and cheese sandwich, apple, nut bar and a bottle water. we were comfortable and fresh on the bottom inside cabin, but people seem to enjoyed the open upper deck. the boat trip can be a bit bumpy depending the conditions but was 45 mins. really recommended the tour.
we enjoyed our short visit. it was a short walk from the parking garage.

we enjoyed our stay with you! the view and the location are truly indescribable! the rooms are large, as are the bathroom. however, what bothered me was that there was no shelf space to put your toiletry bag or anything similar. the lack of a hairdryer in the room was also not ideal. i then got a hairdryer at reception. we would definitely come back! the dinner at the restaurant was really great, very friendly and courteous! you have to have dinner here!

we enjoyed our time during the trail - it has many beautiful viewpoints. you get to see the insides of a jungle forest combined with the seychelles’ amazing rocky relief. we saw the fox bats flying above, stopped at the viewpoints and went down on a smaller beach portion near the end. it was very nice and we did it kinda at the limit, started at around 16:00 and got back just in time to see the sunset. i would not recommend to go there when the sun is strongest, there are around 10-20% parts where you are in direct sunlight. bring water! the trail alternates a lot between parts where you have to go up and down on rocky or earthy terrain. so, the effort required for the total of two hours is not neglijabile if you are not used to effort. also, we had trekking boots, but you can do it with some sneakers if you pay attention to the road and take your time.

we enjoyed our time here. everything was quick while we were there. the only downfall is on the slide, everyone just runs to the front desk and the person serves whoever is there without having any control over those who are actually standing in line. it gets a little confusing bc people are all over the place. they need to control the flow better. we also paid to get into the area across from the restaurant thinking there was an entrance fee into the place but in reality, it was only an area to relax. it wasn’t much but it would’ve been nice to know before we paid bc we were only trying to walk to the slide.

we enjoyed swimming here after experiencing some murky and shallow water at tortuga bay. the water is clear but there are not much fish. also, we were lucky enough to have a smaller group then those thatcame before and after us. if we had a larger group then the experience would be more diminished.
we enjoyed the coffee, pumpkin cake was fine, and the service was great. thank you!
we enjoyed the innerstadt tour, it was one of the highlights of our trip! we wanted to book on the day (note: low season) but this wasnt a problem and quickly arranged by phone call.
we enjoyed the mini cruise. christophe and halil are a professional team, divers who guided us through nice spots. the cabin was clean and comfortable. the boat is new and tidy. recommended!

we enjoyed the mount britton trail. you can see the tippy top of the tower from the parking lot and it seems very daunting, but we walked fairly slowly and steadily all the way up. you walk at about a 5-7 incline and there are places to rest along the way. the view from the top of the tower is worth the hike! and the walk down is super easy.

we enjoyed the peaceful serenity of the forest surrounding us. the staff made sure our visit was the best. it was a beautiful day and the view of the snow-capped peaks in yosemite was spectacular. be sure to use the directions provided by the staff when you plan your visit. there are a couple of routes that require travel on dirt/gravel roads.

we enjoyed the ride…loved the beautiful blue waters and mostly watching the dolphins. the crew was great and kind and made sure all the guests were treated with a very warm welcome. ample of fruits and beverages.

we enjoyed the ride…loved the beautiful blue waters and mostly watching the dolphins. the crew was great and kind and made sure all the guests were treated with a very warm welcome. ample of fruits and beverages.
we enjoyed this experience. rocky and heidi made the tour fun and very entertaining. lots of opportunities to get some insta/social pics. the way the art is displayed is fun for absolutely all ages.
we enjoyed this fantastic rafting experience in the amazing nature of interlaken. the enthusiastic team is just awesome and made us feel save and at home.

we enjoyed this fort during the day. was fun to explore on our own. a guide tried to join us but we did not find that helpful. was better to just walk and explore on our own. it was designed by the same architect that designed the forts in san juan puerto rico.

we enjoyed two delightful massages from a very kind gentleman. very attentive to personal boundaries and giving an effective treatment. insurance receipts available. price is also very reasonable compared to anywhere else. merci nos amis!

we enjoyed very much our trip to mongolia. we were part of the united airlines inaugural flight newark-ulaanbaatar so had no flexibility about the dates of the stay . nomadic expeditions the travel agency was fantastic and made our stay in the desert possible at this very early stage of the season. undrakh welcomed us in ulaanbaatar very warmly with the traditional blue scarf and it was such a good start of the trip ! she is a passionate guide and showed us all the facets of her impressive, ambitious, full of vibes city. she went the extra miles for us to optimise our stay in the capital during all our visits. she was sensational in anticipating our needs : she thoughtfully prepared a delicious snack basket for us and coordinated with the next day driver for an optimal transition and long journey to the desert . she advised us some shops and we are grateful as we came back with beautiful cashmere from …. the stunning shop on main square . i bought traditional earrings but noticed i was missing a piece . i was so disappointed and couldn’t believe that undrakh kindly offered to help me to sort it out . so impressed by such a great dedication. it is more that good customer service it is top professional service and we are so grateful ! we couldn’t have dreamed a better ambassador of her capital city. it exceeded our expectations. alma was a star guide in the gobi desert ! in spite of adverse weather forecasts ( freezing cold and thick fog in the mountains , sand storm in the desert she never gave up trying to overcome the elements ! she is an inexhaustible mine of information and has such a great sense of humour . we enjoyed every step we made in her company. she made sure every minute of our stay was rich , suggesting mongolian movies in the cinema room for example between 2 activities and constantly checked our comfort, desired pace of travel and satisfaction. undrakh and alma made our stay truly unforgettable. the drivers were also excellent, considerate and thoughtful. we drove 9 hours to go to the desert and thanks to their kindness and skilled & safe driving the journey was smooth . we were dropped on the way to a place where we could get a snack and very clean restrooms. every time they could they pointed us interesting things along the road, stopping us a the picture spot !!! the cars were always spotless and punctually ready for our discoveries. we enjoyed the river drive (we could even see a fox!), the walking sticks always available and the warm coffee with biscuits in the boot after our freezing walk to the frozen waterfalls!!! the three camel lodge is a gem ! and we had it all for ourselves! perfectly situated on a hill side …. are stunningly beautiful, tastefully decorated and mega comfortable . from our yurt we could admire a stunning view on the immensity crown with mountains and observe the wild horses coming to the community well. a unique spectacle! the common area is beautifully decorated and the bar very welcoming and the coaches with their thick soft blanket were an invitation to relaxation ! we must confess very happy to be able to stay connected with a good access to internet . we had so much to share !!!! all staff was impeccable, anticipating our needs and fulfilling our dreams like archery lesson . the lodge chooses carefully their partnership with the locals : the camel farm was a delightful moment in a cosy yurt! what an interesting encounter. the chef and the restaurant staff deserve our compliments for all the delicious and varied specialities they prepared for us! such a committed team such a synergy ! five stars merci to all of you from the three of us , for your faultless and exceptional hospitality. you made our dream come true !

we enjoyed visiting the national garden during the day. some sections of the walk offer shade, so there's no need to worry if you go during daylight hours. the place is nice and quiet, and enjoying nature there was truly pleasant. you'll also find puddles with turtles and fish, as well as a playground for the kids. there is a restrooms near the entrance.

we enjoyed visiting this during the day. entrance as only a few dollars per person. we spent close to an hour exploring all the nooks and crannies. lots of old cannons to see and a park like atmosphere.

we entered at 11:30pm and paid 3,000 yen entry. that was well worth it, because the club is nicely maintained and all the staff are very respectful people. we really enjoyed our time and the little show shortly after midnight. if you want a nightclub experience with a very relaxed, respectful atmosphere, this is what we found here. 11th of july 2025 edit: they do offer free drinks for favorable reviews, so keep in mind that the score here on google is biased by that. but everything i wrote above you can count on regardless of that.

we entered through passage on the left side from the wood museum (nejjarine museum) to a leather shop and they let us climb to the top and spend 5 minutes there. “the fee” we had to pay to a guy sitting there (not the most polite) was 2.5 € per person and they didn’t really bother us to buy things. the view was pretty good. not saying you have to go through there, but in case you want, you have the details :)

we entrusted carien from desert air africa safaris to arrange the air and road transfers for our 13 days trip in namibia in this may. carien and her company didn’t let me down. our trip went very smoothly and we were taken care very well. each driver arrived on time, very friendly and responsible. we really enjoyed the trip and experience in namibia. appreciate all the help carien and desert air africa safaris provided. highly recommend this company.

we entrusted guiding galapagos with planning our honeymoon and what they delivered far surpassed any dream we had for the trip. from the moment we landed, it was clear we were in expert hand; felipe and omar genuinely love these islands and take joy in sharing their wonder with others. stephanie at guiding galapagos arranged everything including a once-in-a-lifetime cruise at an excellent price, excursions with knowledgeable and entertaining naturalist guides and seamless transfers. felipe and omar always went above and beyond arranging restaurant reservations at the most idyllic spots and lent us top-quality snorkeling gear so we could explore the incredible marine life. they stayed in contact via wasapp and no question was too small to answer . every detail was thoughtful and catered just for us - they even decorated our room at casa ocean pier with balloons and gifted us a bottle of wine. such kind gestures created a truly wonderful trip with memories that we will treasure for a lifetime. above all, the team welcomed us like friends and genuinely cared about our experience of their home islands. thank you so much for looking after us so well. ben and emily

we expected to see the waterfall but got a full blown cultural experience that we will remember for a long time! william was a fantastic tour guide and showed us the way to the impressive waterfall, while giving context about the local vegetation. it’s best to bring good hiking shoes because the way there can be quite muddy if it rained before, as was the case for us. otherwise, they also have rainboots to borrow, but hiking boots should offer better grip. we then went to the lunch place to have a local meal starting with soup first, then a rice and beef dish and a fruit plate as dessert. the food was tasty and really authentic, i especially liked the beef dish. the last part was the coffee experience which really surpised! we first got an intro into coffee making and then went through all the steps (except the 3 werks drying in the sun of course) by ourselves. it was fascinating to see the process from raw coffee beans to an actual cup of delicious coffee. the locals really celebrate this process singing along the coffee making which was a really lovely experience. while making coffee we also got our shoes cleaned from the mud for a small tip. we ended the day with a beautiful view of kilimanjaro, truly a wonderful experience.

we experienced the highland safari over 15 years ago and have always wanted to return. our safari last week did not disappoint! the whole experience was a real treat, with 2 very friendly, helpful, and informative guides, beautiful weather, stunning views, and an abundance of wildlife to observe. the guides were clearly very knowledgeable regarding the history of the local area and landscape. we enjoyed a wee dram and shortbread at the bothy, whilst being observed from afar by a growing number of deer. the centre has expanded since our last visit, nurturing deer and barn owls, which were beautiful to see up close. we couldn't resist making a purchase from the many beautiful items in the gift shop. hopefully, it won't be so long before we return again. highly recommend 👌

we explored breathtaking areas, spotted plants of wildlife, and even learned interesting facts about namibia's culture and history along the way. the accommodation and meals provided were of great quality, and the team always made sure we're safe and enjoying ourselves.

we find many ducks around this place. we can see this government house only during certain times. it's an 1800s mansion. it's open from friday to sunday, do check out the timings before visiting. if you use a guide here, then you need to take tickets or else you can just go around the house you'll find beautiful rose flowers, the garden is maintained very well. you can walk around, there's a fountain in the back of the building.

we first booked the sete cidades tour and were lucky enough to have filipe as our guide. he was amazing and helped us get a better understanding of the most notable geographical and social features of são miguel. overall, a really enjoyable, good value-for-money trip around some of the most beautiful places in the western half of the island. we liked it so much that we decided to book the furnas night trip with the same company. filipe couldn't make it this time, but we were assigned another driver, pedro, who was incredibly helpful and generous, driving us to different spots of the village as well as the crater area and making sure we made the most of it all. highly recommended!

we floated down the seine on the most magnificent morning with captain natacha. the communication was clear on when or where to meet. we brought our own coffees, croissants and baguettes, and captain natacha supplemented with cozy blankets and classic parisian music. the tour was delightful with just the right amount of history and local information. we highly recommend this tour to anyone. well worth the price.
we followed google maps to get there. mistake! just go the opposite way of the crowds after leaving the ferry.

we found botegena boat rentals online and thought it was just another rental agency and that couldn't have been farther from the truth. from the start a true feeling of trust was established by isabella and it continued from there. she took great care of us during our adventure, ensuring everyone had a great time and things stayed in control. we were so thankful for the experience that we booked a second excursion with botegena and her during our trip. she again provided a world class experience, taking us to new places so it didn't feel repetitive. overall a 10/10 experience, all thanks to isabella!!

we found mohammed and his team extremely honest and very professional. they were on time to respond and provide all the details prior to the trip. what we liked the most was everything in the camp and the jeep tour was as per promised. morgan was more than kind to provide me with all the additional details and also help out in booking some of the commutes other than wadi rum. our guide for the jeep tour - ahmed was very knowledgeable about the place and we liked his happy go lucky attitude and openness with which he shared about his life and life choices. we were taken to all the places which are a ‘must visit’ in the dessert with adequate time to explore, climb and maybe just lay back and relax. the tent was very clean with two warm blankets, clean washroom with adequate water supply. the chef - the other ahmed was kind and prepared amazing food in bedouin style. if i go back to wadi rum again - would definitely contact the same team.

we found the jardin des plantes to be a remarkable collection of flowering plants, trees and a rose garden. the sculptures that fill the area are also very impressive. this garden is huge with an abundance of tree shaded seating. the grounds are beautifully maintained and the poppies are amazing.

we found this little place while awaiting an artist show at e11ven. had some outside seating, but we decided to go inside. it reminded me of an old school new orleans bar type of feel. it seemed like a place where you could have a conversation over some great drinks. thankfully, i was right. we ordered a few of their specialty drinks and really enjoyed them. the bar tender was very accommodating and shook the heck out of our drinks. i was quite impressed at his skills as i watched him make our drinks. prices were agreeable as a miami bar. place was clean and we felt safe. i really enjoyed the ambiance. the bathroom was covered in graffiti and was pretty cool. don't think twice about visiting this place. it was a great spot for some drinks in a dimly lit bar for a romantic date.
we found this place accidentally while walking around hanoi. such a hidden gem. tiny cosy area to walk around, really like it.

we found this place by accident and fell in love. it’s cool and quirky and also massive inside. there’s photo booths, a piano, a bookshop/seating area - it really is amazing. the section of food stalls with varied cuisine from around the globe was a real highlight for us. we didn’t get a chance to try a lot as we’d just eaten but we did try a cookie (i had the matcha) and it was so nice. we’d definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for something a bit different - it’s the perfect hang out and would even make a great date day/night or family trip.

we found this place one day before the tour and met the very nice owner yussuf. he gave us very good deal and you can pay with credit card with no sercharge. unfortunately i got very sick that night and couldn't go the next day. yussuf came to visit me, and he gave us a refund. it's such a pity that we didn't end up going, but i highly recommend this company! all the best yussuf😊
we froze like crazy!!!! minus 8°c in the "room" this refuge is on a ridge in gosainkud, and all the others are in a hollow. error of judgment 🥶

we go home tomorrow and it just so happened that the highlight of our trip was saved till today. cannot recommend highly enough, the boat was spotless the service impeccable the music great the scenery stunning and the food was the best we have had in mauritius - if thinking about it book a trip - if not thinking about it still book a trip - you won’t be disappointed

we got a 3 hour couples massage. it was well worth the cost. the ladies did a fantastic job on each of the 3 spa items. they did a masterful job of keeping the room at a temperature both me and my wife can enjoy! the only nitpick was the disposable speedo's for me were a bit small for my size, but it is what it is. they probably buy 1 size fits all. they also had one person that could speak enough english to explain the services. it's rare for a place with almost a 100 reviews to get 4.9 stars and from my experience, this is a 5 star establishment.
we got an awsome time, probably the best way to visit the city. reminded me some épisodes from emily in paris ! ❤️

we got dropped on the beach here on by boat and had a wonderful time with the family. this beach would have to be one of the prettiest beaches in the world especially if you get a clear sunny day. the colour of the water is turquoise blue and the sand is so pure. it’s a stunning place to relax and is the ultimate paradise. people would wait their whole lives to tick off a place like this on their bucket list. people will tell you it has a lot of vendors. if that’s not your thing walk through to the end of the beach it’s phenomenal. i think many people miss the best part of the beach.

we got fondue to start and steak for dinner! both were very good! the views were definitely the highlight! we were lucky and got a table right on the edge of the terrace but any table would have a great view. be sure to get to funicular early because there was a long wait.
