we had a fantastic few hours at calauit safari, we walked around with our guide who was so friendly and informative. we got to feed and take pictures with the giraffes, highly recommend. we drove scooters ourselves from coron town on a sunday and arrived around 2pm. so it's possible to do it later in the day without signing up to a tour. we had the place pretty much to ourselves (no queueing😉)

we had a fantastic half-day tour with dive point! from the punctual pickup at our hotel to the perfectly organized equipment distribution, everything went smoothly. the entire team was incredibly friendly and helpful. a special thank you to our dive guide, salum toro! he was not only super nice and caring but also very attentive. thanks to his experience, we were able to discover many fascinating underwater creatures while diving. the two dives were amazing and very well guided. the prices were also very fair, making the experience even better. overall, an absolutely recommendable experience – we would dive with dive point again anytime!

we had a fantastic motorized trip through the grand canyon with wilderness river adventures! richard, wilbur, monte, and lori were so accommodating. monte fed us more amazing history than you could learn in any course. they were so fun & kind & fed us great food. the sleeping cots and bags were comfy, and the views unsurpassed!!

we had a fantastic rafting tour with simon (owner and operator) and claudia our rafting guide. the location is simply stunning as you can see from the pictures, the rafting itself was gentle for my 9 and 7 year old but still challenging. i still don’t understand how claudia managed to convince my 7 year old to jump from from 3.5m into the cold river 🤣! everything is well taken care from the warm clothing, till safety, fun and timing. highly recommended!

we had a fantastic stay here. the rooms were clean and spacious. staff were very helpful. location was very convenient. best of all though was the pool area which feels like you're in the middle of a rainforest. also really appreciated the focus on sustainability and providing jobs to people with disabilities.
we had a fantastic stay here. we will definitely be going back with the family sometime. beautiful lodge, friendly, helpful staff, great food and chef, stunning area,

we had a fantastic time at amantani lodge! henri and mariluz were among the kindest people we've met on our travels—so warm, helpful, and welcoming. mariluz's cooking was absolutely delicious, and we really enjoyed chatting with them over meals. the island itself is stunning, with a circular walk around it and two temples you can hike up to. there's also a little square where you can grab a coffee or a glass of wine. since we decided not to book a tour, we were a bit unsure about how to get there. we ended up buying a one-way ticket on a tourist boat, and on the way back, we took a 45-minute boat to playa chifron (they leave every hour) followed by a collectivo to capachica, and then another to juliaca. henri and mariluz helped us to sort it all. i’d definitely recommend visiting independently rather than with a tour!

we had a fantastic time celebrating my sister’s 50th birthday! we did a roper romp(mrs. roper theme from three’s company)and our driver juan embraced us! he was fun, energetic, accommodating, and kind. he went out of his way to make sure we were happy and getting all we could out of the expedience. i highly recommend this tour and juan!

we had a fantastic time diving with captain ali's. the team is highly professional, ensuring safety while creating a fun and relaxed atmosphere. captain ali himself is very knowledgeable and made sure we felt comfortable throughout the entire session. the dive sites were absolutely stunning. i highly recommend this dive center for both beginners and experienced divers. looking forward to diving with them again!

we had a fantastic time diving with captain ali's. the team is highly professional, ensuring safety while creating a fun and relaxed atmosphere. captain ali himself is very knowledgeable and made sure we felt comfortable throughout the entire session. the dive sites were absolutely stunning. i highly recommend this dive center for both beginners and experienced divers. looking forward to diving with them again!

we had a fantastic time doing the sunset sup sip & cheese during our trip to switzerland. it was a real highlight of our holiday! we have never paddled boarded before but ismael put our minds at rest straightaway. it was such a fun experience even with slightly challenging conditions with some wind on the lake! we then stopped for a secluded picnic and enjoyed a fantastic selection of local wines and cheeses to watch the sunset. the return journey was also magical with the led lights on the paddle boards! ismael was fantastic from start to finish and we had so much fun throughout. 100% recommend making time to do this experience during your trip!

we had a fantastic time hang gliding in interlaken with bernie and ed. they immediately bring such fun personalities and humor, making our experience quite memorable and enjoyable. and of course, the sights are just absolutely stunning! bernie extended our flight time because he was chasing the “good air,” which was a great plus; he even let me drive for a couple minutes. i highly recommend this to anyone who wants to have fun!

we had a fantastic time here. bedouin roads has a particularly nice location, secluded behind a dune. they have been doing this a long time - this is land that our host zaid's father and his father before him had stayed on. everything that we wanted was organized by them - camel ride and jeep tours. there was also the possibility of sleeping a night under the stars. my daughter (9 years old) had a great time scrambling on rocks and seeing the stars at night. would love to go again!

we had a fantastic time in nile cruise and ahmed elsamman was extremely knowledgable and best guide possible. he was warm, nice and guided us for four days and showed us all the fantastic places. with him we were relaxed and enjoyed our trip and learnt about all the wonderful monuments and places, highly recommend him. thank you ahmed.

we had a fantastic time kayaking with matt. he was a great guide & full of interesting facts. he was fun, energetic & look after us all. he also took amazing photos for us. i would definitely do this again & would recommend paddle pirates. thanks again matt for a unforgettable experience.

we had a fantastic time on our swamp tour! our guide/boat captain (his name is escaping me right now—he was a former cop, firefighter, & military) was great! he was knowledgeable & funny. he made all of his guests feel at ease with being so close to the gators. you could tell that he had a passion & love for these amazing animals. i would highly recommend!

we had a fantastic time on our swamp tour. our driver was very skilled and also very knowledgeable of the area. we even got to get up close and personal to a 12 foot gator who came up to the boat to say hello. this was the highlight of our new orleans vacation!

we had a fantastic time rafting the athabasca river in jasper with our guide, eddie, who has 30+years of experience.. everything was well-organized — we were fully geared up with wetsuits, jackets, shoes, and life vests. eddie was an excellent instructor. he clearly knew the river inside and out, and his calm instructions and sense of humor kept us relaxed and laughing even during the splashiest moments. along the way, he also shared fascinating facts about the river, mountain ranges and wildlife. whether you're a first-timer or an experienced rafter, i can’t recommend this experience enough — especially if you’re lucky enough to get eddie !

we had a fantastic time with jamal. due to time constraints, we couldn’t do the full three-hour tour, but he customized a two-hour experience just for us and was extremely accommodating. to top it off, we had one of the best tea experiences in the heart of the medina, making the tour even more memorable. i sincerely thank him once again for his kindness and responsiveness. i wouldn’t hesitate to call on him again if i ever need a guide in fez.

we had a fantastic time with the guys. they made the entire process super easy. great email communication prior to the day and the rafting itself was awesome. we always felt safe and they made sure we had a great time. they were really good with our teenagers and kept them engaged. the equipment and van were top notch and comfortable. the wet suits were a must. the simme river tour was a great combination of fun rapids, swims, and beautiful views. looking forward to canyoning with them next.

we had a fantastic time! we were picked up at the dock by a friendly crew member who ferried us out to the island, about 10 minutes away. there, some knowledgeable and kind guides talked us through our options and made sure we were safe and cared for. we particularly enjoyed the parasailing and the glider ride!
we had a fantastic tour with nick! the hidden wine cellar tour was amazing! we had no idea what was hidden under the streets of vienna! 100% recommend!

we had a fantastic tour! derek was very friendly and relaxed. we were able to enjoy all the islands without feeling embarrassed that we had to continue sailing. during the tour, derek shared many interesting stories. derek helped us plan the trip. this allowed us to visit colorful murano early in the morning, ahead of all the tourists.we definitely recommend this private tour!

we had a fantastic tour, chandy our local guide was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the art work on display around his neighbourhood. we got so much out of the tour that walking by ourselves we would have missed! highly recommend this!

we had a fantastic trip with the guide sigmund. despite a misunderstanding when booking, they fixed it so that we got an even better trip than we booked! their trip to hestur is a must. probably among the finest and most powerful i've seen in nature!! worth every krona.

we had a fantastic trip! huge thanks to khasab sands tours for organizing everything so perfectly. the staff were friendly, the food was excellent, and we had so much fun. absolutely loved it and can’t wait to return 😊

we had a fantastic upper loop van tour with austin in june. austin showed us tons of amazing sites, provided us with interesting information, and let us control the pace of the day. we saw wildlife like wolves and goats that we never would have seen without his knowledge of recent sightings. snacks and lunches were great. it was a great first day in the park to give us ideas of where we might want to re-visit on our own in future days. definitely worth the money to be chauffeured around on day 1 when we were tired from travelling there the day prior.

we had a few hours before we had to be at the airport for our flight so we thought we would pop here for some wine and cheese board. it was absolutely fantastic. the sound of the ocean, the brilliant wine and attentive staff made it such a wonderful and relaxing experience before we catch our flight. i would highly recommend.

we had a full and very enjoyable day with caucau on the catamaran tour of isla victoria and the arrayanes peninsula. it was well organised, and we took the option of transport from the centre of bariloche to thr launch point about half an hour away. sebastian was our very capable guide for the day, and provided both very good at english and knowledgeable about the flora and fauna we saw on our two “land” tours. food is available on the boat, and the trip across the lake and back was absolutely stunning. would highly recommend

we had a fun time exploring the thermal springs here. there are three sets of springs you can enter and one that has boiling temperature water so you cannot. the first and second were hot springs and the third was much colder but had a nice waterfall and picture opportunity. the second seemed to be the most crowded and the highest spring the least (probably due to the colder water). research told us to buy tickets to the first available time slot and i would pass that bit of information on. in the interest of time, i would also recommend coming dressed ready to enter the springs, as we were able to walk in and were the first group to get into the springs. we enjoyed a good 10-15 minutes at the first spring before anyone even joined us.

we had a good time at this museum on a rainy day! the tickets were cheap but were further discounted (be sure to bring your id) seeing everything in the museum took around 1.5 hours. there were so many amazing sculptures but there was also a photography exhibit as well as an exhibit with many ancient roman artifacts.

we had a good time visiting this temple, the “murals” (i don’t think that’s the most correct word to use) had striking colours and were very detailed. the story behind the lying buddha was also very interesting. one of my memorable place in sr, as this is where we met mr. sakhorn - a lovely man and tuktuk driver, who took us around and out the city, including the “grand tour” of angkor wat. i highly recommend him if you want to explore the city and wider sr area.

we had a good time when we visited nola. it’s a nice aquarium. lots of different areas to see. we loved the butterfly area. so many beautiful butterflies and they just fly around. we wished there was more animals to see and more variety of insects as it was a lot of beetles. it’s kinda pricey but we enjoyed ourselves.

we had a gorgeous sunrise on the harbour with sophie. with her coaching, great equipment and blessings of the wind we slid on past the imposing naval vessels, the beautiful gardens, watched a huge cruise ship go by and got up close with the opera house. (hope to meet the resident seal next time :) all the while being herded into prime photos and regaled with sophie’s enthusiasm and interesting history pieces. a whole new perspective for starting the day!

we had a great adventure. our pilot, mitch made the day perfect. he was so calm and had a great sense of humor. when we landed at the grand canyon, we had a lovely picnic and champagne toast. i would highly recommend!

we had a great day 2.5hr riding the horses on the beach and through the forest. angle and geo were great instructors and made sure we were having fun but also safe while riding. we stopped to have drinks on a beautiful beach before riding back. i highly recommend this tour. they also took our photos with our cameras and no extra charges to pay for photos.

we had a great day and derek was super flexible and took us out to see some amazing animals. if you are visiting yellowstone a tour is really the best option to optimize at least one day. it’s safer also with someone who knows where to go and then you can watch all the wildlife you want! thanks!!!

we had a great day at michaelmas cay & hastings reef. the crew were very friendly & knowledgeable and made the snorkeling lots of fun. yumi is brilliant at spotting turtles, & we lost count of how many we saw. the lunch was fresh and there was plenty of food for everyone. if you’re likely to get seasick, take some tablets before you get on board so they’ve got time to work. and maybe take some ginger beer with you. it’s also easier to wear your swimmers so you don’t have to get changed on the boat.

we had a great day skiing with lukas in lofoten. he is a terrific guide who clearly cares deeply for the mountains, his profession, and empowering people to have a great experience. he did a great job of supporting each member of our group’s unique level and needs, while building our sense of teamwork. we learned new techniques and skills and we thoroughly enjoyed the beautiful mountains.

we had a great day today with the guides at go adventure! we did the zipline and ended with the (optional) repelling at the end. 7 great lines ending with the drop felt like the perfect way to spend my adrenaline in costa rica! the guys were nice, patient, knowledgeable and fun.

we had a great day, our driver elijah was personable, accomodating and informative. the ranch employees were so nice, the pilot was fun, safe, kept our minds at ease and shared a lot of information about the canyon. we enjoyed the scenery on the way to and from the ranch, the hoover dam and grand canyon, was amazing.

we had a great early morning boat trip in one of the small boats. everything worked well, we got to see a lot of fish. we could have stayed under the surface for ever then we got lucky to meet up with dolphins as well. the guys on the boat were both great, helpful and attentive and the fruits were amazing as always.

we had a great evening!! such a nice view, very capabel and kind service. we ordered the platter of mixed tapas (vegetarian) and it was amazing! everything tasted really good. nice glass of cava to finish it off. thanks team, for this top evening !
we had a great experience at ella organic tea garden and learnt a lot about growing tea. we visited the farm, studied the tea procedure and enjoyed delicious tea. can only recommend the place.

we had a great experience at h2o sports. the check in process is smooth, especially if you’ve filled out the waivers online like they prompt you to closer to the date. there’s a space to wait in the back for the boat with the yellow cover that takes you over to where their water activities are. we just went for jet skiing but a lot of people on the boat had doubled up on activities (i.e. parasailing & jet skiing, banana boat & tubing). we did the tandem jet ski and had a great time, were able to switch on the water too. there were some additional costs. it’s $10 pp if we wanted to use their goggles which i think was needed for jetskiing. they used a gopro to take pictures and videos of us. when you check in, they give you a green pouch with the storage cards labeled for your party. when you get to their water activity dock, the people leading your activity take it and load it into the gopro. when you get back from your activity, you can look at all the pictures and video it took. you can either get all the pictures and video for $65, just pictures for $55, or just video for $55. you can’t pick and choose what photos you do/don’t want unfortunately. they email them to you in a link and you have 3 weeks to download them. everyone is nice and friendly. would go back!

we had a great experience at my friend's graduation. they gave us space for 14 people at the outdoor party. it was a tuesday, so i think we were lucky because it was a nice table. we had the special margarita and taco night. i recommend the blackened shrimp and the pork belly in guava sauce. scarlet, our server, was very kind and friendly. thanks to the manager for always looking after us. we'll be back!

we had a great experience at the sports shop in reine. the owner was incredibly friendly and helpful—he let us charge our power banks, helped us find a new sleeping mattress after ours popped in the mountains, and sold us camping gas we urgently needed. really kind service, and we’re super grateful for the support! highly recommended for any outdoor needs in lofoten.

we had a great experience at this gondola ride with an older gentleman in his 60s (william). he was very funny and mentioned he’s been in the business for over 40 years. he took us through the small canals before going out to the grand canal. he stayed true to the 30mins also. i can testify that he is great and would recommend to anyone looking for an honest hard working gondola!

we had a great experience here. entrance is free, and there’s a small shop where you can buy souvenirs and local pineapple products. there’s also a nice spot to sit, relax, and sample some tasty pineapple-based treats.

we had a great experience here. oussama was very knowledgeable about the different materials and showed us the difference in quality, without being pushy. if you want to buy good quality you can get it here.

we had a great experience here. the rides are rather a little short from what i feel but it might just be the standard length for all i know. we got to do a reindeer ride, husky ride, got some good information from the local sámi community and were dropped off at the santa clause village at the end! a well worth experience!

we had a great experience hiring 2 e-bikes for a self guided ride around queenstown bay. booking online was really easy and made for a really quick pickup and we got on our way. staff were knowledgeable about the trail with great tips and a map. bikes were great quality and mechanically sound. we will hire again for sure. thanks

we had a great experience on the half day tour. juho, the owner, was very welcoming and takes great care of his dogs. the trip was fun, and we enjoyed the camp fire at the end as well. would definitely recommend this!

we had a great experience paragliding! the booking process was very easy as well as the pickup instructions. they picked us up on time and drove us to the jump off point. gave us very clear and easy instructions on how the whole process worked. my instructor chris did a great job of making me feel comfortable and safe the whole time while also making sure i had fun throughout the entire thing. it was such an amazing experience and the views were great and stunning!

we had a great experience paragliding! the booking process was very easy as well as the pickup instructions. they picked us up on time and drove us to the jump off point. gave us very clear and easy instructions on how the whole process worked. my instructor chris did a great job of making me feel comfortable and safe the whole time while also making sure i had fun throughout the entire thing. it was such an amazing experience and the views were great and stunning!

we had a great experience using natural world safaris! faith helped us to organize our custom safari and she was outstanding. we had a lot of questions and she always answered them promptly and thoroughly. she helped us plan a safari itinerary that was perfect for what we wanted. our guide was prince and he was clearly very experienced. he was very knowledgeable about all of the animals - even the smallest birds, insects and lizards. his taught us the need for patience while animal viewing. because of him we were able to see a pride of lions make two kills and were able to see a huge male lion wake from a nap and walk super close to us (both of these times we saw that most other vehicles came, saw that nothing was happening and left after five minutes). the lodges chosen for us were fantastic — from the food to the service to our rooms (3 out of 4 had decks with views of the watering holes). my only suggestion would be that the company change how they pay for lodges and park fees. we had delays getting in (and sometimes out) of every park - sometimes as long as 30 plus minutes. it was frustrating to see other safari vehicles zip through the gates quickly while we waited. and we had a problem checking into our last lodge which again caused a long delay. i think these problems could be solved if the company changed how/when they pay their fees. aside from this everything was excellent and i would not hesitate to recommend natural world safaris!

we had a great experience with our tour recently. our guide, elinor, was very friendly and knowledgeable. she especially tailored the questions and explanations for my 8yr old daughter to get highly engaged throughout the day. she also let us borrowed her special phone case to take pictures through a telescope lenses. if we didn’t book the tour, we wouldn’t know what to look for in yellowstone, maybe except bisons. i highly recommend this tour to anyone who will visit yellowstone for the first time.
we had a great experience with the group ski session as complete beginners. definitely try the toboggan track, sounds like it’s for kids but it was intense and fun. recommend goggles though!

we had a great experience with this boat tour. it was private for my daughter in laws wedding. the whole crew were super nice and engaging, especially gregory. i don't swim, so he actually carried me out to the shore so i could enjoy the fun. would book with them again in a heartbeat. thank you for a terrific day!

we had a great experience with this tour company. alexis was fast to communicate from the very start and was flexible with us. our guide carlos and the other staff on the boat were so kind, kept things fun and told us lots of information. we appeared to have a slightly smaller boat than some of the other tour companies which meant we got closer into the tunnels! also, our guide took amazing pictures and videos of everything on his gopro which made things even more special!

we had a great experience! everything was smooth and easy going. the sights were beautiful, the helicopter was comfortable, robert had great information about the area and what we got to see, the staff was friendly and it made for a really great day!

we had a great experience. the camp was located in a beautiful and quiet place and it was very comfortable and well equipped. the food was great. we saw a lot of stunning places and were always given sufficient time to really explore the area. and above all, the guides were very friendly, we had so much fun with them. they've all grown up there and you can tell they are passionate about this region of jordan. the owner is also very nice and funny. he was very generous and a very good driver :) we'd recommend this company for tours and hikes in wadi rum.

we had a great family private pool experience. reasonably prices, spacious pool (2 adults, 2 children), friendly staff, and we were accommodated when we arrived early. we did not try the public pools, but there were a reasonable number of people there, so must be good too. excellent views.

we had a great family trip for a week at meridian with two divers and two snorkelers. all staff we met were exceptional - fantastic on the boat, front desk, restaurant etc etc we visited a lot of islands and scootered all around and we were very happy we booked at meridian ! definitely the best raja ampat accomodation if these things are important to you: family friendly with lots of games and books and a great pool with sun loungers amazing food at the restaurant although more like nz prices very good air conditioning in rooms and dining area, comfortable beds and good options for room side by side for the kids, international power sockets so don’t need adaptor, good safe to put your passport (although prob don’t need it all all staff are very trustworthy and premises are secure) they are very eco friendly. no plastic which is great. bring your own bottle and you can refill from their great samsung filter - cold or hot water on both floors. so great to not be using tonnes of single use plastic bottles of water. also very careful with making sure all divers and snorkelers don’t harm the reef and damage coral. five stars for their eco efforts! western standard bathrooms and nice warm showers catered well for both divers and snorkelers full dive or snorkel equipment available to use with the exception of dive computers but you can hire for another dive shop around the corner if you don’t have your own (use a wetsuit as the jellyfish stingers itch as we found out the hard way!) - very good quality products (aqua lung)/ comfortable masks) amazing fast boats that get you to dive sites super quick so you can do two dive sites in the morning then get back for lunch and chill or go on adventure on the island. all the other boats we saw looked pretty slow in comparison so you can waste a lot of your time there on them! premises are lovely - it’s all so easy and chill once you are there - just the ferry trip is a bit full on for a western family (although meridian managed it very well and made it as easy as possible) but if not up for that then you can book at private boat although obviously more expensive safety outstanding on the boat. very careful with monitoring currents and weather. made it super fun but safe. ross and his crew had such lovely attitudes and were highly skilled. very low key people but structured and safe and really very caring and helpful. equipment obviously kept to a very high standard. they really made the trip special for us and genuinely cared about our experience which we really appreciated. safe to scooter around. people so friendly and polite on the island. drivers super polite all around and particularly with tourists. front desk so great with organising taxis to town or scooters. so easy! markets and blue river and village to the north fun rides. especially blue river amazing scooter ride. just go slow for the occasional pot hole front desk - communication great using what’s app. they are super responsive and really go out of their way to help. amazing attitudes - very genuine and caring people - just so lovely. some icing in the cake extras - a great range of cocktails nice around the beautiful pool area and not too expensive, and a massage in your room for a very reasonable price felt very welcome and will be back for sure !!!!
we had a great flight and great breakfast, despite the difficult wind at the take off! martin is a great pilot and we felt really safe thanks a lot! we would definitely recommand this experience
we had a great gondola ride with chiara. she was friendly and funny, and the route was away from main tourist spots.

we had a great jet boat & snorkel excursion. a great guide took us through some really great things to see around the reef. saw statues, plenty of fish, a couple sea turtles, and a stingray. the boats are fun to drive too!

we had a great morning with our driver/guide winton. he was able to tell us a lot about namibia, the history, the dunes and gave some very good tips about shopping and restaurants. we enjoyed the drive through the dunes a lot! it was a wonderful experience and very well organised, from the pick up at our hotel, the coffee on the way and the lunch, served with care and style. i would recommend this tour to everyone visiting namibia. thanks a lot!!

we had a great morning with our driver/guide winton. he was able to tell us a lot about namibia, the history, the dunes and gave some very good tips about shopping and restaurants. we enjoyed the drive through the dunes a lot! it was a wonderful experience and very well organised, from the pick up at our hotel, the coffee on the way and the lunch, served with care and style. i would recommend this tour to everyone visiting namibia. thanks a lot!!

we had a great night here with kids, we had delicious llama hamburgers and lamb tacos. in the morning we went kayaking to the trout farms across the lake. andres was an attentive, flexible, and all-around great host.

we had a great seabob experience with olivier and steffi! communication was clear from the start, appointments were met, conversation was friendly, equipment was professional. the experience itself was everything we hoped for. great weather, clear water, colorful fish. glad we decided to also order de optional video, wich we still enjoy watching every now and then.

we had a great stay at dao by dorsett amtd singapore. the room was spotless, modern, and well-equipped with high-level amenities that made our stay very comfortable. everything felt fresh, clean, and thoughtfully designed. the breakfast was excellent, with a wide variety of quality options to choose from—definitely one of the highlights of our mornings. what stood out the most was the kindness and professionalism of the staff. they went above and beyond to accommodate our needs, especially on our last day. since we had a late-night flight, they kindly allowed us to use the pool, showers, and other facilities well after check-out time, which made a big difference and allowed us to travel refreshed. overall, we had a very pleasant and smooth experience and would happily return on our next visit to singapore. highly recommended!

we had a great stay during our safari, very attentive staff, and lovely meals. they set up a candlelight dinner for me and my wife on our second night as we were celebrating our honeymoon. the location is superb, in the middle of the serengeti, you can hear the animals outside your rooms and you really feel like you're surrounded by nature. excellent all round!

we had a great stay during our safari, very attentive staff, and lovely meals. they set up a candlelight dinner for me and my wife on our second night as we were celebrating our honeymoon. the location is superb, in the middle of the serengeti, you can hear the animals outside your rooms and you really feel like you're surrounded by nature. excellent all round!

we had a great stay here using this as a base to drive to the park daily. it's just outside of the main entrance and it was nice to come back to at the end of a long hike and relax in their pool and sauna. there was even some patagonia lamb being prepared one evening when we returned available for all guests that was a nice surprise and bonus to come back to and try! the views from the hotel were awesome, we enjoyed the large assortment of breakfast, and there were some delicious options during dinner at the restaurant. we had the superior room which was spacious and well-kept. the road that leads to the hotel has quite a bit of potholes and some slippery gravel on the incline, you just have to take it slow, and it's not much different from the rest of the park that is all gravel anyways.

we had a great time aboard the lucy yesterday! we were a group of four - 2 adults and two kids (ages 7 and 11). our captain was always giving us nice history tidbits of the city and very engaging with our kids. it was a private tour and we were given a great tour of the city and did not feel rushed at any time. the snacks and the champagne was great! a definite must do when you come to amsterdam.

we had a great time and experience ballooning over bagan. robert was our pilot. he was very friendly and knowledgeable. it was great to see how the pilot and the crew interacted very well to make a safe and pleasent flight for us. robert gave us some technical info during the flight which was great as i am a student pilot myself and really enjoyed the detail. all of the crew did a great job!

we had a great time and really enjoyed the rooms/experience (my 3rd time!). much like the tv show, without the cameras ... i did want to pass along one piece of feedback from a couple of people in our group - they mentioned that the guide (jessie) might benefit from fresher smelling clothing and/or personal deodorant. i hope this is taken in the spirit intended: as a small note to make an already great experience even better!

we had a great time at krisna funtastic land! it’s a perfect place for a fun family day out. there are so many rides and activities for both kids and adults to enjoy. the park was clean, well-organized, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. the atmosphere was lively, and we loved seeing everyone having such a good time. it’s also a very affordable way to spend a few hours with the family. we created so many happy memories here — definitely worth visiting if you’re in the area!

we had a great time at nue thai - she lives together with her husband (tuk-tuk driver who picked us from the hotel) and their two daughters (15 and 9yo) - lovely people. we had a great time, the food was very good, everything cooked fresh, in front of us. when the way back to the hotel i asked him to stop in order to taste the local insects (fried grasshoppers, crickets etc) - interesting experience! worth every penny, highly recommended!
we had a great time at the farmers market. fresh micro greens, mushrooms, honey and goat soap. music and great people. dog friendly. loved soap, microgreens and soap.
we had a great time at this cocktail class. i've done 2 cooking classes here also and all have been fantastic.
we had a great time at this little water park! my son loved it. when you pay for entry, food, and drinks are included in admission which is awesome.

we had a great time climbing the kilimanjaro with magnus and the whole miles to smile team! everyone was really nice and friendly while still being professional and safe. the tents, equipment and food were great!

we had a great time cooking with dary and her husband. such an authentic and warm experience. also excellent that she offered a vegetarian option. we will think of them and cambodia when we try to recreate the dishes back home.

we had a great time diving with them on ladigue. they have a nice big catamaran (easy to enter and exit - from land or water) and very friendly and nice staff who are always helpful and caring. across the main jetty is there office, just go there and ask for the dive available options. we did a two tank dive on two consecutive days to marianne and to shark rock. great dive sites and all in all a very good experience.

we had a great time doing the buggy activity with my 5-year-old! the booking process was easy, and the staff were friendly and accommodating. special mention to our guide, jerome—keep up the great work, mate! looking forward to the next one

we had a great time doing the snorkeling tour. there was only 8 of us so it was a small group which i really liked. we visited 4 sites with the last one being the underwater museum which was fantastic. we saw a lot of beautiful fish snorkeling. kevin and ernesto were great! very attentive and accommodating. the margaritas and ceviche (which ernesto made!) were delicious. pepe our driver was very friendly and informative. everything went smoothly. would highly recommend especially if you're look

we had a great time doing water activities here. definitely recommend to negotiate the price. we did 3 water activities: jet ski, snorkeling and donut boat for about $55 usd per person. it does take some time between each activity so keep that in mind if you have any plans afterward.

we had a great time driving a side by side. it was fun going through streams and especially the rock beds. we didn’t see any wildlife but the views were spectacular! it was nice to get the adrenaline pumping and be outdoors! clayton and jamie were our guides and so friendly and kind. they were very knowledgeable about the area, its history and the various rocks…. which i had to add a few to my collection.😊. if you have kids especially middle schoolers who are bored easily, i highly recommend taking them.

we had a great time driving along the the denali highway. the weather was perfect! tommy and abbey were great hosts and shared their knowledge of the land with us. we even walked out on the tundra and picked blueberries! it was a great way to see more of the last frontier.
we had a great time during happy hour! kim provided excellent service — attentive, friendly, and fast. the prices are very reasonable, especially for the brickell area. we’ll definitely be back!

we had a great time exploring the old medina market! it was such a vibrant and authentic experience, full of charm and character. the market was a treasure trove of local goods, from handmade crafts and traditional textiles to spices and souvenirs – there was so much to see and discover. we really enjoyed sampling the local cuisines — fresh, flavourful, and a real treat for the senses. the atmosphere was welcoming and safe, and the locals were friendly and helpful throughout our visit. the evening weather made it even more enjoyable — pleasantly cool and perfect for wandering the beautiful, narrow streets. it’s definitely a must-visit spot if you're in marrakesh and want to soak in some real local culture!

we had a great time here! entry is only 10,000 won per adult and there was so much to see and learn (history, geology, culture, mythology). the whole area is beautiful to walk around and take in the serene landscapes. the park is huge so i’d advise to budget at least 3 hours. there is a recommended route on the park map but if you don’t want to do the whole thing, you can pick and choose what you want to do using the descriptions of each section (e.g. learning about volcanoes, exploring recreations of an ancient village, seeing art created by local artists, etc). also, most of the outdoor walking is quite exposed so best to bring lots of water and sunscreen in the summer. there are a few cafes and gift shops throughout the park if you want to rest or get snacks.

we had a great time here, i can't believe this is not highly recommended by guides or others on santorini. educational wine tour, tasting and a nice local platter, then we soaked up the ambience overlooking the aegean. only €1 for the ferry each, and €10 for our taxi (combined for 2 pax). we made an afternoon of it going over at 1230pm and coming back at 5pm on the ferry.
we had a great time here. lots of animals to walk around and see. enjoyed watching the alligator feeding. the airboat ride was so much fun.

we had a great time hiking with dina and rui (aka mr. nobody)! dina drove us to the starting point in sierra do topo and then all the way back from faja do cubres to our hotel, while rui guided us through the trail giving us a unique overview on the island's flora, fauna and history. we came across amazing viewpoints and the trail itself was enchanting but rui's company and experience really made the difference. we learnt a lot about the island and had a real good time, to the point we gladly share a beer with the guys at the end of the trail!

we had a great time in all our tours, thanks to avi, itzik, tomer, mahmoud, omri, boaz and of course avishai! incredible hospitality, great knowledge from all the guides, and really really well organised! would definitely recommend. highlights were the lunch at the kibbutz on the galillee and nazareth trip, incredible service and knowledge from shai on the way to the dead sea, a comprehensive, funny and smart tour from tomer in caesarea haifa and acre, and the efficiency of the jerusalem tour by avi.

we had a great time jet skiing in isla verde. the sign up was very easy and we were able to ride the jet ski for 30 minutes. so much fun. the staff was very helpful in explaining the riding details and they also picked us up when it was time to return. we will definitely do it again.

we had a great time on our boat tour. they looked after is really well. we did some great snorkeling and loved learning about the komodo dragons. the boat served good local food and the simple cabins had airconditioning. the team looked after us really well. highly recommend.

we had a great time on our cruise in prague – the views were stunning and the atmosphere on board was very enjoyable. the trip itself was smooth and well-organized, and we appreciated the opportunity to see the city from the water. the food was decent, though not exceptional – it did the job for a buffet. one thing we were a bit disappointed with was not being given our own table, which we had expected. we did raise this with the staff, and while they were polite, we would have preferred a bit more flexibility on that front. overall, still a lovely experience and a memorable way to explore prague.

we had a great time on our semi private day cruise! there were about 20 people, but the boat is big enough for everyone to have a comfy spot to enjoy the ride. the food (grilled chicken, wrapped grape leaves, pasta, bread, and greek salad) was very tasty, and i was not expecting it to be that good, but it was! our crew was very friendly and very responsive to our needs and kept checking in to see if we needed more drinks (wine, soft drinks, water). the three swim spots were all different and very enjoyable. and at the last one, you definitely get to see some fish. highly recommend booking... great deal for the price!

we had a great time on the center of puerto rico tour and the el rincón de chencho tour! from the convenience of being picked up right at our condo to experiencing authentic local cuisine, every aspect of the trip was well planned. one of the best parts was that the passengers could choose where to stop along the way and for how long. the waterfall was so much fun as it was private and secluded, absolutely beautiful. our guide, manuel, was outstanding! he was knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and always ready to answer any questions. for the waterfall tour, it ended up just being our family, and manuel was more than willing to go out of his way to accommodate us and make the trip exactly how we wanted it! he will for sure make it so these tours will be a highlight of your trip!

we had a great time on the curieuse & st. pierre snorkelling tour. the guides were amazing. we went on the smaller boat, which was perfect for us. great snorkelling and super nice bbq lunch. 100% recommended!

we had a great time on the golden jubilee boat. carlie was great right from us viewing the boat to the booking process. all went smoothly. on the day, all the staff did an exceptional job. our guests had the best time and we shall be booking again for sure. thanks again for the service given.

we had a great time on the kayak and hike tour as a family of four! they recommended to book a timeslot with another family, which meant the pace was family friendly and relaxed and we were able to bring our young children. i didn't think it was possible to bring our whole family on this kayaking adventure, but they made it happen! i loved seeing the fjord from the water and sitting around the campfire preparing some very delicious snacks. our guide was also extremely patient and kid friendly which helped us relax and feel very safe. we spent about 5 hours on the tour and enjoyed every minute of it.

we had a great time on the sedona vortex jeep tour! it was great to have a jeep to ourselves and go at our own pace. our guide, white wolf, was quite a character and had tons of interesting information to tell us (vortexes, indigenous predictions, geology, ufos, etc.) he pointed things out and told us stories the whole time we were driving around. we went up to a high plateau where a lot of other jeeps were that had great views for photos. he got out a divining rod and showed us how the vortexes moved the rod. he also led us through a guided meditation session which was really cool. we booked the trip through viator, and sometimes when you do that, it's confusing to know what you're actually getting. at the meeting spot, there were tons of different tour operators and the itinerary we went on ended up being totally different than what the ad said on viator. the viator ad said it would go to sedona creative life center, airport mesa, chapel of the holy cross, boynton canyon trail, and cathedral rock. looking back on it now, that itinerary doesn't even make sense because you could never drive to all those places and stay for 20 minutes at each place but somehow fit the whole tour into 2 hours. we didn't go to any of those places, we just drove around and went to the one plateau. i guess i could have asked him at the beginning where we were going but i didn't think of doing that and just went with the flow. also, a couple places he said we couldn't get out of the jeep because they didn't have the right permits or something, so i felt like we were with some sort of sketchy company because it looked like other jeeps had the correct permits. just a bit odd. we didn't really see anything that we couldn't have seen driving around ourselves. but ultimately we were still pleased with the experience. the guide was enthusiastic and fascinating, it was nice to be driven around and fun to be in a bouncy, open-air jeep, and the divining rod and meditation were special experiences. i would recommend this company, but just double check the details if you really want to see something specific. it might be a lot more straightforward to book with them directly instead of through viator.

we had a great time on their catamaran trip to ile aux cerfs! highly recommend booking with them. the boat was clean and in great shape; the crew was friendly and very quick with the drink service. 10/10

we had a great time visiting the berlin wall exhibit near bahnhof potsdamer platz. it was a powerful and educational experience, especially sharing it with the kids. seeing the actual remnants of the wall sparked some meaningful conversations about history, freedom, and unity. the displays around the site are very informative, with photos and facts that helped us understand the significance of this area during the cold war. we learned how potsdamer platz was once a desolate “no-man’s land” and is now a vibrant part of the city — such a striking transformation! it’s a quick stop, but packed with history. a great way to introduce kids to this important piece of the past while enjoying all the excitement berlin has to offer nearby. highly recommend!

we had a great time! booked the introductory dive. please if you get sea sick don’t be brave take a motion sickness tablet. it was a bit rough on the way out (being a seafarer it wasn’t rough for me at all). the team encouraged guests to come and get motion sickness tablets several times before starting off and i kid you not over half the boat was vomiting. i’ve never seen so many vomit bags being given out and i worked on ship! vomit all over the bow of the boat the poor crew who have to clean that up. anyway! do yourself a favour and take the antisickness. we went to all three outer reef dive sites. we were all split into groups for our dives ours being the second site which i thought was probably the best to dive in due to the towers of coral. the dive was safe although a bit rushed compared to some of the other intro dives i have done in other countries. we also couldn’t swim independently we had to hold hands and the instructor held on to two people. which again i understand as we spent 10 minutes going over skills. they had a professional photographer which was great although warning expensive. 1 digital photo $36. he took such good ones we couldn’t not buy the five best ones he took of us for $106 but you get 30 reef pictures included in that and its all air dropped to you there and then. the first dive site was our favourite. we saw a 1.5m long reef shark then a ray and all these cute squid. there was just so much to see and explore. none of the sites we went to were crowded it was just our boat at every site which was really nice! toilet on board was the cleanest marine toilet i have ever used. all these cute squid staff and super friendly and informative. food was amazing and just kept coming. cheese focaccia sandwiches and muffins for morning tea. pork curry and veg and chickpea curry (which was amazing), prawns, chicken drumsticks, plain salad, greek salad, pasta salad, bread rolls and fruit for lunch. afternoon tea the best chocolate cake i have had for a while! carrot cake and cheese and biscuits. they also had water refill. very well organised day. lots of space on the boat never felt too crowded. would definitely recommend booking! thank you.

we had a lovely day with mauro ramon and our driver efrain. good conversation, knowledgeable and fun.

we had a lovely hike to a lake in the lauterbrunnen area with guada including a delicious fresh picnic that she lugged up. it was fantastic to go on a more locals trail and up and over some of the valleys and mountains we had been seeing from the gondolas and the place we were staying. she also got us set up for paragliding later in the week and we got the royal treatment there with her booking.
we had a lovely picknik and lucky for us there were some festivities with life portuguese music that made the afternoon even more lovely
we had a lovely stay in cape town... from the office ladies and our chauffer to the airport all was in order and proper.... our tour guider in cape town mr orlan was heaven sent ... thank you motema

we had a lovely time at duta orchid garden while visiting with friends. the open-air restaurant offers a beautiful view over the garden, and we enjoyed exploring the vast collection of orchids and other plants. ibu kadek welcomed us warmly with a big smile and even picked some water apples and lemons for us to try. their lemon tea was delicious—a real treat for visitors! we’ll definitely be back with more friends. the venue is also ideal for hosting parties, with a parking lot and spacious outdoor areas available. if i may suggest, adding italian coffee options like espresso or cappuccino would nicely complement the menu. thanks again for the warm welcome!

we had a lovely time, we stayed there for two nights. the rooms are clean and comfortable. the food is good (sometimes it was a bit less water affordable but you can ask for more). the owner is a really nice guy and really flexible, you can always ask him for everything. we also did the full day jeep tour and it was nice. we could stay at every attraction for how long we wanted without any time pressure. the lunch at the tour was incredible and also the short nap afterwards. all in all i would really recommend going to this camp it is a basic one with not much luxury but that is exactly what we wanted. it is also not near to another camp so you have the feeling the whole dessert is yours.

we had a lovely visit to john o'groats, there was loads of parking (£3.50 for all day) and the machine actually took cash. we had a really good scottish breakfast in one of the cafes. the hotel and other holiday accommodation looked good and so did the views out to sea and the islands. there were other shops, toilets, gift shops and a tourist information centre. i was happy to see that they have kept it simple and not gone all commercialised. nice place. good for solo travellers, couples and families.

we had a lovely week here with a group of friends diving & snorkeling april 25. beautiful dive sites rich with coral & fish. we even saw manta rays. our dive master clive was amazing he really knew his craft and went over & above to make our experience magical. the resort is amazing and all the staff were great. would definitely recommend it to you.

we had a lovely winter stay in the taigalampi cabin. it was the perfect place for our 2 families, very cosy and well equiped. janne and terhi showed us the beauty of winter lapland, and we tasted from several winter sports (snow shoeing, cross-country, back-country ánd downhill skiing). the husky tour was simply fantastic! janne and terhi guided us in a very warm and personal way, and served us great food, even during the excursions! thanks to janne’s suggestion, we were able to see the northern light, what a wonderful experience!

we had a lovey day out, the weather was alright, a couple of showers. we done the drive around and delighted to have seen the polar bears, lots of lovey animals and very interesting, our nephew who is 5 loved this experience. we walked all around for hours, seeing all the other animal, had a play in the park and some food, we also went into the gift shop where the staff were lovely, on hand to help and answer any questions we had, a lovely day out.

we had a marvellous 2 hour cruise for a group of 23 people, celebrating two 60th birthdays. we were warmly welcomed aboard the stan huygens, a fantastic boat with table seating for all of us and plenty of room each. we opted for the tour with meats and cheeses and unlimited drink. they offered a wide range of wines and beers as well as soft drinks. the staff and service was second to none. all three staff offered excellent attention, knowledge and friendliness. i can't recommend this company and cruise highly enough. thank you pure boats for making our stay in amsterdam that little bit more memorable.

we had a marvelous experience on our honeymoon. highly recommended in every way. raja ampat is gorgeous. definitely worth the trip. highlights: 1. they gave us a bespoke experience. from the time staff took to get to know us to their recommended daily activities, they provided us 5 star service. 2. you’re able to scuba dive without a certification. our guide was incredible and really made the experience the best it could be. and if diving isn’t your thing, the snorkeling is awesome! 3. food was good! there’s some limitations given the location, but i enjoyed every meal. 4. bar was excellent. 5. the island is gorgeous.

we had a nice experience with this company. the reindeer farm visit with sleigh ride experience was a little disappointing because we only got to see the four reindeer pulling the sleighs and not actually visit them in the farm but the ride itself and feeding those reindeer was nice. the guide was really informative and happy to answer questions. the company should definitely enforce that you wear the winter clothes provided (and anyone reading this should definitely wear them regardless of how warm you think your clothes are). there is no option to leave luggage at the office building. we had better experiences with different tour providers in rovaniemi but this one wasn’t bad :)

we had a one-night stay at misty hills cabins and were genuinely impressed by the exceptional hospitality. from the moment we arrived, the staff went out of their way to ensure we were comfortable. the food was absolutely delicious- both dinner and breakfast were included and far exceeded our expectations in taste and variety. the cabins were spotless, well-maintained, and thoughtfully equipped with amenities like an ac heater and a bed mattress warmer, which made a real difference in the chilly weather. every detail, from cleanliness to comfort, was clearly well thought-out. the service was warm, responsive, and truly top-notch. the staff were incredibly kind, attentive, and always had a smile on their faces. they made us feel welcome and looked after throughout our stay, which added a personal touch that we truly appreciated. we left feeling relaxed and well cared for. highly recommended to anyone looking for a cozy, well-run stay in the pangong area!

we had a pawtastic time at happy tails kennel. we enjoyed our visit, including our 3 year old. it was a cold day but they had all the gear we needed to stay warm. our dog handler sled guide was very knowledgeable. we could tell he had a passion for the dogs and sledding. thank you for sharing this with us! the dogs were all great, happy and friendly. we would recommend this adventure for anyone visiting southern alaska. a bucket list item for sure!

we had a perfect experience with the 5 days/4 nights tour from el nido to coron. tarek was the best tour guide ever! also the whole crew was the best, very kind, friendly and always with a phillipino smile. they always made sure that everyone felt comfortable, helped us with everything and took very good care of us. the places we visited were breathtaking, i have never seen more beautiful beaches and reefs for snorkeling before. the food was great, even for me as a vegetarian, they always made sure to give me something extra without meat or fish, thank you again dadu!! the whole atmosphere was very relaxing, at the different stops you could always choose to swim or snorkel or they would take you to the beach by boat or you could just relax on the boat, so you could just do whatever you want. the sleeping places were basic but still clean and comfortable and always with an amazing view of the beach! i think you have to be open minded about the experience but if you are, you will have the best time of your life!

we had a perfect gobi experience during our 3 night stay at the mirage lodge. from the first contact with nandia who answered all our questions in advance until our stay it the ger everything was so nice! jack was very caring and waited for us even when we arrived very late in the evening. he helped with our intinerary as he had great knowledge of the area! food and rest of the staff was very nice and the gers where in great condition. over all i would recommend the stay for everyone who wants to explore the gobi desert area.

we had a private driver, which was a big advantage. beautiful property. stunning gardens. thorough, detailed tour. skipped the onsite restaurant (it seemed good, though) in favor of a local spot back in the nearby village. definitely make a plan in advance!

we had a really fun time waterfall abseiling with these guys the lovely staff provided all the equipment and advice we needed. you start with a small waterfall, then move onto a big one. it’s safe, fun and pretty cool. $30 each. note that it’s a 20 minute walk down to the waterfall and a tricky, rocky climb back up.

we had a really nice hammam and massage. i still smell the essentials oils and my skin was baby soft. the lunch we had before our treatment was good. very nice pastilla and briouats. friendly staff.

we had a really nice quad tour through the woods this morning. we were able to take some great photos and videos. our guide joona also took some photos and videos of us, which we were able to download after the tour. cookies and drinks were served. we had a great adventure!

we had a really nice tour with the boys today. visited 5 islands, snorkeled in the sea and had lunch on the beach on the island with the golf course. the two boys obviously knew their stuff very well and were extremely accommodating. and all of this for two people (i.e. very privately) with a 140 hp boat. i can only recommend it to everyone. 👍

we had a really nice walk looking at this structure and the surrounding area. very beautiful and peaceful. we parked away from the area and walked. no entrance fee walking it seemed but there nay be if you use parking up the beach. there are several different types of spots to look at in this area, i hope you get to see it. the photo i added is looking at it from across the water.

we had a really wonderful experience here. to get here, you can take a shuttle bus from ocean park entrance. fortunately, we were here on a saturday with fewer crowds than usual,so the lines were short and only took us about 5 to 20 minutes, the rides were super clean and at top quality, and the tuck shop food was awesome. staff attitude absolutely perfected our journey in this wonderful world of water. definately recommended to all.

we had a sunset tour with julius and we had so much fun!! he was very friendly and took good care of us. he made sure all of us got some nice pictures!! we love that! we met him in another day on padar island and he was welcoming and friendly as usual!! highly recommended!! can’t wait to come back next time! thank you julius!

we had a super day here! archery, and owl and deer talk followed by red deer feeding, panning for gold and gems, delicious coffee and lunch! the cheese scones are a must! staff are super, interactive, friendly. a definite recommendation.

we had a superb morning tour with abdulali this morning , strongly recommend. a wonderful combination of culture, history and fun. so glad we did this tour, my understanding of fes, and what goes on within the medina, has vastly improved and i’m now really enjoying fes! thank you so much abdulali 🙏

we had a superb time on the islands and were particularly impressed by the rubber duck we chartered which was very comfortable, and the hospitality provided by the skippers, wild africa provided everything we needed for an unforgettable experience, highly recommend them, and big thanks to mark the owner, mario and madiba for all their efforts and knowledge of the area !

we had a thrilling time racing and bouncing across the waves to see the awesome majesty of the sea eagles and the beautiful trollfjord. and thrilling and exciting as it was we were well equipped with the right clothes and safety gear and felt safe at all times. highly recommend

we had a truly amazing balloon ride experience, seeing the breathtaking views of the serengeti from above. we were able to spot numerous animals during the flight and felt completely safe with our pilot, who was not only highly experienced but also spoke three languages proficiently. his professionalism was outstanding throughout the entire experience. the balloon ride was followed by a beautiful breakfast in the bush, which was absolutely stunning. the food was amazing and perfectly complemented the incredible setting. the staff and everyone involved made this experience truly memorable for us. an unforgettable way to see the serengeti from a completely different perspective. highly recommended!

we had a truly amazing cruise with a family of 20. the captain and crew could not have been better they catered to our every need . we had an amazing lunch on board . the boat was spotlessly clean and really comfortable for all of us - i can recommend this boat trip enough and the best part was travelling back in to the sunset and beautiful views of athens bay and city. if you want a good trip on the sea in athens - book this you won’t be sorry - highly recommended from an irish family of 20

we had a truly amazing experience doing the 20 km safari. it felt too short after all the beautiful experiences and scenery we experienced. you can truly feel that the people who run the husky farm love their dogs and what they do as a living. it is also worth knowing that they take really exceptionally good care of their dogs and even the older and weaker ones get loved and are cared for.

we had a truly fantastic experience that we will cherish for years to come, and our wonderful three-night stay at the extraordinary masai mara intrepid camp was remarkable. from the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warm hospitality and a profound connection to the stunning natural surroundings. each day was filled with thrilling adventures and breathtaking sights, making this trip genuinely unforgettable and exceeding all our expectations. the memories we've created during this stay will linger in our hearts forever, and we look forward to sharing stories of our incredible journey through the beautiful landscapes of the masai mara.

we had a truly lovely experience on this trip. our driver was professional and incredibly helpful throughout the day, making the journey smooth and comfortable. julia, our snorkelling instructor, was brilliant. she was knowledgeable and friendly and made everyone feel completely at ease in the water. the highlight of the day was swimming with turtles in the stunning gulf waters. it was such a peaceful and memorable experience, and everything was well organised from start to finish. the only aspect that could be improved was the bbq. it seemed to be just some grilled chicken, and by the time we had showered and got to the food, it was unfortunately cold. it didn’t quite live up to the 'bbq' label. that said, everything else was seamless and enjoyable. we would definitely recommend this trip for anyone looking for a beautiful and unique day out from abu dhabi.

we had a truly lovely stay at the house of melissa, a seafront colonial house. the chickens, ducks, and bee apiary were such a delight, and we had great fun feeding them. the sea view was beautiful, and kept the grounds breezy throughout the day. breakfast overlooking the sea was bliss. inside, the house was filled with old-world charm — with interesting details in various corners to spark our curiosity. service was prompt and clarence and his team were so kind to share the source of a photo book in the house that my hubby had been searching for for ages. my extended family and i thoroughly enjoyed the experience. thank you for such a memorable stay!

we had a truly wonderful experience. we did this the first night we arrived and the very pleasant, more intimate boat, with live conversation with the tour guide was really wonderful. this was a fantastic way to see amsterdam from the canals and to learn more about its history, it really was the best way to start our trip! highly recommend, and this is a really great way to support a small business in amsterdam!

we had a two-hour hike here, as part of our 2-week galapagos cruise, visiting two beaches, in dec 2024. wildlife spotted: greater flamingos (6 of them), blue-footed booby, brown pelican, sea turtles, sally lightfoot crabs, white-cheeked pintail duck, plover bird, sanderlings, wedge-rumped storm petrel, galapagos shark, spotted eagle ray.
we had a very beautiful ride along the small canals and then the grand canal. you will be lucky if rocco is your gondolier, smooth driver and interesting conversation!

we had a very comfortable stay! the host was incredibly kind and attentive, making sure we had everything we needed—hot water bags were even provided on request, which was a thoughtful touch. hot water was available round the clock, and the food was delicious, made with fresh vegetables grown right in their own compound. the view from the property was absolutely stunning, and the tents were clean and well-maintained. overall, a very pleasant and memorable experience. highly recommended!
we had a very enjoyable afternoon on the basic tour. our guide was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. a great way to see the sights while relaxing on the deck.

we had a very good afternoon and evening here. there are lots of water sports that they offer. we did the wakeboarding and it was very well arranged. after the water sports we spent the rest of the afternoon at the pool and in the evening we had a lovely dinner right at the beach. the staff is very friendly and helpful.

we had a very great time with fanie. he was very helpful and waited with his tour until out cruise ship had arrived. in the tour he shared his deep knowledge of the desert and his history. we also had much fun driving with the quads to the different spots!
we had a very nice experience with rosalia. the homestay was very good. rosalia takes you as a journey to their way of living in these 2 days. we loved it, thank you!

we had a very nice ride with jill. she was very easy to talk with and knowledgeable about the horses. she did a really good job when we ran into other people in the trail making sure they acted properly when the horses walked by. nice small groups makes the experience so much better.

we had a very nice safari tour today. we did the tour before with someone else and it wasn’t the same as today. we really got what was promised. the camp was nice and we enjoyed the food en service at table. wali is a nice driver, he was very helpful and took the time to make pictures for us during the trip. the car was also big and comfortable. i will definitely plan other trips with this group!
we had a very nice stay and super hospitality from the host. bonfire 🔥🔥 added one more star in our trip.

we had a very nice stay at this sopa. the grounds are lush and beautiful. the view is stunning and peaceful. the food is excellent. the staff are friendly and attentive. my only concern is how hot the hot water in the room sink and shower get and that it could burn someone. if it’s possible to turn it down or give a warning that would be good. everything else was great. the food was excellent. amazing taste, preparation and variety. the service was very friendly and attentive. it was a wonderful family getaway. we loved our stay!

we had a wanderfull snorkeling experience in pinzon island with suzy and the rest of the crew. suzy was so friendly, knew a lot about the marine life, and really helped the people who struggled with snorkeling. she also shared the amazing videos she took with to go pro. highly recommended!

we had a wine tasting with food pairing here as part of a private tour. the wines were delicious, and the dishes were exceptional— the best food imo we had while in santorini! the portions of all were ample. make sure to check out the photographic exhibition there as well. peaceful setting. i wish i could remember the name of the lovely young woman who took care of us. she was so nice. definitely make this a must-visit while in santorini!

we had a wonderful 3 hours today with brian and steven as our guides. a fun stop to see tortoise on moyenne island followed by a hard hike around the island, the path is shady but has many steps. you can choose easy to difficult routes to hike.. on snorkeling in the marine park, we began with feeding the fish and then went snorkeling off the boat. we were surprised with the number of fish you can see, we are especially happy to see the lettuce, coral and batfish which we haven’t seen on other snorkeling trips. we had plenty of time to snorkel and steven jumped in the water with us to help us find unique fish. a quick stop to round island for some pictures and then back to the docks. water to drink, fins, mask and snorkel provided, bring a towel.

we had a wonderful and relaxing stay in nesland! the accommodation is wonderfully quiet and a perfect starting point for hikes – for example, to the picturesque nusfjord, which is directly accessible from the house. the staff on site, mostly from slovakia, were extremely friendly, professional, and helpful – we immediately felt welcome. we stayed in two rooms: room 1 had a private bathroom and was very nice overall with a sea view – unfortunately, it lacked storage space such as shelves or a closet, so most of our things ended up on the floor. it's a shame, because the room actually has a lot of charm. room 2 was cozy, but had a shared bathroom, which you also share with guests of the in-house café. that took some getting used to. the bathroom itself, however, was well-equipped and almost always clean. it definitely needs some privacy screens on the windows, but the staff were willing to take care of that. important to note: the nearest shopping or restaurant is in ramberg, about a half-hour drive away – the road there is narrow and winding in places. "i'll just quickly go shopping" doesn't work. despite a few minor drawbacks, it was a great stay – we would come back.

we had a wonderful and romantic gondola ride thru city park. robert was so helpful in planning and very friendly. we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and highly recommend this activity in an authentic venetian gondola!
we had a wonderful archeology day tour with our guide juca. it was very interesting to hear a different story about the history of these beautiful islands.

we had a wonderful day! the tour was perfectly organized and everything ran smoothly from beginning to end. our driver, ibrahim, was truly excellent — very kind, skilled, and knowledgeable. he made the whole experience even more enjoyable with his thoughtful guidance and friendly attitude. they are also honest with their prices, which is especially appreciated in a place where many take advantage of tourists. thank you again for your professionalism. i absolutely recommend this tour!
