we had a wonderful desert experience. we enjoyed it so much. from the hotel pick up to drop off, everything is done perfectly. we are grateful to our amazing tour guide / driver syed mohib, for giving us a comfortable and a safe ride from the beginning till the end of our journey. you are a great person, and you are amazing! thank you!!!

we had a wonderful experience and highly recommend for both divers and non divers. it is a truly special place. the facilities, staff including dive guides and management, equipment, focus throughout on safety, incredible service, food and attention to detail throughout were impressive. the casual, authentic approach was very relaxing and engaging. we especially enjoyed meeting and interacting with other guests that came from around the world. the focus on conservation including education by directly supporting efforts locally as well as globally were incredible. the concrete efforts to improve the lives of local people and their communities were especially notable. sorido bay vastly exceeded our expectations.

we had a wonderful experience at organic tea queen - first we got a tour through the estate while being able to pick our own tea leafs. afterwards we got a big selection of fresh brewed tea to try, accompanied by traditional sri lankan and hindi treats and snacks. if you are looking for a one of a kind experience visit them!! highly recommended!

we had a wonderful experience at rancho terramar. when we arrived, we were welcomed by the owner which is very friendly. besides us there were only 3 other guests, so we had a very small group and a great guide that showed us the lava tunnel and the turtoises. very informative and we had the chance to take all the photos wie wanted! entry was 10$ per person. if you think about visiting the galapagos turtoises, rancho terramar is the perfect place!

we had a wonderful experience on both our african eagle tours. firstly the township tour we went on recommended by our hotel. this was such an amazing experience. it was an afternoon trip and first off our driver/guide took us to the district six museum. our guide explained some of the exhibits and had great knowledge of the group areas act and how this impacted the people involved. he then gave us some time to look around on our own. we were then taken to langa township. we were given lots of history on the way about the passing landmarks and history of capetown. when we arrived at langa we were passed to a second guide who took us around, introducing us to the people that live there and explaining the housing system and the ways the community come together to support each other. everyone was very friendly and welcoming. i highly recommend this tour to everyone that visits cape town. it’s very easy to pass these townships from the highway and make a judgement. the tour give you real insight into the positivity that thrives in the area and the strength and resilience of the people living there. we also went on the full day cape peninsula e-bike tour. it was a pure joy to cycle through the mountains with the e-bike which can be effortless if you so wish. our guide mosses was very knowledgeable of the area and made our trip.

we had a wonderful experience on this el yunque excursion with narayan where our group of 12 got to hike and swim in the river! he was a knowledgeable and patient guide and ensured that everyone had a great time! thank you for making the birthday celebration one to remember!

we had a wonderful experience the team and liked it a lot. we saw different kinds of whales and even more dolphins. it was amazing getting everything explained by scientists, who definitely care a lot about the animals. very good and easy communication, everything worked out well. by booking with naturalist you directly support the scientific research of these species. i would definitely recommend it!

we had a wonderful experience with cape fusion tours in cape town. for 3 days, we had private tours with our guide, ryan. ryan was friendly, and very knowledgeable about each site we visited and the history of cape town and south africa. each morning he met us at our hotel and we set off for the day's activities. we did a tour of cape point/boulder's beach, a cape town day including a visit to table mountain and a cool coffee bar, and a day in stellenbosch wine country. all tours were well organized, arranged and we were so happy to have ryan as our guide. he knew the city and country well, was a conscientious driver and we felt very comfortable with him during our trip. his enthusiasm for his homeland really shined! if you're considering any tours in cape town, i'd highly recommend cape fusion tours! thanks ryan!

we had a wonderful experience with rock the boat company. we wanted to do something different and special to celebrate my friend’s birthday so we booked their private dinner tour. vanessa was our driver, tour guide and waitress. she did an excellent job at all three. we had a great time talking with her and soaking in her knowledge of amsterdam. she was just very delightful. the food and wine was also delicious. we went in feb in the evening so it was a tab bit cold outside but to our pleasant surprise they had a plastic cover over the open area of the boat and had the seats heated and blankets. we were running late due to the train schedule and so i called to let them know and right off they were very accommodating. all in all this is probably one of the best things we did while in amsterdam.

we had a wonderful experience with this company. the crew were absolutely amazing and the boat was great. they took us to a beautiful secluded beach. the food was also very delicious. thank you for helping us make some wonderful family memories ❤️

we had a wonderful experience! we flew an 8 pm tour in late may that was incredible. their planes are twin-engine which allows higher altitude than a single engine. the scenery is so beautiful, there are not enough adjectives to convey the breathtaking mountains and glaciers. everyone has a window, and the view out the windows on the opposite side works well too. there were a few clouds when we flew, but we flew under the clouds to see the dramatic mountains and glaciers on the approach to denali, and both under and over to see the majestic highest mountain in north america. highly recommended!

we had a wonderful flight! the weather wasn’t cooperating for a denali mountain view, but we didn’t have time to reschedule. our awesome pilot, chris, was very honest about the conditions and let us decide if we wanted to see some other sights. i’m so glad we decided to go up. the entire area is just gorgeous from the air. i’m not even disappointed we couldn’t see denali mountain on the flight. we saw so many other amazing things. 100% worth it.
we had a wonderful group workshop with monika. it was great fun and i had a lot of new experiences.
we had a wonderful hike with gayan. he was friendly, knowledgeable, and made us feel safe while showing us beautiful hidden spots in the mountains. highly recommended!

we had a wonderful ice fishing experience in inari and a great reindeer lunch with our guide anna! she was really nice and interesting. we didn't catch any fish, but the landscapes were breathtaking, thank you!

we had a wonderful overnight trip to wadi shab and wahiba sand desert. our guide mohammed was kind and knowledgeable and very helpful. the highlight of our trip was the trekking at wadi shab and the sunset and sunrise on the top of the dunes. my kids ride a camel as well. overall, the tour was amazing. thanks to our excellent guide mohammed, highly recommended.

we had a wonderful private sunset cruise with sail away in santorini. the captain and crew were lovely and did everything to make us feel comfortable and well looked after. a nice swim in calm turquoise water with lots of fish to see followed by a delicious meal prepared on the yacht. we enjoyed the experience very much!
we had a wonderful ride through the countryside behind puerto natales.

we had a wonderful stay at arenal with arenal manoa and hot springs. the rooms were lovely, we had a view of the volcano which was beautiful to wake up to. the property is very well maintained, from the hot springs to the restaurants. we were a big group of vegetarians and they prepared delicious food for us everyday (sushi was the highlight!) there are many activities to do nearby as well and i’m glad to say we had an amazing trip. would love to come back here again!

we had a wonderful stay at bubblerum camp in wadi rum! the camp had all the basic necessities—clean and comfortable bubble tents, hot showers, and great food—all in a truly stunning setting. what made the experience even more special was the hospitality. muhammad was an incredible host who seemed to anticipate our needs before we even voiced them. he regularly checked in to make sure we were enjoying ourselves and went out of his way to make us feel welcome. it was the perfect mix of comfort and adventure in one of the most beautiful places on earth. highly recommend!

we had a wonderful stay at ella flower garden resort. the rooms were very comfortable and well-equipped with everything we needed. the pool was great and felt very private. a special thanks to hansaka from housekeeping who helped us a lot during our stay. the outside area was beautiful and relaxing. breakfast was also really good. overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend it! rooms: 5/5 | service: 5/5 |

we had a wonderful stay at the gobi mirage lodge! the ger was very fancy and well-maintained. on our way there, we got a bit lost since there were no signs along the road, but jack, the manager, realized we were struggling and kindly waited for us outside the camp late at night until we arrived, tired and hungry. he was extremely welcoming and helpful. jack also gave us great advice for the rest of our trip and helped us plan our route with excellent english and outstanding service. highly recommended!

we had a wonderful stay at the resort. the place is beautiful, and everyone was very friendly and welcoming. thank you to the whole resort family for making our time here so special.” i’m still in awe — such a beautiful resort with the kindest people. thank you for everything!”

we had a wonderful tasting and tour at estate argyros. we tried four or five wines, all of which were delicious. the wine came with cheese and meats. it was delicious. after, we walked the grounds briefly to learn how the wine is made. the property is beautiful. the staff is knowledgeable. i recommend it.

we had a wonderful ten days at the cove. you can see from the photos how great the location is, its remoteness notwithstanding. make the effort and go! it's not a 'five star' resort but most emphatically it scores five stars for homeliness friendliness informality and individual attention. the staff without exception are warmly welcoming and bend over backwards to make your stay enjoyable. they very happily accommodated our individual dietary preferences for each meal, with well executed home style cooking. we did our padi certification while we were there and we reckon obin is the best instructor ever! he's the last word in patience and kindly forebearance, while maintaining a very clear focus on safety. if you want learn in warm water and a stunning aquatic environment, just don't hesitate! our final padi open water training dive, by chance, was with the manta rays.

we had a wonderful time on this tour! i booked the sunset cruise departing at 8:45 pm. boarding was very organized—we began queuing around 8:30 and were admitted right on time. we chose seats on the top deck, which i highly recommend for the best views. if possible, sit on the port (left-hand) side, as that’s where you’ll catch most of the sights. each ticket included a drink card valid for a beer, glass of wine, champagne, or a soft drink. naturally, i went for the champagne—when in paris, why not? the atmosphere on board was lovely, with peaceful music playing as we cruised along the seine. the only slight disappointment was that the eiffel tower lights didn’t come on at sunset as expected (the reason i chose this time slot). luckily, by the time we returned to the dock, the tower lit up and we were able to enjoy the sparkling lights from the nearby bridge, which was still magical. overall, i thoroughly enjoyed this cruise—it was relaxing, scenic, and a memorable paris experience. highly recommend!

we had a wonderful time visiting the singapore botanic gardens. the entire park is beautifully maintained, offering a peaceful and refreshing escape from the city’s hustle and bustle. our favorite part was definitely the orchard garden. the lush greenery, vibrant flowers, and tranquil paths made it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy nature. it’s an ideal place for both leisurely strolls and photography. the gardens are family-friendly and very accessible, with plenty of shaded areas and benches to rest. we highly recommend the botanic gardens to anyone visiting singapore or looking for a serene place to unwind. a true green gem in the heart of the city!

we had a wonderful time. due to weather conditions we did not get to see denali. however they were honest and upfront and gave us the option to reschedule, get our money back or continue. i am so glad we continued as we got to see beautiful glaciers and scenery. our pilot was very informative and entertaining. i highly recommend denali air. you will not regret going. we would definitely book this again next time we go!!!
we had a wonderful time. the crew was amazing and the food delicious.

we had a wonderful tour in prague with our host, karel. he guided us through the old town and the jewish quarter with an incredible depth of knowledge and enthusiasm. the visit to the synagogues was moving and informative, and his stories about kafka added such a meaningful cultural touch to the experience. karel kept the tour engaging, blending history, architecture, and personal insights seamlessly. highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to truly connect with prague’s history and spirit.

we had a wonderful tour of the spice farm with shazilie. he is very knowledgeable of all the plants and their cooking and medicinal uses. he very patient with all of my wife’s questions and jokes too. would highly recommend this tour!

we had a wonderful visit here earlier this year. a beautifully decorated and superb example of old palaces that have been restored. not difficult to get to as the transport system locally is excellent, i try us well worth the visit. it is required to book a time in advance, my advice is to book early as there is such a lot to see. thoroughly enjoyed the walk through history that it afforded us. thank you.

we had a wonderful visit to the husky park this summer! our one-hour tour was both informative and fun. juho, our guide, introduced us to all the huskies and shared interesting stories and facts about them. the highlight was definitely the end, where we got to feed the huskies and even try to pet them for about ten minutes—it was such a memorable experience. highly recommend for anyone who loves dogs and wants a hands-on encounter with these beautiful animals!

we had amazing experience on snorkeling and we could spot turtles and many varieties of fish! lady guide was able to understand our wave length as first try experience ! kudos to her! scuba dive unfortunately does nt go through well ! family had ear problems while going down and we come back quickly! area for improvement: even though great guides and facilities available we feel briefing shall include full narrative of “what to do” “how to do “ and when we go down pressure drop and temperature changes we usually face etc at water itself. just covering signals won’t work for first time experience people like us! these briefing should help to simulate the changes when we start the dive. above all narrative we hear our adjacent boat instructors giving to their group while we watch on the upper deck! then we realize what we missed! further do not propose changes from “try dive” to boat trip. i can understand you are trying to club the activities to your convenience but travelers had pre planned trips/activities and finally end up with late timing as what happened in our case! late start and late end! almost 1:30hours delay in our case. lastly the pics shows on website consider as advertising purpose only mostly we won’t get these as per our experience! may be our expectations are more than what we experience 😉

we had an absolutely amazing experience on saturday, august 29th with the 9am athabasca falls/canyon trip! our raft guide, connor reinhardt 😍, was a total pro—fun, knowledgeable, and made the whole trip memorable. the jasper rafting company provided everything we needed for a chilly, rainy day: warm wetsuits, water shoes, socks, and even hats and mitts. highly recommend this route and company, especially for first-timers!

we had an absolutely amazing experience with the ride guide in queenstown! our 2+2 lesson with finn was beyond what we could have hoped for. finn is an incredible teacher — patient, knowledgeable, and super encouraging. he made the session so much fun while also pushing us just the right amount to improve our skills and boost our confidence on the trails. thanks to finn, we felt comfortable tackling new challenges and noticed real progress in just one lesson. we couldn’t recommend the ride guide more highly — if you’re looking to level up your mountain biking while having an awesome time, this is the place to do it!

we had an absolutely exceptional shopping experience at the louis vuitton store in venice, thanks to luisa. from the moment we walked in, she greeted us with warmth and professionalism and made the entire experience feel both luxurious and personal. luisa went above and beyond to help us find exactly what we were looking for while offering helpful suggestions without ever being pushy. she was knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely attentive. her assistance made shopping for my wife not just easy, but a true pleasure. it’s rare to come across someone who balances top-tier service with authenticity and grace. luisa made us feel welcomed and valued every step of the way, and her thoughtful service left a lasting impression. this was by far one of the best louis vuitton experiences we’ve ever had, and luisa is the reason why. if you’re visiting venice and thinking about stopping into the lv store, ask for luisa—you won’t regret it. highly recommended.

we had an absolutely horrible experience on the sunset cruise they offer tonight! starting off we were told the best spot on the boat would be the front, which it was while we were leaving the harbour. as soon as we were out in the open ocean the massive swells began and soaked everyone up the front. i’m aware that the company has no control over the weather and the size of the waves but they were well aware of how choppy the ocean was, as they had just returned from a previous sail, and still failed to warn us about what was coming. we continued to sail into very deep waters with huge waves and the captain made no attempt to alter our route for a safer and more comfortable ride. i would also like to note that there were a lot of cruises going out at the same time as us, which stayed close to the shore due to the large swells, unlike the boat we were on! the only positive thing i have to say is the young girl working on the both (i believe her name was catarina) was very empathetic when people were getting sick.

we had an absolutely incredible experience with our tour guide helder in san miguel from the moment the tour began,he was professional, friendly and incredibly knowledgeable about the island history,culture and natural beauty. he tailored the day to our interests, shared fascinating local stories, and took us to breathtaking spots we would have never found on our own. his passion for the azores truly showed in every part of our tour. whether it was navigating scenic routes or recommendations for great local food or explaining the volcanic landscapes, he made the entire experience feel special and personal. if you are visiting san miguel island we highly recommend booking a tour with helder. he was truly excellent!

we had an absolutely lovely time at kulala desert lodge. the views are breathtaking, and the lodge itself is both beautiful and comfortable. even without air conditioning, our room stayed surprisingly cool and pleasant throughout the day and night. one of the most memorable experiences was sleeping under the stars. the staff helped us set up a cozy outdoor bed, and while it did get a bit cold later in the night, it was totally worth it for the experience. but the true highlight of our stay was the exceptional service, especially from our guide/driver/bartender, steven. he went above and beyond. friendly, knowledgeable, and with a great sense of humor. he really made our time here unforgettable. highly recommend this place if you're looking for an incredible desert experience while visiting sossusvlei.

we had an absolutely perfect holiday here. the resort has everything you could need during your stay to maximize your time in the snow. lift tickets were easy to collect at the ticket counter and we even did an extra night sesssion. the japanese restaurant and the taco spot were our favorites as well as the inclusive brunch. plenty of options to eat, just get there early so you don’t have to wait outside to get a table in the morning because it does get busy! will def be back, possible every single winter from now on…

we had an absolutely wonderful day with dina! she is truly amazing! it was her birthday but she still agreed to take us all around her beautiful island. we went to a private cheese factory where we were able to meet the owners, she tooks us for a delicious lunch, her family's coffee plantation and to a few different lookouts and churches. dina was so fun to hang out with, had a world of knowledge and spoke english very well. we felt like we were with family. highly recommend 🧡

we had an absolutely wonderful experience diving with alex — an incredibly attentive and thorough guide who made every moment feel safe, exciting, and full of discoveries. the boat and the crew were top-class, offering a truly high-end experience from start to finish. the 360° tour was also beautiful — including unforgettable snorkeling at kicker rock and other stunning island spots where we saw sharks, red-footed boobies, and many other endemic species. highly recommended!

we had an absolutely wonderful experience with the catamaran cruise arranged for our family! from start to finish, everything was flawlessly organized. the team made private arrangements just for us, which made the experience even more special. being a vegetarian family, we really appreciated the effort put into customizing the catering to suit our dietary preferences. the food was fresh, delicious, and thoughtfully prepared. the staff was super skilled, professional, and extremely hospitable—they made us feel welcome and well taken care of throughout the cruise. highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing, luxurious, and family-friendly experience on the water!

we had an amazing 2 week dory trip down the grand canyon! all of our guides and boat crew were friendly, supportive, knowledgeable and skilled. you could tell how much each of them loved and cared for the grand canyon and the importance of protecting it for future generations. they educated us on geology, history and were always reminding us that this is still the home for many local tribes and we were to hike with a clean heart and be respectful of these sacred places. the crew took care of us from sunrise to sunset! they cooked delicious meals, set up camp (including the “groovers”) every evening and broke it down every morning. they read poetry, told stories, played beautiful music under the stars (and in blacktail canyon) and guided us on gorgeous hikes to places like north canyon, south canyon, the nankoweap granaries, the little colorado, elves chasm, stone creek waterfalls, deer creek falls patio, havasu creek, and fern glen canyon. all of this in addition to safely rowing us down the thrilling, and sometimes scary, white water of the colorado river! we all made it down safely, no flips on this trip! seeing the grand canyon from the river is an incredible experience that i highly recommend! the beauty surrounds you and there is so much life in this desert setting. the side canyons were gorgeous, i was not expecting fern covered walls and waterfalls in the summer! we saw a multitude of birds, deer and big horn sheep. and those night skies….they were awesome, in the true sense of the word. a huge thank you to all our guides and boat crew from oars: ryan lindsey (tl, guide) dave garcia (guide) steve kenney (guide) max andarise (guide) don bendell (boat crew) wren gober (boat crew) melissa giovanni (boat crew) sonwai wakayuta (assistant)

we had an amazing 2-night stay at kimana mara camp! from the moment we arrived, the friendly and welcoming staff made us feel right at home. a special shoutout to emily, whose warm hospitality and attentiveness truly stood out and made our experience even more memorable. the camp itself is beautifully situated, offering comfortable tents and a peaceful atmosphere that perfectly complements the stunning maasai mara surroundings. everything was clean, cozy, and well-maintained, allowing us to relax fully after our exciting game drives. overall, kimana mara camp exceeded our expectations with its excellent service, great location, and genuine warmth from the staff. we highly recommend it to anyone looking for an authentic and comfortable safari experience in the maasai mara!

we had an amazing 4 hour trail ride up to little beehive. paige was our guide and was phenomenal. we had tea and lunch at lake agnes before heading back down. absolutely recommend if you’re in the area and have time!

we had an amazing 8 night stay in namibia and every aspect was easy. from the airport pick up to the printed itinerary we felt like we knew what we were doing every step of the way. the only negative was that we couldn’t spend more time there! wonderful experience without a hitch

we had an amazing and authentic experience at the tea plantation! mahinda was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about tea. he took the time to show us every step – from picking and drying to grinding and tasting. we even got to try different types of tea and enjoy some local snacks, all in a peaceful, beautiful setting. the tour was 1,5h long. you can feel how much heart he puts into what he does. it wasn’t just a tour – it felt like visiting a friend. we’re so grateful for this unique and personal experience, and we absolutely recommend it to anyone coming to ella!

(the best pie ever). the stay in lumsden at the royal mail hotel was definitely noteable. this lovely old building has been renovated beautifully. great trip. thanks mike

we had an amazing day at waterbom bali with the whole family—my wife, our kids, and lots of laughter all around! from the moment we walked in, the place just felt like a tropical paradise built for fun. what stood out most was how family-friendly it is. nearly every ride is suitable for kids, and our little ones had the time of their lives zooming down slides and splashing in the pools. it’s perfect whether you're an adrenaline junkie or just in it for the chill, splashy moments with the kids. the waiting times weren’t bad at all. sure, there's a bit of a queue now and then, but nothing that kills the vibe. the staff were friendly and efficient, which made the whole experience smoother. oh—and the food! ⭐ absolutely top-notch. we weren’t expecting gourmet-level quality at a waterpark, but we were pleasantly surprised. the drinks were refreshing and well-crafted too—perfect for a sunny bali day. it’s definitely not the cheapest day out. if you’re planning to spend the whole day, grab lunch, sip a few drinks, and maybe take home a couple of those fun printed photos, expect to spend over $200 usd. but honestly, worth every penny. we didn’t even manage to finish all the rides—there are about 12 in total, and we still have four more to conquer. so yes, we’re definitely coming back for round two!

we had an amazing snorkeling experience with this extra divers — the water was crystal clear and the marine life was stunning. the staff were incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and made us feel safe and welcome throughout. my family also completed their diving licenses here, and they couldn’t be happier with the training. they left feeling confident and well-prepared. highly recommend them for both snorkeling and diving!

we had an amazing snorkeling experience! our guide nemo was the best! he was kind, funny, had a lot of knowledge about this island and he was the best dj! ;) even though we did this tour during ramadan, we were offered water, juice and snacks along the tour, which was very nice! this was for sure the 6th or 7th time snorkeling and i've never seen this many turtles in my life!! so beautiful! also the beaches were amazing and the water was very nice to swim in!

we had an amazing snorkeling tour with galápagos below as a family, and it truly exceeded our expectations. our guide, esteban, was incredibly kind, attentive, and made sure everyone felt safe and comfortable throughout the entire experience. even though we were told visibility might not be great due to high tide that day, we were pleasantly surprised — the water was clear, and we had the chance to see so many beautiful animals: sea turtles, reef sharks, penguins, rays, and a colorful variety of fish. snorkeling around islote tintoreras felt like entering another world. we’re so grateful for this unforgettable experience. everything was well-organized and respectful of nature. congratulations to galápagos below for offering such a high-quality, heart-filled tour. highly recommended for families visiting isabela!

we had an amazing snorkeling trip from start to finish! as soon as we boarded the boat, we were warmly welcomed and well assisted. even before we set off, we were offered cold water to stay hydrated, along with a thoughtful souvenir water bottle. captain fahad gave us a long and very informative briefing while we headed toward the island, which made us feel both excited and well-prepared. at our first snorkeling spot, we were lucky to witness a wide variety of marine life turtles, stingrays, octopuses, and colorful fish. we also visited a beautiful, secluded area of the island that felt like a hidden gem. a shower on the boat was available for guests to freshen up after snorkeling, which was a great touch. after our first stop, bro nasser treated us to delicious sandwiches, giving us the energy to continue our adventure. the second snorkeling session was just as breathtaking, we explored a stunning underwater garden filled with vibrant corals. a special thanks to miss lea, who helped us capture amazing gopro photos of all the marine life we saw. finally, we head back to al mouj marina feeling refreshed, amazed, and so grateful for such a well-organized, unforgettable experience. huge thanks to the whole team for making it so special!

we had an amazing stay at melozhori. the lodge is tucked away in a dreamy, peaceful setting wild, quiet, and the perfect place to truly disconnect. far from the crowds, it’s ideal to slow down and reconnect with nature. a peaceful slice of heaven! the lodge is beautiful, super comfortable, and the views are just incredible. we loved the silence, the wildlife all around, and of course, the hot tub in the middle of it all. a big thank you to mareesa for her warm welcome, kindness, and flexibility. a magical escape we’d love to repeat every year.

we had an amazing stay at meridian adventures! our dive instructor, ross, was incredibly knowledgeable, accommodating, and took fantastic underwater photos. he made sure we had everything we needed and felt totally comfortable diving. the staff was wonderful, the rooms were spotless, and the food was great. highly recommend this resort!

we had an amazing stay at richar and lucrecia’s home with their lovely daughter isabel. lucrecia is the kindest women, and her cooking is truly delicious ! we were greeted with a yummy sopa de quinoa and grilled trutcha for lunch, then lucrecia showed us the way around the lake shore, and the beautiful sites of pachamama and pachatata. isabel took us to a lovely welcoming party the community is hosting for tourist close by the house, and lucrecia did us the honour to lend us some of her beautiful traditional clothes. we then had a great night of sleep in the super comfy and warm beds of our room, with a terrace overlooking the beautiful lake titicaca. can only highly recommend staying with these amazing and loving host. my only regret is we didn’t stay any longer than 1 night ! muchissimas gracias de nuevo por todo lucrecia, abrazos fuerte de las francesas marine y clemence !

we had an amazing stay at the fullerton hotel singapore for our wedding! special thanks to wendy, our sales manager who gave us a 5-star service beyond imagination and we would like to personally give a shout out to her services. despite our requests, she went beyond and above our expectations to serve our needs. all of our guests had memorable impressions of our wedding dinner and some were asking us for recommendations to them for their own weddings. it was definitely the best memory for us to spend our big day with the fullerton hotel singapore. thank you for giving us the best!

we had an amazing stay at the mara sopa lodge last week over a two nights stay. the property is well maintained and views are breathtaking. we enjoyed all our meals and drinks at the restaurant & bar along with the courteous hospitality. we were also delighted to view the documentary which was followed by a colorful performance by the masai troupe. enjoyed the show and thankful to the sopa lodge for this opportunity. got some items from the masai women stall too and the gift shop. all the staff were very helpful and warm especially with my husband who had restricted mobility (a cast foot) and needed wheelchair assistance. just a small mention - the path is not wheelchair friendly- it was a big struggle moving up & down to our parked vehicle. hair dryer is not provided in the room, however, one can procure it with a deposit of $20, which i accidentally happen to see a lady take one from the reception area. we definitely had a good pleasant stay and enjoyed the game drives. what a feast for the eyes. we left contented for our next destination- serengeti! asante sana for these sweet memories 😊

we had an amazing stay. it's the most amazing vacation with kids and we had a wonderful time. we are looking forward to booking our next trip here! special thanks to the following go who are friendly and helpful: - nathan from sports (hiking guide). - jessie from archery. - jacky (man in a cowboy hat) from mini club. - taka from reception. - go i forgot his name but he was walking around during dinner time in restaurant and helping guests make premium reservation for the front seats at theater for evening shows on aug 5 and aug 6. he's very friendly. everything is almost perfect. a few suggestions for the resort to improve: - the female washroom on the first floor is very smelly. it's clean but it smells, and lasts for a few days. - coffee is not nearly good enough for someone who enjoys a good coffee. can resort consider buying a expresso machine? - please also consider adding oat milk and almond milk to the choice of coffee.
we had an amazing sunset cruise with thomas and his crew!! the boat was nice but the crew made the whole experience🫶🏻🫶🏻 thank you thomas, we will be back!!

we had an amazing time at into wild africa tent. the stuff was really kind, helpful and welcoming. the rooms were clean and spacious! thank you for everything!

we had an amazing time at kid city honolulu! it’s the perfect spot for young kids to play and explore. my child loved the interactive areas, especially the mini grocery store and vet clinic. we also hosted a birthday party in their party room, and it was fantastic. the space was spacious, bright, and well-equipped. the staff was super helpful and made sure everything ran smoothly. kid city is a must-visit for fun and stress-free playdates or parties. we’ll definitely be back!

we had an amazing time at klein's camp. it was our first time in tanzania, and i’m so glad we chose &beyond for our special anniversary trip. as soon as you arrive in kilimanjaro, you are taken care of by the &beyond staff. they provide a meet and greet service so you won’t get lost after arriving. we were especially worried about arriving at jro early in the morning at 1 am, but with the greeting service from the staff, i felt very safe and relieved. klein's camp has breathtaking views as it is located on top of a hill. the room was well maintained, tidy, and cozy. they even place a hot water bag underneath your comforter at turndown service for a good night’s sleep. the food was also delicious. we were worried about the food in africa when preparing for this trip, but i was wrong! the chef at the property is incredibly talented and prepares well-balanced meals every day using local ingredients. you will be extremely well fed while staying at the camp. klein's camp is special because it is situated in a private reserve, allowing you to go on a night game drive — a highlight of staying at this camp, since serengeti national park does not allow night drives. we were extremely lucky to have massey as our guide. he was the best! he made our drive so exciting and ensured we had the experience of a lifetime! i have been to many five-star hotels around the world, but i felt the &beyond staff were different. you really build a special connection with the staff in just a few days. every &beyond staff member i encountered was sincere and attentive. i could feel that they genuinely want you to have the best time possible, especially since, for many of us, visiting tanzania is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

we had an amazing time at the jericho beach kayak centre. our first time in vancouver, we decided to join a group doing the sunset kayak tour. the scenery was beautiful, and our guide ladan was fantastic with everyone on the tour. the 2+ hours were well worth it. highly recommend!

we had an amazing time doing the led kayaking, and our guides were very sweet. i think their names were joshua, angel, george, and alex. it’s a cool way to experience the city and sea life at night. the paddling gets a little bit tiring because it’s not something that we are used to doing, but i think it was a great experience!

we had an amazing time doing the via ferrata baumes corcades with alex as our guide! it was our first time and we really enjoyed our experience and got a lot of cool photos! we highly recommend booking with brollats. for anyone looking to enjoy nature and adventure, don't hesitate to consider this activity. eit was thrilling and rewarding and was the perfect way to end our trip. alex was also super fun and encouraging. we learned a lot about the geography, as well as the history of the area. overall we had so much fun and would definitely consider doing canyoneering next time! thank you alex and oscar for this experience 10/10 in terms of communication and fun! to all those looking for a guide to try out a via ferrata, brollats is the company for you :)

we had an amazing time during our excursion with andres. he picked us up from old san juan and he stopped along the way to get some delicious local coffee from a coffee truck on the side of the road. he also stopped for us to admire gigantic avocado trees, mangos, and many other fruit trees that i have never seen in my life. my children, 15 and 17, loved the cliff jump. i did it as well, but not the most challenging one : ) after a short hike, we arrived at the river and waterfall. andres gave us all the time to enjoy the quiet part of the river as well as the part that leads to the waterfall. you may even swim under the waterfall to explore the river. my husband and son did it but my daughter and i couldn't do it. the current was too strong for us. we learned that andres is a musician and composer, he shared a couple of beautiful songs with us and taught my daughter how to play an instrument made out of a local gourd. i highly recommend this excursion. andres is a wonderful person, very knowledgeable of the region and passionate about the environment.

we had an amazing time going on a jeep tour in sedona. our guide knew so much about the wild life and rock formations we saw. ethan also gave us excellent recommendations for out time in sedona, which we ended up doing and would not have done without his knowledge. highly recommend this company and you will get the most amazing pictures to remember your time.

we had an amazing time here and don’t want to leave! the view of the volcano from our room is amazing. in the morning we did some birdwatching from our balcony and saw toucans, parrots, and hummingbirds. we took 2 nature hikes with the hotel guides and saw so many animals and birds. i recommend the night hike. the hikes with the guides are a must. this is a great location to explore the area. the food is great and all of the staff make you feel at home. the views from the dinning room and the deck are also amazing. only come here if you like stunning views, amazing flora and fauna and helpful staff.
we had an amazing time here! we were treated very well and our tour guides were very accommodating. this was a 10/10 experience.

we had an amazing time here. many thanks to our lovely volunteer guide (sorry we can't recall your name) who explained the rehabilitation process, about some of those which can't be rehabilitated, the history of the project and many other absorbing details. after the visit we then hiked up the adjacent river to the nearby bang pae waterfall for a cooling dip!

we had an amazing time here. staff was very nice and informative. we went on a sunday morning and it was not busy at all and had the place to ourselves which surprised us because it was such a cool experience and turned out to be our favorite of our trip. no one in your face trying to sell you something every 10 steps. definitely recommend. the monkeys are so cute and the plantation was great too.

we had an amazing time in cape town using the city pass cape town. we purchased the one-day pass as it would let us do everything we wanted for the day. we started off in the morning by catching the hop-on hop-off bus up to table mountain to do the incredible aerial cableway. one piece of advice for this is to get the first bus and get up to the aerial cableway early. we were there just after 9 am and it was already busy, but by the time we returned back down at 11:30 am, the queue was three times the size! we then returned back to cape town with the hop-on hop-off bus via camps bay and then spent the day doing various attractions in the v&a waterfront. the two oceans aquarium, pienaar & son distilling co. gin tasting, sky-hi ride and zeitz mocaa - museum of contemporary art were all highlights of our day and all included within the pass. we finished the day with a sunset cruise around cape town with waterfront charters, which was absolutely stunning and a highlight of our trip to south africa. you’ve got to pre-book it in advance, but it is certainly worth it, as the experience was magical. overall, we had an amazing day exploring the best of cape town with the city pass cape town, and i would highly recommend purchasing one if you’re planning to see some of the bit sights the city has to offer.

we had an amazing time in tanzania with safari soles! everything was very well planned and organized. we booked a 5-day safari to tarangire, serengeti and ngorongoro. it was the best experience that we could have imagined. we were so lucky to have rajabu as our safari guide. he explained us so much about the animals and tried his best to make sure we see all the big five and even the migration. we had a wonderful time and are very grateful for these unforgettable memories in tanzania. also the accommodations, the food and service was always great and everyone was very friendly! additionally we also booked a day hike to kilimanjaro and some other activities such as a hikes to napuru and materuni waterfalls, a coffee tour, a visit to kikuletwa hot springs and visits to arusha. we especially liked the coffee tour and hot spring. our guides on these days were also great and were telling us a lot about the people and country. we can highly recommend safari soles to everyone who is planning to visit tanzania!

we had an amazing time jet skiing and our instructor, camillo, made the experience even better! he was super helpful, very friendly, and made us feel safe and comfortable the entire time. he even used our gopro to film us without us having to ask, and let us swim freely in the open sea. such a memorable moment! camillo truly went above and beyond. best instructor ever 10/10 experience! highly recommend! gr ludvie & randall from the netherlands

we had an amazing time on my scuba diving experience! the entire team was incredibly friendly and welcoming, making the whole day enjoyable from start to finish. a special shoutout to paul, our instructor, who was exceptionally kind and patient. as it was my first dive, i was a little nervous, but paul made sure i felt comfortable and confident in the water. his calm and supportive approach really made a difference. the dive spots were absolutely incredible—crystal clear water and so much marine life! we saw a huge variety of colourful fish, and the whole underwater scenery was just breathtaking. i couldn’t have asked for a better introduction to scuba diving—highly recommended!

we had an amazing time on our 7 day cruise! this was our first liveaboard experience, so we were unsure of what to expect, but it was incredible! it was absolutely the best way to fully experience raja ampat and we are so glad we booked the wisesa. the crew were so thoughtful and went the extra mile for the guests. the chef was wonderful and every meal was fresh and delicious. our fellow guests were friendly and it was great to get to know them better over meals and downtime. our cruise director anne was outstanding -- she was an awesome guide and went out of her way to organize special land outings for coconut crabs and birds of paradise, per guest request. the whole itinerary was the perfect balance of relaxing, snorkeling, and adventure. we enjoyed a short kayak to a remote beach and a river trek to a picturesque swimming spot. the majority of the snorkeling excursions we were the only ones there, and the wildlife was spectacular -- reef sharks, mantas, turtles, cuttlefish, barracuda and tens of thousands of fish. the coral was the healthiest and most vibrant that i've ever seen. i would highly highly recommend the wisesa and we are so grateful to the crew for such a memorable honeymoon!

we had an amazing time on our kayak tour in deep cove! our guide adrian was fantastic – very knowledgeable, friendly, and made the whole experience fun and easy. we were lucky to see seals and starfish up close, and the natural beauty of the area was just breathtaking. it was the perfect mix of adventure, relaxation, and enjoying the outdoors. highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting vancouver!

we had an amazing time on the sambangan long walk with kris. the waterfalls were spectacular, the hiking was not too challenging, and kris was a lot of fun to spend the day with. the company is totally locally operated. i would absolutely recommend going!!

we had an amazing time on this boat with a group of 11 friends! the experience was smooth, fun, and unforgettable. the boat was comfortable and well-maintained, and the staff was super friendly and accommodating. we loved every moment of it and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great group activity. thank you for a fantastic day on the water!

we had an amazing time paddle boarding and kayaking down the river today with pacific watersports palm cove. luke and noelle were terrific guides and such a lovely place to have a paddle and swim with our teenagers. beth gave great updates ahead of the tour. highly recommended!

we had an amazing time renting a motorboat at lake minnewanka! you don’t need a boating license for the smaller rentals, and the staff gives you clear instructions before you head out. it takes a little getting used to if you’ve never operated a boat before, but the lake is huge with plenty of space to figure it out and enjoy the ride. the views are absolutely stunning and the whole experience made for such a special memory for my son and me. highly recommend this for anyone looking for a fun, unique way to enjoy the lake!

we had an amazing time staying here! it's unbelievably beautiful, especially at sunset and sunrise. the tents are quite comfortable and there are great bathroom/ shower facilities onsite. salem and frances were lovely and thoughtful hosts and provided delicious food and lots of tea. we did a camel ride, which was delightful, and a half-day tour, and only wished we had been able to stay longer. it's such a unique and beautiful place.

we had an amazing time thanks to the tulum catamarans team. everything was super smooth from finding the right boat to the pick up and all the way through to the drop off back at our villa. we were 10 in total with 5 kids so the catamaran was the perfect size. we had a fantastic crew who took us to a lovely location where it was just us. the food and drinks were delicious and served in style on the deck. it was probably among the best guacamole we all had tasted. miguel who we coordinated with was very responsive which made things extra easy. thank you guys for a such a special experience!

we had an amazing time with arenal water sports rentals! my kids rented jet skis and had a blast — definitely a core memory from our trip. the dock is super close and easy to access, which made getting in and out a breeze. the staff was incredibly friendly, helpful, and very diligent about going over all the safety instructions, which i really appreciated as a parent. i highly recommend going out mid-morning before the rain rolls in — the lake is calm and perfect for riding around at that time. bonus: there are a couple of the sweetest lake dogs hanging around the dock, malik and toto! they’re super friendly and will probably come say hi while you’re waiting or gearing up. all around, just an awesome experience. we’ll definitely be back!

we had an amazing time with azores retreat on their buggy tour of terceira! it was such a fun and adventurous way to take in the island’s stunning views, hidden trails, and the fresh, earthy scents of nature. the tour offered the perfect balance of excitement and sightseeing. driving the buggy through different terrains made it a thrilling experience we won’t forget. highly recommend if you’re looking for a unique and memorable way to explore terceira!

we had an amazing time with bluewave, the staff is very friendly and professional. the boat is very pleasant and clean, there is plenty of food and drinks, toilets and showers on board. the captains were very nice and comitted to our well-being, they made sure we didn't miss any of the sealife the beautiful island had to offer. we aways had one of the two captains in the water with us, showing us the best spots. we got to swim alongside wale sharks, turtles, sting rays and a variety of fish ! i highly recommend this company, and will use it again for future trips to oman.

we had an amazing time with daredevil adventures in namibia! the quad bike ride across the dunes was an unforgettable experience—thrilling, scenic, and so much fun. riding up and down the golden sand dunes felt like a real adventure. a special shoutout to our guide michael, who was friendly, professional, and made sure we felt safe while having a blast. highly recommend this activity to anyone visiting swakopmund!

we had an amazing time with island adventures on the private snorkeling and fishing tour. snorkeling near a quiet reef with no other boats around was incredible, and our guide juan pointed out so many fish and even a stingray. he also walked me through how to bait the hook during the fishing portion, which was fun to learn. theo, our captain, kept everything smooth and relaxed from start to finish. the water in isla mujeres is bluer than any pool i’ve ever seen, and with calm seas and sunny skies, it was the perfect day. highly recommend!

we had an amazing time with jerry! he was flexible and friendly. he took us to a secluded river with beautiful waterfalls and clean water. great place for cliff jumping, hiking, swimming, and chilling out. he took us to a small restaurant on the way back - incredible food! definitely worth it. 10/10 experience!

we had an amazing time with khlafa at our full day tour of fes. he speaks excellent english and shows a true passion for guiding and teaching stuff about fes and morocco. during our full day not only did he teach us thing, he also took us through the amazing maze that is fes and took us to all the highlights and a few more than we thought too. besides stopping at the historical sights he also found time to stop at several handicraft businesses (woodworker, brass worker, a hammam, weavers, pottery, rugs and of course the tannery) but these visits were both interesting and there was no pushing you to buy anything. he also suggested an excellent lunch restaurant too. i would love to do more guided tours with him and fes became the highlight of our 9-day trip around morocco, much because the final day with khlafa. highly recommended!

we had an amazing time with pure kitesurf! after just a few days of lessons, we managed to stand up and zoom around the waves 🌊 christina is so friendly, and all instructors we had were super helpful and patient. the spot and their equipment is great, we will definitely come back soon! (also highly recommend getting one of these straps for your sunglasses - we both lost our sunglasses in the sea..)
we had an amazing time with siobhan, amy, charlotte and jesiah serving us throughout the night behind the bar. great views of london, good price pints and friendly staff. class evening on the thames!
we had an amazing time with soup (stephan). first we swam with the dolphins and then stopped at crystal rock and le mourne. it was just stunning! thank you for the great experience!

we had an amazing time with wadi rum tours. they took us to see a number of key sites in the desert, at night we star gazed by a beautiful campfire and they provided delicious food for the entire trip. at lunch time they took us to remote beautiful sites and prepared lunch. an unforgettable experience - thank you ahmed.

we had an amazing time! jerry was our host and was awesome 😎! everyone in our group had a wonderful trip! my husband has a fear of heights! he was able to make it through all the zip-lining!!! my last picture is a hummingbird!!!

we had an amazing time! the guides were knowledgeable, friendly, and so passionate about the forest and their history. they were happy to answer questions and share all they knew. the hike was relaxed and short (about 1/2 mile each way). on the first let, we spent time learning about the plants and the history. we went swimming as the sun set, which was beautiful. we spent the hike back looking at tons of frogs and other animals. we saw the forest in a very unique way with the guides and learned a ton. i definitely recommend this tour!

we had an amazing time!!! this is a once in a lifetime, bucket list experience. if you love the outdoors and adventures, this a must do. the staff were all so knowledgeable, warm and friendly. teddy took us horseback riding, atv touring and showed us the best spot on the grounds to catch the sunrise and sunset (he’s the best!). it’s a beautiful location and does not disappoint. the stars at night are unreal and you’re surrounded by wildlife. this is in the top 3 of all the trips i’ve taken over my lifetime, possibly my number 1.

we had an amazing time!!!! we felt safe with the crew…in and out of the water. they treated us all awesome!! i personally will book with them again!! great job to the captian and his crew!!! sandwishes and drinks were phenomenal….thank you!!!

we had an amazing time, love the atmosphere and the setting is top notch. wife and friends enjoyed their dishes. i had fish of the day, for 50 eu was expecting some kind of salad or bread to come with it but just a small piece of fish and pretty salty. give 5 stars for the atmosphere and cold beer!!!
we had an amazing time, our group of 15 colleagues embarked on this adventure and it turned out to be an incredible experience. staff attentive and knowledgeable. great for team building. thanks

we had an amazing time. i visited with two teenagers and there was something to keep us all interested. the staff were amazing and always on hand to help with photos and to explain things. it was actually really informative as well and i learned a thing or two.would i go back? definitely and i highly recommend it to anyone who’s up for a bit of fun. well worth the a visit.
we had an amazing time. my husband and i were the only one on the tour. he was so nice and gave a freestyle session doing full throttle. everyone was amazing here, staff was very nice.

we had an amazing time. we were a group of four friends and got a big room, all amenities included. the rooftop is just perfect with different ambiances (including a swimming pool!). the staff is very professional, close and attentive. everything is taken care of in this place!

we had an amazing tour of sandwich harbour and walvis bay, all thanks to jp. we are usually a little skeptical about such tours because usually the operators/guides are time-bound and always in a rush to finish the tour at a given time. however, our experience was exactly opposite of it. jp is the best person to do this tour with. he is a fantastic guide, very knowledgeable about the area, super fun, and cherry on the cake - a great photographer too. we enjoyed every single minute of the tour, at our own pace, stopping as many times as we wanted. jp has an eye for spotting the animals on the way. we were also lucky to see some whales playing super close to the shore. jp also arranged a very nice special vegan meal for us at pre-request.

we had an amazing tour today with francesca. i highly recommend emailing them in advance to set up a tour. her family has lived in venice for generations, and as we were taking the tour her father was in the shop working on a gondola. it was a fascinating experience to learn how the gondolas are made.

we had an amazing trip. the lodge is in the backcountry of denali and is only accessible by helicopter so it felt like we had the park all to ourselves. when we got there we were met with welcoming staff, great service, clean rooms and great food. everyone here was so nice and welcoming and made the experience feel very personal. there were many activities to choose from including bike rides, hikes, kayaks, etc. there’s also a great private sauna. it was an amazing way to experience denali national park. it was an unforgettable trip that i would absolutely recommend.

we had an amazing visit at happy trails kennel. martin, kathy, chad, and sue were excellent hosts. we were able to meet the new litter of pups and well as many of the other dog "athletes" team members. if you are looking for a kennel to learn about the iditarod and the mushing profession, happy trails kennel is the place to visit, you'll walk away with an entirely new perspective about the race and the role sled dogs play in alaskan culture. 6/2025
we had an awesome afternoon on the barron river. sambo was a fantastic guide, he worked very hard keeping us all safely in our raft.

we had an awesome ella tour with dilshan today 11 august 2025. he took us to nine arch bridge, little adam’s peak, rawana falls and little waterfall to have a refreshing dip. he is very knowledgeable about the area. he is also a guide registered with the department of tourism in sri lanka. he picked us up from the railway station yesterday when we arrived. we had to get returning tickets from the railway station which took a bit of time. dilshan waited till the we got it sorted & helped us to get some take away dinner. lovely person. we highly recommend him to anyone travelling in ella or other destinations in sri lanka.

we had an awesome experience here !! very kind and patient with us whilst we chose a rug which we loved but that also fit into our budget. all the rugs seem like great quality compared to others stores we looked at and we felt like the staff were super honest and knowledgeable ⭐️ would definitely recommend if you want a good quality rug :)

we had an awesome experience last april when we went for our vacation. staff where so great! experience seeing those dolphins cant compare. seeing my daughter and husband enjoyed kayaking. daughter bravely slide, got to drive that boat is a cherry on top... love it! although i got to use the blue bag 😅 thank you dolphin and you 💙 happy family

we had an awesome experience on the evening canyon rafting trip! our guide, loomis, made the entire trip so fun. he pointed out special landmarks and historical sites along the way, as well as provided fun information about himself, the raft adventures crew and background, as well as alaska in general. we would raft with these guys again for sure at our next visit to denali!

we had an awesome time at the resort. from 10:00 am on we were able to drop our luggage off at the concierge desk and go to the hot springs. the hot springs were amazing and the hotel guest exclusive area was really nice. on the day of your check out you can stay in the springs till 10:00 pm. all the staff were english speaking, extremely accommodating and friendly, the room was immaculate and the bed was very comfortable. it's hard to speak too highly of this place.

we had an awesome time on our full day canyoning in the routeburn - our guides, dan and oscar, were professional, extremely knowledgable and gave us all the best tips and tricks. the canyon is gorgeous, and the combination of jumps, abseils, zips, slides and climbing was so much fun! highly recommend canyon explorers - thanks for a brilliant trip!

we had an awesome time! the staff member was very cool and informative. the safety briefing was solid. the equipment was really high quality. the launch was easy. note: we booked three hours, which was pretty aggressive for our first time out. two hours is still a lot of time and that would have been a more sensible amount of paddling. bring water shoes or flip flops, sunglasses, a hat, sunscreen, and drinking water. also bring a change of dry clothing, which you can store in their lockers...you can change in the public restrooms. final note: ask about a monthly or annual membership! such a bargain.

we had an epic experience with finn. the first day was the long and hard cross country ‘coronet loop’. worth all the pain for the amazing views and sense of achievement. could not have done it without finn’s guidance. he’s a great mountain biker, very sensible and safe. the second day was a half day of gravity shuttles on coronet peak. he choose some great trails to send us down and explained the features so we knew what to expect. after the ride he returned our hire bikes and dropped us off at our next adventure. nothing was too much trouble. best to involve him early when planning your trip as he knows everything about adventure around queenstown
we had an epic trip seeing paris from a beautiful aspect along with the guidance of knowledgeable philip .. highly recommend 🙌

we had an excellent canal boat tour with eco boats. the price was more than worth it. our captain and guide was great, the boats were comfortable and nicely designed. the tour lasted around 1 hour and 15 minutes — a beautiful way to experience amsterdam from the water. definitely don’t miss it, such a lovely experience!

we had an excellent dinner cruise experience with sea angle dinner cruise. we visited here on 1st august 2024. luckily, it was not rained and weather was so pleasant. it was cloudy weather throughout the trip. it rained previous 2-3 days during the trip. package name is “phuket ko sire: cruise with live music and 4-course dinner”. package includes 2-hours cruise ride with 4-course dinner, unlimited mineral water and soft drinks, live band music, hotel pickup and drop-off. live music was good. dinner is also equally good. dishes are freshly prepared and had great texture. phuket ko sire beach view was awesome 🤩 🙌 cruise round trip ride is from the island of ko sire to panwa cape. cruise is clean and well maintained. staff are attentive and prompt service.
we had an excellent evening meal.

we had an excellent experience on our cruise. the staff were friendly, the food and drinks were plentiful and the landscape was beautiful. the snorkeling at telegraph island was surprisingly good with heaps of fish, urchins and coral. also lots of encounters with dolphins.

we had an excellent experience with eric today doing private tour. the van was clean and well stocked. we learned more about the grand canyon then we could if we read a book in just a few hour tour. the whole route was well planned we had plenty of time to experience each stop. our family would highly recommend this tour to anyone who is looking for a very unique thing and tailored experience in grand canyon.

we had an excellent guide called dom. he was very knowledgeable about the local wildlife. he talked about it in a very interesting way. he took great care for the comfort of all participants. however, i think the tour was too long by at least 2 -3 hours. i would have loved to have stopped in port douglas for at least half an hour instead of walking through the rainforest we had already seen at the start of the tour. the meal served at the local bar was very tasty. also, the ice cream we ate along the way was some of the best i've had in australia.
we had an excellent guided tour of yellowstone. carl is very knowledgeable of the history and culture of the park. highly recommend.

we had an excellent time on our tour. we were picked up promptly from our hotel and taken to the boat which was a fast 10 min car ride. pepe our captain and tour guide was fantastic. he gave us so much information on the uros islands and the communities that live there. we met a local family and they showed us their way of life. while there were items to buy they were a good price and you weren’t made to feel you should. we paid the extra 20 soles per person to go on the traditional boat. the 9am tour was a perfect start to the day.

we had an excellent tour with ronny. the whole experience felt smooth and bespoke. we had heard that visiting uros can feel like landing in a tourist trap. this was very different, we peacefully paddled through the reeds observing local wildlife and arrived at a small island with one family. they kindly shared how they build the islands, traditional clothing and a lunch of trout with us. ronny also arranged a taxi to and from our hotel. he works for some other tour operators but i think the price is best if you go direct.

we had an extremely memorable,enjoyable and fulfilling stay in shyok view camp, teerith. away from the crowd of hunder and diskit, this camp is in an extremely scenic location exactly beside the river, with a small stream flowing within the premises. the tents are picturesque. though no luxury arrangements are there, all basic necessities are well taken care of. you get plenty of hot water, thanks to the efficient solar heater, comfy beds, lots of blankets, and electricity. the food is perhaps the best food we had in the entire region. cooked in very homely style with locally produced ingredients, it is a challenge not to overeat. the best feature of the camp is the owner mr. thondup, and his wonderful ladakhi hospitality. he is an army veteran, without much experience in tourism business, but he knows only one thing, giving the guest a wonderful experience. maybe the army has taught him not to say no, and he doesn't refuse any requests of the guests and ensures an experience of a lifetime. it is less than a year old venture, but i am sure anyone who visits here would only shower praises for the place.

we had an incredible 31-day by bucket list adventure across southern africa, combining 3 tours - the best of kruger, garden route, and an overland safari through namibia, botswana, and victoria falls—all thanks to elana at detour africa. she was friendly, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable, handling every detail from tours and transfers to accommodation and visa help. elana was always responsive, answering our many questions and even checking in mid-trip to ensure everything was running smoothly. the tours exceeded our expectations, and africa truly captured our hearts. we can’t wait to go back! if you want expert guidance and exceptional support, we highly recommend elana and detour africa.

we had an incredible adventure on our safari experience! from start to finish, everything was well-organized, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable journey. our travel to and from the venue was safe and comfortable, allowing us to fully enjoy the experience without any worries. a special thank you to our driver and tour guide, muhammad anwar, for his professionalism, hospitality, and expert guidance throughout the trip. highly recommended! thank you muhammad anwar!!

we had an incredible day with seastar cruises! the boarding process was prompt and smooth, they made sure everyone had a wetsuit, flippers, goggles, and life vest if needed. the water was very choppy and it was hard to move around the boat while it was moving but the seating was fairly comfortable and allowed for a pleasant journey. once we got to our first stop at michaelmas cay we chose to go out on the glass boat tour which was a very cool experience, tim was a great guide for this and we got a nice introductory look at the reef. we chose to do a scuba dive, so after the glass boat they brought us back to the main boat and got us ready to dive. our instructor was maddy and she was so nice and helpful, she did a great job taking us through all the instruction and safety briefings. it was my first time diving and she was so patient and made sure we were ready and comfortable for the entire dive. between the glass boat tour and the dive we didn’t have time to see much of the cay or snorkel there, so we chose to only do the one dive and then snorkel the whole time at the second location, hastings reef. i would say if you are considering doing a dive, to maybe do two dives. the first dive is spent mostly getting acclimated whereas i think you’ll see more in your second at hastings reef, and if you’re like us and want to do some snorkeling as well, it seemed like there would have been plenty of time to both dive and snorkel at hastings. in between michaelmas and hastings we also attended a reef talk with yumi which was very nice. at hastings reef we took part in a snorkel tour which was nice to do before going off on our own, we saw turtles, sharks, and plenty of amazing coral and fishes, my favorite spot of the day were the massive clams! lunch is provided, and in the mornings they had tea, coffee and some muffins with some cake and fruit in the afternoon. it’s not a ton of food but for the 8.5 hours you’re out there it was sufficient. they also very kindly take some photos for you in the water, although on a personal note i highly recommend bringing your own underwater camera so you can take photos of everything you spot on your own as well! we also quite enjoyed getting a chance to sunbathe on the front of the boat after swimming that was lovely! we chose seastar because of its smaller size we had about 20 people and thought it was the perfect size, not too crowded at all. i cannot stress enough how excellent the crew was, everyone was eager to help whether it was helping you in and out of your wetsuit, putting on your life vest, or taking off your flippers. yumi was also an amazing snorkel guide, she helped my mum who was a little nervous about swimming and stayed with her the entire time and for that i cannot thank her enough! overall i would definitely recommend this excursion if you are looking for a smaller tour to see the great barrier reef! the crew was amazing and provided you with everything you needed, and we saw some fantastic sea life while checking off a bucket list item!

we had an incredible day with this tour agency, truly one of the highlights of our trip to greece! everything was perfectly organized, and the experience felt personalized, attentive, and luxurious from beginning to end. we saw dolphins in the wild, which was absolutely magical. we explored stunning beaches: the red beach, the white beach, each with its own charm and crystal-clear waters. the tour also included stops at hot springs and a volcano, adding adventure and a unique touch to the day. as the sun set, we were treated to one of the most beautiful sunsets we've ever seen, right from the boat. to make it even more special, they let us use the barbecue onboard, where we cooked, shared, and laughed while enjoying the view. the food was spectacular, delicious, homemade, and full of authentic greek flavors. every bite felt like a celebration of the local culture. the crew was kind, professional, and incredibly attentive. they made sure we felt comfortable, safe, and cared for throughout. we truly couldn’t have asked for more. it was the perfect blend of relaxation, discovery, fun, and authenticity. we’ll remember this day forever and highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for a first-class experience in greece!

we had an incredible experience at art space winery! esmeralda was just fantastic — her english was excellent, and she explained everything about the history of the winery, the art, and the wines in such an engaging way. the setting is unique, blending the charm of old santorini wine caves with a beautiful art gallery. the wines themselves were delicious, and we left with a much deeper appreciation for santorini’s winemaking tradition. highly recommend this stop if you’re visiting the island!

we had an incredible experience learning about local māori culture and the geothermal landscape with tour guide mere (or mary). she shared beautiful stories - it was such a gift to experience the geysers with someone who grew up in the valley! the evening cultural performance was powerful. guides maia and rob were wonderful in closing out the evening experience. so cool to know that purchasing tickets supports the arts institute and helps keep traditions alive!

we had an incredible experience on our private speedboat tour of the 5 islands! our skippers were amazing- great energy, very informative and a huge respect for the environment they work in. i highly recommend the tour

we had an incredible experience on the 2-night snorkelling liveaboard trip. we went on 7 snorkel sessions across 5 sites and managed to see several sharks, turtles, stingray, moray eel and more species of tropical fish than you can count. we were very well looked after by a very safety-conscious crew which made for a reassuring experience. although the sessions are primarily aimed at scuba divers, we still were able to enjoy the reefs to the fullest. some things we wish we'd known beforehand were that all the dive boats are no-shoe zones, so don't waste bag space with shoes! also it wasn't clear that things like the sharks in the dark session was only for certified scuba divers which resulted in disappointment. some detailed information provided before the trip would have been greatly appreciated. the detail that was given ahead of time was useful - don't underestimate how cold it is on the boat, take extra layers. since this is a very active trip, it was great that there was always cold water, hot drinks and fruit available. the meals were excellent portion sizes, varied and made with very fresh ingredients. we had no issues as vegetarians. all in all, a great trip and would highly recommend.

we had an incredible experience with blue sky agency. from the moment we walked into tjeir office we felt welcomed and well taken care of. the staff were super friendly and helped us choose a tour that fit exactly what we were looking for (snorkeling with wildlife, amazing scenery and bit of beach time to relax). we did the pinzon island tour and it was beyond our expectations. the guide susy was funny, informative and spoke both english and spanish fluently, which made it really easy for everyone on board to understand. we saw everything from sea turtles, marine igunas, sea lions and sharks. the boat was clean and comfortable, and the lunch they served on board was simple but delicious (rice, fish, vegetables, beans and fruits) . the snorkeling gear was in good shape and they even had wetsuits for those who needed them. what i appreciated most was the attention to safety and the respect they showed toward the environment and the animals. if you are visiting the galapagos and want to choose a local company that knows what they're doing, this agency is the one to go with. we highly recommend to ask for josue! gracias por todo!
