we had an incredible experience with priscilla! her warmth, energy, and passion create such a welcoming and uplifting atmosphere. the sound bath was truly amazing, but what made it even more special was simply connecting with her. she has a gift for making you feel grounded and present. if you're looking for a meaningful and memorable experience, we highly recommend sacred rememberings!

we had an incredible experience with the cau cau tour to isla victoria and the bosque de arrayanes in march. this was a family trip for us, visiting from florida, and it exceeded all our expectations. our guide, raul, was exceptional and ensured everyone in our group had a fantastic time. his attention to the needs of all the guests was commendable, particularly making sure that an elderly person in our group was comfortable and well taken care of. the boat was spotless, the snacks on board were delightful, and the tour was very punctual. all the bilingual tour guides were ready to answer any question, no matter how silly, especially from the kids in our group. we truly appreciated the passion and love that tour guides like raul have for their work. we have been happy to share this wonderful experience with our friends and family in the u.s. we highly recommend the cau cau, raul, and the entire team for this amazing tour. thank you for a memorable adventure!

we had an incredible experience with this diving center in beau vallon! the entire team was exceptionally friendly, welcoming, and helpful, making us feel at ease from the moment i arrived. our 5 dive trips and 10 dives were very relaxed and enjoyable, with a focus on safety and comfort. the underwater world was absolutely breathtaking – we saw turtles, sharks, schools of fish, moray eels, and so much more. each dive was an unforgettable adventure, and we couldn't have asked for a better team to explore the vibrant marine life with. highly recommend this diving center to anyone visiting the seychelles! thank you guys and ladies for making our vacation perfect! benjamin & veronika

we had an incredible experience! the hosts were extremely friendly, welcoming, and spoke english very well. we loved the guided tour through the local market and fruit garden. the food was absolutely delicious, and the cooking instructions were clear and easy to follow. everything was thoughtfully organized. overall, a truly amazing experience that we highly recommend!

we had an incredible experience, i went with my partner, we love bariloche, lake nahuel huapi and what is unique is what you experience from the sailboat, the peace and the beautiful colors that fill your eyes, with the stories and guide of seba and capi who are geniuses. i highly recommend it

we had an incredible island hopping experience thanks to discover el nido! we did tour a and c, for 2 executive days. the team was very knowledgeable about all the islands we visited. they were also so friendly and entertaining, keeping the energy up throughout the day. from start to finish, we felt well taken care of and in good hands. they prioritized everyone's safety at every stop. it was a fun, worry-free adventure that we'll always remember. highly recommended for anyone looking to explore the islands of el nido, palawan with a professional and fun-loving crew!

we had an incredible island hopping experience with our stories travel and tour! the scenic beauty, well-planned itinerary, and friendly staff made our trip unforgettable. thank you for creating wonderful memories for us!☺️

we had an incredible private tour with 360 tour. it was truly a highlight of our trip! our group of seven, including three kids (ages 11, 12, and 14), had a blast paddling through the calm waters of the nichupté lagoon. david was an outstanding guide—friendly, knowledgeable, and full of fun stories that kept everyone engaged from start to finish. the whole experience felt safe, scenic, and serene. highly recommend this tour for families looking to connect with nature and have some fun on the water!

we had an incredible stay at lerai safari camp with a group of 10. the staff truly exceeded our expectations; everyone was thoughtful, attentive, and incredibly accommodating. a special thanks to sammie, lawrence, mark, sharon, and lucas, all of the maasai who accompanied us during our game drives. their knowledge and passion made our experience unforgettable. they ensured our safety throughout the drives and at the property, creating a sense of security that allowed us to fully enjoy our adventure. chef martin also deserves a special mention his culinary skills are superb! each day featured a rotating menu that kept our dining experience exciting. for our final night, he even organized a private dinner, showcasing his dedication to making our stay unforgettable. throughout our time, we were never met with a "no," which made us feel genuinely valued. from cozy bonfires to endless cups of ginger tea and just relaxing at the camp, our stay was the best part of the trip due to the outstanding service at lerai. the tents were exceptionally comfortable, and the early morning coffee delivered right to our tent before our game drives was a delightful touch. we felt more like family visitors than hotel guests, which made our experience even more special. returning home after such exceptional service has made it hard to adjust back to the norm! the hospitality we received at lerai is truly unmatched, and i cannot recommend this camp highly enough. if you're looking for an unforgettable safari experience, this is the place to be!

we had an incredible stay at lerai safari camp. we were a multigenerational party of 10, with kids ranging from 10-18 as well as our parents. as we were a large group, for most of our stay we had the camp to ourselves. the staff is excellent, everyone was so thoughtful and accommodating. the chef is superb, with a rotating menu each day. the tents were very comfortable and the service was outstanding, which included daily laundry (helpful since we wanted to pack light) and early morning coffee delivered to the tent prior to game drives. we honestly felt more like family visitors than hotel guests. i cannot recommend this camp more highly.

we had an incredible time - some of the best days of our life ! leo and a were incredible guides and the entire crew took the best care of us! thank you again to everyone who made this trip so special! until next time

we had an incredible time here. the whole property has a very relaxed castaway island feel but in the most luxurious way. every detail has been thought of. the staff are exceptional, nothing is too much trouble. thank you to everyone who made our stay so memorable, zane, isac, our wonderful dive master lorenzo and our butler paulo, who is just the happiest person to be around. also, the food was incredible. thank you, we plan to come back one day!

we had an incredible time last night with sydney harbour kayaks — it was absolutely perfect! the guides (shannon and gabi) were fantastic: knowledgeable about the harbour, the icons, and everything in between. kayaking was such a brilliant way to experience vivid and see the harbour from a whole new perspective. as a total novice on the water, i felt completely safe and surprisingly confident — almost like an expert! a brilliant family outing for both teens and parents. thanks sydney harbour kayaks.

we had an incredible time on haqqy life’s tour a in el nido—even with a surprise rainstorm! the staff had such positive, funny energy and kept everyone smiling the whole day. the tour hit all the beautiful spots like the big lagoon and seven commandos beach. the snorkeling was incredible with crystal-clear water and vibrant marine life. we were blown away by how beautiful everything was! we ended up eating on the boat because of the weather, but the food was still a highlight—fresh, delicious, and so well-prepared. highly recommend haqqy life for a fun, unforgettable experience, we met some great people who were also staying at frendz hostel who we will stay in contact with from the tour.

we had an incredible time on our santorini boat trip, thanks to anastasia and mike. they were friendly, professional, and made us feel so welcome. the views were stunning, the swim spots were perfect, and the whole experience felt really special. highly recommend!

we had an incredible time sailing across the lagoons, stunning views, great vibes, and drinks set the tone before we jumped in for some snorkeling. we spotted a couple of sea turtles and were surrounded by colorful tropical fish that made the experience unforgettable. on our way back, we were lucky enough to see a pod of dolphins! the entire 3-hour trip was filled with fun, good food, drinks, and music. truly a perfect mix of adventure and relaxation. we’ll definitely be back for more!

we had an incredible time with our tour guide who was funny, very knowledgeable, and was even good at the political satire. the boat was intimate, wine selection was great, and blankets on board were a welcome addition. it was lovely to see amsterdam from the waters perspective and areas we wouldn’t have gone to by foot or bike.

we had an incredible time with salim! from the moment of our meeting, he exuded so much warmth and kindness. he is very knowledgable about fez and it's rich history and can go in great depth with every question you might have. he is a true local as he spent his childhood in the streets of the medina. he brought us to places where we otherwise would have not discovered ourselves. he showed us little gems like the leather auction, a local bakery, a rooftop overlooking the university, and a local restaurant (we were the only tourists). he made sure that we had an authentic experience and allowed us to take our time if we needed to. we felt safe and cared about in his company. he even picked us up from our riad and brought us home. and our tour lasted few more hours than the initial plan, as he made sure that we saw everything and had a great time. salim is truly one of a kind. my partner kris and i are truly grateful that we met salim. he is a wonderful human being that made our fez trip a more meaningful one. thank you salim. i will hold our experience with you close to my heart. -- if you are looking for the best tour guide and an unforgettable experience, look no further. :)

we had an incredible time with sidecar adventures, truly one of the most unique and unforgettable ways to experience & cruise cape town in style. i'd recommend starting your adventure at the depot, where the fun kicks off with choosing your perfect leather jacket and enjoying a warm welcome over a great cup of coffee. from there... let's just say, a few surprises await - one in particular might just leave a citrusy smile on your face! the team looked after us so well from beginning to end. the ride itself was smooth, scenic, and so much fun - coastal roads, mountain view’s, fresh air, and absolute freedom. an experience that feels cinematic and personal all at once. whether you're visiting cape town or rediscovering it, sidecar adventures is a must - full of charm, thoughtful touches, and the kind of memories that stay with you long after the helmet comes off.

we had an incredible time with these crew. even being a complete beginner, we felt welcomed and well looked after. eduardo was our instructor and he was so chilled, funny and taught very well. all other team members always said hi to us and were also super friendly. over 10 hours of learning i was able to body surf comfortably, and also stand on the board for a few seconds up to 20 seconds (am medium-sporty). i would come back to this kite surfing place again and do more hours. one warning is don’t expect ‘efficiency’ and ‘perfect planning’, as kite surfing depends on the wind and tide that day and time. hence recommend having a hire car so that you can go somewhere else near by if the kite surfing is cancelled in the morning for example. but definitely go here if you want a relaxing and chilled kite surfing experience.

we had captain scott and santiago on a tuesday at 1pm tour, they were super friendly, fun, and responsible tour! it’s one of the fewer places that offer afternoon tour that we found by googling. the other cheaper under $100 tours are usually larger groups and in the morning only. since the capacity was 6 people, we were worried it might be canceled if not enough people booked at that time slot. turned out when we arrived there was a family of 7 who booked through a 3rd party site like trip advisor or some other, so captain max couldn't take them as it was over legal capacity, and the family had to get refund theough the 3rd party site... i felt bad for them, but a good lesson learned to not book through 3rd party website, as miscommunication happens. it was a sunny and very calm day, and santiego attempted a few good photos of my bro and i, since i snorkeled in shallow beaches and had never done open waters before now, it was my first time with only a small belt float as a challenge. it was also the first time we were able to get photos of both of us in water, since usually we take pic of each other. so we bought the photos from the tour around $125, even though i had to photoshop them on my own in the end, knowing santiego's photo skills definitely have room for improvement haha overall nice people, good experience, saw many sea turtles, fish, urchin, and some saw baby shark! also since we accidentally end up with an exclusive private ride that day with only 2 of us on boat... so 5 star! :)

we had the best time here, there is so much to see, and a surprising amount of wildlife! geckos, frogs, hawks, and more. the grounds are absolutely beautiful and you could spend an entire day here. parking is super easy, fun gift store, and the cafe has a great iced latte. they have plants and areas that you don’t see at other gardens so i really recommend it. we drove from pa and it was surprisingly easy to get to this part of the bronx as it’s right off 95.

we had the best time on our boat ride along the seine for my bachelorette party — seriously one of the highlights of our trip! our captain, lionel, was amazing. he was so kind, attentive, and made the whole experience feel special from start to finish. he shared the most interesting facts and bits of history about the buildings and bridges we passed, which added such a meaningful touch to the ride. it felt like a perfect mix of relaxing, beautiful, and learning something about the beautiful city! if you’re planning a girls trip to paris, i highly recommend booking this! it’s such a fun and unique way to see the city, especially with a glass of wine in hand and great company. we’ll be talking about this for awhile!

we had the best time on our boat tour with ben! firstly, ben is such a lovely guy and took the time to talk us through all the major landmarks along the seine with plenty of historical facts and bits of info! super interesting and on a hot day like it was, it was the perfect way to see paris. he also made sure we stopped to get pictures with the best backdrops, and even let us drive the boat!! so so much fun! the boat itself was lovely! really clean and plenty of space, it felt like a luxury experience and being able to connect your music via bluetooth was an added bonus. we could also eat and drink on the boat which was great! thank you so much ben for the brilliant experience and we all would highly recommend this tour!

we had the best time on our e-bike tour with outdoor interlaken. the bike ride took us to places we never would’ve discovered on our own. west was hands down one of the best guides we've ever had. super fun, friendly, and incredibly knowledgeable. it ended up being the highlight of our whole vacation. can’t recommend it enough!

we had the best time on this private boat adventure on the seine river! in our 2+ weeks in france, this tour was one of the greatest highlights. the family-owned company was fantastic from start to finish. working out the details with artur was easy and efficient, and our journey on the river with daughter patricia was outstanding. the special treats they provided for our 60th birthday celebration were so appreciated. we'd rate this tour 100 stars if we could. if you're in paris, this is a must do!!

we had the chance to visit little canada and were pleasantly surprised by how much we enjoyed it! the staff were incredibly kind and attentive — they even let us in a little earlier than our scheduled time, which we really appreciated. the space is clean and well-organized, with clear instructions throughout. the exhibits are truly impressive, offering something for everyone. while it's definitely fun for kids, adults will also find a lot to admire and enjoy. from the detailed miniature landscapes to the interactive elements, it's a unique experience that's both educational and entertaining. also, a big plus: clean washrooms and great service overall. highly recommend visiting if you're in toronto!

we had the most incredible experience aboard our yacht, all thanks to melanie and team! from start to finish, the service was nothing short of exceptional. the crew was attentive, professional, and genuinely dedicated to ensuring every detail was perfect. communication was seamless, making the entire process—from booking to boarding—stress-free and effortless. the yacht itself was stunning, offering a luxurious and comfortable setting with breathtaking views. every moment felt elevated, whether we were enjoying gourmet bites, sipping cocktails, or simply soaking in the atmosphere. if you’re looking for a truly top-tier yachting experience with impeccable service, this is it. i can’t recommend it enough!

we had the most incredible experience on a 4-hour vortex tour with danil from one tribe tours. from start to finish, danil was kind, attentive, and deeply in tune with the environment around us. he guided our meditations with such care and precision, creating a space that felt safe, grounding, and transformative. danil’s knowledge of the area was remarkable—he knew exactly where to take us to avoid the crowds, allowing us to truly connect with the beauty and energy of the surroundings. he pointed out flowers, trees, and other details we might have overlooked, reminding us to slow down and appreciate the wonders of nature that we so often take for granted. to top it all off, his wife made us the most delicious organic cookies and refreshing tea, adding such a thoughtful and personal touch to the experience. thank you, danil, for your patience, for holding space for us, and for sharing your knowledge and energy. this tour was not just a journey through the vortexes, but also a journey inward, and it’s an experience i’ll carry with me for a long time. i can’t recommend one tribe tours enough—this was truly a magical and unforgettable experience.

we had the most incredible experience on our private boat day tour with karlos excursions. the tour started bright and early at 7.30am, and we were back by 2.30pm, perfectly timed to make the most of our day. the snorkelling on the reef was fantastic – we saw loads of fish and in calm waters. the skippers - ricardo and jordan - were great, especially in spotting whales for us, which wasn’t even part of the itinerary. jordan even dived into the water to get sea urchins for us from the rocks, which we ate fresh at lunch. they tasted similar to oysters and added a unique touch to our meal. a highlight of the trip was our visit to the island, which was completely private with our own table, a delicious bbq, and a private musician playing local music on the guitar. other companies arranged lunch at crowded communal tables and we were the only people with a private table setting. i highly recommend paying extra for the lobster – it was worth every penny. we finished the day by cruising slowly over the stunning blue waters. although we were unlucky not to see dolphins on this trip, the manager, virginia, was fantastic. she organized a 2-hour dolphin tour for us on another day at 50% of the cost, and we were lucky enough to see dolphins in the wild and even snorkel with them briefly. overall, this tour was an absolute highlight of our trip to mauritius. highly recommend it to anyone looking for an unforgettable and picture perfect mauritian experience.

we had the most incredible experience with palaweña during our honeymoon in el nido! from the moment we reached out, wineth’s communication was absolutely amazing—so warm, helpful, and responsive that it truly felt like i was chatting with a friend. she made planning our tours so effortless and exciting. both our private and shared tours were nothing short of perfect. the staff was professional, kind, and clearly passionate about making every moment memorable. everything was well-organized, and the attention to detail was top-notch. we felt safe, cared for, and completely immersed in the beauty of el nido thanks to the team’s expertise and energy. as honeymooners, we couldn’t have asked for a better way to explore this paradise. whether you’re traveling as a couple, with family, or with a group of friends, palaweña is the absolute best choice. we’re already dreaming of coming back with our loved ones and reliving this unforgettable experience—with wineth and her incredible team at the heart of it all. highly, highly recommend!

we had the most incredible scuba diving experience exploring both a shipwreck and a vibrant coral reef, and it’s a day we’ll never forget! from the moment we arrived, the team made us feel safe, excited, and completely taken care of. a special shoutout to arturo, our guide, who was absolutely phenomenal—knowledgeable, calm, and passionate about diving. he made sure we felt confident at every step and pointed out so many amazing underwater sights. the shipwreck dive was amazing— we saw multiple eagle sting rays and barracudas. then the coral reef blew us away with its colors, schools of fish, and peaceful underwater world. raul, the photographer, captured stunning photos of the whole experience that we’ll treasure forever. he somehow managed to get action shots and candid moments that truly reflect how magical it all felt. and last but not least, alex, our boat driver, was fantastic—friendly, helpful, and clearly experienced. he made the boat rides smooth and fun, and was always ready with a smile and a hand when we needed it. if you’re looking for an unforgettable dive with a professional, caring, and downright fun crew, look no further. thank you arturo, raul, and alex for making this such a great experience.

we had the most incredible stay at this resort. the service was absolutely excellent and our every need was taken care of by the azura team. the facilities are fantastic and the food is out of this world!! this is a wonderful place to take children - the staff were amazing at every step in catering for them and us. loved every minute of our trip here - cannot recommend it enough!

we had the most incredible sunrise kayaking experience with sydney kayaking tours. we knew from the start that we were in good hands. the team was super professional and experienced in what they do. we were given clear guidance and were well looked after from start to finish. everyone in the team was warm, kind and respectful. there were many wholesome peaceful moments in the water at every little break we took and when we watched the sunrise together on this beautiful harbour. chris kindly took photos to capture these moments and shared with us at the end. we wrapped up the day with a delicious coffee and pastry at the bay, still feeling exhilarating from the experience. me and my group of friends absolutely made a lasting memory from this event. it couldn't have gone any better. highly recommend!

always taken care of having chotak, rishav, anton, and daria along for most of the trip was a true blessing. we had endless conversations, plenty of laughs, and their willingness to share their we have been going to high park over 20+ years but never went into this museum. it’s was very interesting to learn more about high park history. from colborne lodge: colborne lodge, now a museum, is the historic 1837 home of john and jemima howard, the couple who founded high park. it is a rare north american example of a regency picturesque building, which is more common in britain. designed to compliment the natural world, colborne lodge sits comfortably among high parks beauty and includes 19th-century recreated gardens, a coach house and the howards' tomb. the muse um also displays much of the howard's original furnishings and watercolours. following howard's death in 1890, the property and surrounding land was donated to the city of toronto with the condition that the surrounding land would remain free to use, remain untouched and be used exclusively for the enjoyment of residents. it’s an important part of the community thank you for keeping the community together and sharing this beautiful place with us all. we owe to the howard family 💕

we have taken cooking classes all over the world, and we thought savuth’s class was one of the most authentic and enjoyable classes we have ever attended. he invited us to customize the menu, and he carefully prepared each course so that we could cook it ourselves under his instruction. if there was something that had to be done ahead of time, like pounding the spice mixture for the amok, he still showed us step by step how he did it. that’s really important for cambodian cooking because pounded herbs and spices is one of the defining characteristics of the cuisine. thanks to savuth, i now know that the ingredient in everything from bar peanuts to soup that i couldn’t quite recognize is kaffir lime leaves. we even learned how to roll fresh spring rolls out of rice paper, and i can’t wait to try that at home. savuth is a well trained and skilled chef, but he is also a talented and patient teacher. the last thing i want to mention is his amazing kitchen. it is out in the countryside, and savuth’s stove is wood burning. as westerners, we expect a steamer basket to be metal. at savuth’s cooking school, the steamer basket is an actual wicker basket submerged in a pot of boiling water. the mis en place bowls are handcrafted from coconuts and the amok molds are real bamboo sections. every part of the open air kitchen was lovingly built and artistically decorated by his own hand. we were there during the rainy season, and on the way to dinner, we got caught in a rainstorm. but when we reached the kitchen, everything was snug and dry. savuth is proud of his cooking school, and he should be. i highly recommend it.

we have taken this ferry several times going to iceland or the faroe island with our car and once even with our trimaran on a trailer to sail the greenland sea. this is the only ferry that crosses the north atlantic and has been cancelled only once. be prepared you may have some wild storms if you travel autumn and winter. it connects hirtshals on northern jutland to seydisfjördur on the southeastern tip of iceland via torshavn, the capital of the faroe islands. if you want to travel comfortably, book one of the superior cabins. avoid high season if you can and prefer the á la carte restaurant to the buffet. they feature a rather decent wine list. there is high alcohol consumption on board. if you have nothing else to do during daytime you can train your bird photography skills on the accompanying gannets and fulmars.

we heard lots of hype about going on adventure boogies' buggy ride. we ended up booking the ended up booking the evening tour. we were picked up from our hotel in punta cana at 5:10 and brought to their facility. it was a pretty quick ride from ocean blue & sands. the overall experience was great! the staff was all incredible! the dinner was of local flare and delicious. we tried their local chocolate, and they had a gift shop to buy their specialty coffee and drinks. the cave raves, and the shows were lots of fun. our only disappointment was the buggy ride. on the ride, there were probably 30 buggys, all single file down the roads up into the mountain. they are 200cc side by side buggies that if i had to guess topped out at 55kph, but the fastest we were able to go was 43kph a couple times because i left a big gap and sped up to the other buggy. on a couple of turns, i tried to slide around a little and was quickly reprimanded. the rest of the adventure was awesome, though!

we hiked this levada and really enjoyed it. the trail ends at a beautiful waterfall – there’s technically a “no entry” sign, but everyone goes past it, and you can even take a dip in the waters below. just be prepared – the water is ice cold! we arrived at the parking lot a little before 9 am, and it was only about one-third full. parking is paid – €2 per hour, with a daily maximum of €10. entry to the levada is €3, payable at the start via qr code. we left around 1 pm and had no trouble getting out of the parking lot, despite what some reviews say. the hike wasn’t too demanding, especially in august when it’s dry – we didn’t have to wade through water or go under waterfalls. there are about three tunnels along the way, one of them about 100 meters long, we used our phones flashlight to see and it was completely fine. the views throughout the hike are stunning. on the way to the waterfall, we had the entire levada to ourselves, which was amazing. on the way back, we passed a few people, but nothing like big crowds – it was always easy to pass by. just watch your step near the edge of the levada… unlike me, who managed to step right in. 😀

we hiked to kennedy falls this saturday and it turned out to be the perfect day, just the right balance between cool and warm, making the trek really enjoyable. the trail starts at the end of mountain highway in north vancouver, along a wide gravel road that branches off into several trailheads. the kennedy falls trail itself felt beginner to moderate in terms of difficulty. there were a few sections that required careful footing, especially the part where we had to walk along tree roots with a chain on the side to help balance but nothing too intense. we even saw a few elderly hikers on the trail (though no kids or dogs), which reassured us that it’s doable for most people with decent fitness. the path winds through a lush forest filled with stunning west coast scenery. one of the highlights was following the big cedar tree trail, where we encountered a massive old cedar tree that felt like a piece of history standing tall among the woods. the trail gradually climbed higher with a mix of uphill and downhill sections, keeping things interesting but not exhausting. the best part? the end reward; kennedy falls itself. a long, dramatic waterfall that made the whole hike worthwhile. it’s a peaceful spot to take a break, enjoy the view, and soak in the sounds of rushing water surrounded by untouched forest. overall, if you’re looking for a trail that offers variety, forest charm, and a stunning waterfall at the end, kennedy falls is definitely worth the adventure.

we hiked to materuni waterfall, which is located at the foot of mount kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in africa, standing at 5,895 meters. every step was worth it to take in the surrounding landscape, immerse ourselves in nature, feel the (very cold) water coming down from kilimanjaro, and also enjoy the coffee-making process in the area ☕️. additional insight: materuni waterfall is not only a stunning natural attraction but also offers a unique cultural experience. the area is inhabited by the chagga people, who have a rich tradition of coffee farming. during your visit, you can learn about their traditional methods of coffee production, from bean to cup, making the hike both a scenic and cultural journey. note: don’t forget to wear hiking shoes, especially if you visit during the rainy months, as the ground can be very slippery.

we hiked to the second (third?) lake and back. 7 hours total time with 600+ metres of elevation gain (and descent of course on the way back down). the trial starts off innocently enough - maintained trail, gentle slope, easy route finding but lots of mud and roots. stays like this for about 2 km to the first lake. then the trail skirts the lake over some rocky and less well maintained trail for about another km until it veers left at the end of the first lake. the easy part is now over. the trail now climbs straight up past the first waterfall. you can navigate through the rock fields on the right to avoid the scramble through the bush but there are no trail markers. once you are past the first waterfall and until you reach the second much smaller lake near the main waterfall there is lots more elevation gain through never-ending fields of rock that can be difficult to find your way through. there are cairns to help guide you at times, but they are not always obvious. once you get up level with the base of the main waterfall the trail turns into a scramble route straight up a steep loose rock slope for about 200 meters in elevation gain over about 300 metres distance. after you make your way to the top of this section, the trail cuts right across the top of the rock slope and heads up towards the high point. from here the third lake comes into view quickly on your right and lower down. another km over more shattered rock will take you to to the camp site at the other end of the lake. as others have said before - please for the sake of your dog don’t bring them past the first lake. it would be extremely difficult for any breed.

we hired these architects to carry out a major project at the villa, which turned out spectacular. the surprise came when, after a few years, the lights and transformers in the suite and columns they designed and installed with one of the companies they brought in began to fail, and we spent months trying to fix them without success. we contacted them, but in addition to receiving a blunt and curt response, they barely provided us with phone numbers, and they have been giving us the runaround for months, only to tell us that they can't fix the lights, that they don't know where or how the transformers were installed, and that to do so, we would have to remove the mirrors with suction cups, although we weren't even sure how to do it. we were surprised when we were able to speak with part of the team that carried it out, and they assured us that some of the glass was glued in without being able to be removed, following the architect's direct instructions. he gave the order to do so due to the difficulty of the work. after several broken glass sections, he preferred to glue them back in, assuring us that if the lights ever needed replacing, we would take care of replacing the glass as well. it's unacceptable for architects to act this way. now we find ourselves in a complex and complicated situation to resolve due to their poor practices and desire to finish and get paid. as architects, very well done, but be careful with subsequent maintenance, as you'll have problems with whatever they design for you.

we joined the atoll team for two morning dives and had a truly special time. the marine park was a stunning location above the water and a real treat below the waves. we saw a bunch of eels and turtles as well as some really healthy lookout hard and soft coral. twin barges was a fun two for one wreck dive. both were teaming with life. the whole crew was friendly, professional and kind. the boat was the most comfortable i’ve ever had the pleasure of diving from. my only regret is that we didn’t budget more time on our trip for diving. i’m already looking forward to a return trip someday.

we joined the ha ka combo. the duration of the guided tour is 1.5 hours, very informative, can see a lot of māori carvings, then went to a house with several kiwis there. the geysers were the most impressive! finally we watched a dance show. unfortunately it was raining on that day otherwise it would be more enjoyable. overall the place is recommended!

we joined uncle brian’s best of both worlds 2-day tour on august 8, 2025 (mom 57 + son 17) and it was the highlight of our trip! 🌿💦 our guide coco was incredible—funny, caring, and always focused on safety. he showed us how to jump, slide, and play in waterfalls like a natural aqua park, while also offering alternative rainforest walks for those who preferred to stay dry. he kept the bus rides entertaining with games, quizzes, and even window drawings. we saw rainforest waterfalls, rivers, lakes, a night canoe with wildlife (platypus, flying foxes, golden possum), a crocodile river cruise, and a kangaroo rescue center. the dorm stay was clean and social, with great food—especially the bbq dinner and endless snacks! this tour is perfectly planned, full of adventure, laughter, and unforgettable memories. highly recommend uncle brian’s (and ask for coco!) if you want the best mix of nature and fun in cairns. 🌟

we just arrived from our trip to south africa, zimbabwe and botswana. our itinerary, hotels and transportation were organised by nicole from timeless africa safaris. our experience from the trip is beyond expectation. we want to say "big thank you" to nicole who was on phone with us trying to arrange every detail of our trip considering everything we wanted to experience in african adventure. thank you nicole for all nice gifts awaiting us at the hotels. thank you for being with us every step of the way, checking us in on our flights, meeting personally and making our trip unforgettable. thank you rehana,our tour guide and personal driver, for being very knowledgeable and helpful. we enjoyed every tour and every accommodation we stayed in. now we plan another trip with timeless africa safaris. lynton and vera (australia)

we just ate at batch and had a delicious meal and the best service ever. the batch attack burger was the best burger i’ve ever eaten. the wings were amazing and so was the philly cheesesteak. they make everything from scratch, even their bitters, sodas and infused whiskey. what a find!!

we just came back from an amazing tour to tronador with natural travel turismo and we had a great time. the guide nestor was exceptionally nice, caring, tolerant, knowledgeable and informative. everything ran smoothly and on time. we will book one more tour with them. highly recommended!

we just came back from our full day dhow cruise. everything was great, the team was friendly, the food was good. we had the boat for ourselves. incredible views, nice snorkeling and of course we saw around 20 dolphins that followed our boat for at least an hour. overall great experience. i highly recommend ahlam musandan tours.

we just came back from our full day dhow cruise. everything was great, the team was friendly, the food was good. we had the boat for ourselves. incredible views, nice snorkeling and of course we saw around 20 dolphins that followed our boat for at least an hour. overall great experience. i highly recommend ahlam musandan tours.

we just came back from our full day dhow cruise. everything was great, the team was friendly, the food was good. we had the boat for ourselves. incredible views, nice snorkeling and of course we saw around 20 dolphins that followed our boat for at least an hour. overall great experience. i highly recommend ahlam musandan tours.

we just came back from our full day dhow cruise. everything was great, the team was friendly, the food was good. we had the boat for ourselves. incredible views, nice snorkeling and of course we saw around 20 dolphins that followed our boat for at least an hour. overall great experience. i highly recommend ahlam musandan tours.

we just completed the bright angel trail to the 1.5-mile turnaround point, and it was such an awesome experience! i hiked it with my 12, 14, and 17-year-old kids, and we all loved it. the trail is well-maintained and full of stunning canyon views the entire way down and back. the weather was perfect, which definitely made it doable and enjoyable—we couldn’t have asked for better conditions. the 1.5-mile resthouse is a great goal for families—it’s a rewarding distance with plenty of beauty along the way. just be warned: the hike back up is no joke, so take your time. and bring plenty of water—you’ll need it more than you think! such a great memory made together. highly recommend this hike if you’re looking for something active but manageable on your grand canyon visit!

we just finished 3 days of diving at meridian dive resort highly recommend it. we location is great for the best dives in the ares, the dive boats are new and comfortable but what really stands out is the team. dive master ross made us feel completely taken care of. when small issues arose they were handled professionally. he went out of his way to make this a memorable vacation. and since this is the first dive resort i’ve been to where they take photos and videos, we have wonderful pictures to remember it by. also a shout out to aldo, joane and the rest of the staff for taking care of all our arrangements and transfers. from meeting us at the airport and finding a hotel to wait for the boat transfer, it made the trip to indonesia very easy. we will definitely be coming back.

we just finished a 10 day trip to israel with assaf as our tour guide for the whole trip and he was amazing! he was so engaging, fun, and knowledgeable and really was one of the highlights of the trip. he was able to answer well any question we sent his way, always had a great sense of humor, knew the best places to take us, and even taught us hebrew words every day. i seriously cannot day enough good things about him. you want him as your tour guide!

we just finished a 2 day tour with andile. he was the best guide ever. from the scenic vineyards to the langa township, he made us feel welcome. he was passionate about his home town and gave us lots of recommendations and local insights that made the trip really enjoyable. his level of professionalism was outstanding, always making sure we felt comfortable and relaxed. the itinerary was well planned and was a great mixture of local food and sights. we enjoyed local coffee and pastries to gourmet lunches and home cooked food. we hesitated to book initially but both tours were a worthwhile investment and i can’t recommend andile enough. thank you for 2 amazing days!

we just finished our incredible cape town tour with kiff kombi tours, and we couldn’t recommend them more—especially andile! from start to finish, he went above and beyond to make our trip unforgettable. his deep knowledge of the city, rich storytelling, and easygoing nature made every moment both informative and fun. whether it was exploring hidden gems, sharing local insights, or keeping us entertained along the way, andile truly made our experience special. if you’re visiting cape town, book kiff kombi tours and ask for andile as your guide—you won’t regret it!

we just got back from a 3-day, 2-night (24-26.03.2025) adventure with el nido paradise, and honestly—what an unforgettable experience. from the moment we stepped onto the boat, everything felt like a dream. bryan and the crew were simply incredible. they didn’t just guide the trip—they made it feel like home. we felt safe, well taken care of, and completely at ease the whole time. every little detail was thoughtfully handled. the barman kept the good vibes flowing happy hour - isa pa!!), the food was beyond amazing (we're still thinking about those meals! even so simply... peanut were omg!), and the cabins in the islands were clean and cozy—perfect for winding down after a day of exploring. this is more than a trip; it’s something everyone needs to experience at least once in their life. el nido’s/coron beauty is breathtaking, but it’s the people (we had amazing group and amazing crue) and the atmosphere that truly make this journey special. 10/10—would do it again definately!!!

we just got back from a great day trip around santorini. we were picked up from our hotel and taken to the port. the whole experience was fantastic, the staff that collected us and the crew on board were great. we went to several locations including the red beach, hot springs and the white beach (where we snorkelled) all around the caldera. the food was delicious (thanks chef mike) and on the way back we were really lucky to see dolphins! we made new friends aboard, so all in all a great day out! thanks sirigos sailing!

we just got back from our first trip to the serengeti and a hot air balloon ride was something i wanted to do. our tour company booked a ride for us with miracle experience and we were not disappointed. they came to pick us up from our camp, had light coffee and snacks set up before the ride. everyone was amazing, from the staff setting up and working behind the scenes to the captain. they have cars following during the ride to pick you after the ride and take you to have a bush breakfast. they celebrate special events, so they had a cake ready for us and another couple who were also on their honeymoon. i am soo glad we did this, truly a once in a lifetime experience.

we just got off a 7 day lees ferry to whitmore wash trip this past week. in short, it was an incredible trip. i have a background in river running--having guided in dinosaur national monument when i was younger so i can appreciate a little more than average the service and quality of the experience. the grand canyon has always been on my bucket list. grand canyon whitewater and their guides (evan, caitie, savannah and walt) exceeded my expectations. words are inadequate to describe the beauty of the canyon--you have to experience it yourself. my interaction leading up to the trip with gcw was exceptional--they do a great job preparing you for the trip. the guides on our trip were fantastic both on the river and in camp. my work situation does not allow me to get away for a longer trip (i would like to do an longer oar raft trip and take some more time in the canyon) but the motorized raft trip was perfect for my first time exposure to the canyon. i did this with my 17 and 18 year old sons and they loved the trip! (they especially enjoyed the helicopter ride out of whitmore wash and the plane ride back to paige and seeing from the air what we had been experiencing in the canyon. in short, take the trip! it will change your life for the better

we just had a wonderful experience. we drove here without reservations. we bought a whole day. we didn’t really want the included breakfast or lunch but after a two hour safari , we were hungrier than the lions we saw. the safari was wonderful and we saw the big four (no leopard). rhino’s with babies, a young pride of lions, mountain climbing elephants …

we just had completed the 5 day w trek with eco camp patagonia. we loved our whole experience. our guide jean was just amazing and very informative and funny and generous with his knowledge. we also had a great driver (nelson) who safely got us from place to place. the staff were very helpful particularly with sorting some complicated logistics for our group at the start of the tour. we loved staying in the domes, they are so cozy and the beds are extremely comfortable. the food is amazing and very generous. and the hiking was spectacular highly recommend

we just had the most incredible 3 night / 4 day tour with buhay isla from coron to el nido!! team sun were just perfect, all the crew members were very friendly, helpful and attentive, they made us feel super comfortable on the boat and in all of the base camps. they had a great dynamic and fun sense of humour, and the chefs did an excellent job - every meal was a culinary experience prepared with love and care. the group of travellers we had on board was great, very diverse backgrounds and ages. i couldn’t have wished for a nicer few days exploring the beautiful islands in between coron and el nido. i would definitely recommend this boat tour!!
we just left the spa and had the couples massages. they were so good we are going to go back tomorrow. the massages were fantastic and i highly recommend. plus the price is very good.

we just loved this spot! such a perfect japanese garden with a ton of history and historical significance. the foliage was lovely and really took you out of the city! but our favorite part were all the lovely bridges and stone walkways over the water. oh and did i mention it was only about $2/150 yen for the both of us!

we just returned from an amazing weekend cruising around the musandam peninsula or also known as the omani fjords with khasab tours. we were 10 adults and 8 kids and took their luxury boat which has 8 cabins and 16 bunk beds. mohammad the marketing manager was my main point of contact in arranging everything prior to arrival. he was very helpful in assisting with all of our requests and answering all of our questions. rafic was at the docks to welcome us and make sure everything was to our satisfaction before departure. once on board and settled, the captain and crew took care of all our needs and requests. a very nice lunch was served not long after we departed. we then arrived at our private bay in the afternoon and spotted a few dolphins. we enjoyed swimming in the bay and paddling around in the provided kayaks. when the evening arrived dinner was prepared and we enjoyed the meal under the bright stars which we cannot see from dubaj due to the light pollution. then some of us enjoyed a late night swim before we all went to sleep. the next morning we were all up my 7am to a serene scene. had an enjoyable breakfast and then set off to explore another bay. there we swam and dived off the boat some more. we finally, headed back to khasab port but first took some time to spot a few more dolphins on the way back. overall, it was a very enjoyable weekend with amazing friends making memories to last a lifetime. thank you khasab tours for everything.

we just returned from our liveaboard with blue marlin and it was truly the best trip ever! we had high expectations, but this trip exceeded them all! the dive sites and the underwater world were truly incredible and so diverse! both dive guides, harold and joe, were fantastic, as was the entire crew on board. everyone made sure that we had the best time ever. the food was amazing! definitely the best we had on our whole trip. also, sleeping on deck was super comfortable. you get pillows, sheets, blankets, etc. it was way more luxurious than we had imagined. on top of all that, we were incredibly lucky with our fellow divers and were such a great, harmonious international group. the only downside was that i didn’t want the trip to end. thanks again for this amazing experience i’m gonna cherish forever!

we just returned from three weeks in south africa, zimbabwe and botswana and are already planning our next trip all thanks to bianca and craig!! it was a life-changing trip and made all that much better because we had such amazing travel agents, that we now consider friends. during the planning phase they offered suggestions, addressed our questions, and worked with us when we decided to make last minute changes/additions. once there, they were flexible, accommodating, tolerant (as with 6 people traveling together it can be a lot), knowledgeable, and available via what's app whenever needed. they are literally two of the most wonderful and genuine people you could meet and i felt so lucky to have them by our sides during our journey. if you are planning a trip to southern africa i highly recommend using southern african tours!!!!!

we just spent 2 days and 2 nights here with my boyfriend and it was really an amazing experience! the hosts, gilbert, mariella and their 2 daughters are really kind, welcoming and full of good intentions to make you feel as good as possible! they organize really nice activities for you like fishing, art crafting, boat ride, etc. plus they cook you really good meals! also, their island is away from the bigger and more touristic uros islands. so it is very calm and you have a great view! and it is beautifully arranged and really cozy and comfortable! we highly recommend it!

we just spent 3 nights / 4 days onboard ciela and had a fantastic time. the very friendly crew and our guide couldn’t have done any more for us. from the initial meet and greet to the drop off back at the airport the trip was superbly planned, even when we had to change itinerary at the last minute due to a flight change. the food was excellent - varied and very tasty with a good mix of local and international dishes to suit everyone’s palette. our guide worked extremely hard to make sure we all got the most out of the trip, and always with a smile! from getting us up early to see sunrise from the top of padar island, to making sure we got the opportunity to swim with manta rays, turtles and baby sharks - he made the whole trip one we will remember forever! the dolphins were an added bonus to top off a very special 4 days.

we just stayed at earthsong in july of 2024. the place is fantastic. we would highly recommend it. our cabin was awesome. it was spotless and very comfortable and the views are fantastic. the property manager tye, was friendly, always easy to talk to and was always around to be sure we had everything we need. the cafe was a big plus for us because of the added convenience of having a great breakfast before heading out to denali, and grabbing a great box lunch to take on our day trips. we had a great stay and would definitely stay there again!

we just stayed here for part of our cr trip (2 nights) and enjoyed it. they welcomed us with a refreshing wet towel with lemongrass and juice, a nice touch that we got the days before at tabacon. they also gave a bottle of wine to celebrate our 10 year wedding anniversary. so kind! the welcome desk was great, and we did the hour long tour along the grounds to learn more about the creatures and grounds at aol. we had dinner that night at the on site restaurant and food was good, the service could have been quite a bit better. but that’s not a deal breaker. breakfast service was great as was the food but beware they don’t open until 6:30 (along with coffee outside of what they give you in room) so we had 10 minutes to get it to go and run down to town for the 7am tour, which is what most guides offer. as for the grounds, gorgeous. we heard howler monkeys each morning and saw a great thunderstorm both nights. we didn’t use the pool or hot tub but they looked great too. we did, however, go up the 95 foot tall nest for the aerial view. scary, but worth it. if you’re looking for a nice calm and gorgeous stay about 30 minutes out of the town, this is a great option.

we just want to walk in the garden and enjoy it. the garden is big wide on 3 levels. unfortunately the flowers were not well keeps. they grow between high grass and you feel like you walk in open fields not in a palace garden :). the green lawn is well kept. yea it is free to get in but they can star charging some small amount the will help to keep the beauty of the garden.

we just wrapped up an incredible three-day team-building tour with wayne, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. from the very start, he was an absolute joy to work with, helpful, patient, and full of great ideas to make sure everything ran smoothly. wayne’s energy and enthusiasm never wavered. he kept us engaged the entire time, balancing fun activities with fascinating stories and local gems that we never would have discovered on our own. he made sure every detail was taken care of, which meant we could just relax and enjoy the experience. beyond being a fantastic guide, wayne felt like part of the team. his warmth, humor, and genuine love for what he does made all the difference. we had so many laughs, learned a ton, and walked away with some amazing memories. wayne, thank you for making this such a special experience, we’ll definitely be back for another adventure!

we keep lions, siberian tigers, snow leopards, and amur leopards. we used to have ezo brown bears here, but they moved when the ezo brown bear house was built. you can see four species of wild animals, carnivores, and members of the feline family - all fairly large. it's built along a slope, so you can observe them from various angles. the cage juts out into the air, and we were able to see a snow leopard lying there from directly below. it has beautiful fur and a dignified gaze. even when it's just lying there, it has a certain dignity to it. it's fun to watch it for hours. my 1.5-year-old grandson "meow meow, it's so big!" he said (lol). no wonder it's bigger than our cats (lol).

we knew it would be an adventure but we were blown away with the experience we got! it was wild in the best possible way! definitely recommend. and definitely would do it again! half day rental is probably the way to go as the 2 hr doesn’t leave much room for getting out for exploring/pictures but definitely doable in 2 hrs.

we learnt 3 typical colombian dishes in a really fun class. chef jazmina walked us through various ingredients and how to prepare them. we then sat down for an amazing 3 course meal - look forward to trying these at home!

we left our camp at 0500 to get to the launch site and do the paper work. the max is 14-16 people in the basket.we had 6 + 8 plus 2 no shows so we had our 6 on our side which gave us more room. there are toilets at the launch site and you spend about 45 minutes there. we had captain ray, who is from canada and has been flying for 30+ years. 4000+ hours in balloons. he said he was in charge of safety for the company and i believe him. he was funny and skilled. after we launched with 5 balloons, i could see other balloons about a mile away on either side. the launch site for governor's is prime to allow flying over the mara river and seeing everything. we saw a lion protecting her kill from hyenas, hippos running back to the river after a night of grazing, and so much more. we flew right over the river. it was apparent the other companies can't do that. perfect landing then a hot breakfast in the field. if you want to fly over the river with a safe crew this is it.

we left the car there today. the pay and display machines were out of order, so we didn't need to pay. overall, there are plenty of parking spaces 👌👍. we went for a 25 km hike to bynack more and barns of bynack, which took us almost 7 hours. along the way, we stopped at the beautiful green loch. check out some photos from this trip, which i’ve attached below the review. it was wonderful 👍👌⛰️🏞🏴❤️🙂.

we left the pier a bit later than scheduled but still managed to reach maya bay on phi phi island before the main crowds arrived—definitely worth the early wake-up! one of the highlights of our trip was lunch on phi phi island, which exceeded everyone’s expectations. the food was delicious and served promptly, making for a great experience. we traveled from kamala beach, with a pickup at 6:20 am and returning around 5:00 pm. it was a long but well-organized day, and we’d highly recommend it!

we liked the park and activities, there but the rain suddenly started while we were there. therefore we had to find shelter for almost an hour. we also renter the boats but that was honestly nothing special. park seems to be maintained just fine. you will need to dedicate more time in cas you would like to see all the amenities it offers, might be worth it.

we logged close to 5 miles just in a fraction of the park - it is a huge place! locals take full advantage of the trails for juggling, walking, with dog or on bike. it is a cool place to exercise and relax on hot summer days.

we looked for a while to find a place here in vienna that served good coffee. this place was exactly what we were looking for. extreme attention was paid to every step of the preparation of our coffees, and there was nothing to complain about. prices are very reasonable, especially when taking into account the effort put into every coffee. the setting is also very nice, inside a beautifully decorated corridor.

we love being members here. it’s got something for everyone and perfectly located in the city so you feel like you in a totally different place. we enjoyed the shaded areas during a hot summer day. the food wasn’t bad either when we took a short break while it sprinkled. one of the coolest places was an area for the kids to play and cool off in the heat. my twins didn’t want to leave until i told them we were heading to see the gators. they have a beautiful collection of animals and it was really clean everywhere we went.
we love it. very convenient with child 👍🏽 food is free for child, good swimming pool, playing garden with workers for child.

we love spa eastman. we have tried every spa in the eastern townships and it is our favourite. the grounds are beautiful. the swimming pool and the pond are well separated and great to swim in. we love the hot pools and the whole layout really. it is very calm, and not over crowded like so many places that only offer day spas. it is a nice mix of hotel guests and day spa guests. the dining room is also great. and the treatments are very professional. we highly recommend it.

we love the disney family museum and come here a few times a year. we will normally come around 4pm with the kids so we can wander through quickly with the kids before they close for the day. make sure to head downstairs where the bathrooms are because there are some fun coloring sheets. my kids love the tiki bird that is interactive. it takes about 2 min to reset after each person (and between each of my kids that 2 min seems like forever). this museum never gets old and every-time we visit something new catches my kids attentions. (which is why we visit so often) we have never bought our tickets online - we buy them right when we arrive without any issues. we park easily. there are normally food trucks across the grass (they close up at 4pm). also, check out the tunnel tops and the playground and field station (closed monday and tuesday) @raising4harrisons

we love the san francisco botanical garden. our oldest son wasn’t too excited about going and thought it would be super boring. once we got inside - he had a really good time. we spent about 2 hours here and only went through half of the areas. (so we need to go back). the kids got hungry which is why we left (mom tip: take snacks) the trails are thin/narrow in some areas and just watch that your kids don’t run off through the plants and trees. check out their website as there are some fun events you may want to check out. (example yoga in the garden) parking can be a bit of a challenge- we found street parking right by the entrance (thankfully). definitely come on a weekday if you can.

we love this attraction and went for 2 more rides. a must do in the park!

we love this zoo! we are yearly members and go to most events they offer. such fun for kids to just be able to run , see animals and play. only wish they also had a playground for kids (as well as the sand play area) but such a good zoo. been to glow event 3 years in a row… first year was the best and since then it’s became more about money then experiences. but in current times that’s most activities. wish they offered cheaper and better food options. and this year aquarium wasn’t open at night like previous years. kids love that area especially at night.

we loved everything about our recent stay at rio serrano. our room had a magnificent view, the ambiance of the hotel was wonderful. we enjoyed the amenities including the saunas, pool, and gym. we were very happy with the selection at breakfast and the overall menus at both restaurants. and the staff were wonderful, very friendly and accommodating. special thanks to felipe who lit the fireplace every night for us and victor at breakfast who was always happy and smiling prior to 6am. i wish i had remembered other staff names to give a special thanks as everyone was wonderful.

we loved it! an amazing experience that we will surely repeat when we come back to barcelona! i thought it was going to take me longer to learn it but it was quite fast, the trainer is very patient and kind. thank you so much!!!

we loved it! we were at wilder and his family's house last year. we felt at home, they treated us very well and we were able to learn about quechua culture and cuisine up close. a highly recommended experience.
we loved it. thank you so much team. joe and his brother a great guide. celine, melanie & karim

we loved lido islad with great public transport on land and on water services

we loved our adventure with off-road expeditions. dennis and sam were awesome! they are both talented drivers and very confidence inspiring despite going up some pretty steep roads in the mountains. we had amazing views and tons of fun. they catered to all of our requests to make it more exciting or chill. dennis especially had a lot of interesting insights to share about the valley. this was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to new zealand! thank you dennis and sam so much for a wonderful experience!!!
we loved our afternoon with elsa — a fun and thorough experience of greek wine, food, and culture outside of the “norm”! highly recommend!

we loved our experience at ididaride! micah (not sure if i spelled that right) was an awesome musher- provided tons of knowledge and was very passionate about these dogs. they provided a video of us mushing and a bunch of photos, which i loved. plus the puppies!!!! they were only 3 days old and the cutest babies i’ve ever seen. all the dogs were such good boys and adorable. very cool to learn about mushing!

we loved our experience at maji moto, it is a very unique experience when visiting masai mara. the tents are very comfortable and all the staff is very nice. food is simple but very delicious. despite the fact we really enjoyed our stay, we were not fully satisfied with the day we did the game drive. the driver that took us, headed out from the park at 3:40pm when it was supposed to be a full day game drive. when talking with the manager, it should not have been the case. in the future, the staff should be well informed about the timings and should ask clients what do they prefer. this was the downside of our visit

we loved our experience renting a yacht from tulum boat experience. angelo was prompt with responding and gave us a great deal on our 80 ft yacht. it was the perfect size for our bachelor-rette celebration. the crew on board was super fun and kept the food & shots coming. we especially love the double deck allowing for amazing photos and views of the gorgeous caribbean sea. next time we’re in cancun & tulum we’ll be renting again. highly recommend!

we loved our go kayak experience into the mangroves. the owner andres is such a great guy who genuinely cares about this precious space in cancun. he was friendly, knowledgable, and caring. his company helps to clean up garbage in the mangroves. he brought his camera and took our photos, then send them to us not even asking for money. we came here right after doing excursions with extreme adventures which was very commercialized, everything was about money. it was really refreshing to chat with andres, you feel like you are just kayaking with an old friend! we signed up for the 2 hour sunset tour. something to know is to bring bug spray and wear long sleeves. we were swarmed by these little unknown flying insects and they bite our arms, a week later, we still dealing with itchiness.

we loved our guide mark! such a knowledgeable and funny guy. he really made the ride great. we took the 1.5 hr ride and saw the seven sacred pools and devils kitchen. really great stuff! able-bodied individuals can totally just hike to these spots, but the jeep ride is thrilling of course. it’s just not necessary and is quite expensive but is totally fun if you have the money to spend.

we loved our stay at mara maisha! we stayed for 2 nights and we absolutely loved it. the food was amazing, the staff was very kind and helpful and the heated pool was the cherry on top. this perfect place to rest after a long safari day. special thanks to ivy, who looked out for us during our meals and to the head chef. looking forward to see you again!
we loved our stay at natural palace farmstay! the family is really so friendly and welcoming. we appreciated the great food, the large rooms, the balcony and the beautiful surroundings.

we loved our time at the camp, everything was clean, cozy, and a very unique experience overall. the hosts were really welcoming and i enjoyed playing chess with them in the evening (even though i always lost). exploring the red desert was definitely a highlight and it was amazing to learn more about bedouin culture and trying the local food. we’d absolutely come back again

we loved our tour of sierra chuincua butterfly sanctuary. we rode horses up the mountain a bit then walked further into the butterflies. 100% amazing sites. my cheeks hurt from smiling so much. peaceful, beautiful, almost sacred experience. diego was great at answering our questions, but also letting us enjoy the views. we were lucky that in mid-march we caught so much butterfly action. on our way out we shopped the little market and diego was so helpful mediating/helping us communicate with our very minimal spanish. only downside: the car. it was 3 hours from our hotel in mexico city. there were 3 of us, plus diego the tour guide and a driver - so 5 people. the car we were in was for 4 people (as in, no seatbelt or headrest for the middle person). too small for 5. we were jammed into that backseat so tight - for 6 hours. not comfortable.

we loved our tour yesterday with bailey and don who were very knowledgeable, professional and safety alert during our tour of 11 jeeps. the jeeps were in good shape and easy to drive for a bunch of old people. this tour is highly recommended and five star.

we loved our trip to the reef with down under cruise and dive. the staff was fantastic, the meal was delicious, and the views were unbeatable. we enjoyed visiting two different reefs and snorkeling at each, and at the second reef we were able to experience a semi submersible (for a small additional charge). i appreciate that they had a strong focus on safety, while also ensuring that we had an unforgettable experience! highly recommend!!!

we loved our visit to the butterfly garden! the place has a very relaxed vibe, and the guide was incredibly knowledgeable. we learned all about the butterfly life cycle and saw a variety of butterflies with different shapes and vibrant colors. there were also different kinds of plants and chameleons in various stages of growth—it was fascinating! our kids (ages 3 and 5) had a great time exploring and were so engaged throughout. it’s also wonderful to know that our visit helps support around 30 local families through the ticket fees.

we loved our visit to the cape of good hope. the landscape is rugged and wild in the best way. you can do short hikes, take photos at the famous sign, or just sit and enjoy the ocean crashing below. it’s part of the table mountain national park, and the area is well maintained. try to go early to beat the crowds

we loved out stay. our family suite with spa pool was perfect for us and our children. it had all the amenities we needed. the queen bed wasn't the most comfort but no bed bets the bed at home. we would definitely stay here again

we loved pedro for our full day tours! he picked us up at our hotel and we toured most of the island in 2 days! he spoke portuguese and english and the car size held about 6 people! he was very funny and fun to be with! we paid 75.00 a person lunch was a big buffet and was included. i would make reservations if it’s the busy season. we did the tour sete cidades and furnas! i would chose him again and again! you won’t be disappointed unless he is booked up! the tours are cash and although they don’t expect a tip it’s a nice way to say thank you! enjoy my photos!

we loved snorkeling here! it is only a short bike ride from the town and there is a place to park your bikes. it is a short walk on a board walk to get to the pier. the pier was slightly crowded, but there was still enough room for us to get our gear on! there were also hooks that we used to hang up our bags to keep them off the wet ground. we went during the recommended low tide and the water was a perfect temperature! just on the dock, we saw 2 iguanas and a sea lion. in the water, i saw a star fish, many smaller fish, a couple of beautifully colored parrot fish and a ray! there are steps to get in the water so that it is easy to enter! the entrance is free as well.

we loved staying at the cove eco lodge. it is very well managed and the staff was wonderful. we appreciated all the attention to detail. the bungalows were lovely and very comfortable and the meals were delicious. the daily excursions were well-planned and we visited so many beautiful places for snorkeling and trekking. it was an outstanding experience and we would love to return.

we loved the beer, just wish they would freeze the glasses to keep the beer colder for longer. coconut rum was a pleasant treat, although you can definitely taste the water from the ice cubes. would recommend using filtered water for the ice. would definitely return if we had time.

we loved the bungalow!… very traditional costa rica, clean and beautiful and cozy! for a more modern option they also have cabins with a/c, tv, etc. the weather cools down enough at night so that a/c is not necessary. the pools are man made and are filled with the natural thermal waters from the volcano. they have 5 pools to choose from with varying temperatures making it easy to find a comfort level and place to relax with friends and family. the landscaping is beautiful and the entire property is gorgeous. we definitely want to come back the next time we are here!

we loved the casual flow of the tulum ruins and sian ka’an muyil tour. we walking around the tulum ruins and learned about the mayan civilization. it was early enough the weather wasn’t too hot to enjoy walking around the site. we also went to the newly built museum. the artifacts were well displayed and informative. it was nice to see the carvings and stonework up close since the ruins are closed off to public access. the float through muyil was refreshing and relaxing. we saw fish, birds, floral and fauna. miguel was very knowledgeable and friendly. he always made sure everyone had enough time to enjoy the experience and was comfortable. he was constantly checking if we needed food or water.

we loved the entire experience but i must mention how fabulous the entire staff that waited on us was! each and every one did an excellent job. my daughter is lactose intolerant and she commented that this staff did a better job of helping with that than any other restaurant she has experienced! many thanks!

we loved the experience of the concert at the palace. the orangery was a beautiful venue and the setting was great from the point of view of the acoustics. we had great seats which were a little expensive but worth it as we had the best chance to enjoy the wonderful orchestra and the very talented soprano and baritone artists. we really enjoyed the concert and the quality of the performance. we would recommend it to anyone as a special event.

we loved the market! we spent a couple hours walking around. i could have spent half the day here! must visit! we took it all in before choosing the sandwiches and treats we wanted to taste! so delicious!
