we loved this beautiful park that was within walking distance from where we are staying. gorgeous views. a perfect for so many activities - swimming, walking, picnics. seems to be a spot the locals love too. lots of animals - so many birds, chickens, roosters, wild cats and mongoose. at the very end is a lagoon with fairly calm water. went snorkeling and saw a few fish and some sea urchins too. the rock walls surrounding the lagoon blocks the waves so this is a perfect spot for families to swim.

we loved this beautiful track. it’s mostly uphill, so pace yourself and enjoy a slow, steady climb. along the way, there are a few perfect spots to stop, catch your breath, and snap some great photos. the scenery is full of lush trees and peaceful nature, making the walk as relaxing as it is rewarding. we really enjoyed it and would come back to do it again. you can also bring something cute to put alongside other fairies.

we loved this experience! it was our first time fishing on a boat, and it turned out amazing. we were lucky to have great weather, a wonderful captain, and plenty of fish. we were provided suits, fishing equipment, and bait. even if it wasn’t for the fish, the ride with the boat is worth it too. thank you, captain!

we loved this heritage hot spring bath, the water is at different temperatures and the pools look and feel natural, the views and setting make for a really authentic experience. clean changing rooms and welcoming reception. be open to the water being naturally mossy and careful with the slippery surfaces.

we loved this hike! we did the 3 mile red trail but there are shorter trails as well. it took us a little less than 2 hours. the trails are well marked and really interesting! a shout out to jean pierre at the reception desk who was very gracious and helpful, and to nicolas working at the small outdoor restaurant where we enjoyed iced coffee and fresh pineapple on their patio overlooking the arenal volcano!

we loved this kayak tour! not only was it fun and beautiful to be out on the water in this stunning place.. but the guide axel was great and told us a lot of interesting history about the area! definitely recommend this kayak tour in lofoten!
we loved this market. lots of nice items. the freshly squeezed juice is delicious and they have a nice sandwich bar. also great selection of candy/chocolate.

we loved this place. the town is so beautiful, peaceful and quiet. the family was very welcoming and la mama was so kind to us. the rooms were very pretty and big. the food was great!! the experiences we got to do were fun! i would strongly recommend!!

we loved this tour! saw plenty of gators, birds, and beautiful bayou scenery. some moments of high speed airboat fun and close up gator viewing really made this tour awesome. thank you to our guide dalton for adding some humor and fun facts along the way! additional thanks to the office folks who helped me out when i made some reservation changes a few days prior.

we loved using these boats in london. this was our preferred mode of transportation. the lines moved pretty quickly, it just depends on how early you make it there. and how late in the day it is (sometimes they would be behind schedule and have to leave early) the only negative was that the experience varied every time. sometimes there would be a tour, and sometimes not. overall would recommend, though. a great way to see the city.

we made a 5km husky run and it was amazing. we were allowed to „drive“ the sledge by our own after a short introduction. the dogs were super excited and happy. after the run we were allowed to pet them and they also had some puppies. mario told us a lot about the dogs and the work with them and everyone noticed how much he likes his job! it was a great experience and the dogs are well treated!

we made a booking for the following day having seen a poor weather forecast. the beautiful interior of the building created an atmospheric experience. sadly the quantity of clients booked resulted in a rush less relaxing than we hoped. in addition their card machine didn’t work all afternoon so we had no option but to pay cash.

we made a short stop at kemenuh butterfly park during our trip, and i’m really glad we did. although the visit wasn’t very long, it turned out to be one of the highlights for our kids. they were fascinated by the butterflies flying freely around the enclosure and enjoyed spotting different colors and sizes up close. we ended up taking a lot of pictures — it’s a very photogenic place, and you can get quite a few lovely shots with butterflies resting on your hand or shoulder if you're patient. one of the unexpected positives was how the visit helped reduce some of the fear of insects that my kids had before. seeing butterflies in such a calm and natural environment made them more curious than scared, and they walked away with more appreciation for nature. the park is clean, well-maintained, and peaceful — a nice break from the busier tourist spots. if you’re in or around ubud, i’d say it’s definitely worth adding to your itinerary, especially if you’re traveling with children. it’s not a place you’d plan your day around, but it’s a lovely, low-key stop that offers something memorable in a short time.

we made cenote triple adventure tour as 4 people with guilio on march 31, 2025. it was one of the most remarkable days in our 22-day mexico trip. guilio is so dynamic, energetic and friendly that he is not just the best tour guide but a friend who does the tour with you! and the tour itself was breathtaking. cenotes are wonderful and visiting 3 of them was quite easy with the tour. jumping from 6 meters high into the second cenote was the peak point of this experience. definetely try to do it! even not, seeing and swimming in the cenotes are like seeing the mysterious beauty of tulum. thank you adventure tour center and guilio!

we made no plans before arriving in sorong. i recommend that you actually make plans and consider allowing a few days for your birding adventures. nonetheless, i contacted charles a couple of days before and he could accommodate us. (it was off-season.) we drove close to town to a mangrove forest that is developed with walkways for birding. people fished their, too. we saw a number of our target birds. charles did his best with his portable bird caller on his back. that attracted some of the desired spotting. he had a scope and binoculars. it was a great afternoon. we learned that if you really want to adventure, you need a couple of days to overnight in a local village. that sounded great, but we didn't have the time. i should mention that i vetted charles through the hotel. they knew him well because he books some of his tours to stay at our hotel. that made us feel better about a random activity in indonesia. you will have fun with this company. (ps. hop dogma is not part of this, google edit is bad.) here are some birds that we saw: brown-backed honeyeater orange-fronted fruit dove sahul sunbird shining flycatcher willie wagtail uniform swiftlet white-bellied cuckooshrike common sandpiper

we made reservations for their course menu and wine pairing. we had two different course menus (the 60 - and 105 euro courses). the two courses were great; from start to finish, the food and appropriate wine pairings were great. with the exception of the mains (fish and chicken) were very delicious, and the wines they were paired with were great. the fish dish was good, but the surrounding sides were too salty. the chicken was a bit dry and did not have a lot of flavor. aside from those two, everything else was outstanding. the service and atmosphere were great. overall, whether you want to eat or taste wines, this is a good spot to try.

we made the appointment prior to arriving in marakesh though their website and they responded well. they told us that they only accept cash payment in the spa for which we agreed. we found this while looking for a nice hammam experience near our hotel since it is our first time in marakesh. this is just 11 minutes walk from our hotel. we came 30 minutes early for our appointment. we were greeted with a very warm welcome by the receptionist and were offered mint tea and some snacks while waiting. the hammam experience was different but we totally enjoyed it. those ladies may not know lots of english but they are very polite and tried their best to make you comfortable and relaxed. the 1 hour massage was incredible, refreshing and relaxing. the owner even greeted us after our massage and offered tea. overall, 430 dirhams for more than 2 hours is definitely worth it! surely we will comeback and recommend it. 😊😊😊

we made the mondesa township tour. it was a really great experience. you learn a lot about the living conditions and culture of the local black population. it is eye-opening and makes you more humble to what you really need in live.

we met captain hajl at the beach in jambiani. he was so kind and welcoming. we were booking a package of tours (dolphins, snorkelling, pungume island and the salaam cave). he gave us a really nice price and was able to manage everything very spontaneously (hakuna matata)☺️. the tour was amazing, even if we couldn’t be able to see a lot of dolphins, because they were hunting for food. he gave us everything and was so kind. it is a beautiful memory and we can definitely recommending a tour with captain hajl. asante sana for this amazing day captain hajl🥰

we next went to las bovedas artisan center. today, las bóvedas is a popular tourist attraction because of its traditional colombian shops selling columbian merchandise and an array of souvenirs. originally, they were built as storage vaults, and attached to the city walls, but were used as dungeons during the civil wars. they were finished in 1795. the porticos were finished in 1798. a side street will take one up to the roof top area, where there is an expansive view.

we only walked a short part of the trail. we caught bus no 6 from city hall and got off at the road leading to the wing nai chung reservoir to repulse bay. the weather was cool, windy and wet, but it was beautiful. i'm sure the views would have been amazing if the weather was fine, but there is nothing like the damp earth smells of wet weather hiking. the way to the top is clearly marked. there are quite a lot of steps, but nothing compared to the steps on the way down. it would be a very steep hike, but on steps, if you came from repulse bay. at this time of year (february) the small indications of spring are magical. repulse bay has plenty of trendy little bars and restaurants in front of the beach, if you are hungry afterwards, and the connections back to town are very good. highly recommended. if this review is helpful please like it.

we opted for a private tour and had sara as our guide and it was 110% worth every penny! although we are both outdoorsy, felt it was safer to do the ice hike with a guide and now having done it, definitely stand by that. with changes in temperatures etc, it was assuring to go with sara as she helped us navigate through some trickier spots of the canyon but also avoid any areas that could be dangerous. she was super knowledgeable and funny and we had an absolute blast with her. booking was easy to arrange, and we are so glad we were able to make it happen and that the weather held out! whether you are a confident hiker or a newbie, definitely recommend getting a guide like sara for the canyon because it will make your experience that much more enjoyable (and she snapped some great pics for us too!)

we opted for a superior king room, but the room was very basic and tiny for a 5 star hotel. the mini bar is only on order and it is not even worth it, a soft drink is around $7, no snacks are provided. there is no bathrobe, it is on request only. the pool is cramped, no space for people to enjoy. the 2hr policy is not respected. the hotel is 4 star under. otherwise, the staffs are very friendly, they provided an amazing customer service, always have a smile on their face. the hotel atmosphere is nice as well.

we opted for the buffet lunch which was really nice and the afternoon game drive. the game drive met all our expectations. we are a family of 5 with children ages 6 to 17 and we all loved it. i would recommend aquila to family and friends. a wonderful way to see some of africa's wild animals.

we organised this tour for a day to mostly go out to see the seaweed projects by the women on the east coast of zanzibar. we booked it online on the colours of zanzibar website, and had good communication through email (we were on the road travelling for a few weeks before zanzibar). first off we were taken to the jiz forest reserve, where there was a mass of tourists all gathered around the monkeys,, then we were taken through a 20 mins forest stroll with an obviously scripted stopping point tour guide. we had to force a few minutes to go to the forest display to read about the background of the reserve. then back into the bus to nip down to the mangroves, and walk though them on raised boardwalks. we enjoyed this bit, but mostly because one of our group was a marine biologist who could cover all the info and elaborate on the limited knowledge of our guide. we then drove onwards to the village on the east coast which was unexpectedly right behind a beach full of resorts. we picked up a village guide who talked us through the village very well, and we finally got the seaweed project. turned out the tide was in now in the afternoon and we couldn’t walk out to the seaweed beds and racks. back at a house we had a great demonstration of maize milling, flour milling, rope making and seaweed processing. we were rushed through rest of tour and missed the basket weaving so we could get to lunch, which was in a local house, and very good to see local living and food. driving back to stonetown, we noted that the forest reserve was now very quiet with few tourists, and suggest that the trip be run backwards with the village first and forest on way home., and we could have seen the seaweed racks at low tide in the morning. the guide did her best we feel, but lacked the knowledge in any depth. overall we were a little disappointed by the tour, as it was possibly just not aimed at our type of tourist, probably more towards the mainstream/mass market from the big resorts.

we originally booked just three days to learn how to kite-surf, but we ended up staying two full weeks because we fell in love with the spot and the people—the perfect pace for true slow travel and total relaxation. kite-surfing lessons: as complete beginners, we couldn’t have asked for a better instructor than donald. every session felt safe and perfectly paced; the lesson plans built on each other logically, so we were always learning something new without ever feeling overwhelmed. hospitality & facilities: the property is clean, and the food is outstanding—fresh, flavorful, and mostly locally sourced. what truly sets this place apart, though, is the team’s generosity: they welcomed us into their everyday life, inviting us to share meals, local outings, and stories as if we were old friends. extras that made our stay: / van pick-up transfers to and from el nido were arranged in minutes—totally hassle-free. / access to paddleboards and kayaks kept us busy on no-wind mornings. / the staff even helped us track down a scooter to rent so we could explore the area on our own. if you’re looking for a place where you can learn to kite in a safe, encouraging environment and feel genuinely included off the water, this is it. we can’t wait to come back!

we pulled in for two nights and stayed 11. great shower house (hot water and clean), beautiful setting - creek x 2, gardens to roam, cool hand-built terraced property, things to explore, great views, close to sedona (15 min drive to the heart of sedona - traffic determining) and big sky. close to trails and state parks. has power and water available throughout the property. wifi…. we’re camping and trying to disconnect, so can’t speak to it. i also can’t speak to a summer stay, but the sun found us in november for some early morning heat, which after a cold night was great. we tented. there’s a raised platform to meditate on and do a bit of yoga on in the morning sun. and the javalinas are definitely something to remember as far as keeping a clean campsite. was such a gift to see and hear them at night. we loved seeing them. silly canadians! lol. the name is a tad misleading - retreat. maybe there’s classes and such during the busier months, but having the ability to join some meditation or yoga classes on site would be great to really feel the retreat/community vibe. and learning more about the creators of this property would have been great as well, maybe that’s more posted info on site, maybe reading material? all in all, we’d come back for sure. thank for camp avalon for the great stay! but really, no complaints and at $40 a night, we were more than happy to spend considering what a hotel would have been and the next nearest “open” camp spot was at least 20 minutes away.

we really struggled to find a dive center, because all the ones recommended by others were fully booked. which i am glad they were because as a newbie to diving travellers galapagos really looked after me. we did an equipment check the night before where we meet the two instructors jordy and susie - both were full of energy and really friendly. on arriving on the morning of the dive we were met with taxis who took all the equipment and drove us to the doc where we waited whilst they put all the equipment on. safety started there where we were given instructions on how to get onto the boat. the boat itself at times felt a bit small but my group was almost at their capacity of maximum numbers. and the sea was rough at times so recommended taking sea sickness tablets - even if you don’t usually get sea sickness like me - i was very sick! at no point did they make me or anyone else who was sick feel embarrassed about this they offered non stop support. there was a general briefing and then we dived into two groups. those who had a padi and those who didn’t (discovery) susie looked after my group and was excellent at explaining how all the equipment worked whilst explaining in english and spanish. her passion was pure and the excitement she had was really motivating in times of anxiety. once in the sea i completely freaked out and wanted to go back to the boat. susie allowed me time to relax and then offered me the option of going back to the boat or continuing, with no judgment just kindness. i chose to stay on the dive and she stayed with me the whole time and on the more open dive held my hand the entire time. if it wasn’t for them i wouldn’t have seen hammerhead sharks, sea turtles, eagle ray, manta ray, eels, reef shark and so many beautiful fish. highly recommend and couldn’t thank susie enough for everything she did for me that day. so in summary: - safety checks - before, during and after dives - great team onboard boat - photos and videos included - great energy - saw so much marine life - value for money - great instructors - yummy ecuadorean lunch - snacks and drinks included - toilet which was clean and spacious (for a boat) - option to buy padi (discovery) - optional upgrades

we recently had the pleasure of taking a wildlife tour with maligne adventures in jasper, and it was truly unforgettable — all thanks to our incredible guide, allan. the tour included stunning sights at maligne lake, paradise lake, and medicine lake, with bonus stops around jasper to witness the impact of last year's wildfires and appreciate the strength of the local community. allan made the entire experience exceptional. he’s knowledgeable, warm, and genuinely passionate about the wildlife and landscapes of jasper. we were lucky to spot a wide range of wildlife — marmots, osprey, bald eagles, deer, elk, and even a bear in action chasing a group of elk! allan’s enthusiasm and storytelling brought everything to life. he’s not just a great guide but a fantastic human being who made us feel welcomed and inspired throughout the journey. thank you, allan, for making our trip to jasper so special. highly recommend this tour for anyone visiting the area — especially if you’re lucky enough to have allan as your guide!

we recently participated in the takaya tours cultural experience as part of a team-building event for our organization, and it exceeded our expectations. the tour was a perfect blend of cultural education and adventure. the guides were engaging and knowledgeable, sharing powerful stories and insights into the history of the tsleil-waututh nation. paddling together in traditional canoes added a unique element that strengthened our sense of teamwork and connection. it was an enriching and memorable experience that we would highly recommend for other teams looking to build stronger bonds.

we recently spent 10 days scuba diving in raja ampat with meridian adventure scuba dive resort and had the most amazing experience! from start to finish, everything was seamless, professional and full of unforgettable moments. the team made us feel welcome and well looked after - both on land and underwater. the dive sites were absolutely breathtaking with abundant marine life! all the staff were fantastic - friendly, knowledgeable and always ready to help. a special thank you to our dive guide abner, who was incredibly patient and supportive on my first few dives as i regained my confidence in the water after not diving for five years - quite literally held my hand and provided calm reassurance. mid trip i completed my advanced open water certification with ross, who is an exceptional instructor - calm, clear and confident. a big shoutout to tommy who is a great addition to the mad team! planned a social dinner at a local restaurant, that provided a lovely community feel to the trip with our new dive buddies. the surface intervals were just as thoughtful and enjoyable as the dives themselves. between dives, the team took us to nearby islands where we could relax, soak in the scenery and enjoy refreshments. the accommodation was comfortable, clean and provide a perfect location to relax after diving. thank you to the incredible team at meridian adventures for making this such a memorable trip, we can't wait to return!

we recently spent a fantastic week with the team from daytrippers raising money for charity with a sponsored hike and bike. the team were so professional and friendly - they gave us all an unforgettable experience!!

we recently stayed at a hotel close to this area and absolutely loved the ambiance. our room had a small balcony, which allowed us to experience the vibrant nightlife, adding to the charm of our stay. despite the noise at night, the area is totally lovely. highly recommend it for anyone looking to enjoy a lively and picturesque location!

we recently stayed at aux du littoral in quebec. the first impression was positive, the reception area, spa, and café are quaint and charming, and the room design is modern and clean. unfortunately, service and operations fell short in several ways. only 3 of our 5 rooms were ready at the 3 pm check-in, with the remaining 2 not available until 4:30 pm. worse, we had no hot water for over 24 hours but could be longer, and the front desk’s only response was that it was a maintenance issue and they’d knock 10% off. there are no posted reception hours, and it closes at 9 pm while we were there, meaning no support is available after that. one of our guests slipped in the shower because the floor was dangerously slippery, and no bath mats were available — a safety issue that should be addressed. the elevator is oddly designed: you must hold the button the entire time to call it or go up, or it won’t stop at your floor. even worse, we had to wait for staff to finish their personal conversation before they acknowledged us. housekeeping is not done automatically and this was never explained. trash bins remained full, beds weren’t made, and tea/coffee supplies weren’t restocked. we were told it would cost $40 to request cleaning — and even when we asked, towels were taken but not replaced. overall, while the look of the hotel is inviting, the lack of communication, attention to safety, and overall service make it hard to recommend especially for the price point.

we recently stayed at dreams macao for a wedding and were planning to book a private boat tour in advance—but i’m so glad we waited. we met david at the resort and explained what we were looking for. not only did he offer us a better price than what we’d seen online, but the entire experience was seamless from start to finish. a driver was waiting for us in the lobby exactly when promised and took us directly to the boat’s entrance. the tour itself was fantastic. there were four of us, and i personally had a great experience. highly recommend this service!

we recently stayed here for 3 nights. the camp is tented with wooden structures. they have 12 canvas rooms nicely decorated and spacious. we visited in june and it can be very cold in the morning and evening so do pack extra layers, hats and gloves. they provide hot water bottles which is needed both for the room and for early morning game drive. the daily plan is you get a wake up call at 6am, breakfast at 06h30 then you leave at 7am for game drive then return around 11h30/45 and lunch is at 12h00 then siesta till 3pm when you have tea and then head out for afternoon game drive, back by 18h30 latest which is the rule for the national park and then dinner at 7pm where there is singing and amazing food. they have water activity a boat cruise small boat for about 4 / 6 max and its a must do and a nice break from the truck game drive as you might spot hippo or elephant in the water which is truly typical okavango sighting. the staff are super friendly and go out of their way to ensure you have the best time. we had a guide called ts who was knowledgeable, friendly and full of information and drove very well. the guide really makes the experience and you get to share meals also and learn so much about the animals and the culture of botswana. i would definitely recommend camp x.

we recently stopped in japan on one of our trips to korea to visit my wife’s family. from tokyo, we book a tour to kyoto on the bullet train. one of the places we visited on the tour was the heian jingu shrine in kyoto. the main building was beautiful and very well maintained. not too busy on the day we visited which was good.

we recently visited camden market and had a fantastic time exploring everything it has to offer. one of the highlights was the incredible variety of fast street food vendors flavours from around the world, all freshly prepared and absolutely delicious. there’s truly something for every palate. we also took a scenic canal boat trip, which was a lovely way to step back from the crowds and enjoy the atmosphere from a different perspective. another standout was the arts and crafts section near the dock a charming setting with quality handmade goods, perfect for finding unique gifts or souvenirs. the only downsides were the heavy crowds, even on a monday, which made some areas feel a bit congested. additionally, the approach to the market had a few vendors that felt a bit run-down, which slightly took away from the otherwise vibrant experience. that said, camden market remains a must-visit. the energy, diversity, and creativity of the place far outweigh the minor drawbacks. highly recommended!

we recently visited jackson hole and my husband and i wanted to see yellowstone. we didn’t know where to begin or where the best spots were. fortunately, we googled tours and found moses for a private tour. he picked us up promptly at 6am sharp from our hotel at snow king resort. he drove us all around to see the hot springs, yellow stone river, old faithful and other great spots. he also provides lunch at a nice picnic area near the river and the deli sandwiches were delicious. moses was very knowledgeable throughout our trip and pleasant to be around. he knew the best times to show up at certain locations and when to leave to beat the crowd. the trip was a great guided experience and well worth it. if you wish to save valuable time trying to figure out when and where to go, hire moses for your next trip. you won’t be disappointed, thank you moses for a memorable trip!

we recently visited lion country safari and while it’s still a fun outing for families, we couldn’t help but feel that it’s lost some of its magic compared to earlier visits. 🚗 drive-through safari: it used to feel like a real adventure — animals roaming freely, lots of close-up encounters. this time, there seemed to be fewer animals out, and many were far in the distance or hard to spot. it didn’t feel as lively or immersive as before. 🎡 safari world (walk-through): the walkable area is still nice for kids with a small splash pad, a few rides, and feeding stations. but again, the animal variety felt limited, and some enclosures looked a bit underwhelming. ☀️ summer tips: it gets very hot, so bring water, sunscreen, and hats. mid-day visits can be draining, especially with young kids. overall, it was a decent day out, but not quite the wild experience we remembered. we hope they bring back more animals and that the park gets some refresh soon.

we recently visited the hotel to use the facilities (bowling). being dark when we arrived, we did not see the signs outside advising that a parking disk was required. given it is a hotel and its remote location, it would not have occurred to us that this might be the case. unfortunately we returned to our car after our 1 hour bowling and had a parking fine for €60 attached to the car. when we queried this with the hotel, they informed us that they use a private company (parkkipate) to patrol the area and there was nothing they could do. when i contacted parkkipate i could use the ticket to log in and view the images of the car. you can imagine my surprise when i saw a picture of our car with a parking permit on the windscreen showing that we had overstayed the 2 hour parking limit. this was impossible as we were not aware of the need to have a permit and we did not have one on display. the photo had clearly been edited. i am pursuing this with the company and will not be paying the account but want to warn others using the hotel's facilities of what happened to us. the car was a rental and we were clearly tourists. it seems like a scam really and, while the hotel can't be held liable, they are employing this company to patrol the parking onsite. it leaves a bad taste for visiting the hotel in future and, isn't a great reflection on how tourists are treated by the parking company.

we recently went on the pure aloha adventures, oahu catamaran snorkeling tour off the coast of oahu, and it was easily one of the highlights on island. if you’re looking for a relaxed, authentic, and safe way to snorkel with sea turtles, this is the tour to book. 🛥️ the oahu catamaran: the boat was clean, spacious, and not overcrowded like some of the big commercial tours. it had a friendly, laid-back crew with great music and a knowledgeable, fun-loving crew with two adorable dogs. they made sure everyone was comfortable and knew what to expect before we even got in the water. the cruise along the waikiki coastline was absolutely stunning. 🐢 snorkeling with turtles: the snorkeling spot was excellent with relatively calm waters with decent visibility. within minutes of getting into the water, i saw multiple fish and two hawaiian green sea turtles gliding gracefully through the ocean water. the guides were great about pointing out marine life and making sure everyone stayed respectful of the turtles and the environment. 🛟 safety & support: whether you’re a strong swimmer or a little nervous, they had flotation devices, snorkel gear, and patient instructors ready to assist. the vibe was totally supportive and non-intimidating, even for first-timers. 🌈 overall experience: the small group size, personal attention, and genuine aloha spirit set this tour apart. it felt less like a tourist excursion and more like spending the day with local friends who truly love and respect the ocean. would i recommend it? absolutely. whether you’re visiting oahu for the first time or a return traveler, pure aloha adventures delivers a magical, responsible, and memorable ocean experience. great for solo travelers, couples, and even families with teens.

we rented a 200cc atv for two people for 48 hrs. they dropped it off at our hotel and it was a great way to explore the beach zone by our hotel and get to tulum town for more options for eating out, without the hassle of long walks or hailing taxis. we used it to reach cenote escondido, and also parque del jaguar for a snorkelling day trip. the prices are very reasonable, the vehicle was great, the service via whatsapp is quick and helpful, and the guys are really friendly. and it definitely worked out cheaper overall, as tulum taxis are pricey. recommend!

we rented a car here. the car (a renault clio) was quite new and drove well. this was by far the cheapest offer in town. although a bit slow, the staff was friendly and 2 out of 3 spoke english very well. great price/quality ratio. thanks!

we rented a motorboat and it was an amazing experience! hamish helped us and he was great, he showed us how to drive the boat and gave us confidence. it was our favourite activity in banff, absolutely worth the time and money. the rental was just over $160 for 1 hour and the boat fits up to 5 people. lake minnewanka is absolutely gorgeous. it was so peaceful and incredible. they open at 10am and i recommend being there first thing, registration was quick and very smooth. by the time we were leaving just past 11am, the place had started filling up with a lot more people.
we rented a paddle boat and had a great time in the lake. the february weather was perfect and people were picnicking in the park and enjoying the day.

we rented a small boat in the afternoon. everything was great, very beautiful places and sunset. but unfortunately we were not allowed to go ourselves, although in the reviews it is written that people drove themselves without experience. but still everything was amazing! thank you!!!

we rented a two-person kayak from steve, and it was an absolutely unforgettable experience! over four days, we circumnavigated gambier island, and steve was incredibly supportive throughout our journey. he provided daily wind updates, detailed guidance on ferry crossings and campsites, and even offered a capsize training session before we set out on the water, which gave us extra confidence for the trip! i can absolutely recommend renting a kayak from steve and his team!

we rented bikes for the day here, amazing service and can’t fault the bikes! we cycled to the wall of tears, and the man in store gave us a really good description of where to go and recommendations. the bikes have a gel inside the tires to help with any of the spikes from the trees, and you get given a helmet, bike pump and lock within the price too. $20 per bike well spent!

we rented classic bikes here our first day off the boat to ride over to the wall of tears. they were sufficient but had to walk up some hills so would have been better off with a mountain bike. that was our own fault because we decided to cheap out even after the employee servicing us told us about the terrain and hills on the way.
we rented fjellski for a tour from kilpisjärvi. skis and equipment were in top condition. pick up and drop off in kilpisjärvi on time and well organized. clear recommendation!

we rented for an overnight double kayak so we could camp up the say nuth kwah yum. the staff were incredibly pleasant. we booked the earliest time they had (9 am) knowing the parking lot can get very busy. this allowed us to not feel anxious, got there 45 min early, lots of parking at that time on a saturday. takaya will give you a pass to put in your car for the overnight parking and you just pay the $17.50 at the meter. the kayak was a double necky, which was fine and did it's job but wish it was a seward as necky can be a bit heavier, and ours was well used.

we rented our boat from sea4all and it was honestly one of the absolute highlights of our trip to santorini! the booking process was easy and the crew was incredibly friendly, professional, and patient – even though we’re not experienced boaters. the boat itself was in excellent condition and easy to handle. with the map and great tips they gave us, we were able to explore beautiful hidden spots around the island, stop for swimming and snorkeling, and just enjoy the peaceful views. you can really tell the team loves what they do – we felt safe, well taken care of, and completely relaxed. if you’re looking for a unique and unforgettable experience in santorini, definitely rent a boat from sea4all!

we rented several boats through cartagena water sports and everytime it was a huge success - great boats and captains. we rented the subwing and it was a blast! danny is a great instructor and knows the best spots for snorkeling at the islands.

we rented ski equipment (boots and boards). you can leave your shoes there until you return from the hill. the service was very friendly, especially from joaquín, who very kindly drove us to and picked us up from the entrance to the hill when it was raining. they also gave us complimentary sports drinks, a small gesture that goes a long way. important: they give a cash discount if you book at the base (we booked in the city at the patagonia showroom, but they don't give the discount there).

we rented the 47 ft sea ray for a bachelorette party of 12 girls staying in tulum. we had an amazing time with the crew apollo, victor and captain alex who truly made our experience so fun. they made sure our drinks were flowing at all time (margaritas and whatever other mixed drinks we wanted plus bottles of tequila for shots), boated us to 2 different spots to swim and float on and take awesome photos! the lunch they made us was also amazing- homemade guacamole, shrimp ceviche and chicken fajitas. it was overall an amazing experience and definitely would recommend to big groups looking for a fun boat rental for half the day!!!

we rented the boat istranka for 4 hours and had the time to visit the blue cave, 3 green caves and touring the zaton bay. it's our first boat experience and it went great! the boat is at 15hp and can go around 6mph. to visit islands around dubrovnik it is enough. mario was there to explain to us how to drive the boat and recommanded places to go. if you want to visit caves around dubrovnik and take time to explore them( + have a boat driving experience), this is a better solution than taking tours for 60 euros / person.

we rented the recreational kayaks for 2hrs and had a great time. we saw lots of sea creatures during our paddle. the staff were all very friendly and knowledgable. would definitely recommend pedals & paddles for anyone visiting the sunshine coast.

we sailed with janka, who not only prepared us wonderfully with training but also carefully chose our direction depending on gusts of wind. we had difficult weather conditions, but with janka, we felt safe and completely trusted her decisions. thank you, janka! we'll be back for better weather. i definitely recommend nordland outdoor if you want to have great guides who care about your experience and want to make it fun and pleasant for you!

we saw a family of 4 turtles eating and swimming around and tons of corals. the half day snorkeling trip is totally worth it. they do 2 stops for snorkeling. crystal clear water. they provide sandwiches and snacks on the boat as well. highly recommend!

we saw a unique and endangered santa cruz giant tortoise just sitting on the road, thrilling! we hiked on the ciclo via trail and reached a two-story building with 360 degree views all around, so gorgeous! we went here as part of a 2-week yacht cruise on coral i with "go galapagos" around the galapagos, in december 2024.

we saw all big 5 in four hours. how lucky we are? incredibly amazing 😲😍🐆🦁🐒🐾 it's an adventure to visit tanzánia itself, but it's definitely worth everything. we saw all 5 five after 4 hours. it was raining 3 days in a row, and animals were hungry, so it was the best time ever ! i will never forget it in my life and i've been on holiday with my amazing brother ! that brought more happiness into my life. what's better than a sibling, unconditional love with beautiful surroundings. our vip private tour was absolutely amazing , just us two and local tour guide and driver. adventure worth everything. i am highly recommending mikumi national park

we saw back to the future in this small theatre on the strand. our seats were front row balcony. not much leg room but good viewing. show starts slow but the second act is excellent. it's a lite but entertaining show in a comfortable west end theatre.

we saw exhibit on photojournalist. it is a great way to get a glimpse of recent iceland events. a few captions missing. othere were very well done, clear and informative. well worth a visit. also great gift shop with interesting items for the curious.
we saw giant turtles. easy bike ride. fun outing!! bring warer and suncream.

we saw lots of alligators, pigs, insects, raccoons and other interesting sites. a great boat ride too!! captain ben was a really nice guy who was happy to answer all our questions. a great day out! - no need for insect repellent. - tap water drinkable if needed, so bring a bottle. - under cover from the sun at all times - driving from new orleans is no problem with enough parking available

we saw many injuries from the slides. half day fun. activities for all the ages but it’s getting old. a lot of trash 🗑 behind the fence in the nature. service is meh and i did not like the food. not so healthy.

we saw the sunrise on the water and it was very beautiful. highly recommended experience. the instructors were very friendly and well equipped, we received all the instructions needed to stand on the board, got very good pictures as well! hope to come back to barcelona to do it again.

we saw the waterfalls when driving and though we would check this out. they are part of the park. we went in june. it was completely empty. it was quite clean. many playground for kids. the park is big and we didn’t see all of it but we liked the parts that we walked through

we saw titanique at the criterion theatre. it has a small cast but they all play their roles superbly. it was funny with more than a touch of camp panto at times. the script is regularly updated with several current references, which is very clever. we laughed all through the show. well worth a visit. the theatre is smaller than some but beautifully restored.

we scheduled a sunset cruise with green river and we couldn't be happier. our original cruise night called for rain so we were going to cancel but they accommodated us for the next evening and the cruise was the highlight of our vacation. the captain was so friendly and knowledgeable. we were given the option for wine or champagne. they provided glasses, blankets (not neeeded), a table and the option to listen to music. the pontoon boat was safe and very comfortable. we were passed with several large tour boats just crammed with people that seem to race up and down the river. if you want to be treated like royalty schedule a private cruise with green river.

we scheduled an incredible tour with akal. he provided me with so much information, i truly believe he was reading me. i experienced moving with the spirit, which was so unexpected, yet amazing. i received a message from my best friend and felt an intense, electrical presence from my mom, whom have both passed on. thank you akal! ❤️

we schedules this outing last minute based upon our time in barcelona but this is an incredible park! the masterpiece that was another incredible work by gaudí! easy to walk around with or without a guide. a guide helps to give some color on the history if you choose one.

we seen this show on saturday and had second row! we literally could see everything! wasn’t sure what to expect however i was really impressed, the songs, the staging and the cast! thankfully vanessa williams was performing as miranda which is one off the reason we went! however all of the cast was incredible and the voices was also amazing, each and every one! i am already looking at tickets to visit again! the theatre its self is actually a beautiful building, with plenty of bars and toilets and hardly any queues before the show or even in the break! drinks wasn’t overly priced either! it really was a great end to my birthday! as someone who loves fashion and does follow fashion a lot, the outfits was amazing!!! the cast was absolutely stunning and very talented!

we signed up for a cooking class here. it was an amazing full sensory, full load experience. we went to the market and he explained all the details of what we were buying fresh. we had a chance to understand and taste, smell and then we went to the cooking school. across the street was their farm with so many different herbs and ingredients. then we were taught how to prepare, chop, mortar and pestal various ingredients into a three course meal. understanding measuring chopping pounding, and then cooking the ingredients to create a meal with help of the chef was an amazing experience!!! oh and the meal was delicious!

we signed up for the 4 hour tour and khalid and his staff were amazing. it felt like we had booked the whole day. they gave us a tour around the beautiful mountains and saw the sunset which is a must see. later spent the night in the bedouin camp and had dinner followed by shisha and team by the fire. the rooms were of a lovely standard and we woke up to a buffet breakfast before being transported back into town. the host khalid was amazing and went the extra mile to make a trip to lovely experience

we spent 10 days in botswana with kalahari breeze in october. from the very first contact, the company was incredibly responsive and attentive to our needs, tailoring the entire journey to match our wishes. once we were on-site, everything was impeccably organized, making for a seamless and enjoyable experience. the guides were not only highly knowledgeable but also very kind and helpful, always eager to share their insights and ensure we had a memorable safari. we enjoyed every day vaious game drives, bush walks, mokoro rides and much more. one special highlight was to watch a real lion hunt. incredible amazing! they really cared about us and the meals they provided for us were so delicious. thank you again! we couldn’t have asked for a better experience!

we spent 10 nights at corepen homestay and we were very happy to stay in this homestay. far away from big towns this place is a little paradise. the bungalows (7 in total) are simple but very clean and confortable. the bed is excellent surrounded by an anti-mosquito net (but their are no mosquitos, we didn’t used any of our spray). the sheets are clean and this room perfectly settled in front of the blue lagoon which contains beautiful corals and fishes. of course the toilets are also simple but their are two showers and 3 wc which is sufficient for 14 people max. we loved the food that is served at 7 am, 12 am and 7 pm. the cooker makes good different receipies mainly with chicken, fishes and grilled tofu and vegetables. we had also fruits every days, papaye and delicious little bananas. the breafast was fine with rice, bred, jam, eggs and bananas, tea, coffee and suggar. in addidition we had every day a small sweet at 4 pm. the diving center is perfectly organize and the material in good shape. when we were there, they just bought 2 brain new bcd and 2 octopus. maria, sandi, kun and handy are excellent master divers with a perfect professionalisme. they were searching for us little animals and particularly le pygmy sea horse which is so difficult to see. we felt really well with them during the dives and specially when we had strong currents, for example on sardine reef and cape kri. the fast boats used for the different sites have excellent drivers. there is a lot of different dive sites which can be selected after the dinner with maria and sandi with aggrement of everyone. all the team was particularly avalaible for any questions and advices. in conclusion we had a very good stay at corepen homestay having done 20 dives. all of them were full of surprises and beautiful. we highly recommend this place for the diving and the kindness of the staff.

we spent 10 unforgettable days at the eco lodge and cannot emphasize enough how special this place is. managing to design, build and operate a truly environmentally sustainable accommodation whilst adding the luxury touch on this island paradise is a huge achievement, and one that you need to experience for yourself. take time to learn about how the lodge really focuses on sustainability first from jack, and enjoy the absolutely delicious food and hospitality from the guest team, all whilst sitting comfortably from your lodge overlooking a sea full of amazing sea life. you can even see dolphins and whales from your room! if you come to raja ampat to enjoy nature at its best, stay in a place like this that protects it.

we spent 2 days with abdalsalam in wadi rum, it was amazing! a full day tour, ektir kaset chai, delicious food, and one night in a cave. abdou made us feel very welcome, and was very generous in sharing his culture and special desert spots. i’ve not felt this relaxed in a long time! shukrn ektir❤️

we spent 2 weeks on arborek diving everyday with arborek dive shop. githa and her crew are truly amazing, they made us happy with their enthusiasm and love for local marin life, especially for manta rays! every dive site around arborek is incredibly rich in terms of variety and and quantity: corals, manta rays, sharks (blacktip, whitetip, grey shark, wobbegong, walking shark...), napoleons, etc. night dives were very exciting as well, we saw plenty of fantastic little creatures that we cannot see during the day. githa knows very well where to find them! if you are looking for a place to dive in raja ampat, i definitely recommend arborek dive shop. you won't regret your choice! p.s.: be careful, as there is another new structure on arborek calling itself with the same name. the original, and the best, is owned by githa and marsel. make sure that you are diving with githa's crew :)

we spent 4 nights at shinde in august of 2023. the experience was incredible. our guide, chacos, knew all about the area as well as the natural and human history. he could find us wildlife and get us to a vantage point where were were able to have great views of the animals. as a birder, i was very pleased that he could always come up with an identification for what we saw. the accommodations were extremely comfortable and we were very well taken care of by the staff. the food was some of the best that i've ever tasted. we have absolutely no complaints about our trip and many, many thanks to give to those that work for shinde.

we spent a day horseback riding here during our honeymoon. charlotte was an amazing guide who took us all over the ranch and hillsides and shared mate with us. the horses were very well trained and easy to ride. we will definitely be recommending lazo to our friends and will return next time we visit tdp. our ride at lazo was definitely the jewel of our two-week trip in south america.

we spent a delightful evening at black spruce and really can’t recommend this experience enough. jeff and kate clearly love what they do and also love sharing that joy with others. after a short talk about mushing, the iditarod and other races, and dog care and training, we started by meeting their fifty or so alaskan huskies. we loved them all! the dogs were energetic but surprisingly loving and eager to interact with us, though not as eager as they were to be chosen for the evening’s mushing practice. after a team of sixteen was selected we helped to harness them and attach them to the line before climbing aboard the atv (the summer wheeled sled!) and going for about a 2 mile ride. it was warm even though it was late, and we stopped every so often to let them cool off in well-placed kiddie pools, giving us more chances to interact. jeff was our musher for the evening and he gave us tons of information throughout our ride. everything about the evening was fantastic. it was a dream experience. truly, truly recommended!

we spent a few days at the fullerton hotel as a family, and it was truly a memorable experience. the heritage charm of the building paired with modern comforts made it special for both the adults and the little ones. service was warm and thoughtful throughout ,the staff made us feel welcome from check-in to check-out. our room was clean, spacious, and had a lovely view of the river. the kids especially enjoyed the pool, while we appreciated the peaceful atmosphere in such a central location. breakfast was a treat with a wide selection to suit all ages. and being close to marina bay and the merlion meant we could easily explore without needing to travel far. we’d love to return for another family stay.

we spent a few hours hiking this legendary trail. the trailhead begins at grand canyon village and we descended 1100 feet to the 1.5 mile station where restrooms and water are available. the trail provides views of the grand canyon that are simply not available from the rim and immerses the hiker in the beauty of the place. we brought trekking poles which made navigating the trail safer and easier. this is a must do activity for those who are physically able. definitely recommend!

we spent a long time here. when you first enter it may seem that you won’t be here long, but if you take your time and really stop and look you will be so hooked by the art and stories. i can’t say you will be hooked in a positive or a negative way though, as we are all different. i personally loved this museum and it made it in the top three of all the museums i went to in iceland.

we spent a lovely couple of hours here swimming and sunbathing. the water was lovely and refreshing. i'd recommend renting a lounger as otherwise you have only concrete to lie on! very reasonable entry cost of €3 each, and the parking was also close by and reasonably priced.

we spent a week there and had an amazing time. the food was delicious with reasonable portions, the staff were friendly, and the drinks were great especially the fresh fruit juices and milkshakes! it’s also the only place we found where you can eat and drink right on the beach, which was a big plus. we stayed at a resort with beach access, but they didn’t allow drinks on the beach, so this was a real highlight. the location was also pleasantly calm and not too crowded during the day, which made it even more relaxing.

we spent a weekend enjoying a picnic at preußenpark, and just around the corner was thaipark—a vibrant spot bursting with authentic thai food and lively energy. the atmosphere was full of fun, with so many delicious options to try. to top it off, there was even a flea market nearby, adding to the charm of the whole experience. a perfect weekend outing! even they have a live thai music stall.

we spent a wonderful day here last month. before going, i emailed with a few questions which were answered quickly. the entrance fee for the day was reasonable and the pool next to the lake with mountains overlooking it was simply stunning. we plan to visit the area again and intend to spend time here when we do.

we spent a wonderful day on thirasia island with my wife — such a peaceful and scenic escape! we had made a reservation in advance for a tasting of three wines, but we couldn't resist adding some delicious cheese and cold cuts to the experience. we especially loved their terrasea — so much so that we opened a bottle right then and there to enjoy on the spot. a truly relaxing place with stunning views. absolutely worth it — a perfect day out!

we spent a wonderful time in ladakh. ladakh is one of the most beautiful area in india. sonam organized a worderful trek in markha valley, a tour to visit the best monastery aroud leh. he also organized all the trip to move aroud leh and to go back in manali. everything was smooth and easy. if you are looking for a great experience in ladakh, you can trust in landscape explorer agency, sonam is very professional and helpful! thank you again!

we spent all day here! it was great! we started off with the seals boat tour - saw 9 in total plus a seagull chick. the guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. then had a picnic in the gardens which were so peaceful, beautiful and well maintained. then we finished in the castle. the rooms are fabulous. the staff are super friendly and knowledgeable. all in all, worth the £17.50 for the castle and gardens and the £13.50 for the seals! not good for mobility though.

we spent almost 45 mins here, that includes in 3 floors, interesting section is located in basement what you can try many shoes py person! worths coming one time, upstairs is a collection of new and vintage shoes.

we spent an amazing day visiting a few islands and snorkeling in breath taking spots. they also showed us dolphins and turtles. the boat crew was great and took very good care of us. i highly recommend jonathan and his crew.

we spent an entire day, from morning to night, at tabacón thermal resort & spa, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. from the moment we arrived, we were mesmerized by the lush tropical surroundings, with vibrant greenery and the soothing sounds of flowing water creating a peaceful, almost dreamlike atmosphere. the natural hot springs, heated by the arenal volcano, were divided into several sections, each offering a unique experience. some pools had stronger currents, while others were calm and perfect for relaxation. one of the highlights was the grand thermal river, where we could sit under cascading waterfalls and feel the warm, mineral-rich water ease away all tension. the temperature of the pools varied, allowing us to move from comfortably warm to almost steamy waters, each providing a different level of relaxation and rejuvenation. as the day turned into night, the resort transformed into an even more magical place. soft lights illuminated the pathways, and the warm steam rising from the water created an enchanting, mystical effect. soaking in the hot springs under the starlit sky, surrounded by the sounds of nature, was a truly surreal and peaceful experience. tabacón was not just a visit—it was a journey into a natural paradise where relaxation and beauty came together in the most perfect way.

we spent an excellent day with this tour company. our trip was a full day trip to west of sao miguel. must say thanks to filipe. he is an amazing guide for this island. highly recommended in azores....

we spent five days at &beyond benguerra island as the final stop of our honeymoon. unfortunately, it didn’t meet our expectations, and we ultimately felt it wasn’t worth the cost. while the island is undeniably beautiful, and the staff did try their best, several issues detracted from our overall experience. as avid scuba divers with experience on multiple liveaboards in thailand, the maldives, and egypt, we were excited to spend our days diving. however, we were disappointed to learn that the nearest reef was located in open ocean waters, requiring a 40-minute journey by zodiac. this wasn’t possible on days with high winds due to large waves, and the island’s boat options felt inadequate for such conditions. as a result, we were limited to just one dive over five days, despite hoping to do around eight. they should consider upgrading to a larger boat that can handle the rough seas better. if we had known about these limitations in advance, we would have chosen a destination with more accessible dive sites and reliable options. additionally, one of the main attractions used in the agent for the resort’s marketing is the possibility of seeing dugongs. however, we found out that dugong sightings are incredibly rare, which was quite disappointing. we also missed the opportunity to go whale watching, which was another experience we were looking forward to, due to high winds and the limitations of the boats. while the horseback riding was pleasant, including a sea ride and a beach island ride, these activities alone didn’t justify the overall cost, and we felt our money could have been better spent elsewhere. another significant issue for me was my gecko phobia. growing up in thailand, i’ve encountered plenty of geckos, but i manage as long as they stay outside. unfortunately, &beyond benguerra island had large geckos—some nearly 30cm long—everywhere, including inside our room. at other luxury resorts i’ve stayed at, like soneva and six senses in thailand, staff are always available to remove them upon request, as this phobia is quite common. however, when we informed the staff at benguerra, they shrugged it off, simply saying the geckos help with mosquitoes. this lack of concern made the experience worse for me, and i spent much of the trip feeling anxious. on several occasions, we even missed meals because i was too uncomfortable to leave the safety of the mosquito net around our bed, where i felt protected from geckos in the bedroom, bathroom, and even the lobby where meals were served. additionally, walking to the lobby for dinner each night felt unsafe due to the poor lighting along the footpath. the few lanterns provided minimal light, so we had to rely on our phone flashlights to navigate. installing fairy lights or more substantial lighting along the path would greatly improve this experience for future guests. overall, for the price we paid, we were expecting exceptional. &beyond benguerra island fell short and was a disappointing destination for our honeymoon. we had chosen it to try something different, as we’ve visited the maldives several times before, but in hindsight, we wish we had returned to the maldives instead.

we spent four days in the old city mostly in the upper city and partly in the lower city. so many beautiful buildings, streets and neighborhoods to explore. we enjoyed just walking randomly around the city and found many interesting surprises.

we spent here christmas eve, and there was such a warm and welcoming crowd. there was music, circus, and good food. it was an unforgettable and magical night with our 7 years old. the stuff is super helpful, kind and generous.

we spent in total four days at the camp and had the best time there. the guides, being true locals to the area, showed us the best places in the wadi rum area apart from the usual tourist spots. they also let us into their day to day bedouin life, sharing meals with us and their families, letting us try fresh camel milk and even brought us to see a camel race. specifically attala and zaid made a massive effort to let us enjoy our time in wadi rum. the camp itself is far off from other camps and sheltered from noise. the tents and sanitary areas were well maintained and very clean. mohammed always prepared incredibly fresh and delicious meals for us and provided vegetarian options as well. thank you bedouin roads for the experience!

we spent one night at refugio lopez before we went to the summit of pico turista and we enjoyed it. food was warm and nice. accommodation was basic with bed and mattress in a shared room. you need to bring your own sleeping bag. they also provide campsites if you prefer. everything needs to be booked in advance. you can refer to their instagram for more info

we spent part of our winter holidays in magical lapland, and chose a local tour company for four different experiences: husky sledding, northern lights hunting, reindeer rides, and cross-country skiing. and honestly? every single moment was incredible. the organization was flawless. warm clothing was always provided, and after every adventure, we were treated to hot tea and some meals. but what really stood out was the kindness and care the guides showed throughout—imagine staying warm, cheerful, and genuinely attentive while standing in -35°c. that kind of hospitality isn’t just professional—it’s extraordinary. what made the experience even more special was how the guides spoke about their traditions. there was a quiet warmth in the way they shared stories about their culture, and you could tell it wasn’t just for show. it felt real, personal, and deeply rooted. we didn’t just go on tours—we learned, listened, and connected. it’s rare to find something that feels this unforgettable. i truly hope to return one day and do it all over again.

we spent several days at corepen homestay and dive center and had a truly memorable time. the homestay is peaceful and our host maria was absolutely wonderful, warm and welcoming. food is delicious and plenty, beds comfortable. we also went diving with corepen, which we highly recommend. the dive sites were stunning and the equipment in great conditions. the overall experience was safe, professional and fun. however we were seriously concerned to learn that rat poison was being used on the property during our stay. this raises environmental and health concerns. since the homestay uses pumped groundwater poisoned animals such as rats can re-enter the water system. this poses a real risk to local wildlife, including birds, pets and even humans. we kindly ask future guest to be aware: if you notice dead or dying rats, this likely means toxic poison is still being used. please consider mentioning to the management, as many travelers come here to enjoy nature. protecting it should be a shared responsibility. despite this concern, we truly enjoyed our stay, the diving and the people we met. we hope the homestay continues to grow while adopting eco-friendly alternatives to chemical pest control.

we spent the morning at maji moto and stayed for lunch - it was an amazing experience! the warmth and kindness of everyone made us feel right at home, and we learned so much about their culture. the setting is absolutely stunning. lunch was served among the bushes, and they thoughtfully prepared a gluten free buffet for me, as i’m celiac.

we spent the night in this camp after going through a scam. they literally saved us! super friendly and beautiful camping in the middle of the desert. amazing atmosphere! the hole family was super kind with us, and it was also a great chance to socialize with the other guests, also super friendly! they have a common area with games to play all together. they also showed us the way they prepare food underground. the whole dinner was delicious! couldn’t recommend it more!

we spent three nights at this wonderful camp in the okavanga delta and we highly recommend visiting. the staff is so warm and welcoming. every staff member goes out of their way to make your experience special. our guide, salani, was truly exceptional. he worked very hard to make sure we had a special trip and saw what was important to us. he is a wealth of knowledge. there is a variety of activities to do at this camp (game drives, boat trips, botswanan canoes, bush walks. while we were there , we had a mother and cub leopard living in the camp. it was amazing. we always felt safe. if you like to see lions and leopards then this is a good place to go. the animals are not afraid or scared off from the vehicles so there is great viewing. the rooms are great. they also do special things like making sure we had a packed lunch the day we left. our last camp didn’t do that and we missed lunch all together. compliments to the staff!!

we spent two days and one night with rachid and his brother abdallah exploring wadi rum in their pickup truck: it was incredible! the guides were both present and gave us time to enjoy the different points we visited at our own pace. everything we needed was provided: water, blankets, and meals (i was afraid of being cold at night, but that wasn't the case at all thanks to the fire and blankets, and yet we slept under the stars in an open-air cave 💫). a magnificent desert tour. we met other tourists on the same tour, but it didn't bother us. the authenticity was there, as well as the humor and insight into the bedouin way of life! thank you to rachid, abdallah, and their family for their hospitality and for this beautiful camp where we spent the night. these moments will be etched in our memory forever 🏜️🐪🙏🏽 don't hesitate to come and experience something new! clémence and nabil

we spent two days diving with oswaldo and the team from blue evolution, incl. kicker rock. he was an excellent dive guide who took very good care of us both on land and in the water. the whole team is great, equipment was good and everything was handled very professionally while also ensuring we had fun. can wholeheartedly recommend blue evolution

we spent two days with rashid and his brother audi touring the wadi rum desert, and it was an unforgettable experience. they're bedouins, a lifelong family from the wadi rum village who know the desert like the back of their hand. they took us to the most iconic places in the desert, as well as to other lesser-known places, and on the second day we hiked to umm ad dammi (the highest peak in jordan). they guided us and shared conversations, while also giving us space for ourselves. we saw incredible sunsets, went sandboarding, visited canyons, and were shown the caves where their ancestors took refuge. we had dinner around the fire (they're great cooks, by the way!), witnessing one of the most spectacular starry skies i've ever seen. honestly, anything i can say is an understatement; the experience in wadi rum with them is incredible. thank you both so much!! ♥️

we spent two incredible days with rashid and audi. they took us all over the wadi rum desert, showing us the best areas and telling us about their bedouin lifestyle. the lunches and dinners they prepared in the middle of the desert were spectacularly good, and the conversations we had were some of the best parts of the trip. the dinners under the stars were amazing, as were the sunset spots. you can clearly tell they're from there and know everything they need to make sure you have the best experience. i highly recommend it!

we spent two nights here as a family over new years. it was wonderful! the accommodations were spectacular and the customer service even better! the wait staff is so kind and thoughtful. we loved the food and the laughs and the water and walking safaris. we saw many animals including hippos, cape buffalo, giraffes, baboons, monkeys, warthogs and even lions. the canoe experience was also very serene and peaceful as we travelled on the okavango river. we had a blast interacting with our guide tizzar, the management team: md, angel, obie and the wait staff. they sang and danced for us and it was just a spectacular experience. my wife and 5 kids loved it. listening to the rain pitter patter on the roofs as we drifted off to sleep was a memory we’ll have for a long time. we will come back here when we come back to botswana.

we spent two weeks in raja ampat and stayed in three different places. nyande is by far the best amongst them. with its great location on north central mansuar, it’s easy to reach almost every tourist hotspots in the area. water around the lodge is pristine, and house reef is healthy teeming with marine life. the design of this place is very eco-friendly. unlike some other homestays in ra, each unit comes with its own detached bathroom on land, no bio waste is discharged directly into the ocean. all the trips are well organized and esni, our tour lady, is the best we have encountered. the whole place is beautiful and clean, with great food and simple yet comfortable accommodation. i would come back every year had we not lived so far away. one caution though, if you have any snacks, please get a food storage container from them. we left unopened snack in its original packaging in our brand new backpack, and something (not sure ants or crabs) chewed big holes through it. needless to say we are a bit pissed but oh well, we learned from our mistakes and got storage box afterwards everywhere we went in ra.

we spontaneously went there in the morning and were able to take an amazing tour of the tea plantation. the owners were super friendly! they showed us the whole house and gave us a thorough introduction to tea processing. we got to taste different types of tea and had also some snacks. if you're looking for an authentic tour of an organic tea farm, we definitely recommend it!

we started our yoga retreat at this temple, doing a traditional ceremony. we were lucky to have a priest we hired to act as our guide, so we were given a thorough understanding of the what and why of the process, as well as blessed by his leading the ceremony for us from start to end. the understanding made the experience deeply spiritual for us and set the tone for the week ahead. i understand this particular sight is not as crazy busy and we had the gift of not feeling rushed as we went through the cleansing. would recommend you get a priest to help you through to make it a true spiritual practice, if that is what you're looking for. our only negative was the rather aggressive sale people when we left.

we started out on a rainy, cloudy morning and weren’t sure if the views from the top would be worth it — but they absolutely were! we ended up staying for about an hour, and as the clouds shifted the scenery changed from good to absolutely incredible. a wonderful experience, even in less-than-perfect weather

we stayed at alva estate for 2 nights and we had a memorable stay! we were lucky to stay at amba to live the full experience. breakfast is fab and served whenever you are ready - cooked by locals. you have the ability to walk to magnificent areas in the estate with rock pools for a morning swim and learn about tea doing the tea plantation. we met one of the owner that joined us for dinner - welcoming and making you feel at home. thanks for such a great experience !

we stayed at azura benguerra as part of our honeymoon. we couldn't recommend it more. it's such a special place. the rooms are incredible with your own private pool and the beach at the end of a pretty garden. there are lots of activities including island tours, snorkeling, sunset dawa boat and beach picnics which were all brilliant. the staff are all so lovely and couldn't be more helpful. big shout out to our host hassan who made our stay extra special. we loved the special for dinner and in our room. we hope to be back very soon!! thank you for making our honeymoon unforgettable.

we stayed at bitu samata at hunder near nubra valley. we loved the detailed care in which they have created the place. the organic farms and the swizz tents are very charming. the food was tasty, the toilets were clean. don't waste water as it's available very less.

we stayed at five camps during our three week stay in central africa. camp xakanaxa was by far our favorite. a big reason why we loved it so much was due to the efforts of our guide, gb. this guy is dedicated to assuring that everyone had a great experience while in moremi game reserve. gb got us to view so much wildlife and put us in a place to get great photos. he was very patient with our many questions about the wildlife, plants, birds and culture in botswana. we were thrilled to see lions, cheetahs, leopards, hippos, wildebeest, cape buffalo and even a pack of african wild dogs. we came away from camp xakanaxa with great memories and experiences like we saw with marlin perkins and jim fowler on mutual of omaha s wild kingdom when we were kids.

we stayed at kadizora camp in november 2024 for a week and had the most amazing experience. the staff and food were all wonderful, and our room was kindly upgraded due to availability. the view over the delta was amazing. our knowledgable guide sparks was really informative and fun to hang out with. he always went above and beyond to find us the animals we were looking for - notably we followed a pack of wild dogs 🐕 on multiple occasions, and went leopard spotting. 🐆 we enjoyed our visit to the local village and school as well, and the mokoro canoe ride. we would highly recommend this place and the okavango in general. it felt very exclusive and like you were really remote, in a good way. price-wise kadizora was great for the okavango. so happy we went and we can’t wait to go back! thanks so much to everyone for making it our best holiday 💕

we stayed at mma dinare for 3 nights on our honeymoon and could not rate it higher. the camp is situated on a beautiful bend in a river beside a clearing that sees a constant flow of game wandering past and through it with elephants regularly browsing the trees and bushes beside our tent. the staff were extremely hospitable and welcoming and the food was excellent. they put a huge effort into welcoming us and even surprised us with a private candlelit dinner on our last evening which was delightful. the real highlight was the wildlife. the concession is teaming with game and predators and the guides and trackers are remarkable talented at finding it. we had dalton and sam who utterly professional and remarkable good and spotting and tracking wildlife and extremely knowledgeable. within the first 24 hours of our stay we had followed a cheetah and her cubs out hunting, seen a leopard, watched a lioness defending her cubs from a pack of wild dogs and then followed that pack of wild dogs for several hours while they hunted. what makes it so special is that there are never more than 3 vehicles at a sighting and the area is so large with so few vehicles in it feels very private and wild. the guides also work together to share sightings so the chance of seeing predators is very high. we had the most amazing time here, thank-you to all the team at mma dinare!

we stayed at northern explorer as for 2 nights and loved the peaceful atmosphere. though we didn’t have time to try the activities, the sunsets were stunning—amazing colors, reflections on the beach, and clouds rolling over the mountains. a beautiful, calm place to relax!

we stayed at splash camp from 4-24 through 4-28 of 2022. this camp was amazingly beautiful and luxurious camp. gone are the standard tented camps and replaced with hard sided accommodation with screen fronts to wilderness. if you are hesitant on being part of the bush then this camp is designed just for you. while you walk a long distance to your "room" they are expertly designed to fit within the bush and be spaced so that you feel isolated and private. lovely and attentive staff dedicate themselves to the upmost service and treat all guests as special. we loved the food, the attention to detail, and the added bonus of being able to do the bush walks, mokoro dug out canoe, and boat safari from the okavango delta river. our guide godfired was a wealth of knowledge and we really got to know him when we had a private vehicle with him and tracker sb. i highly recommend booking a private vehicle here to get to know your tracker and guide. unforgettable nights and drives. must book now!!! we will be back for sure!!
